trips.title: Japan Signature Group Trip : Tokyo to Osaka (8N/9D) | XMAS and NY Edition

Pick-up at Haneda/Narita Airport.
Transfer to the hotel.
Check in and enjoy the rest of the day at leisure, exploring the city's vibrant atmosphere at your own pace.
Stroll through the lively streets of Shinjuku.
Visit the iconic Hachiko Statue.
Wander through the nostalgic alleys of Omoide Yokocho.
In the evening, experience the unique nightlife of Golden Gai and savour authentic Japanese cuisine at local restaurants.
Overnight stay in Tokyo.

itinerary.title: Tokyo – Where Tradition Meets Tomorrow

After breakfast, start your Tokyo city tour covering:
Imperial Palace (drive-through)
Senso-ji Temple
Asakusa
Tokyo SkyTree Tembo Deck (350 m)
TeamLab Planets Tokyo

itinerary.title: Leisure Day

Full day free at leisure.
Explore Tokyo on your own.

itinerary.title: Mt. Fuji Private Tour + Stay at Kawaguchiko
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out and start your private tour covering:
Mt. Fuji 5th Station or the highest accessible point (weather-dependent).
Lake Kawaguchiko.
Oishi Park.
Chureito Pagoda (400 stairs), offering iconic views of Mt. Fuji.
Check in to the hotel at Kawaguchiko.
Overnight stay in Kawaguchiko.
Transfer: Private tour with pick-up and drop-off from the hotel.

itinerary.title: Hakone Private Tour + Transfer to Kyoto

Lake Ashi Pirate Cruise Ship.
Hakone Togendai Ropeway to see the LIVE Volcanic Vent area.
Gotemba Premium Outlets.

itinerary.title: Kyoto & Nara – Walking Through Japan’s Timeless Heritage

Todaiji Temple.
Arashiyama Bamboo Forest.
Kinkakuji Temple.

Osaka Castle.
Osaka Aquarium.
Shinsaibashi.
Dotonbori Street.

trips.title: Bali Community Signature Trip (7N/8D) | XMAS and NY Edition

itinerary.title: Welcome to Bali | Arrival & Transfer to Ubud
itinerary.description:
Your unforgettable Balinese escape begins as you arrive at Ngurah Rai International Airport, where our representative will warmly welcome you and escort you to your luxurious retreat in Ubud, the cultural heart of Bali. After a seamless check-in and some time to unwind, spend the evening at your leisure, immersing yourself in the island's sophisticated dining and lifestyle experiences (at your own expense). We recommend a visit to Cretya Ubud, celebrated for its breathtaking infinity pools overlooking lush rice terraces, or Taman Dedari, an elegant riverside sanctuary adorned with magnificent angelic sculptures, refined cuisine, and an enchanting ambiance.
As the day draws to a close, return to your hotel and relax in the comfort of your accommodation, enjoying a peaceful overnight stay in Ubud.

itinerary.title: Mount Batur Sunrise & ATV Adventure
itinerary.description:
Start your day in the early hours with a pick-up from your hotel (approximately
2:30 AM) for an extraordinary Mount Batur Jeep Sunrise Tour. Journey to one of Bali's most iconic viewpoints and witness a spectacular sunrise over the island's volcanic landscapes, creating memories to cherish for a lifetime. Following the sunrise experience, continue your adventure with an exhilarating 90-minute ATV ride, navigating through picturesque countryside trails, lush greenery, and rugged terrain for an unforgettable off-road experience. After the excursion, return to your hotel and enjoy some well-deserved time to relax. As evening falls, you may choose to stroll through Ubud's charming local markets at your leisure, discovering handcrafted souvenirs and authentic Balinese treasures at your own expense.
Conclude the day with a comfortable overnight stay in Ubud.

itinerary.title: Ubud to the Gili Islands
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a delightful breakfast before checking out of your hotel and transferring to the port to board your fast boat to the idyllic Gili Islands. Sit back and take in the scenic journey as you make your way to this tropical paradise, renowned for its crystal-clear waters and laid-back island charm. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and spend the remainder of the day at your leisure. For a memorable evening, you may choose to visit PinkCoco Gili, famous for its captivating beachfront fire show accompanied by dinner, or head to Aston Sunset Beach Resort to enjoy a unique movie screening by the beach while watching the sun dip below the horizon (both experiences are at your own expense). Please note that Cidomo (horse cart)
transfers are not included in the package. To explore the island at your own pace, you may hire a bicycle or an electric buggy at an additional cost.
After a relaxing day in paradise, return to your hotel for an overnight stay in Gili.

itinerary.title: Snorkelling Adventure in the Gili Islands
itinerary.description:
Begin your day with a delicious breakfast before setting off on an unforgettable snorkelling excursion in the pristine turquoise waters surrounding the Gili Islands. Dive into a vibrant underwater world as you swim alongside wild sea turtles, explore the iconic underwater statues, and marvel at the colourful coral reefs and diverse marine life that make the Gilis a snorkeller's paradise. The remainder of the day is yours to enjoy at leisure. In the evening, you may choose to experience the lively foam party at Rabbit Jump or capture the island's iconic sunset horse photoshoot along the beach, both available at your own expense. Please note that Cidomo (horse cart)
charges are not included in the package.
Return to your hotel and unwind with a comfortable overnight stay in Gili.

itinerary.title: Gili Islands to Bali – Uluwatu Temple & Kecak Fire Dance
itinerary.description:
Savour a leisurely breakfast before checking out of your hotel and making your way to the port to board your return fast boat to Bali. Upon arrival, continue your journey to the magnificent Uluwatu Temple, one of the island's most revered sea temples, dramatically perched atop towering limestone cliffs overlooking the Indian Ocean. As the sun begins to set, experience the world-renowned
Kecak Fire Dance, a captivating Balinese cultural performance set against the stunning backdrop of the ocean and golden sunset, offering an unforgettable blend of tradition and natural beauty. Please note that Cidomo (horse cart)
charges on the Gili Islands are not included in the package.
After the excursion, proceed to your hotel in Kuta for check-in and enjoy a relaxing overnight stay.

itinerary.title: West Nusa Penida Island Excursion
itinerary.description: Enjoy a delightful breakfast before transferring to the port to board your ferry for an unforgettable excursion to West Nusa Penida, an island renowned for its dramatic coastal landscapes and turquoise waters. Discover some of the island's most celebrated landmarks, including the natural infinity pool of Angel's Billabong, the breathtaking rock arch at Broken Beach, the world-famous cliffs of Kelingking Beach, and the crystal-clear shoreline of Crystal Bay. Along the way, savour a delicious local lunch, offering a taste of authentic Balinese flavours. After a day of exploring the island's spectacular scenery, board your ferry back to Bali in the evening. Upon arrival, return to your hotel in Kuta and unwind with a comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Leisure Day in Kuta – Beaches, Surfing & Shopping
itinerary.description:
Begin your day with a leisurely breakfast before spending the morning at your own pace. In the afternoon, gear up for the iconic Beer Cycle Party, a unique and entertaining experience combining sightseeing, music, and a vibrant social atmosphere. As you pedal through lively streets, enjoy unlimited beverages, including Bintang Beer, Guinness Smooth, Smirnoff Ice, Apple Green & Pink Lemonade, and Sugar-Free Mojito Seltzer, while taking part in fun games and upbeat music that make this one of Bali's most memorable group experiences. As night falls, the island comes alive with its world-famous nightlife. You may choose to continue the celebrations by visiting some of Bali's most sought-after beach clubs and nightlife venues, such as Finns Beach Club, Atlas Beach Club, Motel Mexicola, or Savaya Bali, all at your own expense.
Return to your hotel after an exciting day and enjoy an overnight stay in Kuta.

itinerary.title: Departure from Bali
itinerary.description: Enjoy a leisurely breakfast before checking out of your hotel. Depending on your flight schedule, take advantage of your remaining time to indulge in some last-minute shopping, explore nearby attractions, or simply relax and soak in the final moments of your Balinese escape. Approximately three hours prior to your departure, your private driver will meet you at the hotel and provide a comfortable transfer to Ngurah Rai International Airport for your onward flight. As your unforgettable journey through the Island of Gods comes to an end, we hope you depart with cherished memories and look forward to welcoming you back to Bali for another extraordinary experience.

trips.title: Experiencing Vietnam (7N/8D) | XMAS and NY Edition

itinerary.title: HANOI ARRIVAL
itinerary.description:
Welcome to Vietnam!
Upon arrival at Noi Bai International Airport (Hanoi), you will be greeted by our private driver and transferred to your hotel in the city center. Please note that standard check-in begins at 14:00, while early check-in is subject to availability and additional charges. The rest of the day is free for you to explore Hanoi at your own pace. You may visit attractions such as Hoan Kiem Lake, St. Joseph's Cathedral, Hanoi Train Street, the Old Quarter, or enjoy a traditional Water Puppet Show. If you're visiting on a weekend, don't miss the vibrant Walking Street and Night Market.
Overnight stay in Hanoi.

itinerary.title: HANOI - NINH BINH - HOA LU - TAM COC - HANOI
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, meet your guide and depart for a scenic drive through the countryside to Hoa Lu, Vietnam's ancient 11th-century capital, where you will visit the historic temples of Kings Dinh and Le. After free time for lunch, continue to Tam Coc for a peaceful sampan boat ride along the Ngo Dong River, passing dramatic limestone karsts, rice fields, local villages, and the famous caves of Hang Ca, Hang Hai, and Hang Ba. In the late afternoon, return to Hanoi and transfer to your hotel in the Old Quarter.
Overnight stay in Hanoi.

itinerary.title: HALONG BAY DAY TRIP - SHARING CRUISE
itinerary.description:
After an early morning pickup from your hotel, travel to Tuan Chau Harbor in Halong City via the expressway. Board your cruise and enjoy a delicious Vietnamese lunch while sailing through the breathtaking limestone islets of Halong Bay. Explore the magnificent Sung Sot Cave, experience kayaking or a bamboo boat ride at Luon Cave, and visit Titop Island, where you can relax on the beach or hike to the viewpoint for spectacular bay views. Later, unwind on the sundeck before returning to the harbor and driving back to Hanoi. Arrive at your hotel in the evening.
Overnight stay in Hanoi.

itinerary.title: FLIGHT TO DA NANG
itinerary.description:
Enjoy breakfast at the hotel and spend the morning at leisure. Approximately
2.5 hours before your flight, our driver will pick you up from the hotel and transfer you to the airport for your flight to Da Nang. Upon arrival in Da Nang, you will be met by our driver and transferred to your hotel ( no tour guide included). Check in and enjoy the rest of the day at your leisure.
Overnight in Da Nang.

itinerary.title: BANA HILLS - GOLDEN BRIDGE - FANTASY PARK
itinerary.description:
After breakfast at the hotel, depart at 08:00 for Ba Na Hills, a picturesque mountain resort renowned for its cool climate, French-inspired architecture, and the world-famous Golden Bridge. Enjoy a scenic cable car ride to the summit and visit highlights including the Golden Bridge, Jardin D'Amour flower gardens, Luna Castle, Linh Ung Pagoda, and Vietnam's only hill-climbing funicular railway. Lunch will be at your own expense. In the afternoon, explore Fantasy Park, Vietnam's third-largest indoor amusement center, featuring exciting attractions such as 4D–5D cinemas, Dinosaur Park, skiing simulators, and more (coin-operated and prize games are at your own expense). At 15:00, descend by cable car and transfer back to your hotel in Da Nang, arriving between 17:00 and 17:30.
Overnight in Da Nang.
Note: The Sun World Ba Na Hills ticket does not include the Wax Statue Museum, Debay Wine Cellar, Rain Sheltering Teahouse, Alpine Coaster, Wowpass, 10D movie, beverages, or any coin-operated and prize redemption games.

itinerary.title: DA NANG - BASKET BOAT AT COCONUT FOREST - HOI AN ANCIENT TOWN - DA NANG
itinerary.description:
Enjoy breakfast at the hotel before spending a relaxing morning at leisure. You may choose to unwind at the hotel or explore the nearby area on your own. At 14:00, you will be picked up and transferred to Cam Thanh Water Coconut Forest, where you will enjoy an approximately 30-minute ride in a traditional basket boat through the peaceful waterways. Afterwards, continue to the enchanting Hoi An Ancient Town to visit iconic attractions including the Japanese Covered Bridge, Sa Huynh Cultural Museum, and a traditional Ancient House. Stroll along the colorful Lantern Street and browse the lively Nguyen Hoang Night Market. Dinner will be at your own expense before returning to your hotel in Da Nang at around 20:00.
Overnight in Da Nang.

itinerary.title: FLIGHT TO HO CHI MINH - CU CHI TUNNELS
itinerary.description:
After breakfast at the hotel, our driver will pick you up approximately 3 hours before your flight and transfer you to the airport for your domestic flight to Ho Chi Minh City. Upon arrival at Tan Son Nhat Airport, meet your guide and proceed to the historic Cu Chi Tunnels, located around 70 km northwest of the city. Begin with a short documentary introducing the construction of the tunnels and the remarkable wartime life of Vietnamese soldiers. Explore the underground network featuring living quarters, kitchens, storage rooms, weapon factories, field hospitals, command centers, and hidden trap systems. Enjoy a tasting of traditional cassava and tea, once the staple food of guerrilla fighters, followed by a short break and an optional opportunity to try live shooting at the range (at your own expense). After the tour, return to Ho Chi Minh City.
Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City.

itinerary.title: HO CHI MINH -DEPARTURE- AIRPORT DROP OFF
itinerary.description:
Enjoy breakfast at the hotel and spend the remaining time at leisure until check-out. Approximately
3.5 hours before your departure flight, our driver will pick you up from the hotel and transfer you to the airport for your onward journey. As your Vietnam adventure comes to an end, we sincerely thank you for choosing to travel with us. We hope you return home with unforgettable memories and cherished experiences, and we look forward to welcoming you back to Vietnam on another exciting journey in the future.

trips.title: Experience Sri Lanka (7N/8D) | XMAS and NY Edition

itinerary.title: Arrive at Colombo & Transfer to Mirissa
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Bandaranaike International Airport, Colombo, complete the immigration procedures and meet your driver. Continue with a picturesque coastal journey to Mirissa, a beautiful beach destination in Sri Lanka. Along the way, enjoy views of the Indian Ocean and charming seaside towns. On arrival, check in to your hotel and take some time to relax. In the evening, head to Mirissa Beach to admire the sunset or enjoy a delightful dinner at one of the beachfront cafés before returning to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Bentota & Galle Exploration
itinerary.description:
Start your day with breakfast at the hotel before driving to Bentota, famous for its scenic coastline. Enjoy optional activities such as water sports, a visit to the Turtle Hatchery. Later, continue to the historic city of Galle and explore the UNESCO-listed
Galle Fort, along with its lighthouse, Dutch Reformed Church, Clock Tower, and Flag Rock Bastion. If time permits, relax at Jungle Beach or Unawatuna Beach before returning to Mirissa for a restful evening.

itinerary.title: Mirissa to Ella
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and journey to Ella, passing through Sri Lanka's picturesque hill country. Admire breathtaking views of tea plantations, cascading waterfalls, lush greenery, and rolling mountains along the way. On arrival, check in to your hotel and unwind. Later, take a stroll through Ella Town, where you can explore its lively cafés and charming atmosphere before returning to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Explore Ella
itinerary.description: After breakfast, visit the iconic Nine Arch Bridge before hiking to Little Adam's Peak for stunning panoramic views of the surrounding hills. If time allows, continue to Ravana Falls and Ravana Cave, two of Ella's popular natural attractions. In the evening, enjoy a leisurely walk through Ella Town, exploring its cozy cafés, local markets, and vibrant atmosphere before returning to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Ella to Kandy (Scenic Train Journey)
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and board the scenic train from Ella to Nanu Oya (subject to availability), renowned as one of the world's most beautiful rail journeys. Admire spectacular views of tea plantations, misty mountains, waterfalls, and charming villages along the way. Upon arrival, meet your driver and continue to Kandy, stopping en route to visit a Tea Plantation & Tea Factory. If time permits, enjoy a visit to Gregory Lake in Nuwara Eliya before reaching Kandy. Check in to your hotel and relax for the evening.

itinerary.title: Day Excursion to Sigiriya
itinerary.description: After breakfast, drive to Sigiriya and visit the magnificent Sigiriya Rock Fortress, a UNESCO World Heritage Site renowned for its ancient palace ruins, beautiful frescoes, landscaped gardens, and the impressive Lion's Gate. If time permits, continue to the historic Dambulla Cave Temple, famous for its ancient Buddhist murals and statues, before returning to Kandy for a relaxing evening.

itinerary.title: Kandy to Colombo
itinerary.description: After breakfast, visit the revered Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic and enjoy a stroll around the scenic Kandy Lake. Later, drive to Colombo for a city tour featuring Galle Face Green, Gangaramaya Temple, and the historic Colombo Fort area. In the evening, you may opt to experience Colombo's vibrant casino scene and try your luck at one of the city's renowned casinos. Afterwards, check in to your hotel and relax, enjoying your final evening in Sri Lanka.

itinerary.title: Departure from Colombo
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and enjoy some free time at your leisure, depending on your flight schedule. At the designated time, you will be transferred to Bandaranaike International Airport for your onward journey. Depart with wonderful memories of your unforgettable Sri Lankan holiday.

trips.title: Bhutan Signature Road Trip with Punakha valley (6N/7D) | XMAS and NY Edition

itinerary.title: Arrival in Phuentsholing
itinerary.description:
Upon arrival at Bagdogra Airport, embark on a scenic drive to Phuentsholing, the charming gateway to the Kingdom of Bhutan. Upon reaching the border town, complete the immigration formalities before checking in to your hotel. Nestled along the Indo-Bhutan border opposite the Indian town of Jaigaon, Phuentsholing is Bhutan's principal commercial hub and the country's busiest entry point. The town offers a unique blend of Bhutanese tradition and modern commerce, making it an ideal introduction to the Land of the Thunder Dragon. Spend the rest of the day at leisure, relaxing and unwinding after your journey.
Overnight stay in Phuentsholing.
Altitude: Approximately
300 m.

itinerary.title: Phuentsholing to Thimphu
itinerary.description:
After a delightful breakfast, set out on a picturesque drive to Thimphu, the enchanting capital of Bhutan. As you leave the bustling border town of Phuentsholing behind, the landscape transforms into a breathtaking panorama of lush forests, cascading waterfalls, charming villages, rolling hills, and majestic Himalayan vistas, offering a perfect introduction to Bhutan's pristine natural beauty. The journey winds through verdant broadleaf forests before gradually ascending into the cool temperate alpine region, making every mile as memorable as the destination itself.
En route, visit: Chuzom
– the scenic confluence of the Thimphu and Paro Rivers, where the highway branches towards Thimphu, Paro, and Phuentsholing. Admire the beautifully displayed portraits of the King and Queen of Bhutan, symbolically welcoming visitors to the kingdom.
Enjoy short stops along the way for tea or coffee, refreshments, photography, and to take in the spectacular mountain scenery.
Upon arrival in Thimphu, and if time permits, enjoy a leisurely walk through the city. Explore its vibrant streets, browse traditional handicraft shops, discover local markets, and experience the unique charm of the world's only capital city without traffic lights.
Return to your hotel for a relaxing overnight stay in Thimphu.
Altitude: Approximately
2,400 m.

itinerary.title: Punakha Excursion via Dochula Pass
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, embark on a scenic day excursion to Punakha, travelling through the breathtaking Dochula Pass, one of Bhutan's most picturesque mountain passes. Situated at a high altitude, Dochula is renowned for its sweeping Himalayan panoramas and the iconic 108 Druk Wangyal Chortens, which create a truly mesmerizing sight, particularly on clear winter days when the snow-capped peaks are visible in all their glory. Continue your journey to the historic valley of Punakha, where you'll visit some of Bhutan's most celebrated landmarks.
Punakha Dzong
Discover the grandeur of Punakha Dzong, an architectural masterpiece built in 1637 by Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal. Gracefully positioned at the confluence of the Pho Chhu and Mo Chhu rivers, the fortress-monastery is one of Bhutan's most iconic monuments. Once the country's winter capital, it continues to serve as the winter residence of the Je Khenpo, Bhutan's Chief Abbot, and holds immense historical and spiritual significance.
Punakha Suspension Bridge
Visit one of the longest suspension bridges in Bhutan, stretching gracefully across the Pho Chhu River. Enjoy a leisurely walk while taking in spectacular views of the river valley, surrounding countryside, and traditional villages.
Optional Activity: Enhance your adventure with an exhilarating White River Rafting experience on the Pho Chhu River (available at an additional cost).
After an enriching day of sightseeing, return to Thimphu and relax with an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Thimphu Sightseeing and Transfer to Paro
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, explore Thimphu, Bhutan's cultural, religious, and administrative capital, where modern development blends seamlessly with traditional Bhutanese heritage.
Highlights of the day include:
Buddha Dordenma Statue
Visit the iconic Buddha Dordenma, overlooking the Thimphu Valley from Kuensel Phodrang Nature Park, and enjoy panoramic views of the city and surrounding mountains.
Simply Bhutan Museum
Experience Bhutan's rich traditions through interactive exhibits featuring traditional attire, archery, folk culture, and local customs.
Later, drive to Paro, stopping en route at:
Tachogang Lhakhang
– A historic temple beside the Paro River, accessible via a traditional iron bridge (subject to time).
Paro Airport Viewpoint
– Admire breathtaking views of Bhutan's only international airport, nestled amidst the Himalayan mountains.
Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and enjoy an overnight stay in Paro.
Altitude: Approximately
2,200 m.

itinerary.title: Paro Sightseeing or Taktsang Hike
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, set out to explore the scenic Paro Valley, home to some of Bhutan's most treasured cultural and historical landmarks.
Taktsang Monastery (Tiger's Nest)
Embark on a memorable hike to Bhutan's most iconic monastery, dramatically perched on a cliff nearly 900 metres above the valley. The trail rewards you with breathtaking views and an unforgettable spiritual experience.
Ta Dzong (National Museum)
Visit the former 17th-century watchtower, now Bhutan's
National Museum, showcasing an impressive collection of historical artefacts, traditional art, and cultural heritage.
Paro Dzong (Rinpung Dzong)
Explore the magnificent "Fortress on a Heap of Jewels," one of Bhutan's finest examples of traditional architecture, overlooking the picturesque Paro Valley.
Optional Activity: Relax with a traditional Hot Stone Bath (available at an additional cost).
Return to your hotel for an overnight stay in Paro.

itinerary.title: Paro to Siliguri via Phuentsholing
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out from your hotel and begin your scenic drive from Paro towards Siliguri, passing through Bhutan's picturesque valleys and mountain landscapes. Upon reaching Phuentsholing, complete the Bhutan immigration exit formalities before crossing the border into India. Continue your journey to Siliguri, arriving by evening. Check in to your hotel and unwind after the day's drive.
Overnight stay in Siliguri.

itinerary.title: Departure from Bagdogra
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a leisurely breakfast before checking out of your hotel. Proceed to Bagdogra Airport (IXB)
as per your flight schedule (airport transfer on your own unless booked separately). As your unforgettable journey through the Land of the Thunder Dragon comes to an end, depart with cherished memories of majestic monasteries, breathtaking Himalayan landscapes, and the warm hospitality of Bhutan.
Tour concludes with unforgettable memories.
✨

trips.title: Udupi & Agumbe Signature Trip (2N & 3D)| XMAS and NY Edition

itinerary.title: Travel Day
itinerary.description: We start with our overnight journey from Bengaluru around 8:30 PM. While onboard, our trip captain would have a fun ice-breaking session planned for you to get you out of the office blues and get to know each other.

itinerary.title: Udupi – Malpe Beach – St. Mary's Island
itinerary.description:
Arrive in Udupi and freshen up & have breakfast.
Visit Malpe Beach and enjoy the beach atmosphere.
Enjoy optional water activities such as kayaking and other available beach activities. (Self Sponsored)
Take a boat ride to St. Mary's Island, subject to ferry operations and weather conditions. (Self Sponsored)
Visit Kapu Beach and explore the iconic lighthouse.
Enjoy the sunset and head to the accommodation.
Overnight stay in Udupi.

itinerary.title: Udupi to Agumbe – MIGHTY HILLS, SPLASHY WATERFALLS
itinerary.description:
Wake up and have breakfast.
Early Morning Krishna Temple Visit (if time Permits)
Proceed towards Agumbe. Enjoy a scenic drive through the beautiful Western Ghats.
Visit Kundadri Hills, known for its panoramic views and ancient Jain temple.
Explore the beautiful surroundings and enjoy the lush greenery.
Visit Sirimane Waterfalls, an ideal spot to relax and connect with nature.
Overnight stay overnight at your property near Sringeri..

itinerary.title: Exploration & Return Journey
itinerary.description:
Wake up to nature and enjoy breakfast & checkout from the property.
Visit Varanga Lake Jain Temple, a unique temple floating on still waters.
Explore Sringeri Sharada Peetham, an ancient Adi Shankara mutt by the Tunga River.
Take a reflective walk across the temple bridge or listen to devotional chants.
Begin the return journey to Bangalore at night, ending the weekend filled with memories of your Udupi & Agumbe travel experience.

trips.title: Ooty - Coonoor & Kotagiri Signature Trip (2N & 3D)| XMAS and NY Edition

itinerary.title: Bangalore to Kotagiri – Overnight Journey
itinerary.description:
Your Ooty weekend trip from Bangalore begins with a late evening departure around 9:30 PM.
This Ooty tour package from Bangalore takes you through a scenic overnight drive covering approximately 270 km into the Nilgiris.
We opt for this route in a Ooty Coonoor Kotagiri itinerary of 3 days, so that you can reach early and enhance your experience. The journey sets the tone for a peaceful Ooty budget trip itinerary from Bangalore, away from the usual crowded hill stations.

itinerary.title: Kotagiri – Offbeat Exploration and Scenic Views
itinerary.description:
Arrive in Kotagiri, which is known for its calm environment and fewer tourist.
This destination is often preferred for an offbeat experience, making it ideal for slow travel.
After check-in,(early check in is subject to availability) take time to relax and enjoy the surroundings. This slower pace is a key highlight of an Ooty Coonoor Kotagiri itinerary for 3 days, especially for travellers looking to unwind.
Visit Catherine Falls, a scenic double-cascade waterfall surrounded by greenery, often included in Kotagiri's hidden places and viewpoints.
Head to Kodanad View Point, offering expansive valley views, tea estates, and distant plains, which is an essential stop in any Ooty travel itinerary with lakes and viewpoints.
Spend time exploring nearby tea estates and quiet trails, reinforcing the charm of a Kotagiri offbeat stay experience.
Return to your stay by evening, followed by dinner and an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Coonoor to Ooty – Views, Train Ride, and Town Exploration
itinerary.description:
Start your day with breakfast before heading to Coonoor, a key destination in most Ooty Coonoor Kotagiri itinerary 3-day plans.
Visit Dolphin’s Nose, one of the most popular Coonoor sightseeing places, known for its dramatic cliffside views.
Experience the Nilgiri Mountain Railway toy train ride in Ooty, a UNESCO-recognised journey connecting Coonoor to Ooty. This ride is a highlight of any Ooty tour package from Bangalore.
(Toy Train Tickets are subject to availability)
Upon arrival in Ooty, visit Ooty Lake for boating or leisure activities. This spot is commonly featured in an Ooty travel itinerary with lakes and viewpoints.

itinerary.title: Ooty Highlights and Return to Bangalore
itinerary.description:
Begin your day with breakfast and check out. Start exploring key attractions included in a well-rounded Ooty travel itinerary with lakes and viewpoints.
Visit local tea and chocolate factories to experience regional flavours, an important part of most Ooty tour packages from Bangalore.
Head to Pykara Lake, known for its scenic surroundings and calm waters, making it a must-visit location in an Ooty budget trip itinerary from Bangalore.
Stop at Shooting Point and Pine Forest, both popular for photography and often included in Kotagiri's hidden places and viewpoints extensions.
Begin your return journey to Bangalore, concluding your Ooty weekend trip from Bangalore with a mix of relaxation, scenic landscapes, and curated experiences and reach at late midnight back to Bangalore.

itinerary.title: Bangalore to Thekkady – Overnight Journey
itinerary.description:
Your Kerala weekend trip from Bangalore begins with an overnight departure around 8:30–9:00 PM.
This Thekkady tour package from Bangalore takes you through scenic highways into Kerala, covering over 500 km. Our itinerary balances travel and exploration, ensuring you experience both destinations without feeling rushed.

itinerary.title: Thekkady – Wildlife and Cultural Experiences
itinerary.description:
Arrive in Thekkady and check into your hotel. After some rest, begin exploring the region, known for its rich biodiversity and proximity to Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary travel guide locations.
Visit Elephant Junction, an experience often included in a Thekkady wildlife and spice plantation tour, where you can interact closely with elephants.
Continue to Green Park Spice Plantation for a guided walk through spice gardens, a core highlight of the Thekkady wildlife and spice plantation tour experience.
In the evening, attend traditional cultural performances including Kathakali and Kalaripayattu, adding depth to your Kerala weekend trip from Bangalore.
Return to the hotel for dinner and overnight stay, completing the first day of your Thekkady Vagamon itinerary 3 days.

itinerary.title: Thekkady to Vagamon – Jeep Adventure Experience
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out and proceed towards the Vagamon hill station trip, a peaceful destination known for its rolling hills and quiet landscapes.
Arrive and check into your stay. The calm environment is a defining feature of any Vagamon hill station trip, making it ideal for relaxation.
Post lunch, begin your Vagamon jeep safari adventure experience, which takes you through offbeat forest trails and scenic viewpoints.
Key locations covered during the jeep ride include waterfalls, tunnel routes, the Idukki Dam catchment area, Kaidapara Viewpoint, and Uluppuni Viewpoint. These stops are essential highlights of the Vagamon jeep safari adventure experience.
Return to your hotel by evening. Dinner and overnight stay conclude another day of your Thekkady Vagamon itinerary 3 days.

itinerary.title: Vagamon Exploration and Return to Bangalore
itinerary.description:
Start your day with breakfast and check out. We will continue exploring Vagamon. Visit Vagamon Meadows, known for its open landscapes and tranquil setting, often included in a Kerala budget trip itinerary from Bangalore.
Head to Vagamon Adventure Park, a key attraction featuring activities such as ziplining and sky cycling, making it a highlight of Vagamon adventure park activities in Kerala.
Explore the Pine Forest for a scenic walk and photography, followed by a visit to Thangalpara for panoramic valley views. These experiences further enhance your Vagamon hill station trip.
Begin your return journey to Bangalore, concluding your Kerala weekend trip from Bangalore.

itinerary.description:
We start with our overnight journey from Bengaluru around 8:00 PM.
While onboard, our trip captain would have a fun ice-breaking session planned for you to get you out of the office blues and get to know each other.

itinerary.title: Explore the Colonial Charms of Fort Kochi & Alleppey Backwaters
itinerary.description: Arrive in the charming coastal town of Kochi early in the morning. Have breakfast (Self Sponsored) Later, we drive towards the serene backwater town of Alappuzha (Alleppey). Check in to our stay around the standard check-in time and relax for a bit In the evening Experience a magical Shikhara ride through the Alleppey backwaters Go kayaking during sunset, gliding through palm-lined canals Visit a nearby beach along the Arabian Sea to unwind Wrap up the evening with dinner and return to the stay for a relaxed night.

itinerary.title: Varkala Cliff Vibes & Black Sand Beach
itinerary.description:
Start the day early and depart from Alappuzha after breakfast.
We head towards Varkala, a scenic 3–4 hour drive along Kerala’s beautiful coastline.
On the way, experience a unique Kerala tradition with a Toddy tasting session (subject to availability).
Upon arrival in Varkala, Check in to our property and freshen up.
Then head out to explore:
Walk along the lively Varkala Cliff, lined with cafés, music, and stunning ocean views Enjoy café hopping and shopping around North Cliff
If time permits, we’ll head towards South Cliff for a sunset swim and relaxed beach time.
Spend the evening soaking in the laid-back Varkala beach vibe.

itinerary.title: Jatayu Earth Centre & Return Journey
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out early and begin our return journey.
On the way, we visit the majestic Jatayu Earth’s Center, home to the world’s largest bird sculpture, inspired by the legendary Ramayana story of Jatayu.
Explore the viewpoint Learn about the mythology and history of the site Capture stunning photos of the massive sculpture and surrounding landscapes Later, we begin our journey back towards Bengaluru, carrying home unforgettable memories of Kerala’s backwaters, cliffs, beaches, and culture.

trips.title: South India Signature RoadTrip (Coorg - Wayanad & Ooty) 5N & 6D | XMAS and NY Edition

itinerary.title: Bangalore → Coorg | Journey into the Hills
itinerary.description:
Your journey begins early in the morning from Bangalore as you drive towards the beautiful hills of Coorg.
En route, visit the famous Namdroling Monastery (Golden Temple) at Bylakuppe, one of the largest Tibetan monasteries in India.
Continue to Harangi Elephant Camp, where you can observe elephants in a natural environment.
Upon arrival in Coorg, check in to your hotel and relax after the day's journey.
Overnight Stay: Coorg

itinerary.title: Explore Coorg
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, head towards the stunning Mandalpatti Peak, offering breathtaking panoramic views of the Western Ghats (Jeep ride at additional cost).
Later, visit the picturesque Abbey Falls, nestled amidst coffee plantations.
Spend the evening at the iconic Raja's Seat, a popular viewpoint known for its spectacular sunset.
Return to the hotel for the night.
Overnight Stay: Coorg

itinerary.title: Explore Wayanad | Waterfalls, Adventure & 900 Kandi
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, set out to explore the natural beauty and adventure-filled landscapes of Wayanad.
Begin your day with a visit to the stunning Soochipara Waterfalls, nestled amidst lush forests and tea plantations.
Later, experience the thrill of Zipline (at an additional cost), offering breathtaking views of the surrounding valleys.
Continue to the picturesque 900 Kandi
Jeep Ride (Self Sponsored), one of Wayanad's most scenic destinations, known for its hanging bridge, panoramic viewpoints, and tranquil landscapes.
After a memorable day of sightseeing and adventure, return to your hotel and relax.
Overnight Stay: Wayanad

itinerary.title: Wayanad → Banasura → Ooty | Lakes, Adventure & Scenic Drive
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel and visit the magnificent Banasura Sagar Dam, the largest earthen dam in India.
Surrounded by lush hills, the dam offers breathtaking views and optional adventure activities such as speed boating and ziplining (at additional cost). Later, continue your scenic drive towards Ooty through the beautiful Nilgiri landscapes.
Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and spend the rest of the evening at leisure.
Overnight Stay: Ooty

itinerary.title: Ooty Sightseeing

Toy Train (subject to ticket availability).

Tea Park

En route, visit: Pykara Waterfalls
Pykara Lake
Pine Forest
9th Mile Shooting Point
Drive through the scenic Bandipur National Park before reaching Bangalore by night.
Tour Ends with Wonderful Memories!

itinerary.title: Travel Day
itinerary.description:
We start our journey overnight from Bangalore at 9:30 P.M
Enjoy a road trip of 8 hours with blazing music and cool breeze.

itinerary.title: Take a dip in fresh mountain water & Visit the longest zipline and 900 Kandi.
itinerary.description: • Reach property located in the middle of Wayanad, freshen up • Fuel up with authentic Kerala Breakfast • Head towards 900-Kandi which is in deep forest, hike up on a mix of mud and cement road in the jungle, walk along with tea/coffee estates. Visit the glass bridge that protrudes into the valley. • Lunch at a local restaurant (Kerala meals) • Head towards the Longest zipline which is along a tea plantation walk. • Head back to the property in the evening, refresh with evening Tea • Bonfire with music between 9 to 10 PM. After this, we have to respect nature in Wayanad and enjoy our social gatherings by sharing stories and playing games • Hot dinner with veg/chicken curry and ghee rice. Rest for the night in your assigned tents.

itinerary.title: Drive to Irrupu waterfalls, & Explore Raja seat
itinerary.description: Wake up early morning, have breakfast, pack your bags to experince an amazing day ahead. Start your journey towards Coorg and visit Irrupu waterfalls which is in deep forest, hike up on a mix of mud and cement road in the jungle, walk along with tea/coffee estates. Have Lunch at a local restaurant. Note that food options are limited in this place. Travelers are advised to have whatever local food is available at that time. Enjoy the most famous sunset of Coorg at the Raja’s seat, a tourist attraction that offers panoramic views of the valley. Madikeri town is famous for spices, coffee, tea, and honey. Take half an hour to shop Return to the stay, refresh and enjoy a campfire night. Fun, food, and music with long and deep conversations followed by a peaceful slumber.

itinerary.title: Coffee estate walk- Visit Mandalpatti and backwaters & Soak in the peaceful views of Golden Temple
itinerary.description:
Wake up to a relaxing morning in the lap of nature. Indulge in some fun activities at the homestay.
Drive to the base of Mandalpatti and Go on a bumpy Jeep ride to one of the most prettiest places in Coorg – Mandalpatti. It takes about an hour journey by 4×4 Jeep. Witness amazing views from one of the highest points of Karnataka and soak in the sun Make a visit to the Namdroling Monastery, one of the Largest centers of Buddhism dedicated to the Vajrayana Tibetan Buddhism.
After lunch, head back to Bangalore with some amazing trip memories Return journey to Bangalore. We will reach Bangalore by 10:30 PM. (Approx)

itinerary.title: Arrival in Jaipur | Pink City Sightseeing & Cultural Exploration
itinerary.description:
Upon arrival in Jaipur, our team will welcome you and arrange your transfer to the hotel. After check-in, meet your Trip Captain for a detailed briefing about the upcoming adventure.
Begin exploring the Pink City with visits to the iconic City Palace, Hawa Mahal, and Jantar Mantar. Continue to Albert Hall Museum and explore the vibrant local markets of Bapu Bazaar and Johari Bazaar.
In the evening, immerse yourself in Jaipur's local culinary scene and enjoy authentic Rajasthani flavours. Return to the hotel for an overnight stay in Jaipur.
Overnight Stay: Jaipur

itinerary.title: Jaipur Fort Trail | Royal Heritage & Panoramic Sunset Views
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, embark on a full-day sightseeing adventure through Jaipur's royal heritage.
Visit the magnificent Amer Fort, renowned for its grand architecture and its association with the Bollywood film Jodhaa Akbar. Continue to Jaigarh Fort, home to the famous Jaivana Cannon, one of the world's largest wheeled cannons.
Later, explore the stunning Sheesh Mahal at Nahargarh Fort and witness a breathtaking sunset overlooking the Pink City, with panoramic 360-degree views of Jaipur.
Proceed to Jal Mahal for a scenic photo stop and visit the beautiful Birla Temple. If time permits, conclude the day with an optional visit to Chokhi Dhani, a traditional Rajasthani village-themed experience featuring folk performances, local cuisine, and cultural activities.
Return to the hotel for an overnight stay in Jaipur.
Overnight Stay: Jaipur

itinerary.title: Jaipur to Jodhpur | Blue City Exploration & Heritage Walk
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel and begin your journey towards Jodhpur, the enchanting Blue City of Rajasthan.
On arrival, explore the magnificent Mehrangarh Fort, one of India's most impressive hilltop forts, with spectacular views of the blue-painted houses below.
Continue to Jaswant Thada, a beautiful marble cenotaph often called the Taj Mahal of Marwar. Later, visit the grand Umaid Bhawan Palace and admire its royal architecture.
As the day winds down, enjoy a leisurely heritage walk through Jodhpur's blue streets, capturing memorable moments with your fellow travellers.
Return to the hotel for an overnight stay in Jodhpur.
Overnight Stay: Jodhpur

itinerary.title: Jodhpur to Jaisalmer | Golden City Heritage & Desert Adventure
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out and begin your road journey towards Jaisalmer, the Golden City of Rajasthan.
Upon arrival, explore the magnificent Jaisalmer Fort, a living fort renowned for its golden sandstone architecture. Discover the intricate carvings of the city's iconic havelis before heading towards the spectacular Sam Sand Dunes.
Experience the magic of the Thar Desert with an exciting camel safari across the golden dunes, followed by an adventurous dune-bashing experience.
As the sun sets, immerse yourself in an unforgettable desert evening featuring a traditional bonfire, Rajasthani folk music and dance performances, and a lively DJ night with your fellow travellers.
Enjoy dinner under the desert sky and experience an exciting night at the desert camp.
Overnight Stay: Desert Camp, Jaisalmer

itinerary.title: Jaisalmer to Jodhpur | War Museum Visit & Departure
itinerary.description:
Wake up to the desert's peaceful atmosphere and enjoy breakfast at the camp.
After breakfast, check out and begin your return journey towards Jodhpur. En route, visit the serene Gadisar Lake, a beautiful historic water reservoir surrounded by temples and ghats.
Continue to the Jaisalmer War Museum, where you can explore India's military history and learn about the bravery of Indian soldiers, particularly in the western desert region.
After the visit, proceed to Jodhpur, arriving around 4:00 PM.
Your Rajasthan Social Escape concludes with unforgettable memories, new friendships, royal heritage, and thrilling desert adventures.

itinerary.title: KOALSAY LAKE AND CHARYN CANYON - OVERNIGHT STAY IN SATY VILLAGE
itinerary.description:
Breakfast at the hotel.
Get ready to take an amazing road journey.
Depart from Almaty for a day trip to Kolsay Lake, a stunning mountain lake renowned for its beauty.
Explore Charyn Canyon, often referred to as the Grand Canyon’s little brother, known for its dramatic rock formations.
On the way, we will take a stop to explore the biggest canyon in Asia - the Charyn Canyon.
Upon reaching, hike inside the canyon to marvel at the various natural rock formations.
Next, we will head to our hotel in Saty Villag
Overnight stay in Saty Village, immersing yourself in the local culture and hospitality.

itinerary.title: KAINDY LAKE - OVERNIGHT STAY IN ALMATY
itinerary.description:
Breakfast at the hotel.
Visit Kandy Lake, famous for its submerged forest and turquoise waters, offering a unique landscape for exploration.
On the way, we will visit the majestic Kaindy Lake, perfectly tucked in mountains.
Upon reaching the base, we will take a Local Van for 2 kms through rough mountain roads.
After this short adventurous ride, we will reach the Kaindy Lakes - one of the most beautiful lakes here.
Spend some time around the lake which appears blue in summer and freezes completely in winter.
Next, we will head back to the base and continue our journey further to Almaty.
Upon reaching Almaty, check-in to the hotel and call it a day.
Overnight stay in Almaty.

itinerary.title: SHYMBULAK SKI RESORT WITH CABLE CAR | OVERNIGHT STAY IN ALMATY
itinerary.description:
Breakfast at the hotel.
Get ready to spend an amazing day Depart for Shymbulak Ski Resort (30 km from Almaty and the journey takes 1 hour)
Upon Arrival at Shymbulak Ski Resort ,Take a cable car to Shymbulak Ski Resort.
Enjoy cable car rides and capture the majestic views of the surrounding mountains Explore Shymbulak and return to Almaty.
After reaching top you can explore winter activities (by own)
Upon completing the sightseeing tour for the day, return to your hotel.
In the evening, You can plan for casino as tomorrow will be half free day. Casino’s are open till 5 AM. Its an 1 hour drive from your hotel.
Overnight stay in Almaty.
In the evening, You can plan for casino as tomorrow will be half free day. Casino’s are open till 5 AM. Its an 1 hour drive from your hotel.

itinerary.title: TOUCH DOWN IN PARADISE: CHECK-IN & CHILL IN UBUD
itinerary.description:
Land in Bali and meet your tour coordinator at the airport.
Transfer to your hotel in Ubud, Bali’s cultural and spiritual hub surrounded by lush rice terraces and jungle landscapes.
After check-in, relax and refresh from your journey.
Spend your evening soaking in Ubud’s serene atmosphere – stroll through art-filled streets, explore cozy cafés, or simply unwind amidst the greenery.
Note: Pickups will be arranged at a common scheduled time.

itinerary.title: ADVENTURE MODE ON – ATV RIDE + COFFEE ESTATE + BALI SWING
itinerary.description:
Start your day with an exhilarating ATV ride through Bali’s rugged trails, forests, and rice fields.
Visit Alas Harum Plantation – learn about Luwak coffee, walk through scenic terraces, and take in stunning views.
Get your adrenaline fix (and best photos) with the famous Bali Swing that flies high over the jungle.
Highlights: Raw adventure, local flavors, and sky-high selfies.

itinerary.title: OFF TO THE ISLANDS – TRANSFER TO GILI FOR PURE PARADISE
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, it’s time to island-hop!
Check out from Kuta and cruise your way to the Gili Islands – car-free, carefree, and drop-dead gorgeous.
Arrive and check in to your beachside stay.
Spend the rest of the day at leisure – chase sunsets, sip fresh coconut, or explore the island by foot or cycle.
Note: Local transfers in Gili (by cidomos or bicycles) are to be managed on your own.
Note : Guests are required to pay a harbour fee of idr 20,000 per person directly at the harbour.

itinerary.title: DIVE IN – SNORKELING AND ISLAND LEISURE IN GILI
itinerary.description:
Today’s all about living the island dream.
Embark on a 3-point snorkeling tour across Gili’s best underwater spots – crystal-clear waters, coral reefs, and sea turtles await.
The rest of the day is yours – chill on a hammock, beach-hop, or join the fun at beach bars as the island lights up at night.
Highlights: Epic marine life, slow island vibes, and night fun.

itinerary.title: TRANSFER TO KUTA + CLIFFSIDE SUNSET WITH KECAK FIRE DANCE
itinerary.description:
Say goodbye to Gili and journey into Bali’s buzzing beach town.
After check-in, unwind, and In the afternoon, visit the stunning Uluwatu Temple sitting dramatically on a cliff.
Watch a fiery Kecak Dance performance against a golden sunset backdrop – a true Balinese spectacle.
Return to Kuta and soak in the island nightlife or relax.
Highlights: A dramatic cultural sunset performance.
Note : Guests are required to pay a harbour fee of idr 20,000 per person directly at the harbour.

itinerary.title: INSTAGRAM-WORTHY DAY OUT – FULL-DAY NUSA PENIDA TOUR
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, get ready for a ferry ride to Nusa Penida, Bali’s untouched island gem.
Snap photos at Kelingking Beach, dip your toes in Angel’s Billabong, and take in the natural beauty of Broken Beach and Crystal Bay.
Savor a local lunch.
Head back to Kuta in the evening. Vibe Check: Offbeat island vibes, perfect photo ops, and underwater magic.
Highlights: Stunning Island landscapes and picture-perfect spots.

itinerary.title: NEW YEAR’S EVE CELEBRATION
itinerary.description:
Kickstart your day with a delicious, power-packed breakfast at the hotel.
Spend a relaxed morning at leisure to rest, recharge, and gear up for an exciting New Year's Eve celebration.
In the evening, immerse yourself in Bali's electrifying New
Year's Eve festivities, filled with music, dazzling lights, and unforgettable celebrations as you welcome the New Year in style.

itinerary.title: SAY GOODBYE (FOR NOW) – DEPARTURE DAY
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out from your Kuta hotel.
Transfer to the airport for your onward flight.
Head home with a full heart, sun-kissed skin, and unforgettable memories.

itinerary.title: Phi Phi Day Trip With Indian Lunch | Maya Bay | Overnight Stay At Phuket
itinerary.description:
After having breakfast, get ready your self, It's just day two- but we aren't slowing down.
Our theme for today is Sunning, Swimming, and Snorkelling as we hop on to our boats to visit the most postcard worthy place of all - The Phi Phi Islands.
Up in our itinerary is the stunning Phi Leh Lagoon, surrounded by limestone cliffs & Maya Bay made famous from the movie 'The Beach’. Completing the trip Snorkelling among native fish and coral gardens. In place of Maya bay we will explore Khaiisland, Viking caves, Monkey beach, Lohri Samay Bay (view only).
During the tour you will get Lunch. Enjoy your lunch at beachside.
Arrive Hotel by 6-7 PM, After so much soaked in Island time we will hit the night clubs of the city to enjoy the cities most prominent party culture.
Overnight stay at Phuket hotel.

itinerary.title: Phuket To Koh Samui | Exploring The Island | Full Moon Party
itinerary.description:
After having breakfast check-out from the hotel you will be transfer to Koh Samui by Land + ferry transfer on SIC basis.
Taking our ferry to the island that's naturally pleasant, exciting, and wild at the same time. We check into our rooms, change into beachwear, lay your feet up, and soak into the beauty that is before us.
Today we transfer ourselves to the party island also known as Koh Phangan by Speedboat. It is the day you will attend what you probably came in for - The Full Moon Party. With Alcohol Buckets in our hands and Neon Paints on our skin we will let loose to the music, dancing till the wee hours.
Overnight fullmoon party at Koh Phangan on Haad Rin Beach.

itinerary.title: A Leisure Day In Koh Samui | Overnight Stay At Koh Samui

Enjoy beach surroundings follow up with zestful environment.
Overnight stay at Koh Samui Hotel.

You can also shop from the vast options of stalls selling locally-made crafts and clothing. The markets are also a culinary treat, serving some of the best flavors Thailand has to offer.
Overnight stay at Krabi Hotel.

Visit the islands of Koh Poda, Chicken Island, Tup Island and Phranang Cave Beach. Take some time to swim and snorkel in beautiful and relaxing places.
Overnight stay at Krabi hotel.

itinerary.description:
Give one last look at the island . It might be our last day but remember your taking back crazy memories, a few ticks from your bucket list, and strong bond friendships.
We know by now Thailand has your hearts.
You will take your rides from Krabi to Phuket to catch your flights.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Port Blair → Chidyatapu Sunset Experience
itinerary.description:
Experiences at a Glance
Port Blair Arrival • Chidyatapu Beach • Sunset Experience • Café Hopping
Your Day Looks Like
Welcome to the paradisiacal Andaman Islands
! Upon arrival at Port Blair Airport, our representative will welcome you and assist with your transfer to the hotel.
Check in to your hotel, freshen up and take some time to relax before beginning your island adventure.
In the late afternoon, head out to Chidyatapu Beach, one of Port Blair’s most scenic spots, known for its lush surroundings and beautiful coastal views.
As the evening sets in, enjoy a beautiful sunset experience at Chidyatapu, followed by some free time to stroll around, explore local cafés or simply unwind by the coast.
Return to the hotel, enjoy the delicious dinner and relax after your first day in the Andamans.
Overnight stay in Port Blair.
Wravelers' Tip
Keep your evening light and relaxed; you’ll have plenty of island adventures waiting for you over the next few days.
Note: Standard check-in time is 1:00 PM. One airport pickup will be provided at 12:00 PM.

itinerary.title: Port Blair → Havelock Island → Radhanagar Beach
itinerary.description:
Experiences at a Glance
Ferry Ride • Havelock Island • Radhanagar Beach • Sunset • Café Hopping • Nightlife
Your Day Looks Like
After breakfast, board a scenic ferry to Havelock Island (Swaraj Dweep)
. Keep your camera ready as the journey offers beautiful views of turquoise waters and scattered tropical islands.
Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and take some time to relax before heading out to explore the island.
In the afternoon, make your way to the world-famous
Radhanagar Beach, known for its pristine white sands, turquoise waters and breathtaking coastal scenery.
Spend some time by the beach, soak in the tropical surroundings and enjoy a mesmerizing sunset at Radhanagar.
Capture beautiful memories against one of the Andamans’ most spectacular landscapes.
The evening is free for self-exploration and café hopping. If you’re looking to experience Havelock after dark, you can also explore its local nightlife.
Overnight stay in Havelock Island.
Wravelers' Tip
Keep your evening free to explore Havelock at your own pace. The island has plenty of cafés and laid-back spots to discover.

itinerary.title: Elephant Beach | Water Sports Adventure
itinerary.description:
Experiences at a Glance
Elephant Beach • Coral Reefs • Water Sports
Your Day Looks Like
Early risers can opt for an early-morning scuba diving or kayaking experience at their own cost, a great way to experience the Andaman waters before the day gets busy.
After breakfast, head to Elephant Beach, one of Havelock’s most popular spots for coral reefs, marine life and water adventures.
You can spend the rest of the day trying out different adventure activities at Elephant Beach or simply relax by the shore and enjoy the tropical setting.
The evening is free for self-exploration and leisure, giving you time to discover more of Havelock at your own pace.
Overnight stay in Havelock Island.
Wravelers' Tip
Carry an extra set of clothes and keep your belongings protected from water, especially if you plan to try additional activities at Elephant Beach.
Note: Guests can opt for various activities at Elephant Beach at their own cost.
All activities are subject to local association guidelines and weather conditions.
Optional Activities: Bioluminescence Kayaking –
INR 3,500/-
| Shore Scuba Diving –
INR 3,500/-
| Deep Sea Scuba Diving –
INR 5,500/-

itinerary.title: Havelock → Neil Island | Beaches & Sunset Views
itinerary.description:
Experiences at a Glance
Kalapathar Sunrise • Ferry Ride • Natural Rock Formation Bridge • Bharatpur Beach • Laxmanpur Beach
Your Day Looks Like
If you’re an early riser, you can opt for a sunrise experience at Kalapathar Beach at your own cost. The peaceful shoreline and early-morning light make it a beautiful start to the day.
Later, board the ferry to Neil Island (Shaheed Dweep)
, a quieter island known for its pristine beaches, lush landscapes and laid-back atmosphere.
Upon arrival, begin exploring the island’s stunning coastline and take in the mesmerizing shades of blue that surround Neil Island.
Visit the iconic Natural Rock Formation Bridge, a unique coastal formation shaped over years by the waves.
Continue to Bharatpur Beach, where calm turquoise waters, coral reefs and optional water activities make it a great place to spend some time by the sea.
End the day at Laxmanpur Beach and witness a spectacular sunset against the island’s dramatic coastline.
Overnight stay in Neil Island.
Wravelers' Tip
Neil Island is best enjoyed at a slower pace, so take some time to simply walk along the beaches and soak in the island’s peaceful surroundings.

itinerary.title: Neil Island → Port Blair | Ross Island Excursion
itinerary.description:
Experiences at a Glance
Ferry Ride • Ross Island • Colonial Ruins • Cellular Jail • Light & Sound Show
Your Day Looks Like
After breakfast, board the ferry back to Port Blair, enjoying scenic views across the Andaman Sea along the way.
After reaching Port Blair, head out for an excursion to Ross Island (Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose Island)
, once the administrative headquarters of the British in the Andaman Islands.
Walk through the island’s fascinating colonial-era ruins, including the remains of churches, officers’ quarters, a bakery and other historic structures that now stand surrounded by lush tropical vegetation and giant banyan roots.
Later in the evening, visit Cellular Jail (Kala Pani)
for the captivating Light & Sound Show.
Through narration, music and visuals, the show brings alive the history of India’s freedom struggle and the sacrifices of the freedom fighters imprisoned within these walls.
Return to the hotel and relax after a day that combines the history and heritage of the Andamans.
Enjoy a hearty dinner before settling in for the evening.
Overnight stay in Port Blair.
Wravelers' Tip
Carry water and comfortable footwear for Ross Island, as you’ll be walking around the historic ruins and exploring the island on foot.
Note: Ross Island visit is subject to available time and weather conditions.

itinerary.title: Departure from Port Blair
itinerary.description:
Your Day Looks Like
After breakfast, check out from the hotel and get ready for your onward journey.
Depending on your flight schedule, you can use the morning to relax or spend some final moments taking in the island atmosphere.
Our representative will assist with your transfer to Port Blair Airport.
As you leave the Andamans, take home memories of turquoise waters, pristine beaches, colourful coral reefs, island sunsets, thrilling adventures and the laid-back charm of these tropical islands.
Wravelers' Tip
Keep some extra time for your airport transfer and avoid booking an early flight, as island travel can sometimes be affected by weather and operational conditions.
Note: Standard check-out time is 10:00 AM.
One airport drop will be provided at 10:30 AM.
It is recommended to book your onward flight after 2:00 PM on this day.
The itinerary may be modified due to weather, road conditions, operational constraints, or other unforeseen situations. Changes will be made keeping the safety and comfort of travelers in mind.

itinerary.title: Guwahati Arrival | Drive to Nameri (220 Kilometers)
itinerary.description:
• The group will assemble at the designated pick-up point in Guwahati, where a brief introduction by the trip captain will take place.
• Afterward, we will begin our journey towards Nameri National Park, located on the foothills of the Eastern Himalayas. This biodiversity hotspot is home to rare flora and fauna, including elephants, tigers, hornbills, and more.
• Upon arrival, we will check into our stay surrounded by the natural beauty of Assam’s wilderness. The evening is free for leisure.
• Dinner and overnight stay in Nameri.
 
Note: Standard Check-in time is 01:00 PM.

itinerary.title: River Rafting | Drive to Dirang (160 kilometres)
itinerary.description:
• We will begin our day with a river rafting experience on the Jia-Bhoreli River. 
• After breakfast and the morning activity, we will head towards Dirang, a scenic hill station known for its cool climate and picturesque views of the Eastern Himalayas.
• Upon arrival, check into the hotel and unwind for the day.
• Dinner and overnight stay in Dirang.
 
Highlight of the Day: Rafting in Nameri, scenic drive to Dirang

itinerary.title: Drive from Dirang to Tawang (125 Kilometers)
itinerary.description:
• After breakfast, we will leave for Tawang, a charming town nestled at an elevation of over 10,000 ft.
• En route, we will pass through the stunning Sela Pass and halt at Sela Lake, a high-altitude glacial lake surrounded by snow peaks. 
• We will also visit Jaswant Garh, a war memorial dedicated to Rifleman Jaswant Singh Rawat.
• Upon arrival in Tawang, check into your hotel. 
• In the evening, travelers can explore local cafes or enjoy the mountain views at leisure.
• Dinner and overnight stay in Tawang.
 
Highlight of the Day: Sela Pass, Sela Lake, Jaswant Garh Memorial

itinerary.title: Bum La Pass Excursion | Return to Tawang
itinerary.description:
• After early breakfast, we’ll set out for an excursion to the iconic Bum La Pass, located near the Indo-China border at an altitude of 15,200 ft. The road to Bum La is scenic and adventurous, surrounded by snow-covered landscapes for most of the year.
• Later, we will visit the serene P.T. Tso Lake and the beautiful Madhuri Lake (also known as Shonga-tser Lake), named after the Bollywood actress from the movie Koyla.
• Return to Tawang by evening.
• Dinner and overnight stay in Tawang.
 
Note: Due to border regulations, bike permits may be restricted for Bum La. In such cases, an alternative vehicle will be provided.
 
Highlight of the Day: Bum La Pass, P.T. Tso Lake, Madhuri Lake

itinerary.title: Tawang Local Sightseeing
itinerary.description:
• After an early morning breakfast, we will head out for a local sightseeing tour where we visit the Tawang Monastery known as Gaden Namgyal Lhatse in Tibetan which is the largest monastery in India.
• We will also visit the Urgelling Monastery which is one of the oldest Gompas in Tawang and is also the birthplace of the 6th Dalai Lama.
• Afterward, we will go ahead to witness the Giant Buddha statue which is 30ft tall and overlooks the upper regions of Tawang from an elevation of 10,000ft. 
• Afterward, we will visit the Chakzam bridge which is almost 600 year old and is suspended over the Tawang River.
• Afterward, we will visit the Tawang War Memorial which is a shrine dedicated to the Indian martyrs who sacrificed their lives in the Indo-China War. 
• We will also watch the Light and Sound show that is organized in the memorial every evening and then head back to our hotel.
• Dinner followed by an overnight stay in the hotel.
 
Highlight of the Day: Tawang Monastery, Urgelling Monastery, Giant Buddha statue, Chakzam bridge, Tawang War Memorial

itinerary.title: Drive from Tawang to Bomdila (166 Kilometers)
itinerary.description:
• After breakfast, we will begin our descent towards Bomdila, a quiet town known for its lush greenery, Buddhist culture, and panoramic views of the Himalayas.
• En route, we will stop to visit the stunning Jung Falls, a popular waterfall that gained fame from the film Koyla. 
• Upon arrival, check into the hotel.
• Dinner and overnight stay in Bomdila.
 
Highlight of the Day: Jung Falls, Bomdila

itinerary.title: Drive from Bomdila to Kaziranga (180 Kilometers)
itinerary.description:
• After breakfast, we will make our way to Kaziranga National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site in Assam.
• Known for its thriving population of the Great Indian One-Horned Rhinoceros, Kaziranga is also home to wild buffaloes, elephants, Bengal tigers, and countless bird species.
• Upon arrival, check into your stay surrounded by the beauty of Assam’s wilderness.
• Dinner and overnight stay in Kaziranga.
 
Highlight of the Day: Scenic drive to Kaziranga

itinerary.title: Jungle Safari | Drive to Guwahati (200 Kilometers)
itinerary.description:
• Early in the morning, we will head for a Jungle Safari to explore the park’s stunning terrain and get a chance to spot the rare wildlife in its natural habitat.
• After the safari and breakfast, we will drive to Guwahati. Upon arrival, check into the hotel and relax for the evening.
• Dinner and overnight stay in Guwahati.
 
Highlight of the Day: Jungle Safari in Kaziranga

itinerary.title: Departure from Guwahati
itinerary.description:
• After breakfast, we will check out and head for our onward journey with beautiful memories from the Eastern Himalayas.
Trip Ends.
 
Note:

itinerary.title: Arrival in McLeod Ganj | Local Sightseeing
itinerary.description:
• Upon reaching McLeod Ganj, we'll check into our hotel rooms and spend some leisure time.
• Afterward we will head out for a local sightseeing tour where we will be visiting Bhagsunag Waterfall and the local Tibetan Market, and will also go for cafe hopping. 
• In the evening, we will celebrate Christmas with Music, Food, Cake, a Bonfire, and more. 
• Dinner followed by an overnight stay in Mcleodganj.
Highlight of the Day: Bhagsunag Waterfall, Tibetan Market, Christmas Celebration.
Note:

itinerary.title: Drive from McLeod Ganj to Bir (72 Kilometers, 3 Hours)
itinerary.description:
• After early morning breakfast, we will check out of our hotel and head towards Bir which is situated at an elevation of 5,003 ft and is popularly known as the Paragliding Capital of India. Bir Billing has the Second Highest Take off point for Paragliding in the World and hence attracts adventure enthusiasts from all over the country.
• En route we'd be traversing through Dharamshala which is the humble abode of the Dalai Lama. We will also visit the Dharamshala Stadium which is situated at an altitude of 4,780 ft and is the Highest fully functional International Cricket Ground in the World. Afterwards, we'll resume our journey to Bir.
• Upon our arrival in Bir, we'll check into our hotel. The rest of the day is at leisure, but travelers can explore the array of cafes that Bir has to offer.
• Dinner followed by an overnight stay in Bir
Highlight of the Day: Dharamshala Stadium, Bir Exploration.
Note: 
Dharamshala can be closed on various occasions; in such a case, we will visit Norbulingka depending on time.

itinerary.title: Paragliding in Billing | Drive From Bir to Jibhi (138 Kilometers, 6 Hours)
itinerary.description:
• After early morning breakfast, we'll check out of our hotels in Bir and head towards Billing which is the take-off point for paragliding where Bir is the landing site. Collectively they provide the perfect opportunity for a paragliding session.
• After our Paragliding session in Bir Billing, we'll head towards Jibhi which is a tiny hamlet nestled between lush green forests in the Tirthan Valley of Himachal Pradesh.
• Upon reaching Jibhi in the evening, we’ll check into our hotel. The rest of the day is at leisure but travelers are advised to go to Cafe Hopping and explore the Local Market.  
• Dinner will be served followed by an overnight stay in Jibhi.
 
Highlight of the Day: Paragliding session, Cafe hopping and shopping in Jibhi Market.
Note: Paragliding has a weight restriction of upto 90 kgs.

itinerary.title: Drive to Jalori Pass and Trek to Serolsar Lake (9 Kilometers, 5 Hours)
itinerary.description:
• After early morning breakfast, we will drive to Jalori Pass for Serolsar Lake Trek. The trek leads you to the 360º viewpoint which offers a stunning view of the entire valley along with the Pir Panjal ranges of the Himalayas from
• After traversing through Jalori Pass, we will also visit the pristine Serolsar Lake which is a high-altitude lake nestled amidst alpine forests. Just beside the lake, there is a temple that holds extreme significance for the locals where you can pay your respects as well.
• Afterwards, we will descend and return to our hotel where we will spend some leisure time.
• In the evening, we will have dinner followed by an overnight stay in Jibhi.
 
Highlight of the Day: Jalori Pass, Serolsar Lake

itinerary.title: River Rafting | Drive From Jibhi To Kasol (83 Kilometers, 3 Hours)
itinerary.description:
• Post early morning breakfast, we will check out of our hotel and visit the sparkling Jibhi Waterfall.
• En route to Kasol, we'll indulge in a River Rafting session. 
• Afterward, we'll head to Kasol which is a tiny hamlet in the Kullu district of Himachal Pradesh known for its pristine river streams and lush green forests.
• Upon arrival in Kasol, we will check in to our designated hotel. The rest of the day is at leisure, but the travelers are advised to go Cafe hopping and explore the local market of Kasol, which is always brimming with beautiful handicrafts and colorful clothes.
• Dinner will be served in the evening, followed by an overnight stay at Kasol.
 
Highlight of the Day: Jibhi Waterfall, River Rafting session, Cafe hopping in Kasol Market
Note: River rafting in Jhiri is 8 kms.

itinerary.title: Kasol Sightseeing Day
itinerary.description:
• After early morning breakfast, we'll head for a sightseeing tour where we'd be visiting the Manikaran Temple and Manikaran Gurudwara, both of which hold extreme religious importance. We will also visit the Hot Water Springs in Manikaran which are considered extremely sacred by the locals.
• Afterwards, we'll hike towards Chalal which is a quaint village that offers beautiful views of the entire Parvati Valley.
• In the evening, we will have dinner followed by an overnight stay in Kasol.
 
Highlight of the Day: Manikaran Temple & Gurudwara, Hot Water Springs, Chalal Village

itinerary.title: Kasol to Manali (75 Kilometers, 2 Hours)
itinerary.description:
• After early morning breakfast, we will check out of our hotel and head towards our next destination which is Manali. The picturesque town is popular among backpackers for offering both adventure and solitude.
• Upon our arrival in Manali, we'll check into our designated hotel rooms. The rest of the day is at leisure but the travelers are advised to visit the Manali Mall Road. 
• In the evening, we'll head back to our hotel. The rest of the day is at leisure.
• Dinner followed by an overnight stay in Manali. 
 
Highlight of the Day: Visit to Mall Road in Manali

itinerary.title: Manali Local Sightseeing
itinerary.description:
• After early morning breakfast, we will head out for a local sightseeing tour of Manali where we will be visiting Hadimba Temple which is an ancient cave temple believed to be 500 years old.
• Afterwards, We will also be visiting the Vashisht Temple and Vashisht Hot water springs which are believed to have healing properties.
• In the evening, we will go back to our hotel where we'll be indulging in New Year celebrations with Music, Delicious Snacks, a bonfire, and Cake.
• Dinner followed by an overnight stay in Manali.
 
Highlight of the Day: Hadimba Temple, Vashisht Temple & Hot Springs, New Year Celebrations

itinerary.title: Manali to Solang Valley ( 13 Kilometers, 1 hour) | Solang Valley Sightseeing
itinerary.description:
• After early morning breakfast, we will check out from the hotel and head towards Solang Valley which is a paradise for adventure enthusiasts.
• Upon our arrival in Solang Valley, travelers can indulge in activities like Zorbing, Skiing, ATV rides, Paragliding, Zipline, and more. (on personal expense).  Once we've had our fair share of adrenaline, we will head back to Manali.
• In the evening we’ll board the return bus for Delhi and head out for an overnight journey.
 
Highlight of the Day: Adventure activities in Solang Valley
Note: 
Standard Check-out time is 11:00 AM.
Overnight travel in an A/C semi-sleeper bus from Manali to Delhi

itinerary.title: Trek to Triund | (9 Kilometers, 5 Hours)
itinerary.description:
• After early morning breakfast, we'll head out for a trek towards Triund hill which is situated at the foothills of the Dhauladhar ranges and is known as the crown jewel of Dharamshala.
• At an elevation of 9432 ft, the Triund Top offers stunning views of the entire Kangra Valley. The trail is adorned with pine trees and stretches up to an expanse of lush green grassland. 
• We will have our packed lunch enroute. 
• We will be spending the night under the blanket of stars overlooking the mighty Dhauladhars. We'll descend back to the campsites later on.
• Dinner and overnight stay in campsite.
 
Note: 
• We will stay within one-kilometer radius of Triund Top
• When there is heavy snowfall, it won't be possible to stay in a campsite near Triund Top, so we'll stay at a lower campsite.

• After our Paragliding session in Bir Billing, we will return to our designated stays. Dinner followed by an overnight stay in Bir. 
 
Note: 
Paragliding has a weight restriction of up to 90 kgs.
Dharamshala can be closed on various occasions; in such a case, we will visit Norbulingka depending on time.
In case paragliding cannot be conducted on this day due to time or weather constraints, we'll do it the next day.

• In the evening, we’ll board our overnight bus to Delhi.
