itinerary.title: Shimla to Chitkul/Sangla (225 Kms)
itinerary.description:
Early in the morning, we’ll arrive in Shimla via the Hindustan-Tibet highway.
We’ll be changing our transportation from bus to Tempo Traveler at this point and will head out for Chitkul/Sangla.
Upon reaching Chitkul/Sangla, we’ll check into our hotels.
Later, we’ll indulge in group bonding exercises. Dinner followed by an overnight stay in Chitkul/Sangla.
 
Note: 
We'll stay in Sangla if the harsh weather doesn't allow us to stay in Chitkul. 
The freshen-up point will be 2 hours ahead of Shimla. 
Standard Check-In time is 01:00 PM.
Highlight of the Day: Chitkul, Sangla

itinerary.title: Chitkul/Sangla to Kalpa (50 Kms)
itinerary.description:
• After breakfast, head towards Kalpa and set out for Chitkul sightseeing, exploring the picturesque village and its surrounding Himalayan landscapes. Chitkul is known as the last inhabited village in the Baspa Valley.
• On the way we will explore the small town of Reckong Peo town, serves as the perfect pit stop. If the weather gods are in your favor, you will be able to catch a glimpse of Kinner Kailash Peak.
• We will also visit Kamru Fort en-route Kalpa if time permits.
• Upon reaching Kalpa, after spending some leisure time, we’ll head out to visit the 3000-year-old Kalpa Monastery and the Suicide Point which offers a picturesque view of the Kailash ranges.
• Post-check-in, Dinner will be served followed by an overnight stay in Kalpa.
 
Highlight of the Day: Reckong Peo, Kamru Fort, Kalpa Monastery

itinerary.title: Kalpa to Nako (100 Kms)
itinerary.description:
• After having breakfast, we’ll continue our journey towards Nako, a tiny hamlet situated in the trans-Himalayan ranges.
• En route, we will make a pit stop at Khab, the site of the union between the Sutlej and Spiti rivers.
• In Nako, we’ll visit the serene Nako Lake and pay our reverence at the Nako Monastery.
• Afterward, we'll head back to our designated stays. Dinner and overnight stay at Nako.
 
Note: Due to its altitude, location and temperature, common washrooms will be provided here along with one bucket of Hot Water. Travelers are requested to be prepared beforehand. (Only during extreme winter months) 
Highlight of the Day: Khab, Nako Lake, Nako Monastery

itinerary.title: Nako to Kaza (110 Kms)
itinerary.description:
• Post breakfast, we will head towards the headquarters of Spiti which is Kaza.
• En route to Kaza, which serves as the connective link between the districts, we will find ourselves surrounded by many monasteries. We will visit the thousand-year-old Tabo Monastery followed by a visit to the Dhankar Monastery and the Dhankar Fort.
• We’ll reach Kaza before evening and will check in to our designated accommodations. The rest of the day is at leisure. However, travelers are free to explore the small town.
• Dinner followed by an overnight stay at Kaza.
 
Note: Due to its altitude, location, and temperature, common washrooms will be provided here along with one bucket of Hot Water. Travelers are requested to be prepared beforehand.  (Only during extreme winter months) 
Highlight of the Day: Tabo Monastery, Dhankar Monastery, Dhankar Fort.

itinerary.title: Spiti Sightseeing Day (Komic, Hikkim, Langza, Key, Chicham)
itinerary.description:
• Post breakfast, we’ll head out to visit the Key Monastery locally known as Key Gompa,  followed by Chicham Bridge which is Asia’s highest bridge.
• Later in the day, we will visit the highest post office in the world, Hikkim.
• Afterward, we’ll move towards Komic village which is one of the highest villages in the world connected by a motorable road.
• Last but not least, we will visit the land of fossils, Langza, and visit the Buddha statue that sits on top of a hill overlooking the village.
• Finally, we’ll head back to Kaza where we will have dinner and spend the night.
 
Highlight of the Day: Key Monastery, Chicham Bridge, Hikkim, Komic village, Langza

itinerary.title: Kaza to Kalpa (200 Kms)
itinerary.description:
• After breakfast, we will start our return journey to Kalpa.
• If time permits, we will also visit Lingti Falls, a breathtaking frozen waterfall
• We will reach Kalpa by evening where we will have dinner followed by an overnight stay.
 
Highlight of the Day: Lingti Falls

itinerary.title: Kalpa to Shimla (222 Kms)
itinerary.description:
• After breakfast, we'll resume our return journey and head towards Shimla.
• En route, we'll make a photo stop at the iconic Rock Tunnel, also known as the Gateway to Kinnaur.
• Upon reaching Shimla, we will board an overnight bus towards Delhi.
 
Note: Standard Check-out time is 11:00 AM.
Highlight of the Day: Rock Tunnel

itinerary.title: Delhi Arrival | Tour Ends
itinerary.description:
• We’ll reach Delhi early in the morning and the group will disperse with fond memories.
• End of Winter Spiti Road Trip.
 
Note: To assure a smooth departure, please coordinate with your JW Travel Consultant before booking your departure tickets.

itinerary.title: Kalpa to Tabo (160 Kilometers, 5 Hours Drive)
itinerary.description:
• After early morning breakfast, we'll check out of our hotels and head towards Tabo.
• En route, we’ll be making a pit stop at Khab, which is the beautiful confluence of the Sutlej and Spiti rivers. We’ll also be traversing through Nako Village where we'll visit Nako Lake and the Nako Monastery.

itinerary.description:

• We’ll reach Kaza before dusk falls. Post-check-in, you’re free to explore the town.
• Dinner followed by an overnight stay in Kaza.
Note: The visit to Dhankar Monastery is subject to weather conditions.
 
Highlight of the day: Tabo Monastery, Dhankar Monastery.

• Later in the day, we will visit Hikkim (the highest post office in the world).
• After that, we’ll move towards Komic village (one of the highest villages in the world, elevated at 4600 meters connected by a motorable road).
• We’ll be visiting Langza and seeing the famous Buddha statue.

itinerary.title: Srinagar Arrival | Shikara Ride
itinerary.description:
You’ll be picked up from the airport and taken to Srinagar. In the early afternoon, everyone will meet at a common meeting point, where the trip captain will introduce themselves and brief the group about the trip.
Afterwards, we'll check into our designated Houseboat. Afterwards, we'll go for a local sightseeing tour in the afternoon.
We will visit the Mughal Gardens, famous for their terraced lawns, vibrant flowers, fountains, and stunning views of Dal Lake.
Afterwards, we will go for a Shikara ride in the pristine Dal Lake, which is considered to be the jewel in Kashmir's crown.
In the evening, we'll have dinner followed by an overnight stay in our houseboat in Srinagar.
 
Note: 
A single airport pickup will be provided at 10:30 AM
Standard Check-In time is 01:00 PM.
Highlight of the Day: Houseboat Stay, Shikara Ride in Dal Lake

itinerary.title: Drive to Gulmarg (50 Kms, 2 Hours) | Gondola Ride
itinerary.description:
• After early morning breakfast, we'll check out of our houseboats and head towards Gulmarg which is one of the most popular hill stations of Kashmir known for its snow-covered meadows and skiing slopes.
• Upon our arrival in Gulmarg, we'll indulge in a Gondola ride that will lead us to Kongdoori Peak. Travelers can also indulge in adventure activities such as Skiing, Snowmobiling, Sledging, etc. 
• In the evening, we'll head back to Gulmarg where we'll check into our hotel. Dinner followed by an overnight stay in Gulmarg.
 
Note: Gondola ride tickets are subject to availability. In the event that tickets are not available, we cannot be held responsible. Rest assured, we will do our utmost to offer you an alternative solution.
Highlight of the Day: Gondola Ride to Kongdoori Peak, Snow activities (own expenses)

itinerary.title: Drung Waterfall | Drive to Pahalgam (142 Kms, 4 Hours)
itinerary.description:
• After early morning breakfast, we’ll check out of our hotel and head for a sightseeing tour.
• Board your vehicle as we will be traversing through winding roads offering surreal views via Pampore and Awantipura.
• We’ll visit the Drung Waterfall which often freezes in winter and becomes a breathtaking sight to behold.
• Afterward, we'll head towards Pahalgam which is yet another beautiful hill station in Kashmir known for its picturesque snow-covered meadows.
• Upon reaching Pahalgam, we'll check into our hotel and spend the rest of the day at leisure. Dinner is followed by an overnight stay.
 
Note: Travelers can either opt for ATV rides or local cabs for visiting Drung. ATV rides would be at personal expense while the local cab is included in the package. 
Highlight of the Day: Drung Waterfall, Scenic drive to Pahalgam

itinerary.title: Pahalgam Sightseeing | Drive to Srinagar (90 Kms, 2 Hours)
itinerary.description:
• After early morning breakfast, we’ll check out of our hotel and head for a sightseeing tour of Pahalgam.
• We'll visit Aru Valley which is known for its scenic meadows and the Tarsar Marsar Lakes. We’ll also visit the enchanting Betaab Valley which is nestled between the Pir Panjal and Zanskar ranges of the Himalayas.
• Lastly, we’ll visit Chandanwadi which is the starting point for the Amarnath Yatra and is known for many snow activities like skiing and snowboarding.
• After our sightseeing tour, we'll head back to Srinagar. 
• Upon our arrival, we’ll check into the hotel and retire for the day.
 
Note: Depending on the weather conditions, Aru/Chandanwadi gets closed during heavy snowfall and hence a visit to these valleys is subject to availability.
Highlight of the Day: Visit to Aru Valley, Betaab Valley and Chandanwadi

itinerary.title: Sonmarg Local Excursion

• we'll head to Sonmarg Valley which is yet another gem hidden in the embrace of Kashmir known for its green pastures and pristine water bodies.
• After spending some peaceful moments in the valley, we'll head back to Srinagar.
• In the evening, enjoy a hearty local dinner with Nadur Yakhni, Walnut Chutney, and Hokk Syun. 
• Overnight stay in Srinagar.
 
Note: If due to weather conditions, a visit to Sonmarg is not possible, we'll visit Yousmarg/Doodhpatri instead.

itinerary.title: Cochin Arrival → Local Sightseeing
itinerary.description:
Experiences at a Glance
Cochin Arrival • Chinese Fishing Nets • Fort Kochi Heritage Walk • Café Hopping
Your Day Looks Like
Upon your arrival at Cochin Airport at 12:00 PM, our representative will welcome you and transfer you to the hotel.
Check in to your hotel. Take some time to relax before heading out to explore the iconic Chinese Fishing Nets and watch local fishermen operate these centuries-old marvels.
Continue to Fort Kochi, where Portuguese, Dutch, and British influences come alive through colonial architecture, art galleries, boutique stores, and cozy cafés.
Post sunset, the evening is at leisure. Explore the Fort Kochi area at your own pace, indulge in café hopping, or simply soak in its lively evening atmosphere.
Overnight stay in Cochin.
Wravelers' Tip
Keep your evening free for Fort Kochi; the area comes alive after sunset with cafés, street scenes, and a relaxed coastal vibe.
NOTE: Standard hotel check-in time is 1:00 PM. A single airport pickup will be provided at 12:00 PM, followed by a single pickup from Fort Kochi to the hotel at 10:00 PM.

itinerary.title: Cochin → Munnar | 140 km (4–5 hrs)
itinerary.description:
Experiences at a Glance
Cheeyappara Waterfalls • Valara Waterfalls • Tea Estates • Folk Fusion Cultural Show • Kalaripayattu
Your Day Looks Like
After breakfast, leave Cochin and begin the scenic drive towards Munnar, one of South India's most picturesque hill stations nestled in the Western Ghats.
Stop at Cheeyappara Waterfalls and Valara Waterfalls, surrounded by dense tropical forests.
Continue through rolling tea estates, fragrant spice plantations, mist-covered valleys, and winding mountain roads.
On reaching Munnar, check into your hotel and relax amidst the refreshing mountain air.
In the evening, experience Kerala's vibrant traditions with a captivating Folk Fusion Cultural Show, followed by an energetic Kalaripayattu performance.
Overnight stay in Munnar.
Wravelers' Tip
Keep your camera handy during the drive; the changing landscapes from tropical forests to misty tea plantations are part of the Munnar experience.

itinerary.title: Munnar Sightseeing
itinerary.description:
Experiences at a Glance
Rajamalai • Eravikulam National Park • KDHP Tea Museum • Echo Point • Mattupetty Dam
Your Day Looks Like
After breakfast, head out to explore some of Munnar's most scenic landscapes, starting with the Rajamalai region of Eravikulam National Park.
Explore the area known for its spectacular Western Ghats views and as a habitat of the endangered Nilgiri Tahr.
Next, visit the Tea Museum by KDHP to discover the history, heritage, and craftsmanship behind Munnar's famous tea.
Continue to Echo Point, where you can experience its natural echo phenomenon while enjoying views of the surrounding hills and valleys.
End your sightseeing with a visit to Mattupetty Dam, surrounded by lush tea estates, misty hills, and tranquil waters.
Overnight stay in Munnar.
Wravelers' Tip
Carry a light jacket and comfortable shoes; Munnar's weather can shift quickly, especially around the higher viewpoints.
NOTE: Entry tickets to Eravikulam National Park are not included. During February and March, the park remains closed for the Nilgiri Tahr calving season. In that case, we can cover the scenic Gap Road route up to Chinnakanal Waterfalls, including beautiful viewpoints and tea plantation landscapes.

itinerary.title: Munnar → Thekkady | 100 km (3–4 hrs)
itinerary.description:
Experiences at a Glance
• Spice Plantation • Periyar National Park Activities • Elephant Ride (optional) • Coffee Factory(optional)
Your Day Looks Like
Start early in the morning from Munnar and begin your scenic journey towards Thekkady, Kerala's renowned wildlife and spice destination.
En route, visit a spice plantation and discover Kerala's famous cardamom, pepper, coffee, cinnamon, and clove plantations.
We will reach Thekkady by early afternoon, here you can opt for activities at Periyar National Park, such as a boat safari, jungle hike, and other experiences, at your own cost and subject to availability.
If you are not interested in these activities or tickets are unavailable, you can alternatively opt for an elephant ride or visit a coffee factory, also at your own cost.
Later, check into the hotel and spend the evening at leisure.
Overnight stay in Thekkady.
Wravelers' Tip
If you're planning to opt for activities at Periyar National Park, keep your afternoon flexible and check availability in advance, as slots are subject to availability.
NOTE: Visit to the Spice Plantation is subject to timings. If the visit is not possible on Day 4, we will cover it on the following day. Activities at Periyar National Park, elephant rides, and coffee factory visits are at an additional cost and subject to availability.

itinerary.title: Thekkady → Alleppey | 150 km (4–5 hrs)
itinerary.description:
Experiences at a Glance
Alleppey Backwaters • Vembanad Lake • Evening Motor Boat Ride • Houseboat Stay • Musical Night
Your Day Looks Like
After breakfast, check out from your hotel and begin your journey towards Alleppey, famously known as the "Venice of the East."
Enjoy the scenic drive as the landscapes gradually transition from the spice-scented hills of Thekkady to the lush lowlands of Kerala.
On reaching Alleppey, board your traditional Kerala houseboat and settle in for a peaceful experience across the backwaters and Vembanad Lake.
Explore the serene waterways through an evening motor boat ride, taking in the coconut palms, emerald paddy fields, and charming villages along the way.
Enjoy evening snacks and dinner onboard while soaking in the peaceful surroundings.
Wind down with a musical night at the houseboat and experience the charm of Kerala's backwaters.
Overnight stay in a houseboat in Alleppey.
Wravelers' Tip
Keep your evening relaxed; the best part of the houseboat experience is watching Kerala's backwaters slowly change as the sun goes down.
NOTE: Music at the houseboat is available only until 10:00 PM.

itinerary.title: Alleppey → Varkala | 150 km (4–5 hrs)
itinerary.description:
Experiences at a Glance
Munroe Island • Mangrove Backwaters • Kayaking • Varkala North Cliff • Café Hopping
Your Day Looks Like
After breakfast, check out and begin your journey towards the coastal paradise of Varkala.
En route, explore Munroe Island, known for its narrow canals, coconut groves, and lush mangrove forests.
Enjoy a peaceful kayaking experience through the serene waterways while taking in the region's untouched village life.
Continue to Varkala and check into your hotel.
Spend the evening at leisure. Head to North Cliff to explore the nightlife, browse local shops, or unwind at one of the many cliffside cafés overlooking the Arabian Sea.
Overnight stay in Varkala.
Wravelers' Tip
Varkala's North Cliff is best enjoyed at an easy pace, so keep your evening free to café-hop, browse local shops, and take in the sea views.

itinerary.title: Varkala Sightseeing → Jatayu Earth's Center
itinerary.description:
Experiences at a Glance
Jatayu Earth's Center • Panoramic Hilltop Views • Varkala Beach • Water Sports
Your Day Looks Like
After breakfast, head out to Jatayu Earth's Center, home to the world's largest bird sculpture inspired by the Ramayana.
Explore the attraction and admire panoramic views from the hilltop.
In the evening, head to the beach and spend some time at leisure. Relax by the Arabian Sea, enjoy the sunset, or indulge in available water sports activities.
Return to the hotel and spend the night in Varkala.
Wravelers' Tip
Wear comfortable shoes for Jatayu Earth's Center, especially if you need to take the walking route to the hilltop.
NOTE: Ropeway and entry tickets to Jatayu Earth's Center are not included. If the ropeway is not operational, the hike to Jatayu Earth's Center takes approximately 45 minutes to 1 hour.

itinerary.title: Varkala → Thiruvananthapuram | 100 km (2 hrs)
itinerary.description:
Your Day Looks Like
After breakfast, check out from your hotel and begin the drive from Varkala to Thiruvananthapuram.
Enjoy the final stretch of your Kerala journey as you make your way towards Thiruvananthapuram International Airport.
Our representative will drop you at the airport at approximately 12:30 PM for your onward journey.
It is recommended to book your return flight after 3:00 PM.
Wravelers' Tip
Keep some buffer after the airport drop for check-in and security, especially if you're travelling during a busy period.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Tokyo
itinerary.description:
- Touch down in Tokyo and self transfer to hotel. We will share subway passes with booked particpants for hassle free transfer.
- Check into your stay in the heart of the city.
After settling in, visit Meiji Jingu Shrine, a tranquil forested sanctuary amidst Tokyo’s concrete jungle.
- As evening falls, dive into Tokyo’s nightlife, starting with the quirky Drinkers Alley, followed by the Shibuya Scramble Crossing, one of the busiest intersections in the world. - End the night with a fun pub crawl with your crew.
- Overnight stay in Tokyo.
**Tokyo at a glance:**
A city where centuries-old shrines sit quietly beside skyscrapers and vending machines sell everything from soda to fortune slips. Explore Meiji Jingu’s serenity, lose yourself in the chaos of Shibuya Crossing, and dive into neon-lit nights of izakayas and arcades. Whether it's ancient temples or anime, Tokyo presents a striking contrast at every turn. It’s loud, fast, quirky, and absolutely addictive.

itinerary.title: Tokyo Sightseeing
itinerary.description:
- After breakfast, start your day with a visit to Senso-ji Temple, Tokyo’s oldest and most colourful shrine, situated against a backdrop of lanterns and cherry trees.
- Later, head up to Shibuya Sky for 360° views of the Tokyo skyline.
- Then, it’s off to Akihabara Electric Town, the ultimate playground for anime lovers and gadget geeks.
- Overnight stay in Tokyo.

itinerary.title: Trip to Mt. Fuji
itinerary.description:
- After breakfast, check out and transfer to your accommodation near Mt. Fuji, offering postcard-perfect views.
- Spend your afternoon at Lake Kawaguchiko, where serene waters reflect Japan’s most iconic peak. Walk along the lake, explore quaint cafés, or just sit in silence as Fuji towers above.
- Overnight stay in Fuji.
**Fuji at a glance:**
The air gets crisper, the pace slows down, and suddenly, there it is, Japan’s most iconic peak standing tall in all its snow-capped glory. The Fuji region is all about soaking in the silence by Lake Kawaguchiko, spotting reflections on still waters, and feeling tiny next to nature. It's where you trade neon lights for starry skies and vending machines for steaming onsen. Perfect for that pause your Tokyo hustle forgot to give you.

itinerary.title: Kawaguchiko to Mishima to Kyoto
itinerary.description:
- Check out post breakfast and board the Shinkansen (bullet train) from Mishima to Kyoto.
- After checking in, explore Kyoto’s rich heritage: the majestic Nijō Castle, the hillside beauty of Kiyomizu-dera Temple, and the glowing lanterns of Yasaka Shrine.
- In the evening, wander through Pontocho, Kyoto’s most atmospheric alley, for local food, sake, and glimpses of geishas.
- Overnight stay in Kyoto.
**Kyoto at a glance:**
Once Japan’s imperial capital, Kyoto is all things graceful, poetic, and timeless. Wander through bamboo forests, zen gardens, and streets lined with wooden machiya houses. Watch geishas glide past in Gion and sip matcha in centuries-old teahouses. This is where Japan pauses, and invites you to do the same.

itinerary.title: Kyoto Sightseeing
itinerary.description:
- Start your day at Okochi Sanso Garden, a peaceful garden villa once owned by a famous actor, followed by a stroll through the Arashiyama Bamboo Forest, where sunlight filters through tall green stalks.
- Later, hop on a scenic train to Amanohashidate, a stunning pine-covered sandbar known as the “Bridge to Heaven.” Visit the serene Chionji Temple before heading back.
- Overnight stay in Kyoto.

itinerary.title: Day trip to Hiroshima
itinerary.description:
- Board the bullet train for a full-day tour to Hiroshima.
- Walk through the moving Peace Memorial Park, visit the skeletal ruins of the Atomic Bomb Dome, and spend time in the museum for a powerful look at history, resilience, and the pursuit of peace.
- Return to Kyoto by evening for a quiet night in.
- Overnight stay in Kyoto.

itinerary.title: Kyoto to Osaka
itinerary.description:
- Today, take a short bullet train ride to Osaka, where the vibe shifts to loud, fun, and flashy.
- Start with views from Tsutenkaku Tower, ride the bright red HEP FIVE Ferris wheel, and step into history at Osaka Castle.
- End the night in Dotonbori, Osaka’s buzzing food and nightlife district filled with neon, takoyaki, and late-night laughter.
- Overnight stay in Osaka.
**Osaka at a glance:**
Loud, proud, and a little unfiltered, Osaka is Japan’s fun-loving foodie. From the flashing lights of Dotonbori to the thrills of Tsutenkaku’s glass slider, the city pulses with energy. Eat your way through takoyaki stalls, ride giant Ferris wheels, and toast to the good life at hidden bars. It’s chaos, comedy, and comfort all rolled into one.

itinerary.title: Day trip to Universal Studios
itinerary.description:
- Have a hearty breakfast, then spend the day at Universal Studios Japan.
- From Harry Potter World to thrilling rides and movie-themed madness, it's your day to let loose and feel like a kid again.
- Overnight stay in Osaka.

itinerary.title: Last day in Japan
itinerary.description:
- Post breakfast, check out.
- Bid farewell to your fellow travellers and start your journey back to your native place, or extend your trip to explore the rest of Japan.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bali: Transfer to Ubud
itinerary.description:
- Arrival at Bali Airport.
- Group pickup by 1-2 PM and transfer to Ubud.
- Check-in and rest.
- Explore nearby cafés, rice fields, and markets.
- Overnight stay in Ubud.
**Ubud at a glance**
With endless Ubud tours, adventure options, and soulful cafes, it’s no wonder Ubud is at the centre of so many Bali vacation packages.

itinerary.title: Ubud Adventures
itinerary.description:
- Breakfast at hotel.
- ATV single ride through jungles and villages.
- Arrive to a hot lunch and refreshing drinks.
- Experience the famous Bali Jungle Swing.
- Local lunch included.
- Free evening to explore Ubud.
- Overnight stay in Ubud.

itinerary.title: Bali to Gili Island | Island Transfer
itinerary.description:
- After an early breakfast, head to Bali Pier and hop on a fast boat to Gili Trawangan.
- Cidomo (horse cart) transfers to your cosy stay because cars don’t run here!
- Spend the afternoon exploring or relaxing by the turquoise coast.
- Enjoy beachside dinner scenes, bonfires, and tropical vibes.
**Gili Trawangan at a glance**
Gili Trawangan offers the ideal mix of chill and thrill—perfect for snorkelling, cycling, and catching sunsets. A must in any Bali itinerary or Bali travel packages.

itinerary.title: Gili Island | Leisure Day
itinerary.description:
- Have a lazy breakfast with ocean views.
- Choose your own adventure: rent a bike to circle the island, take a Bali snorkelling tour, or opt for a scuba dive.
- Sip coconuts, read books on the beach, or dive into beach bars by sunset.
- As the music rises, so do the vibes—whether you're into dancing or deep convos by the sea.
- Later, Spend the evening exploring Gili's vibrant nightlife as you hop between some of the island's most popular bars. Meet fellow travellers, soak in the lively atmosphere, and create unforgettable memories under the tropical night sky.

itinerary.title: Gili to Nusa Penida
itinerary.description:
- After breakfast, take the cidomo to the port and board your fast boat to Nusa Penida.
- In the evening, visit the iconic Kelingking Beach, known for its T-Rex-shaped cliff, and catch one of the best sunsets in Southeast Asia.
- Return to the stay for chill time, shared meals, and quiet reflections.
**Nusa Penida at a glance**
Rugged, raw, and jaw-dropping—Nusa Penida is a top highlight in many Bali vacation all inclusive and Nusa Penida private tour plans.

itinerary.title: Diamond Beach | Transfer to Kuta
itinerary.description:
- Start your day early at Diamond Beach, with its breathtaking cliffs and uniquely shaped rocks.
- After sunrise, head back for breakfast, pack up, and return to Bali's mainland Kuta.
- Free evening to explore beach markets and nightlife. Our Trip Captain will guide you to the best spots based on your vibe.
- Overnight stay in Kuta.
**Kuta at a glance**
The beach, the bustle, and the nightlife—Kuta is the hub of action. It’s what makes Bali group tours so vibrant and Bali holidays so dynamic.

itinerary.title: Uluwatu & Kecak Dance | Kuta Stay
itinerary.description:
- Breakfast at the hotel.
- Visit Uluwatu Temple, perched on dramatic sea cliffs.
- Explore Tanah Barak Beach.
- Experience the iconic Kecak Dance at sunset.
- Return to Kuta.
- Later, Spend the evening relaxing by the beach, enjoying the sunset, and experiencing Bali’s famous beach club culture with your group or as per your preference, our trip leader will help with great suggestions ( Finns Beach Club, one of Bali’s most popular beachfront destinations known for its infinity pools, ocean views, and lively atmosphere).
- Overnight stay in Kuta.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description:
- Post breakfast, check out and say goodbye to new friends and the magic of Bali.
- Head to the airport with memories in your heart, sand in your shoes, and stories worth telling.

trips.title: Zo Trip: Full Moon Party Thailand 6N/7D

itinerary.title: Bangkok arrival & shopping extravaganza
itinerary.description:
- Arrive in Bangkok, check into your stay, and freshen up after your journey.
- Meet your trip leader and fellow travellers, setting the tone for an exciting adventure ahead.
- Wander through the massive Chatuchak and Pratunam markets, shopping for trendy clothes and souvenirs and tasting Bangkok’s famous street food delights.
- As night falls, board the comfortable overnight bus + ferry at 8:00 PM to Koh Phangan/Koh Samui, gearing up for the next leg of your journey.
**Bangkok at a glance**
A city that never sleeps, Bangkok is a perfect blend of ancient temples, modern malls, and lively markets. From stunning rooftop bars to bustling street food lanes, every corner of this city has a story to tell.

itinerary.title: Koh Phangan/Koh Samui & Moon Party experience
itinerary.description:
- Arrive in Koh Phangan/koh samui at 10:30 AM and check into the stay, your tropical retreat for the next two nights.
- Spend the day at leisure, exploring the pristine beaches or enjoying a fresh coconut by the sea.
- As the sun sets, head to Haad Rin Beach for the biggest beach party in the world—the Thai Full Moon Party.
- Dance under the glowing moon, marvel at fire dancers, and soak in the electrifying energy of the Moonlight Party Koh Phangan/Koh Samui till the early hours.
- Overnight stay in Koh Phangan/koh samui.
**Koh Phangan at a glance**
A tropical paradise, Koh Phangan is world-famous for its Full Moon Party Thailand Koh Phangan. Beyond the party scenes, the island offers tranquil beaches, scenic viewpoints, and thrilling water activities.

itinerary.title: Recovery & beach day in Koh Phangan/Koh Samui
itinerary.description:
- Enjoy a relaxed breakfast and recover from last night’s madness at your own pace.
- Spend the day unwinding at secluded beaches, taking in the island's serene beauty.
- Opt for an adventure by exploring waterfalls, going paddleboarding, or hopping between hidden beach cafes.
- As evening sets in, chill by the shore and watch the stunning sunset.
- Overnight stay in Koh Phangan/Koh Samui.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Krabi & sunset at Ao Nang
itinerary.description:
- Post breakfast, check out and board a ferry + bus to Krabi, watching as the landscape shifts from island blues to towering limestone cliffs.
- Arrive in Krabi and check into stay at Ao Nang.
- Head to Ao Nang Beach to witness a stunning sunset where the sky turns shades of pink, orange, and gold over the sea.
- Wander through Ao Nang’s bustling night market, trying local seafood and shopping for souvenirs.
- For those up for a party, join an exciting pub crawl through Krabi’s best nightlife spots (drinks not included).
- Overnight stay in Krabi.
**Krabi at a glance**
Home to breathtaking limestone cliffs, crystal-clear waters, and vibrant nightlife, Krabi is a gateway to Thailand’s most stunning islands and beaches. It’s also a popular stop in many Full Moon Party Trip Itineraries due to its relaxed yet lively vibe.

itinerary.title: Phi Phi Island hopping & snorkelling
itinerary.description:
- After breakfast, set off for a thrilling island hopping trip via speedboat to the Phi Phi Islands.
- Snorkel in the crystal-clear waters, spotting vibrant marine life and coral reefs.
- Relax on the sandy shores of Maya Bay, famous for its jaw-dropping beauty.
- Enjoy a delicious lunch on the island and explore its scenic trails and hidden lagoons.
- Spend the evening wandering through Phi Phi’s lively village, lined with beach bars, markets, and sunset viewpoints (National Park fees of 400THB per person excluded).
- Overnight stay in Krabi.
**Phi Phi Islands at a glance**
One of Thailand’s most stunning island chains, Phi Phi is known for its turquoise waters, incredible snorkelling spots, and laid-back island vibes.

itinerary.title: Phuket nights & party scenes
itinerary.description:
- Enjoy a tasty breakfast, check out, and take a ferry + bus transfer to Phuket.
- Check into your hostel and freshen up before heading out to explore Thailand’s largest island.
- Stroll through Phuket’s vibrant night markets, where local crafts, souvenirs, and mouth-watering Thai street food await.
- Experience Phuket’s famous nightlife—hop between beach clubs, dance to international DJs, and enjoy the buzzing party scene.
- Overnight stay in Phuket.
**Phuket at a glance**
A lively mix of beaches, nightlife, and adventure, Phuket is Thailand’s party capital, home to bustling streets, night markets, and legendary beach parties. It’s also a key destination in any Thailand Tour Package catering to party lovers and beach seekers alike.

itinerary.title: Farewell & departure
itinerary.description:
- Post breakfast, check out and bid farewell to your fellow travellers, cherishing the unforgettable memories made over the past week.
- Head back home or extend your journey to explore more of Phuket before departure.
**Thailand at a glance**
From wild beach parties to serene island escapes, Thailand offers a perfect balance of adventure, relaxation, and cultural immersion. This Thailand Trip promises an experience you’ll never forget!

trips.title: Zo Trip: Annapurna Base Camp Trek 6N/7D

itinerary.title: Pokhara to Jhinu to Chhomrong
itinerary.description:
Altitude: 2,170m | Trek Distance: 2.5 km | Duration: 2–3 hrs - At 8 am embark on a scenic drive to Jhinu from Zostel Pokhara, following the Modi River.
- Enjoy breathtaking views of Annapurna South and the majestic Fishtail Mountain.
- Arrive at Chomrong village, a popular stop for trekkers heading to Annapurna Base Camp.
- Explore the village and experience the warm hospitality of the tea houses.
- Have a wholesome dinner with your newfound friends, and spend the night in Chomrong.
**Chomrong Village at a Glance:**
Altitude: 2,170m
Nestled at the base of the Annapurna massif, Chomrong is a picturesque village known for its terraced fields, traditional tea houses, and fascinating alpine views. It’s a gateway to the Annapurna Sanctuary and offers a glimpse into the local Gurung culture.

itinerary.title: Trek to Dovan
itinerary.description:
Altitude: 2,600m | Trek Distance: 9.6 km | Duration: 6–7 hrs - After breakfast, begin with a steep descent to Chomrong Khola, followed by a challenging ascent through lush bamboo, oak, and rhododendron forests.
- Pass through Sinuwa and Khuldigar village, where there are opportunities to refill water bottles at tea houses.
- Continue to Dovan, enjoying occasional views of Machhapuchhre and Annapurna.
- After a community dinner, spend the night in Dovan.
**Dovan at a Glance:**
Altitude: 2,600m
Dovan is a serene stop surrounded by dense forests and the soothing sounds of the Modi River. It’s a peaceful retreat for trekkers before the ascent to higher altitudes.

itinerary.title: Dovan to Deurali
itinerary.description:
Altitude: 3,200m | Trek Distance: 5 km | Duration: 4–5 hrs - Morning post breakfast, start your trek to Deurali.
- Trek along the narrow Modi Khola glacier valley.
- Pass the Himalaya settlement with great views.
- Continue uphill through misty forest landscapes and waterfalls.
- Reach Deurali, where the treeline starts to thin and mountain views intensify.
- Overnight stay at Deurali.

itinerary.title: Trek to Annapurna Base Camp (ABC)
itinerary.description:
Altitude: 4,130m | Trek Distance: 7 km | Duration: 6–7 hrs - Start your day with a hearty breakfast and start your trek with a steady ascent through rugged glacial terrain.
- Arrive at Machhapuchhre Base Camp for panoramic views of the surrounding peaks.
- Continue to Annapurna Base Camp (ABC), where you’ll be greeted by a 360-degree view of Hiunchuli, Annapurna South, Annapurna I, and more.
- Overnight stay and dinner at a tea house in ABC.
**Annapurna Base Camp (ABC) at a Glance:**
Altitude: 4,130m
ABC offers unparalleled views of Mount Annapurna, including Annapurna I (8,091m), Machhapuchhre (Fishtail), and Hiunchuli. The sanctuary is a natural amphitheatre surrounded by towering peaks, making it a bucket-list destination for trekkers.

itinerary.title: Descend from ABC to Bamboo
itinerary.description:
Altitude: 2,310m | Trek Distance: 14 km | Duration: 6–7 hrs - After breakfast, begin the descent from ABC, retracing your steps through the Modi River Valley.
- Pass through Deurali and the Himalayas, enjoying the serene beauty of the forests.
- Arrive at Bamboo, a tranquil stop for the night.
- Overnight stay with a community dinner in Bamboo.
**Bamboo at a Glance:**
Altitude: 2,310m
Highlights: Bamboo is a quiet settlement surrounded by lush forests and the calming ripples of the Modi River. It’s a perfect spot to rest and recharge after the descent from ABC.

itinerary.title: Trek from Bamboo to Jhinu Danda
itinerary.description:
Altitude: 1,780m | Trek Distance: 10 km | Duration: 5–6 hrs - Have a breakfast at the property and then descend to Kimrong Khola, followed by an ascent through rhododendrons, bamboo, and oak forests.
- Arrive at Jhinu Danda, which is famous for its natural hot springs.
- Relax in the hot springs, soaking in the views of lush vegetation and forests.
- Overnight stay in Jhinu Danda.
**Jhinu Danda at a Glance:**
Altitude: 1,780m
Highlights: Jhinu Danda is renowned for its natural hot springs, which provide a therapeutic retreat for trekkers. The village offers stunning views of the Modi Khola Valley and surrounding forests.

itinerary.title: Trek to Jhinu and Drive to Pokhara
itinerary.description:
Altitude: 822m | Drive Duration: ~4–5 hrs - Begin the final day with a short trek along a flat dirt road by the Modi Khola.
- Bid farewell to the trails and embark on a scenic drive through the picturesque countryside to Pokhara.
- Spend the evening exploring Pokhara or relaxing by Phewa Lake.
- Overnight stay in a hostel in Pokhara and part ways by 10 AM the next morning with lots of see-you-soons.
**Pokhara at a Glance:**
Altitude: 822m
Pokhara is a vibrant city known for its serene lakes, stunning mountain views, and adventure activities. It’s the perfect place to unwind after the trek, with attractions like Phewa Lake, World Peace Pagoda, and vibrant markets.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Tbilisi
itinerary.description:
- Arrive at Tbilisi International Airport, where your Georgian journey begins.
*Pickup time: 2 PM
- Meet your local guide/driver and transfer to your hotel in the heart of the city (30-minute drive).
- Check in and settle into your room. The rest of the day is yours, so explore nearby cafes, walk the cobbled streets, or just unwind after your journey.
- Wind down the day with community games, heartwarming conversations, new friendships, and a night full of dancing. Overnight in Tbilisi.

itinerary.title: Explore Tbilisi’s Old Town Charm
itinerary.description:
- Start your day with a hearty breakfast at the hotel before heading out to explore Georgia’s vibrant capital.
- Begin with a visit to the Holy Trinity Cathedral (Sameba), a striking symbol of modern Georgian architecture and one of the tallest Orthodox churches in the world.
- From there, make your way to the Metekhi Church, dramatically perched on a cliff above the Kura River, offering breathtaking views of Tbilisi’s old town. Nearby stands the equestrian statue of King Vakhtang Gorgasali, the legendary ruler credited with founding the city.
- Continue to the Abanotubani district, the historic heart of Tbilisi, known for its iconic Sulfur Baths, natural hot springs that inspired the city’s name, meaning “warm place.”
- Take a leisurely stroll down Sharden Street, a cobbled lane bustling with cosy cafes, wine bars, and artisan boutiques that blend old-world charm with contemporary flair.
- Pause at the whimsical Rezo Gabriadze Clock Tower, where a charming puppet show plays at the beginning of every hour.
- Step inside the Sioni Cathedral, a revered site that once safeguarded the original cross of St. Nino, the saint who brought Christianity to Georgia.
- Just a short walk away, explore the Anchiskhati Basilica, the city’s oldest surviving church, standing resiliently since the 6th century.
- Later, hop on a cable car to ascend to the ancient Narikala Fortress. From its ramparts, enjoy sweeping views of the city below, the river winding through it, and the majestic Caucasus in the distance.
- As the sun sets, cross the modern Peace Bridge and unwind at Rike Park, which is a green, open space where Tbilisi’s contemporary energy meets its storied past.
- As the stars come out, join in for fun games, unforgettable chats, and maybe even a little dance-off.

itinerary.title: Day Trip to Mtskheta & Gori
itinerary.description:
- After breakfast, head out to Mtskheta, Georgia’s ancient capital and spiritual heart.
- Visit Jvari Monastery, a 6th-century hilltop church offering a stunning view where the Aragvi and Kura rivers meet.
- Explore the Svetitskhoveli Cathedral, a UNESCO World Heritage Site said to be the burial site of Christ’s robe.
- Continue to Gori, the birthplace of Joseph Stalin.
- Visit the Stalin Museum to explore the USSR’s leader’s legacy, including his personal train carriage.
- Walk up to the Gori Fortress, an ancient citadel overlooking the town.
- Return to Tbilisi for a relaxed evening and to spend the night.

itinerary.title: A Scenic Drive to the Caucasus Mountains
itinerary.description:
- Enjoy breakfast, then set out along the Georgian Military Highway, one of the most spectacular mountain routes in the region.
- Stop at the Ananuri Fortress, a lakeside 17th-century castle complex once home to feudal lords.
- Drive further into the mountains to reach Gudauri, a popular ski and mountain resort.
- Pause at the Gudauri Friendship Monument, a colourful Soviet-era mural with panoramic views over the Aragvi Gorge.
- Take in the jaw-dropping scenery of the Caucasus Mountains, camera-ready at every turn.
- Head back to Tbilisi for dinner or free exploration. The night’s not over yet, gather for games, music, and conversations that spark joy with your new friends.

itinerary.title: Day trip to Kakheti
itinerary.description:
- Post breakfast, make your way east to the beautiful region of Kakheti, Georgia’s wine country.
- Stop at Sighnaghi, known as the “City of Love,” with pastel houses, cobbled alleys, and views of the Alazani Valley.
- Visit the Bodbe Monastery, the burial site of St. Nino, the 4th-century saint who brought Christianity to Georgia.
- Take part in a wine tasting at KTW Wine Factory and learn about Georgia’s 8000-year-old wine-making tradition in clay qvevris.
- Return to Tbilisi with a warm heart and perhaps a bottle or two of local wine.
- Wrap up the day with shared stories, playful games, and dancing under the stars.

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description:
- After breakfast, check out of your hotel.
- Bid farewell to your fellow travellers and transfer to Tbilisi International Airport for your journey back home or extend your adventure and discover more of the Caucasus.
*Drop time: 2 PM

itinerary.title: Arrival in Langkawi & Sunset at Pantai Cenang
itinerary.description:
- Arrive at Langkawi and self transfer to your hotel, nestled amidst palm-lined streets and island charm.
- After settling in, step out for your first Malaysian evening at Pantai Cenang, Langkawi’s most happening beach.
- As the sun begins to dip, the sky turns orange and the beach comes alive with music, volleyball, laughter, and the scent of grilled seafood.
- Explore the night market, sip on a chilled coconut, try fresh satay or mee goreng, and let the island rhythm set the tone for your trip.
- Overnight stay in Langkawi.
**Langkawi at a glance:**
A cluster of 99 islands in the Andaman Sea, Langkawi is known for its laid-back vibe, scenic beaches, and nature escapes, the perfect tropical starting point.

itinerary.title: Oriental Village, SkyCab & SkyBridge Adventure
itinerary.description:
- Post-breakfast, head to the charming Oriental Village, a vibrant complex of shops, food stalls, and attractions set against a lake and hills.
- From here, board the Langkawi SkyCab, one of the steepest cable cars in the world, for an epic ride up Gunung Mat Cincang.
- At the top, walk across the dramatic SkyBridge, a curved glass-bottom suspension bridge offering 360° views of jungle, sea, and sky.
- Round off the day with a visit to the 3D Art Museum, filled with interactive illusions and quirky backdrops perfect for fun photo ops.
- Return to your stay and wind down with a quiet dinner or beachside stroll.
- Overnight stay in Langkawi.

itinerary.title: Travel to Penang & Street Art Walk in George Town
itinerary.description:
- Check out and head towards Penang, crossing over to the island by ferry or road. Upon arrival, check into your hotel in the heart of George Town, a UNESCO World Heritage city buzzing with creativity.
- After lunch, join a guided walking tour to explore the city’s famous murals, steel art installations, colonial architecture, and charming shophouses.
- You’ll spot works by world-renowned artists like Ernest Zacharevic and learn the stories behind Penang’s cultural melting pot.
- As night falls, visit Red Garden Food Paradise, a bustling hawker centre where you can dig into Penang Laksa, Char Kway Teow, Hokkien Mee, and much more.
- Later, stroll through the beachside night market, packed with handmade souvenirs, colourful batik, and local delights.
- Overnight stay in Penang.
**Penang at a glance:**
Often called Malaysia’s cultural capital, Penang is a canvas of street art, heritage mansions, spice-laden food, and coastal breeze. Its capital, George Town, is a living gallery where every alley tells a story, through murals, food, or folklore. With its creative energy and old-world charm, Penang is a place you feel more than just see.

itinerary.title: Penang to Kuala Lumpur
itinerary.description:
- Have breakfast and check out for a road trip to Kuala Lumpur, the capital city of Malaysia.
- The journey takes you from coastal calm to metropolitan magic, passing by rolling hills and bustling towns.
- Arrive in Kuala Lumpur, check into your stay, and spend the rest of the day at your own pace, explore a neighbourhood café, rest, or step out to see KL lit up at night.
- Overnight stay in Kuala Lumpur.
**Kuala Lumpur at a glance:**
A city of striking contrasts, Kuala Lumpur is where futuristic skyscrapers brush shoulders with colonial buildings and colourful temples. With food streets that never sleep, shopping that fits every budget, and cultural gems hidden in every lane, KL is a vibrant blend of tradition and modernity, always buzzing, always photogenic.

itinerary.title: Iconic KL Tour & Petronas Photo Stop
itinerary.description:
- Start your day with breakfast before heading out for a classic Kuala Lumpur city tour.
- Visit some of the city’s iconic spots, including the Petronas Twin Towers for a stunning photo stop (entry ticket not included).
- Admire KL’s blend of tradition and modernity, from colonial architecture and lush parks to glitzy malls and buzzing streets.
- You might pass by Merdeka Square, the National Mosque, and the Kuala Lumpur Tower during your tour.
- Spend the evening exploring Bukit Bintang, KL’s entertainment district, or dive into street eats at Jalan Alor.
- Overnight stay in Kuala Lumpur.

itinerary.title: Genting Highlands & Batu Caves Day Trip
itinerary.description:
- After breakfast, set off for a full-day excursion to Genting Highlands, perched 1,800 metres above sea level.
- Stop first at the vibrant Batu Caves, a Hindu temple built inside a limestone hill, known for its rainbow-coloured staircase and golden statue of Lord Murugan.
- Then, ride the Awana Skyway cable car through misty rainforest to reach the Highlands.
- Here, explore an indoor wonderland of theme parks, shopping arcades, casinos, and attractions like Ripley’s Believe It or Not, Haunted Adventure, or Zombie Outbreak (Tickets extra chargeable).
- Return to KL by evening, with stories of clouds, caves, and crazy rides.
- Overnight stay in Kuala Lumpur.

itinerary.title: Farewell, Malaysia
itinerary.description:
- Enjoy your final breakfast in Kuala Lumpur.
- Later, say your goodbyes with a group hug, reel-worthy photo dumps, and a bag full of memories, souvenirs, and maybe a little sambal sauce.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Port Blair (Sri Vijaya Puram)
itinerary.description:
- Reach Port Blair, aka Sri Vijaya Puram and check in at Zostel Port Blair, a chill pad for all island lovers.
- Dive into history with a guided tour of Cellular Jail, unravelling tales of India’s freedom struggle.
- End the day with the iconic Light and Sound Show at Cellular Jail and a visit to Corbyn’s Cove Beach for a serene sunset.
- Head back to the hostel for a welcoming session with indoor games and chichats.
**Port Blair (Sri Vijaya Puram) at a glance:**
The capital of the Andaman Islands, Port Blair, is a blend of colonial history and natural beauty. Highlights include the iconic Cellular Jail, serene Corbyn’s Cove Beach, and bustling local markets offering a taste of island life. It also serves as the gateway to exploring the enchanting Andaman archipelago.

itinerary.title: Port Blair to Havelock Island (Swaraj Dweep)
itinerary.description:
- After a wholesome breakfast, take a ferry to Havelock Island, where golden sands and lush greenery await.
- Check in at our partnered resort, and get ready to just chill in paradise.
- Spend the day soaking in the beauty of Radhanagar Beach, acclaimed for its stunning sunsets.
- After exploring the island, return to the resort for an eventful evening and a relaxing overnight sleep.
**Havelock Island at a glance:**
Famed for its world-class beaches, Havelock Island is a tropical gem offering white sandy shores, crystal-clear waters, and dense mangroves. Must-visit spots include Radhanagar Beach for sunsets and Elephant Beach for its vibrant coral reefs and water sports.

itinerary.title: Exploring Havelock
itinerary.description:
- Have a filling breakfast at the resort and get ready for another adventurous day.
- Dive into the scenic waters of Elephant Beach and enjoy snorkelling, along with a variety of water sports.
- Visit the tranquil Vijaynagar and Kalapathar Beach, perfect for photography and unwinding amidst nature.
**Elephant Beach at a glance:l**
Renowned for its water activities, Elephant Beach is a hotspot for snorkelling, seawalking, and kayaking. Its shallow waters and vibrant marine life make it perfect for beginners and experienced snorkellers alike. Meanwhile, the serene surroundings provide the perfect setting to relax in nature.

itinerary.title: Havelock to Neil Island (Shaheed Dweep)
itinerary.description:
- After a delish breakfast, take a ferry to Neil Island to explore its tranquil charm.
- Discover the natural rock formation at Laxmanpur Beach, followed by a sunset to remember.
- End the night with chilling over games, music, and lots of chitchat.
**Neil Island at a glance:**
Neil Island offers pristine beaches, rich coral reefs, and a laid-back vibe. Popular attractions include the Natural Bridge, Laxmanpur Beach for sunsets, and Bharatpur Beach for water sports.

itinerary.title: Bharatpur Beach & return to Port Blair
itinerary.description:
- Start the day with a nutritious breakfast. And then head out for snorkelling or a glass-bottom boat ride at Bharatpur Beach, famous for its crystal-clear waters.
- Return to Port Blair and check in at Zostel Port Blair.
- Later, step out to explore local markets or nearby attractions.
**Bharatpur Beach at a glance:**
A haven for underwater enthusiasts, Bharatpur Beach is renowned for its shallow, turquoise waters and vibrant coral reefs. It’s perfect for snorkelling, glass-bottom boat rides, and soaking in stunning views of marine life. The beach’s gentle waves make it ideal for families and first-time swimmers.

itinerary.title: Ross Island & Mount Harriet National Park
itinerary.description: - Start your day with a hearty breakfast at the hostel. - Take a ferry to Ross Island, the once administrative hub of the British, now a picturesque ruin enveloped by lush greenery. - Explore Mount Harriet National Park, known for its panoramic views of the Andaman Sea and nature trails. - Return to Zostel Port Blair for a relaxed evening. **Ross Island at a glance:** Once the administrative headquarters of the British in the Andaman, Ross Island is now a peaceful retreat featuring colonial ruins, overgrown pathways, and a small sanctuary, home to deer and peacocks. The remnants of churches, bungalows, and offices add a haunting charm to its lush greenery.

itinerary.title: Last day in the Andaman Islands
itinerary.description: - Relish the last breakfast with your tripmates and the last morning in the Andaman before departing with cherished memories.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bagdogra and transfer to Phuentsholing
itinerary.description:
- Arrive at Bagdogra Airport at 10 am and meet your tripmates and trip leader. After warm greetings, by 12 PM transfer to Phuentsholing, it is the 2nd largest town in the country with a perfect amount of nature’s touch.
- Check in at a partnered hotel and enjoy a filling dinner with your newfound friends. Spend the night in Phuentsholing.
**Phuentsholing at a glance:**
Sharing its border with West Bengal, Phuentsholing is the second-largest town in Bhutan. It is the gateway to Bhutan’s wondrous pleasures, and hence, many different communities call it home.

itinerary.title: Phuentsholing to Thimphu
itinerary.description:
- Start your day with a hearty breakfast at the hotel. Later, complete the immigration formalities.
- Now, you’re all set to explore Bhutan. Start with driving to Kharbandi Gompa, one of the oldest monasteries in the country.
- Later, continue your journey to Thimphu, Bhutan’s mini-metropolis. On your way, explore the picturesque villages of Gedu, Chukha, and Chuzom.
- When you reach Thimphu, check in at a partnered hotel in the evening. Chill with your tripmates, enjoy community games, and relish a filling dinner. Spend the night in Thimphu.
**Thimphu at a glance:**
An expanding town of ornate monasteries, chalet-like housing societies, and shopping complexes, Thimphu is a mini-metropolis of Bhutan. Proximity to a blue pine forest keeps the town’s scenic beauty on a high.

itinerary.title: Sightseeing around Thimphu
itinerary.description:
- Have a filling breakfast at the hotel and get ready to explore Thimphu.
- Visit the Buddha Dordenma Statue (Buddha Viewpoint), Simply Bhutan Living Museum, Sangay Gang Viewpoint, Handicraft market and Postal Museum (if time permits).
- Return to the hotel by evening. The rest of the evening is free for leisure. We recommend you immerse yourself in Thimphu’s eclectic nightlife. Spend the night in Thimphu

itinerary.title: Thimphu to Punakha
itinerary.description:
- Relish a delicious breakfast at the hotel and prepare for an amazing journey to Paro.
- Hike to Chimi Lhakang. Located on a round hillock, the Temple of Fertility offers a fantastic view of Punakha Valley.
- Next, visit Punakha Dzong, and walk on the longest Suspension Bridge in Bhutan.
- You can also enjoy River rafting in Punakha (at your own cost) if time permits.
- Return to the hotel for another amazing evening with your newfound friends and a community dinner.
**Punakha at a glance:**
Primarily famous for housing a towering Dzong or castle in its vicinity, Punakha was once the capital of Bhutan. With 2 gentle rivers flowing across the town, and forested hills all around, Punakha is a little wonder waiting to be explored.

itinerary.title: Punakha to Paro
itinerary.description:
- Post breakfast, leave for a scenic drive to Paro, and check in at a partnered hotel.
- Later, visit National Museum of Bhutan, Rinpung Dzong, Kyichu Lhakhang, and Paro airport Viewpoint.
- Next, try Gho and Kira, traditional dresses of Bhutan at a local shop. Evening is free for leisure. We recommend visiting Druk Choeding or Drukgyel Dzong.
- Head back to the hotel for dinner and to chill with your tripmates.
**Paro at a glance:**
One of the best Bhutanese towns to explore on foot, Paro is a charming town located on the banks of Paro Chhu. The main street of the town is the place to be, which is lined with colourful wooden shopfronts and restaurants. When you’re done exploring its main attractions, take an hour or two stroll around the town.

itinerary.title: Sightseeing around Paro
itinerary.description:
- After a filling breakfast at the hotel, leave for a rewarding hike to Tiger Nest Temple. Perched on a rock, this temple overlooks a sheer drop and clings seemingly impossibly to a cliff of rock at 900 m above the valley floor.
- If time permits, go for a Hot Stone Bath session. It is a traditional Bhutanese bath in which hot stones and Menchu, medicinal water, are used. The evening is for leisure.
- Return to the hotel and spend the night in Paro after a wholesome dinner.

itinerary.title: Paro to Phuentsholing
itinerary.description:
- Wake up to a hearty breakfast at the hotel and enjoy a picturesque journey to Phuentsholing and complete the exit formalities when you reach.
- Check in at a partnered hotel and enjoy the last night in Bhutan with your friends and trip leader over a delicious dinner. Spend the night in Phuentsholing.

itinerary.title: Phuentsholing to Bagdogra
itinerary.description:
- Have a final breakfast at the hotel and drive to Bagdogra Airport for your onward journey.
- The trip ends here with lots of see you soons and heartfelt goodbyes.
**Note:** From Phuentsholing to Bagdogra, it takes around 4 hours for the journey. So, we recommend that you book your flights or trains after 3 pm.

itinerary.title: Delhi to Bir
itinerary.description:
- The journey kickstarts at the pre-decided pickup point.
- Board a Volvo bus to Bir for a comfy overnight journey by 8-9 pm.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bir | Culture & Comfort
itinerary.description:
- Arrival and check-in at Zostel Homes, Bir.
- Freshen up and enjoy a leisurely breakfast.
- Guided village tour hike, offering insights into local life and traditions.
- Authentic Dhaam lunch at a 100 years old mudhouse, served in Himachali style.
- Evening sunset experience with freshly brewed coffee.
- Live music & bonfire under the stars.
- Dinner & overnight stay in Bir.

itinerary.title: Bir to Billing via Chainna Pass | Ridge & Views
itinerary.description:
- Breakfast at the property.
- Scenic drive to Chainna Pass via Billing, with panoramic mountain views.
- Check-in at Zostel Homes, Billing.
- Guided hike to Hanumangad/Devdarh/Ruling village (subject to weather & trail conditions).
- Lunch at the property or en route.
- Bonfire (weather permitting) & dinner, soaking in the high-altitude silence followed by star gazing experience (weather permitting).
- Overnight stay in Billing.

itinerary.title: Billing to Rajgundha | Valleys & Waterfalls
itinerary.description:
- Breakfast with views of the Dhauladhar range.
- Transfer to the remote and scenic Rajgundha Valley.
- Riverside lunch amidst untouched landscapes.
- Guided waterfall hike, exploring forest trails and hidden cascades.
- Leisure time to unwind by the river or explore the village.
- Overnight stay at Zostel Homes, Rajgundha.

itinerary.title: Paragliding & Monastic Trail | Departure
itinerary.description:
- Breakfast at the property.
- Transfer to the paragliding take off site at Billing.
- Experience a Prime Paragliding Flight, soaring from Billing to Bir (weather permitting).
- Post-flight monastic tour, visiting local monasteries and meditation centers.
- Begin return journey to Delhi, marking the end of the experience.

itinerary.title: Arrival back to Delhi
itinerary.description:
- Deboard the bus at Majnu ka Tila/Kashmere gate. This is where the trip ends with lots of see you soons for the next adventure.
Usually arriving time in Delhi by 9 am. Advisable to book afternoon flight.

itinerary.title: Arrival at Srinagar & sightseeing
itinerary.description:
- At 11 am, meet and greet fellow travellers at Srinagar Airport.
- Check in at the Partner stay.
- In the evening, take a soothing walk and Shikara Ride at Dal Lake. It is one of the most relaxing and rewarding activities in this itinerary.
- Later, explore Srinagar's local markets and cafes, and head back to the hostel.
- End your night with a filling dinner, lots of conversations, and fun with your newfound friends.
## Srinagar at a glance: Encircled by an arc of green and white mountains, Srinagar is Kashmir’s greatest drawcard. The mesmerising Dal Lake, on which stationary houseboats and shikaras add a riot of colours and a unique offering of romantic chillouts. Apart from the lake, the city boasts charming Mughal Gardens, central-Asian-styled bazaars, soulful Sufi shrines, and many fascinating fortresses.

itinerary.title: Day trip to Sonmarg
itinerary.description:
- After breakfast at the hotel, leave for a day trip to Srinagar.
- En route, take a halt at Sindh River Valley, and gaze at towering mountains and pristine lakes.
- Upon reaching Sonmarg, take a pony ride (extra chargeable) to Tahjiwas Glacier. It remains covered in snow throughout the year, so be prepared to snow fight with your newfound friends.
- If the time permits and the group agrees, you can visit Zojila Pass at an additional cost.
- In the evening, return to your stay at Srinagar for another night of games, talks, and a wholesome community dinner.
## Sonmarg at a glance: Deriving its name from the yellow crocus flower that covers its landscape in cool summer months, Sonmarg is blessed with a backdrop of snowy mountains and gushing tributary Sindh.

itinerary.title: Srinagar to Gulmarg
itinerary.description:
- Have a hearty breakfast. Then, get ready for a scenic journey to Gulmarg.
- Reach Gulmarg by evening and check in at a partnered homestay. Then, take a thrilling gondola ride. This must-try activity is Asia’s largest and the world’s second-largest cable car. There’s a high chance that you might see snowfall in Gulmarg.
*NOTE: Gondola ride tickets are subject to availability. In the event of ticket unavailability, Zostel will not be held liable. We will make every effort to provide you with an alternate option.*
- Afterwards, you can explore Strawberry Valley and Maharaja Palace by ponies at an additional cost.
- Indulge in a lively evening over indoor games, conversations, and delicious Kashmiri dinner.
## Your day at a glance: Today, you can try the 2 phases of the gondola ride. Phase 1 starts from the Gulmarg base to Kongdori Hill (2600 m), and Phase 2 starts from Kondogri Hill to the shoulder of Apharwat Peak. The panoramic mountain covered in snow and valley views from the cable car will leave you speechless.

itinerary.title: Gulmarg to Pahalgam
itinerary.description:
- Enjoy a delicious breakfast at the homestay and get ready for a scenic journey to Pahalgam with breaks at Awantipora Ruins and Saffron Fields at Pampore.
- Once here, check in at Zostel Pahalgam and freshen up.
- In the evening, take a soothing stroll around Kashmir’s Shepherd Valley, which is made lush by the Lidder River.
## Pahalgam at a glance: An all-time favourite of travellers, Pahalgam boasts a poetic landscape encompassing stunning valleys, rewarding treks, and forested mountains. While exploring, you will come across rolling meadows, clear lakes, trout-filled streams, and mighty glaciers that fill the rivers below.

itinerary.title: Sightseeing around Pahalgam
itinerary.description:
- Enjoy a hearty breakfast at the Zostel Pahalgam and get ready to explore the beautiful valley.
- Visit Chandanwari and the stunning valleys of Aru and Betaab by the local union taxi. Here, you can visit Baisaran and Dabyan Valleys by ponies at an additional cost.
- By evening, head back to the hostel and have an amazing dinner.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam to Srinagar
itinerary.description:
- After breakfast, check out from the stay and leave for Srinagar.
- Later, visit Shankaracharya Temple, Hazratbal Shrine, and Shalimar Bagh in Srinagar. This tour will give you a glimpse into the olden sites of Srinagar, laden with rustic wooden buildings and decades-old merchant shops.
- In the evening, check in at Partner stay in Srinagar. Enjoy a happening evening with fellow travellers over games, bonfire, and delicious Kashmiri dinner.

itinerary.title: Departure from Srinagar
itinerary.description:
- In the morning, relish a final breakfast with fellow travellers and the trip guide.
- Check out from stay in Srinagar and bid farewell to everyone with promises of meeting them on other adventures. The trip ends here with wonderful memories for life.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Hanoi
itinerary.description:
- Arrive at Hanoi Airport and grab a taxi by yourself to our comfy partnered hotel.
- Meet & greet with your fellow adventurers and the trip leader.
- For the rest of the day, you can relax at the hotel. After resting, step out to get to know the vibrant Hanoi City as you like. You can explore Hanoi’s oldest neighbourhoods at the Old Quarter, try authentic Vietnamese coffee at the cafes, and check out the Hanoi night market.
- In the evening, take a walking tour to Cathedral, Train Street, Beer Street, Hoan Kiem Lake, and the market for shopping & pub crawl.
- Back at the hotel, swim at the outdoor pool, hit the on-site bar, and head to the rooftop to relax with a view. Enjoy a fun evening with your newfound crew before you call it a night.
**Hanoi at a glance:**
Settled by the Red River, Hanoi, the capital of Vietnam, is known as one of the most ancient cities in the world. It is home to timeless architecture, old pagodas, and numerous museums that give visitors a glimpse into Vietnam’s multicultural past. For entertainment, the lit cafe scene, cool art galleries, and traditional bazaars will have you hooked.

itinerary.title: Hanoi to Tam Coc
itinerary.description:
- Wake up to a wholesome breakfast and get ready to leave for Tam Coc, a town known for its lush greenery, Karstic rock formations, and copious limestone caves.
- Arrive at the Mua Cave. From here, you will be hiking to the top of the rugged and majestic Ngoa Long Mountain. The summit is the perfect spot to catch spectacular views of the valley and rice fields. And at the foot of the mountain, you’ll find a picturesque lotus pond.
- Stop for a quick Indian lunch. Post meal, leave for Trang An Grottoes, a picturesque group of mountains that houses magical valleys, beautiful freshwater ponds, and lush jungles.
- Come evening, go for a cycling ride around Tam Coc to indulge in its countryside charm.
- Later, make your way to the partnered accommodation for a restful sleep and call it a day.
**Tam Coc at a glance:**
About 101 km from Hanoi, Tam Coc is famed for its complex & exquisite cave networks and temples amidst the tranquil limestone outcrops. The best way to explore its charms is through a calm rowing boat ride.

itinerary.title: Tam Coc to Ha Long Bay to Hanoi
itinerary.description:
- Kickstart your day with a warm and delicious breakfast. Then, leave for Halong Bay, known for its magnificent islands, cerulean shores, and otherworldly caves. Also, awaiting you here is an unforgettable 5-star luxury cruise experience.
- By noon, board the cruise and enjoy welcome drinks as you embark on your voyage. Enjoy a decadent spread for lunchtime at the restaurant as you sail by majestic Chicken Rock and Finger Islet, which are named after their appearance.
- Disembark from the cruise by early afternoon to explore the mystical Surprise Cave, one of the biggest caves in Halong Bay. Stop by Titop Island, famed for its crescent-shaped shorelines, to try swimming in the jade waters and enjoy rejuvenating hikes across nature.
- In the evening, head towards Hanoi and check in at partnered accommodation. Spend the night in Hanoi.
**Halong Bay at a glance:**
Halong Bay is situated about a 3-hour scenic drive from Tam Coc. Covered by lush greenery, lofty limestone structures, floating villages, and petite islets, Halong Bay is a true masterpiece of nature. It is especially popular for cruise trips, boat rides, kayaking, and caving experiences.

itinerary.title: Hanoi to Hoi An
itinerary.description:
- Begin your day with a nutritious breakfast before leaving for Hanoi Airport to catch a flight to Da Nang. Upon arrival in Da Nang, you will be transferred to Hoi An.
- Check in at the partnered hotel, step out on a walking tour of the night market and ride a lantern boat riverside near the Japanese bridge.
- Return to the hotel, indulge in social activities, and call it a night.
**Hoi An at a glance:**
Among Asia’s oldest cities, Hoi An is a beguiling port city in Vietnam, about ~42 km from Da Nang city. By virtue of being an essential trading port, Hoi An houses a multicultural charm resounding in its local cuisine and architecture. Settled on the banks of the Thu Bon River, you’ll be met with a number of traditional Vietnamese boats or Sampans, meandering past the city.

itinerary.title: Coconut Village tour
itinerary.description:
- Start your day with a delicious breakfast at the hotel and prepare to explore the city.
- Later, drive to Cam Thanh Village for an adventurous basketboat ride around the coconut forests. Known for its vast and picturesque palm-coconut plantations, this Village is home to a number of crabs, shrimps, and fish.
- Get a glimpse into the fishermen’s lifestyle, partake in a fun basketboat race with some music, and get natural ornaments made of coconut leaves. As you get to know the locals, try your hand at casting net and learn how to paddle traditional basket boats.
- Back to the hotel by afternoon.
- The rest of the day is free for leisure. With its rich history and graceful charms, Hoi An is Vietnam’s most delightful town, and you can explore it.
- Return to the hotel when you have had your fill of Hoi An. Spend the night in Hoi An.

itinerary.title: Hoi An to Da Nang
itinerary.description:
- After your breakfast, leave for a comfy journey to Da Nang, a city of bridges and beaches.
- On your way, visit Marble Mountains, a group of five limestone peaks. Later, check out Lady Buddha, a 67-meter-tall statue of the Goddess of Mercy.
- Check in at the partnered hotel and freshen up. Then, step out to explore Da Nang’s vibrant night market and shop your heart out.
- Return to the hotel after a long haul of shopping. Spend the night in Da Nang.
**Da Nang at a glance:**
Da Nang is dubbed as the city of bridges and beaches. Days here are perfect for exploring iconic sights like the Marble Mountains, ancient Pagodas, and world-class architecture. Meanwhile, the beaches add another edge to the city, with numerous water adventure activities and sports to try. Moreover, the eclectic nightlife is a must-try experience with its spectacular night markets and party scenes.

itinerary.title: Bana Hills and Dragon Bridge tour
itinerary.description:
- Begin your day with a nutritious breakfast before heading out to explore the city.
- The first stop of the day is Ba Na Hills, a popular tourist spot known for its fantasy park, several stunning landmarks, and Guinness record-holding cable cars.
- Here, take a scenic cable car ride to Ba Na Hills Station. Visit the Vong Nguyet hills, Linh Ung Pagoda with a 27 m-long Buddha statue, and the Old Villas of the French. Ride the cable car to the majestic Nui Chua Mountain, the very top of Ba Na Hills. Pay a visit to the Nginh Phong Top, Le Nim Villas, and Orchid Garden while here.
- A funicular train ride uphill will bring you to Debay Ancient Wine Cellar, an old French cellar, and Le Jardin D’amour, the Ba Na Love Flower Garden.
- Next, head to Dragon Bridge for a hip and happening light, fire, and water show.
- Return to the accommodation and spend the night in Da Nang.

itinerary.title: Last Day in Vietnam
itinerary.description:
- Start the last day with a final breakfast with your newfound crew and trip leader.
- The trip ends here with lots of see you soons and heartfelt goodbyes.
- Grab a taxi to head to the airport or extend your stay in Vietnam.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kochi & day trip
itinerary.description:
- Meet and greet your trip leader at Kochi airport at 10:30 am and head towards Zostel Kochi (Ernakulam). Located amid a vibrant colonial street, our hostel offers a comfy space to meet new travellers.
- After a while, step out to explore Kochi in its true essence by visiting the Folklore Museum, Jew Town, Jewish Synagogue, Dutch Palace, St. Francis Church, Santa Cruz Basilica, Fort Kochi Beach, and Chinese Fishing Nets. Note: We will try to cover as many spots as possible.
- The evening is free for a leisurely time at the hostel, or you can visit the urban side of Kochi, which is Ernakulam. Here, you can go on a shopping spree at lavish malls or check out iconic cafes.
- Return to the hostel for a night full of games, conversations, and all things Zostel.
- Have a wholesome dinner because it’s time to hit the hay.
**Kochi at a glance:**
Located on a wide estuary by the Arabian Sea, Kochi is an ancient hub of explorers, traders, and travellers. It is the only place in the whole country where you can witness an amalgamation of 500-year-old synagogues, Chinese fishing nets, ancient mosques, remnants of the British Empire, and Dutch and Portuguese-era houses.

itinerary.title: Kochi to Munnar
itinerary.description:
- Wake up to a hearty breakfast and get ready for a comfy journey to Munnar. South India’s largest tea-growing region, Munnar, is an emerald-green hill station that you will explore today.
- Before reaching Munnar, check out Cheeyappara Falls, Valara Falls, and spice gardens.
- By afternoon, reach partnered stay and check in. Situated in the serene outskirts of Munnar, this hostel treats you to warm meals and jazzy vibes.
- In the evening, gather around for a wholesome dinner and a fun-filled evening.
**Munnar at a glance:**
Situated in the low Western Ghats, Munnar and its rolling hills are no less than a paradise in Kerala. Oftentimes, you will find yourself up above the clouds watching carpets of mist clinging to the green hills.

itinerary.title: Day trip around Munnar
itinerary.description:
- Start your day early at 4 am for an adventurous Jeep Safari to Kolukkumalai Hills (at your own expenses). It’s green, serene, and home to the highest tea plantations in the world.
- Return to the hostel to freshen up and for a delicious breakfast.
- Later, head out to explore Echo Point, Kundala Lake, Kundala Dam, Mattupetty Lake & Mattupetty Dam, Top Station, Carmelagiri Elephant Park (Elephant Ride), Munnar Tea Gardens, and Tea Museum & Factory.
- Return to the hostel for dinner and overnight stay.
**Your day at a glance:**
While exploring lush tea gardens and sloping green hills, you will find why Munnar is a top pick amongst travellers and backpackers. And when you visit the places we have picked for you, mist-covered hills, a fresh scent of spices, and an alluring scenery will take over your senses.

itinerary.title: Munnar to Alleppey
itinerary.description:
- Have a hearty breakfast at the hostel, and prepare for a scenic journey along the coastline to Alleppey. Home to a vast network of waterways, Alleppey is a hub of Keralan backwaters.
- Check in at stay in Alleppey and relax in the colourful common area, on the sprawling rooftop, or at quirky corners around the hostel.
- Later, step out to ride a shikara at serene backwaters, and explore Alleppey Beach, Lighthouse, and Floating Bazaar. Expect a brilliant orange and pink sunset from the beach, a splendid view of the Arabian Sea from the lighthouse, and local delicacies at Floating Bazaar.
- Return to the hostel to chill with your newfound friends over a filling dinner.
**Alleppey at a glance:**
Alleppey, aka Allapuzha, is heaven for backpackers. With its vast network of waterways, natural abundance, and unparalleled local food, this watertown in Kerala will enchant you at once.

itinerary.title: Alleppey to Varkala
itinerary.description:
- After breakfast, start a comfy journey to one of the finest beach towns in India, Varkala.
- En route, explore Munroe Islands, which is an archipelago of eight tiny islands. Here, you can try kayaking or canoeing in the backwaters.
- In the afternoon, check in at Zostel Varkala/similar. Surrounded by coconut trees, with a vast blue sea in front, our hostel is as scenic as this beach town.
- After a while, head out to explore the only cliff beach in Kerala, Varkala Beach and Cliff. Lined up with shacks, shrouded by swaying palms, and a cliff to watch surreal sunsets, this beach will be the highlight of your trip for sure.
- Head back to the hostel for another night of games, conversations, and delicious food.
**Varkala at a glance:**
The sweet scent of incense sticks, dreamy views of the Arabian Sea, and hip music in the air on its boulevard, that’s how you can describe the lesser-known beach town of Kerala. Apart from visiting the only cliff beach in the state, you can spot butterflies, try Yoga on its beaches, and go on nature hikes.

itinerary.title: Day trip around Varkala
itinerary.description:
- You can start your day with an early morning surfing session at your expense or have a hearty breakfast at the hostel.
- Later, head out to visit Jatayu Earth’s Centre Nature Park. The giant statue here symbolises the protection of women and their honour and safety.
- In the evening, we recommend you visit the Varkala flea market for shopping and to try local food.
- Return to the hostel in the evening. It’s your last night in Kerala, so make the most of it by indulging in indoor games and chat sessions.
**Your day at a glance:**
Today is a special day because you will be learning to surf on one of Kerala’s finest beaches. Later on, we planned a day trip to a man-made marvel in the midst of nature. It’s the best of both worlds, Zostelers.

itinerary.title: Departure to Trivandrum Airport
itinerary.description:
- After a final breakfast with your travel companions, it's time for an onward journey. It's a scenic journey along the coast, so don’t forget to put on good music and check out the amazing views.
- The trip ends at Trivandrum Airport with lots of memories, and see you soons on more adventures.
Note: From Varkala to Trivandrum, it takes around 3 hours for the journey. So, we recommend that you book your flights or trains after 3 pm.

itinerary.title: Overnight Journey from Bangalore
itinerary.description:
- Your Chikkamagaluru weekend trip kicks off from Zo house Koramangala with a night drive through the highway’s calm.
- Meet your trip leads, settle into your seats, and let the playlist and conversations roll. The city lights will fade, and soon, the scent of coffee and cool breeze will take over.
**Pickup time: Approx 11:00 PM**

itinerary.title: Chikkamagaluru Sightseeing
itinerary.description:
- Arrive in Chikkamagaluru just as the hills wake up. Check into your cosy Zostel-curated stay, freshen up, and gear up for a full day of exploring.
- First stop: Mullayanagiri Peak, the highest in Karnataka. Breathe in the mist, stretch your legs, and let the views soak your soul.
- Then, head to Jhari Falls, hidden in a dense forest and reached via a bumpy but fun jeep ride. Feel the splash, click a few dreamy photos, or just lie back and listen.
- End the day at the mystical Bababudangiri hills, steeped in spiritual legends and surrounded by clouds.
- Return to your stay by evening, tuck into a hearty dinner, and share stories under the stars.
**Chikkamagaluru at a glance:**
A green getaway famous for its coffee estates, winding ghats, and misty viewpoints. It’s where time slows down, and nature takes over.

itinerary.title: Chikkamagaluru Sightseeing & return to Bangalore
itinerary.description:
- Start your morning with a relaxed wake-up, followed by breakfast amidst the peaceful surroundings.
- Later, visit the Yagachi backwaters, ideal for chilling, kayaking, or just soaking up the breeze.
