- Before heading back, step into history at the Belur Temple, a Hoysala architectural masterpiece that still echoes with ancient chants.
- Wrap up the weekend with a scenic drive back to Bangalore. You’ll be dropped off at Zo house Koramangala by night, with tired legs, full hearts, and your phone gallery packed.
**Drop time: Approx 10:00 PM**

itinerary.title: Delhi to Aut 🚌
itinerary.description:
- The journey kickstarts at the pre-decided pickup point (Kashmere gate/majnu ka tilla) at around 6:45 PM.
- Board a Volvo bus to Aut for a comfy overnight journey.

itinerary.title: Aut to Shoja 🚕
itinerary.description:
- Deboard at Aut and hop on a local transfer to Shoja, a serene valley nestled among forested mountains🌲.
- Check in at Zostel Shoja (Note: Property check-in time : 12-1 PM), where scenic beauty and a quiet, meditative air awaits.
- Freshen up and Later, step out to explore Shoja and Jibhi.
- Explore Jibhi Waterfall and head back to the hostel for a community dinner over a bonfire and a restful night’s sleep.
**Shoja at a glance:**
Amidst the fresh mountain air, laced with oak, deodar, and rhododendrons emerges Shoja, a laid-back mountain village in Tirthan Valley. Located 7 km from Jibhi, the village awakens with the murmur of streams and the chirping of unseen birds.

itinerary.title: Serolsar Lake excursion
itinerary.description:
- Wake up to a delicious breakfast at the hostel and head to the mighty Jalori Pass for a pleasant hike to Serolsar Lake (~5 hrs). Walk through verdant forests, check out 360-degree views, and pay homage to the Budhi Nagin Temple.
- As per legend, birds around Serolsar Lake never let leaves or sticks float on the lake. True or not, the lake looks out of this world in winter, covered in snow.
- In the evening, return to the hostel for a night full of games, conversations, and dancing the night away.
- Have a community dinner and spend the night in Shoja.

itinerary.title: Hike to Raghpur Fort and back to Delhi🚶
itinerary.description:
- Start your day with a filling breakfast and get ready for another adventure into the wild.
- Today, you are going to Raghupur Fort, a ~3 km hike from Jalori Pass. En route, enjoy mindblowing Crystal Mountain views and other famous peaks.
- Return to the hostel for a return journey to Delhi.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Delhi
itinerary.description: Reach Delhi in the morning around 7 am with unforgettable memories of your Tirthan trip.

itinerary.title: Arrival and transportation to Bomdila via Bhairabkund
itinerary.description:
- At 8:30 am, meet and greet the trip leader and fellow travellers at the Guwahati Railway Station.
- Following the meet-up, begin a comfortable and scenic ride to Bomdila, with unparalleled valley and mountain views at your disposal. Apart from the mountain goodness, this scenic town is also known for its art and craft.
- Mid-way, stop for a lunch break near Bhairabkund. Owing to its calmness and serenity, Bhairabkund is a popular picnic spot along the Indo-Bhutan border.
- Once you reach Bomdila, check in at a partnered homestay. Take a well-earned rest or go out for an evening walk.
- At night, enjoy a filling dinner. Before calling it a night, you can unwind with your newfound friends and gaze at a starry sky.
## Bomdila at glance: Also known as the ‘Himalaya’s Veranda’, Bomdila offers a visual treat to its visitors. Apart from pleasant weather and cool breezes, the hill town has plenty of spots and trekking opportunities to keep you busy throughout your visit.

itinerary.title: Bomdila to Tawang via Sela Pass
itinerary.description:
- Get ready for another day of adventure with a hearty breakfast at the homestay.
- Start your journey to Tawang, the birthplace of the 6th Dalai Lama, with breaks for sightseeing and lunch.
- Around the afternoon, stop to click some pictures and unwind near Sela Pass. One of the most heavenly places in the Himalayan Vista, Sela Pass remains covered in snow throughout the year. So expect some snowballs coming your way.
- Visit Jaswant War Memorial in the evening. Overlooking the scenic Tawang-Chu Valley, the war memorial is a 40-foot colourful structure dedicated to the martyrs of the Indo-Sino War of 1962.
- As the sun begins to set, reach Tawang and check in at a partnered homestay.
- End the day with a wholesome dinner over fun conversations.
## Tawang at a glance: Known for many important monasteries, Tawang has many sceneries on offer to make your trip a picturesque one. Tawang will leave you in awe with its natural beauty wrapped inside spirituality. Apart from visual treats, Tawang also offers unique cuisine to its visitors.

itinerary.title: Day trip and sightseeing in Tawang
itinerary.description:
- Kickstart your day with a warm and delicious breakfast.
- Step out to explore Tawang Monastery, and Buddha Statue with a break for lunch.
- Head to Tawang’s vibrant markets around noontime. You can treat yourself to local snacks or handmade goods.
- Come evening, return to the homestay to rest for a while.
- End the day with a freshly cooked dinner, served with fun conversations.
## Your day at a glance: Tawang Monastery is the second-largest monastery in the world and holds immense religious significance. On the other hand, Buddha Statue is a golden idol of Buddha in a sitting position that is surrounded by his disciples.

itinerary.title: Day trip and sightseeing around Tawang
itinerary.description:
- Wake up to a wholesome breakfast at the homestay and get ready to explore nature burrows around Tawang.
- First, we will take the scenic route to Madhuri Lake. Also known as Sangetsar Lake, the natural body is surrounded by breathtaking rocky mountains.
- Around noon, visit Bumla Pass. A snowbound pass situated at 15,000 feet, Bumla Pass marks the border between Tibet and India, and is known to offer awe-inspiring views of the Tibetan plateau.
- Post noon, start the return journey to the homestay.
- Finally, enjoy a wholesome dinner and call it a night.

itinerary.title: Tawang to Sangti Valley via Dirang
itinerary.description:
- Begin your day with a wholesome breakfast and depart for Sangti Valley.
- At noontime, check out the Dirang Monestary.
- Continue your journey towards Sangti Valley in the evening and check-in at partnered homestay upon arrival.
- Before you call it a night, feast on a heartwarming supper at the homestay.
## Sangti Valley at a glance:
The densely forested valley of Sangti is dotted with meandering rivers. It introduces travellers to the unique culture and traditions of the easternmost region of India. Around the valley, you can spot exotic birds and explore fruit-laden orchards.

itinerary.title: Day hike around Sangti Valley
itinerary.description:
- Post a hearty breakfast at the homestay, step out to hike around the valley. On your hike, you can cover green pastures, cloudy hills, and unique flora and fauna.
- In the afternoon, return to the homestay for a quick lunch.
- Leave for Dirang Chu River, post lunch. While there, chill by its bank and bask in the green and serene vistas.
- By evening, return to the homestay, where a wholesome dinner awaits.

itinerary.title: Sangti Valley to Guwahati
itinerary.description:
- At 9 am, depart for a comfortable return journey to Guwahati.
- Come evening, reach Guwahati. The trip ends here with unforgettable memories, and see you soons!
Note: From Sangti Valley to Guwahati, it takes around 7 hours for the journey. So, we recommend that you book your flights after 6 pm.

itinerary.title: Arrival to Moscow Airport
itinerary.description:
Upon landing at Moscow-Domodedovo Airport, meet your guide at the airport exit for the scheduled group pickup between 3-4 PM. You will be comfortably transferred to your hotel to complete registration and check-in (available from 15:00 hrs). The rest of the evening is completely yours to relax after your flight or begin exploring the nearby neighborhood at your own pace before your overnight stay in Moscow.
Notes
Check-in is not until 15:00 hrs. You will have to wait in the lobby if you arrive early.
Only one group pick up will be arranged.
Pick up time will be between 3-4 PM.
Immigration takes time so the exact time may vary.
If your flight is not matching the pick up time then you can take a taxi to hotel directly.
The hotel will do your registration before you check-in and please remember that after you check-out of any hotel you need to carry the registration slip with you till the end of the trip.

itinerary.title: Full Day Moscow City Tour
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, meet your guide in the lobby to discover Moscow’s top landmarks during an 8-hour vehicle service. Walk through the historic Red Square, enter the grand Moscow Kremlin complex to visit its key highlights and historic cathedrals, and then head to Sparrow Hills to enjoy a panoramic city view and take an exciting cable car ride over the Moscow River. Conclude your sightseeing with a deep dive into the famous Moscow Metro, marveling at its spectacular architecture, mosaics, grand chandeliers, and marble interiors before returning to your hotel for an overnight stay.
Notes
Vehicle service is for 8 hours only so please maintain the timeline given to you by your trip captain.

itinerary.title: Transfer from Moscow to Murmansk (By Air)
itinerary.description:
Check out after breakfast and transfer to the airport for your flight north to Murmansk. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel to settle in and freshen up. Bundle up in your warmest clothes, remember to carry your passport, and head out to the Kola Bay for an adventurous, optional ice-floating experience, leaving the remainder of the evening free for personal leisure.
Notes
Put on warm clothes, take passports with you.
Bright colours in your clothes are recommended for taking beautiful pictures.
Food is an issue in Murmansk for Indians so be prepared with ready to eat packets

itinerary.title: Teriberka exploration
itinerary.description:
Fuel up with breakfast and dress warmly with thermal undercovers for a drive to the remote village of Teriberka, sitting right on the shores of the Barents Sea, a magical sector of the Arctic Ocean. Along the route, witness a vast 360-degree tundra, the unique stones' garden, and the world's largest polar wind park. Afterward, enjoy a walking tour of the Teriberka Nature Park to explore the famous Dragon's eggs beach, discover the Dragon's lair, and admire the beautiful waterfall nestled in the red rocks before driving back to Murmansk for the night.
Notes
Bring your passport.
Do dress warmly. We recommend thermal undercover.
Don’t drink much as there are no washroom on the way to Teriberka.
A lot depends on weather and road conditions, so please be cooperative.

itinerary.title: Sami Village exploration
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, take a 2.5-hour drive to the Husky and Reindeer Park Lovozero, where you will spend a magical day hugging energetic huskies, enjoying husky and reindeer sledding, watching and feeding the reindeer, dressing up in indigenous Saami clothes, stepping inside traditional Saami tents, and learning the rich history of the far north people. In the evening, prepare for a 3-to-4-hour Northern Lights hunt accompanied by professional photography to capture stunning shots under the Arctic skies, subject to weather conditions.
Notes
Aurora hunting is subject to weather conditions.
Wovoyage is not responsible in case of an unsuccessful hunt for Northern Lights
Your Aurora hunting tour may last for 3/4 hours so be prepared for the cold Your vehicle would be heated enough to keep you warm Your first northern lights tour can happen on any night depending upon the conditions

itinerary.title: Transfer from Murmansk to St. Petersburg (by artic train)
itinerary.description:
Enjoy breakfast at your hotel before transferring to the Murmansk railway station. Step on board a classic Arctic sleeper train to begin a nostalgic, 24-hour experiential rail journey to St. Petersburg where you will manage your own light luggage and enjoy the basic on-board amenities as the snowy Russian wilderness glides past your window.
Notes you will have to manage your own luggage, so please carry light.
veg food is available on board but very limited option.
hot water is available so carry ready-to-eat meal.
talking loudly on board is not allowed.
this is experiential part of the trip so please be co-operative and be open to adventure.
if you dont want to travel in train, you can take flight to St. Petersburg and book same hotel for one night on your own expense.

itinerary.title: Reach St Petersburg and free time
itinerary.description:
The train pulls into beautiful St. Petersburg today, where you will transfer directly to your hotel for check-in after 3 PM. The rest of the afternoon and evening are completely free to unwind, recuperate from the long train ride, or enjoy an evening of shopping down the city's vibrant avenues.
Notes
The check-in time is 3 PM.
Trip captains / Super guides from our team will be available for all the city tours & Aurora hunting tour (not for your leisure days)

itinerary.title: Sightseeing tour of St. Petersburg
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, meet your guide in the lobby for a 6-to-8-hour guided city tour of Saint Petersburg highlighting its major historical and architectural landmarks. You will visit the iconic Winter Palace and walk through the halls of the world-renowned Hermitage Museum, discovering immortal masterpieces by legendary artists including Leonardo da Vinci, Michelangelo, Raphael, Rembrandt, and Rubens while learning about the city’s rich imperial heritage before your overnight stay.
Notes
Vehicle service is for 8 hours.
You can fly back on 12th December from St Petersburg as well if you are okay with an expensive air ticket (flights from Moscow to Moscow are cheaper).

itinerary.title: Transfer from St Petersburg to Moscow (by train) and drop-off at airport by 12 pm.
itinerary.description:
Check out of your hotel and transfer to the station to catch a 4-to-5-hour high-speed train back to Moscow. Upon reaching the Moscow station, a final private transfer will take you directly to the airport for your final drop-off by 12 PM, concluding your tour as you prepare for your return flights home.

trips.title: Bhutan Explorer – Thimphu, Punakha, Paro, Tiger's Nest & Dochula Pass

itinerary.title: Arrival at Bagdogra Airport & transfer to Phuentsholing
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Bagdogra Airport and meet your fellow travellers before beginning the scenic drive to Phuentsholing, the gateway to Bhutan. Journey from the plains into the Himalayan foothills, check in to your hotel, and spend the evening at leisure before your overnight stay in Phuentsholing.
Notes
Distance: 160 km | 4 hours Scenic drive from plains to foothills In hilly regions, AC doesn’t work. The trip leader will speak to the driver if required.
You need to arrive at Bagdogra airport by 10:30 AM at the maximum

itinerary.title: Phuentsholing to Thimphu
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, complete the permit formalities and begin the beautiful uphill drive from Phuentsholing to Thimphu. Pass through peaceful forests, mountain roads, and the tranquil Bhutanese countryside before checking into your hotel and relaxing for the evening in Bhutan's capital.
Notes
Distance: 180 km | 6 hours Permit processing in the morning may take some time, so please be patient and cooperate.
Mandatory Documents - Adult above 18 yrs- Original Voter Card or Passport ( minimum 6 months Validity ) with 2 copies, PP-size photo. Child below 18 years- Original Birth Certificate in English with 2 Copies PP size Photo or passport.

itinerary.title: Thimphu to Punakha via Dochula Pass to Thimphu
itinerary.description:
Travel from Thimphu to Punakha via the spectacular Dochula Pass, famous for its 108 chortens and sweeping Himalayan views. Continue to explore the magnificent Punakha Dzong, admire the confluence of the Pho Chu and Mo Chu Rivers, walk across the famous Suspension Bridge, enjoy views of Chimmi Monastery, and return to Thimphu for an overnight stay.
Notes
Distance: 70 km | 3 hours Dochula Pass viewpoint (3,150m)
Punakha Dzong
Pho Chu + Mo Chu Rivers
Suspension Bridge, Chimmi Monastery View

itinerary.title: Thimphu Local Sightseeing to Paro
itinerary.description: Discover the cultural highlights of Thimphu as you visit its heritage sites, craft schools, museums, and the iconic Buddha Point. After completing the city tour, drive through the scenic valley to Paro, where you'll check in for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Tiger’s Nest Trek
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, embark on the unforgettable Tiger's Nest Trek, one of Bhutan's most iconic experiences. Enjoy a 5–6 hour trek with breathtaking mountain views before returning to Paro for a relaxed evening and overnight stay.
Notes
Full-day trek (Tigernest trek)
Approx. 5–6 hours Trek difficulty: easy to medium Vehicle drop at base parking Overnight: Paro

itinerary.title: Paro Sightseeing to Phuentsholing
itinerary.description:
Spend the morning exploring the highlights of Paro, including Nya Mey Zam Bridge, Kichu Lhakhang, the Paro Airport View Point, the Tiger's Nest Outer View, and the Paro Museum. Later, drive back to Phuentsholing and enjoy a relaxed evening before your final overnight stay.
Notes
Nya Mey Zam Bridge
Kichu Lhakhang
Paro Airport View Point
Tiger’s Nest Outer View
Paro Museum
Drive to Phuentsholing (180 km | 6 hours)

itinerary.title: Phuentsholing to Bagdogra Airport for departure
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel and drive back to Bagdogra Airport for your onward journey, bringing your memorable Bhutan adventure to a close.

trips.title: Vietnam with Sapa - Hanoi, Halong Bay, Sapa, Da Nang, BaNa Hills

itinerary.title: Hanoi arrival – Hanoi city tour
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Noi Bai International Airport, where the group airport pickup is scheduled between 10:00–11:00 AM, followed by a transfer to your hotel in Hanoi. The transfer from the airport to the city centre takes approximately 45 minutes. After arrival, enjoy free leisure time to relax and unwind after your journey. You can use this time to enjoy a spa, explore nearby places, or go shopping at your own pace. In the evening, visit the famous Train Street and experience the lively atmosphere of one of Hanoi’s most popular spots. After exploring Train Street, return to the hotel and spend the rest of the evening at leisure.
Notes
It is around 45 minutes to transfer from Noi Bai International Airport to the city centre.
Normal check-in time is 2-3 PM & check-out time is 10 am.
No early check-in included. Please consult us before booking your flights.
Group pickup will be done between 10:00 AM to 11:00 AM. Anyone arriving outside of the pick-up time either needs to wait or arrange hotel transfers themselves. We can arrange for you at an additional cost.
Please ensure to finish lunch before the hald day city tour.

itinerary.title: Hanoi – Halong bay day cruise trip
itinerary.description:
Following breakfast, a private vehicle transfer takes you from your hotel in Hanoi to Tuan Chau Island in Halong City. Arriving at the harbor around noon, you will board a beautiful cruise ship for a scenic, 5-hour journey drifting through the spectacular, limestone-studded waters of Halong Bay. Savor a delicious local Vietnamese lunch on board, with vegetarian preferences accommodated upon request, as you navigate deep into the Bo Hon Archipelago to explore the massive stalagmites and stalactites of the Surprising Cave. Afterward, experience an adventurous kayaking session or a tranquil bamboo boat ride through the waters of Luon Cave, before making a stop at Titov Island, where you can relax on the beach or hike up to Titov Peak for sweeping, panoramic views of the bay. Wrap up the perfect afternoon sunbathing on the upper deck during a lively Sunset Party, before cruising back to the shore for your private return transfer to Hanoi, arriving back at your hotel around 8:00 PM for an overnight stay.
Notes
Local food is served on the boat; vegetarian options are available upon request. Kindly let us know your diet preference while making the booking.
Cruise programme is subject to change without prior notice

itinerary.title: Fly to Danang & visit Hoi An
itinerary.description:
Set an early alarm for a morning pickup from your hotel and a private transfer to Noi Bai Airport for an early 7-8 AM domestic flight to Da Nang, maximizing your time in central Vietnam. Upon landing, head straight to the lush Bay Mau Coconut Forest to hop into a traditional bamboo basket boat for an energetic excursion featuring local crab fishing and watching dramatic, traditional net-throwing performances. In the afternoon, transition to the magical streets of Hoi An Ancient Town, where you can grab lunch on your own before embarking on a guided walking tour covering Kwan Temple, Phuc Kien Assembly Hall, Tan Ky Old House, the historic Japanese Bridge, and the bustling Hoi An Market. Enjoy free time to shop with talented local tailors before concluding your evening with a dreamy lantern boat ride along the river, dropping a personal lantern into the water, before transferring back to your hotel in Da Nang for an overnight stay.
Notes
Flight will be early morning between 6:30-8 am so we can make the most of it in Hoi An.
Baggage allowance is 15 Kgs check-in and 7 kgs carry-on.
For group bookings, we’re unable to add extra baggage allowance in advance. If you require additional baggage, you can easily upgrade your allowance at the airport during check-in.

itinerary.title: Bana Hills & Golden Hand Bridge
itinerary.description: Fuel up with breakfast at your hotel before boarding your private vehicle at 8:30 AM for a drive out to the spectacular Ba Na Hills. Step into a scenic cable car ride to ascend the mountains, stopping to walk along the world-famous Golden Bridge held up by giant stone hands, and explore the surrounding French-style villas and panoramic viewpoints. Hop onto the unique hill-climbing train to venture further up Nui Chua Mountain to explore its beautifully manicured gardens and stunning high-altitude viewpoints. Spend your afternoon enjoying free time inside Fantasy Park, one of Vietnam’s largest indoor amusement parks, or exploring the rest of the hills at your own pace before taking the cable car back down and transferring back to Da Nang for your overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Fly to Hanoi & transfer to Sapa
itinerary.description:
Another early morning start begins with a 7-8 AM flight from Da Nang back to Hanoi, ensuring a smooth and timely connection for the next leg of your journey. Upon landing at the airport in Hanoi, meet your dedicated driver and immediately hit the road for a highly scenic, 6-hour drive up into the mountains toward Sapa, pausing for comfortable pit stops along the route. Arrive in the misty, high-altitude town of Sapa in the late afternoon, check into your hotel, and spend the evening relaxing and adjusting to the crisp mountain air before your overnight stay.
Notes
Flight will be early morning 6:30-7:30 am so we can make the most of it in Sapa.
Baggage allowance is 15 Kgs check-in and 7 kgs carry-on
For group bookings, we’re unable to add extra baggage allowance in advance. If you require additional baggage, you can easily upgrade your allowance at the airport during check-in.

itinerary.title: Fansipan Legend & Moana Cafe
itinerary.description: After breakfast, visit Fansipan Legend and enjoy a scenic cable car ride of approximately 20 minutes, reaching an altitude of around 2,800 metres. Explore the spiritual pagodas and viewpoints while taking in the surrounding mountain and cloud views. After lunch at your own expense, return by cable car and visit Moana Sapa Café, known for its mountain scenery and photo spots. Continue to Mong Village to experience the Alpine Coaster before returning to your hotel for an overnight stay in Sapa.

itinerary.title: Cat Cat village, Sapa Market - transfer back to Hanoi
itinerary.description:
Begin the day with a visit to Cat Cat Village, home to the Black H’mong community. Accompanied by a local guide, explore the village, experience local daily life and stop by the waterfall and bridge for photographs. Later, visit a local market for shopping before taking a private transfer back to Hanoi. Enjoy an overnight stay at your hotel in Hanoi.
Notes
You will get local food at Cat Cat village so make sure to stock up your snacks.
You need to check-out before leaving for today’s tour.

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description:
Enjoy your final breakfast in Hanoi followed by a completely free morning to relax, do some last-minute independent city sightseeing, or finish up your souvenir shopping. At 12:30 PM, your driver will pick the group up for a synchronized final transfer back to Noi Bai International Airport for your departure flights home. You will head home with a camera full of beautiful memories, a deep appreciation for Vietnamese hospitality, and lifelong bonds built with your fellow female voyagers.
Notes
Airport Drop off time between 12-2 PM so accordingly book the flights.
If you are opting for late evening flight then you need to manage your own airport transfer. Use Grab cab for economical option.

itinerary.title: ARRIVAL IN SRI LANKA→MIRISSA
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Bandaranaike International Airport and begin your scenic drive to Mirissa, a beautiful coastal town in Sri Lanka. Check in to your hotel and spend the evening relaxing by the beach, enjoying the sunset, or unwinding after your journey.
Notes
Reach the airport before 10 AM. Group pickup will be done between 10:30 AM to 11 AM (only once).
Please consult our team before booking your flights.
Check-in will be done by the evening.

itinerary.title: BENTOTA & GALLE
itinerary.description: Explore Sri Lanka’s southern coast with a visit to a turtle hatchery to learn about sea turtle conservation. Enjoy a peaceful boat safari along the Madu River through mangrove-covered waterways before heading to Galle Dutch Fort. Walk through its historic streets, explore charming cafés and boutiques, and enjoy ocean views from the fort walls before returning to Mirissa.

itinerary.title: MIRISSA→ELLA VIA UDAWALAWE
itinerary.description: Leave the tropical coastline behind and travel inland towards Ella via Udawalawe. Enjoy the changing landscapes as coastal scenery gives way to lush greenery, countryside, forests, and rolling hills. Upon reaching Ella, check in to your hotel and enjoy a relaxing evening surrounded by the cool mountain air.

itinerary.title: EXPLORE ELLA
itinerary.description:
Discover Ella’s scenic beauty with a visit to the iconic Nine Arches Bridge, surrounded by lush greenery and rolling hills. Continue with a hike to Little Adam’s Peak, where panoramic views of the surrounding valleys and mountains await. Spend the evening at leisure, enjoying the peaceful atmosphere of Ella.
Notes
Little Adam’s Peak can change depending on the weather conditions.

itinerary.title: ELLA→AMBEWELA→NUWARA ELIYA→KANDY
itinerary.description:
Begin the day with a scenic train journey from Ella to Ambewela, passing through mist-covered mountains, tea plantations, and green valleys. Continue by road to Nuwara Eliya, where you will visit Seetha Amman Temple, explore Gregory Lake, and discover the process of Ceylon tea production at a local tea factory and plantation. Later, travel to Kandy and check in to your hotel.
Notes
The Ella–Ambewela train journey is subject to availability. If this train is unavailable, the alternative will be the Ella–Badulla train journey.
Activities like speedboat riding and cycling around Gregory Lake are not included in the package cost. You can pay on the spot.

itinerary.title: KANDY→PINNAWALA→DAMBULLA→SIGIRIYA
itinerary.description: Travel towards Sigiriya with a visit to the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage, where you can observe elephants and learn about their care and conservation. Continue to Dambulla to explore the Dambulla Cave Temple, known for its ancient Buddhist murals, statues, and cave shrines. Arrive in Sigiriya, check in to your hotel, and enjoy a relaxing evening.

itinerary.title: SIGIRIYA ROCK→COLOMBO
itinerary.description:
Begin the day with a visit to the iconic Sigiriya Rock Fortress. Climb the ancient rock and discover its fascinating history while enjoying spectacular views of the surrounding forests and countryside. Continue to Colombo, Sri Lanka’s vibrant commercial capital, and explore its cultural landmarks, temples, and notable city sights, including Gangaramaya Temple. Enjoy some time for shopping before checking in to your hotel for your final evening.
Notes
Entry tickets to Sigiriya Rock Fortress are not included in the package cost.

itinerary.title: COLOMBO→DEPARTURE
itinerary.description:
Enjoy your final breakfast in Sri Lanka before checking out of your hotel. Transfer to Bandaranaike International Airport for your onward journey, taking home memories of tropical beaches, scenic train rides, tea plantations, historic temples, and beautiful hill country landscapes.
Notes
Airport drop-off is scheduled around 11:30 AM to 12 PM. So book your return flights accordingly.
Please consult our team before booking your flights.

trips.title: Bali Escape – Ubud, Kuta, Uluwatu & Nusa Penida

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bali
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Ngurah Rai International Airport where you will meet your group for a synchronized pickup scheduled between 2:00 PM and 3:00 PM. From there, take a comfortable transfer to the cultural heart of Bali and check into your hotel in Ubud after 3:00 PM. Spend the rest of your evening relaxing and settling into the tropical atmosphere at your own pace before the adventure begins.
Notes
Check-in is not until 15:00 hrs.
The airport pick up will be once.
Pick up time between 2-3 PM
If you are arriving early, then you have to wait or manage your airport to hotel transfer on your own Airport to hotel 35 KM travel time 1.5-2 hrs depending on traffic.

itinerary.title: ATV and Bali Swing Adventure Day
itinerary.description:
Fuel up with breakfast before heading out for a 1-hour single-rider ATV track session through muddy tracks, rivers, tunnels, and forest trails. After working up an appetite, enjoy an Indian restaurant lunch followed by a visit to Alas Harum, where you can experience the famous Angel Swing ride. Conclude your afternoon relaxing at the luxurious Cretya Ubud Day Club, featuring tiered pools and a complimentary non-alcoholic welcome drink.
Notes
If you don’t wish to participate in the ATV ride, you can relax at the restaurant area while the rest of the group enjoys the activity. You will need to wait for approximately 1 hour until the ATV ride is completed, after which you can rejoin the group Dress rental is not included. (INR 1,500 to 2,000 approx)
Only one swing is included.

itinerary.title: Tirtha Empul, Lake Batur, Mt. Batur, Kintamani
itinerary.description: Begin your morning with a sacred purification ritual at the historic Tirta Empul Temple. Journey onward to the Kintamani highlands to take in stunning panoramic views of Mount Batur and its crater lake while enjoying a scenic local lunch. In the afternoon, walk through the iconic Tegalalang Rice Terraces and stop by a Balinese coffee plantation for a guided tasting session.

itinerary.title: Clubbing Day
itinerary.description:
Check out from your Ubud hotel after breakfast and explore the ancient rock-carvings at Goa Gajah, also known as the Elephant Cave Temple. Head to a local Indian restaurant for lunch before transferring to the bustling coastal region of Kuta for your hotel check-in. Later in the evening, head out for some club hopping and catch a stunning sunset at Finns Beach Club, overlooking the beautiful Indian Ocean
Notes
Seat reservation charges at FINNS beach club is not a part of the package.
All the transport expense of clubbing and shopping is own.

itinerary.title: Pandawa Beach, Uluwatu Temple & Kecak Dance
itinerary.description:
Enjoy breakfast at your hotel before setting out to explore the dramatic limestone cliffs and cafes along Pandawa Beach. In the late afternoon, travel to the edge of the island to visit Uluwatu Temple, perched majestically on a cliff dropping straight into the ocean. As the sun sets, take your seats to watch the captivating, rhythmically chanted Balinese Kecak Fire Dance performance.
optional: Enjoy a free morning until 12:00 PM. If you would like to participate in water sports, please inform us at the time of booking so the necessary arrangements can be made. Water-sports transfers depart from the hotel around 7:00 AM and are available at an additional cost, with transfers arranged only for a minimum of 2 participants. The activity fee is paid directly at the beach counter.
If you prefer to skip the water sports, take it easy at Kuta Beach, explore the local shops, enjoy a coffee, or treat yourself to a massage. Later, visit Pandawa Beach for its stunning turquoise waters and scenic views, with time to relax and enjoy a beachside foot massage.
Notes
Enjoy a free morning until 12:00 PM. If you’d like to try water sports, please inform us at the time of booking. Transfers will be arranged at an additional cost, while the activity can be paid directly at the beach counter.
Water Sports: Leave the hotel around 7:00 AM (approx. 40-minute drive). After the activity, return to the hotel and join the group for the day's next stop.
Transfers will be arranged only with a minimum of 2 participants.
Not into water sports? Take it easy! Relax at Kuta Beach, explore the local shops, enjoy a coffee, or treat yourself to a massage.
Later, we visit Pandawa Beach for its stunning turquoise waters and scenic views. This is more about relaxing and enjoying the beach than swimming. Sit back, soak in the views, and enjoy a beachside foot massage.

itinerary.title: Departure/Nusa Penida extended tour (optional extension)
itinerary.description:
Savor your final breakfast in paradise before preparing for the next step of your journey. For travelers concluding their vacation today, a synchronized group transfer will take you back to the airport between 11:00 AM and 12:00 PM for your flight home. For those opting to stretch out the adventure, today features an unforgettable day trip to Nusa Penida via Sanur Harbour, requiring a minimum of 2 participants to proceed. If the headcount is met, you will cross the water to explore three of the island's most famous natural wonders: Angel's Billabong, Broken Beach, and Kelingking Secret Point before returning to the hotel by evening.
Notes
Airport drop of will be between 11-12 PM.
Only one drop-off will be arranged so please confirm your flight timings with us before booking.
We understand that not everyone’s flight will match, so you might have to go early or you can go later on your own using the grab taxi.
Wovoyage Trip Captain will not be accompanying for Nusa Penida tour.
Minimum 2 people required

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description:
Enjoy your final breakfast at the hotel after your bonus day of island exploration. Pack your bags and check out of your accommodation to conclude the extended tour program. Please note that for today's departure, the airport drop-off must be managed on your own, and you can easily use a Grab Taxi to reach the airport for your flight home.
Notes
We need to know if you want to extend at the time of booking the tour.
Airport drop-off will be managed by own. You can use Grab Taxi to go to the airport.

itinerary.title: Welcome to Iceland
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Keflavík International Airport, meet your driver-guide and travel towards Reykjavík via the famous Blue Lagoon. Enjoy the geothermal waters with Comfort entrance, towel rental, a silica mud mask and a non-alcoholic drink before continuing to Reykjavík for hotel check-in and leisure time.
Notes
Check-in is not until 15:00 hrs.
Keep in mind that due to narrow streets in Reykjavík City Centre, many hotels do not have enough space for a coach to stop outside. Walking distance for passengers can be up to 10 minutes, depending on location. We will arrange a shuttle to transfer the luggage that passengers need to pick up outside their hotel.

itinerary.title: Into the Glacier Tour – Drive to Akureyri
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out and embark on the Into the Glacier tour, exploring a man-made ice tunnel inside a glacier. Discover the fascinating glacial ice and surrounding scenery before continuing on a scenic drive towards Akureyri. Arrive at the hotel for check-in and dinner.

itinerary.title: Goðafoss – Whale Watching from Húsavík – Skútustaðir
itinerary.description: Visit Goðafoss, the spectacular Waterfall of the Gods, before travelling to Húsavík for an approximately three-hour whale-watching boat excursion, with opportunities to spot whales and other marine wildlife depending on natural conditions. Continue towards the Lake Mývatn region and visit Skútustaðir, known for its distinctive pseudo-craters and volcanic landscapes, before hotel check-in and dinner.

itinerary.title: Dimmuborgir – Námaskarð – Dettifoss – East Fjords
itinerary.description: Explore Dimmuborgir’s unusual volcanic rock formations before visiting Námaskarð, known for its bubbling mud pools, steaming vents and colourful mineral deposits. Continue to Dettifoss, one of Europe’s most powerful waterfalls, before enjoying scenic drives through Iceland’s rugged countryside towards the East Fjords. Arrive at the hotel for check-in and dinner.

itinerary.title: East Fjords – Stone Collection – Jökulsárlón
itinerary.description: Travel through the picturesque East Fjords, taking in coastal scenery, mountains and charming villages. Visit the Stone Collection to discover Iceland’s geological heritage, then continue to Jökulsárlón Glacier Lagoon, famous for its floating icebergs and spectacular glacial landscapes. Enjoy time to explore and take photographs before heading to your hotel near the Glacier Lagoon for dinner.

itinerary.title: Skaftafell – Reynisfjara – Skógafoss – Seljalandsfoss
itinerary.description: Explore the Skaftafell region, known for its glacial scenery and rugged landscapes, before visiting Reynisfjara, Iceland’s famous black sand beach with striking basalt columns and dramatic sea stacks. Continue to Skógafoss, an impressive waterfall cascading down a high cliff, followed by Seljalandsfoss, surrounded by scenic countryside. Enjoy photo stops and sightseeing along Iceland’s south coast before arriving at the hotel in Hella for dinner.

itinerary.title: Gullfoss – Geysir – Friðheimar – Þingvellir
itinerary.description: Discover Iceland’s famous Golden Circle sightseeing route, beginning with Gullfoss, known for its powerful cascades. Continue to the Geysir geothermal area to witness Strokkur, the active geyser that regularly erupts. Visit Friðheimar Farm, featuring a geothermal greenhouse and Icelandic horse stables, before exploring Þingvellir National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site with historical significance and a unique geological landscape. Return to Reykjavík for hotel check-in.

itinerary.title: Departure from Iceland
itinerary.description:
Enjoy breakfast at the hotel before checking out and preparing for your onward journey. Transfer from Reykjavík to Keflavík International Airport without a guide, taking home memories of Iceland’s glaciers, waterfalls, volcanic landscapes and scenic countryside.
Notes
In rare cases, a change of itinerary might be necessary during programs in Iceland, should snow, road and weather conditions not allow to follow the scheduled itinerary, and certain outdoor activities/day tours might be cancelled. In this case no refund will be given, but wovoyage will try to find reasonable alternatives where and whenever possible Included & Excluded

trips.title: Europe Tour – Paris, Amsterdam, Prague & Vienna

itinerary.title: Arrive in Paris | Welcome to Europe
itinerary.description:
Arrive in Paris, complete immigration formalities and meet your Wovoyage trip leader for assistance with the scheduled airport pickup and hotel check-in. After settling in, enjoy a sunset cruise along the Seine River and take in the atmosphere of the French capital.
Notes we will use public transportations.
Hotel check-in is not untill 15:00 hrs.
Pick-up is from Paris CDG airport (Charles De Gaulle) at 11 AM. If you are arriving before that, you need to wait at the airport or can come on own.
Please note no adjustments can be made if you don’t opt for airport pick-up.

itinerary.title: Paris Hop-On Hop-Off Bus Tour and Eiffel tower 2 level visit.
itinerary.description:
Explore Paris on a hop-on hop-off bus tour, passing Place Vendôme, Opéra Garnier, Musée d’Orsay, Champs-Élysées, Arc de Triomphe and Alexander Bridge. Visit the second level of the Eiffel Tower, followed by free time for photographs, nearby neighbourhoods or café hopping; entry to Notre-Dame and other monuments is not included in the sightseeing tour.
Notes
This is SIC tour with hop-on and hop-off bus.
Please be prepared to walk atlest 10-12K steps today.
The order of doing sightseeing can change.
We will not be going inside Notre Dame or any monument apart from Eiffel (you may visit the interoirs on your leisure time).

itinerary.title: Day at leisure. Optional Activity (Disneyland Paris / Louvre Meseum / shopping)
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a free day to explore Paris at your own pace, with options for shopping in the city centre, visiting the Louvre Museum or enjoying an optional day at Disneyland Paris. Disneyland Paris tickets are not included in the package and must be arranged separately.
Notes
Carry your passport if you are planning to shop.
Trip leader from our team will be available for all the city tours & sightseeing (not for your leisure days).
Tickets for Disneyland Paris are not included. If you want to do, we can book it for you. Let us know atleast 20 days before.

itinerary.title: Paris to Amesterdam by Bus (Approx 7-8 hrs) | Evening free to explore.
itinerary.description:
Travel from Paris to Amsterdam by bus, with an approximate journey time of seven to eight hours, subject to possible schedule disruptions. After checking into your hotel, spend the evening at leisure with a walk beside Amsterdam’s famous canals, exploring nearby streets, relaxing at a local café or enjoying the city's pub scene; train travel may be considered if required by disruptions.
Notes
Bus schedule may disrupt sometimes in Europe so it might take longer in such cases.
The bus journey generally take approx. 7-8 hrs.
Or alternatively we could opt for a train journey as well. Please be open to flexibility in the itinerary if bus strike happens.
You need to manage your own luggage so keep your bags within optimum weight that you can easily carry and lift.

itinerary.title: Half-day Heineken Tour | Evening Canal Cruise, stroll through red light district.
itinerary.description: Discover the brewing process and history of Heineken during the Heineken Experience, with time to browse the in-house souvenir shop. Later, enjoy a canal cruise through Amsterdam’s historic waterways, passing charming old houses and numerous bridges, before spending the evening at leisure with the option to explore the Red Light District.

itinerary.title: Half-Day Trip to Zaanse Schans Village (SIC) | Evening in leisure
itinerary.description:
Take a half-day shared excursion to Zaanse Schans, a picturesque Dutch village known for its historic windmills and traditional green wooden houses dating back to the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries. Enjoy a stroll through the village and time for photographs before returning to Amsterdam, where the rest of the day is free.
Notes
This will be a SIC tour and we will be using local transportations only.
Trip leader will be available for all transfer, sightseeing, and activities, not during your leisure time.

itinerary.title: Amsterdam to Prague by train (Approx. 12-15 hrs) | Check-in and rest
itinerary.description:
Travel by train from Amsterdam to Prague, with a transfer en route and views of the changing European countryside and towns along the way. On arrival, transfer to your hotel, complete check-in and relax after the journey.
Notes
Trip leader will be available for all transfer, sightseeing, and activities, not during your leisure time.
Train time may distrub so please be cooperative.
Train journey 10-12.5 hrs total with a transfer in between.

itinerary.title: Walking tour in Prague with Charles Bridge | Evening Pub Crawl on own
itinerary.description:
Explore Prague on a walking tour through the historic Old Town, visiting Old Town Square, the famous Astronomical Clock and St. Nicholas Church. Continue past historic squares and colourful buildings to the iconic Charles Bridge, then enjoy Prague’s nightlife with a self-guided pub crawl.
Notes
Prague is best explored walking. So please be prepared to walk 20-25K steps min.
The itinerary may change a little for your comfort so please be open about it.
We will not be going inside any momument. If you wish to go inside, you can visit during leisure time.

itinerary.title: Day at leisure. Enjoy and have fun your way.
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a free day to discover more of Prague at your own pace. Optional activities suggested in the itinerary include a hop-on hop-off bus tour, another walk through the Old Town’s cobblestone streets or a cruise along the Vltava River.
Notes
Trip leader will be available for all transfer, sightseeing, and activities, not during and/or on your leisure day.

itinerary.title: Prague to Vienna by Bus (approx 4 hrs) | Evening Vienna walking tour
itinerary.description: Travel from Prague to Vienna by bus or train, with an approximate journey time of four hours. After checking into your hotel, enjoy an evening walking tour through Vienna’s elegant streets, historic buildings and grand squares, taking in landmarks such as St. Stephen’s Cathedral and Hofburg Palace before an included Indian dinner.

itinerary.title: Hallstatt Day Tour (SIC)
itinerary.description:
Set out early for a guided shared tour to Hallstatt, travelling through the scenic Austrian countryside. Explore this picturesque lakeside village, known for its colourful houses, peaceful lake views and salt mine history, with time to walk along the lake, wander through the village streets and take photographs before returning to Vienna.
Notes
This is a SIC tour. Please be on time, if you miss, we cannot do anything.
Please keep cash with you. In Hallstatt majority of the shops aceept only cash.
Vegetarian options are available.

itinerary.title: Departure | Head back with a lot of happy memories
itinerary.description:
Enjoy breakfast at your hotel before checking out and preparing for your onward journey. Take the scheduled group transfer to Vienna International Airport and head home with memories of Paris, Amsterdam, Prague, Vienna and the beautiful village of Hallstatt.
Notes
Drop-off time at the airport will be between 2-3 PM. Please book the flight accordingly.
If you are taking earlier flight then you need to manage your own transfer.
Bolt or Uber is available and will cost approx 30-40 Euros.
No adjustments can be made if you don’t opt for drop-off service.

itinerary.title: Welcome To Japan: Arrival in Tokyo
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Haneda Airport Terminal 3, where a group pickup will be arranged. Travel to your centrally located hotel by local train, complete your check-in and spend the rest of the day relaxing or exploring the area around your hotel.
Notes
Check-in is not until 15:00hrs. You will have to wait in the lobby if you arrive early.
Early check-in can be arranged at an additional cost and subject to availability. Inform us while booking the trip.
Airport to hotel will be via a local train available from the airport itself.
Room sizes are small in Japan in general, so please be prepared for it.
All commutes will be via local train

itinerary.title: Full-day Tokyo City Tour + Kimono Experience
itinerary.description:
Begin your Tokyo exploration with a traditional kimono-wearing experience in Asakusa. Visit some of the city's best cherry blossom spots, followed by visits to Meiji Shrine and Harajuku. Enjoy the beauty of Tokyo during sakura season before returning to the hotel by local train.
Notes
Expect alot of walking today, so wear comfortable shoes and keep your Suica card handy for local transfers. You'll use local transportation (train) today to explore.
Please note, we’ll be visiting the best cherry blossom spots in the city based on peak bloom conditions. To ensure you get the most beautiful experience, the itinerary may be adjusted slightly.

itinerary.title: Full day Mt. Fuji trip with Indian lunch
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a full-day private van tour to the Mount Fuji region and take in panoramic views of Japan's iconic mountain. Visit Oshino Hakkai, a UNESCO village, where you can explore the surroundings and try local street food. Enjoy an Indian lunch with vegetarian and Jain options, followed by visits to Lake Kawaguchiko and Oishi Park.
Notes
This is a private van tour to ensure a comfortable and seamless experience.
Please be ready to depart at 8:00 AM sharp from the hotel lobby.

itinerary.title: Kamakura Visit
itinerary.description:
Explore the historic coastal town of Kamakura, known for its cultural heritage and scenic surroundings. Visit the iconic Great Buddha (Daibutsu), enjoy a scenic train ride along the ocean and discover real-life Ghibli locations around Kamakura. Later, experience TeamLab Planets before returning to your hotel.
Notes
All transfers via local transportation (bus/train)
For lunch there are many cafes around and Indian restaurant is also there.
Please be prepared to walk a minimum of 20K-25K steps on average.

itinerary.title: Free Day or DisneySea
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a free day to explore Tokyo independently, discover local cafés, enjoy a cup of coffee or experience the beauty of cherry blossoms at your own pace. Alternatively, opt for an exciting visit to DisneySea, where you can explore the park and enjoy its rides. DisneySea is an optional add-on experience and is not included in the regular itinerary.
Notes
This will be a free day for you to explore at your own pace. Visiting DisneySea is an optional add-on experience and is not included in the regular itinerary. Kindly note that the trip leader will not be accompanying the group on this day.
Please be prepared to walk a minimum of 20K- 25K steps on average.
You can take the Disney Resort Line (a special train for DisneySea).
Transportation cost is not included in the package cost on this day.
Please keep your big luggage ready by evening. We will send it directly to the Osaka Hotel. So, you need to pack one small backpack or trolley for 3 days (2 outfits for Osaka and 1 outfit for universal studios )

itinerary.title: Tokyo to Osaka by Shinkansen | Nara Tour
itinerary.description:
Travel from Tokyo Station to Shin-Osaka aboard Japan's famous Shinkansen bullet train. After arriving in Osaka and dropping off your luggage at the hotel, head out for an afternoon visit to Nara Park and Todai-ji Temple. Explore these famous attractions before returning to your Osaka hotel for the evening.
Notes
We will take a local train to Tokyo Station and then take the Shinkansen to ShinOsaka.
We will send your large luggage a day before, and you will get it at the Osaka hotel.
You can carry a backpack or carry-on luggage with you on the Shinkansen.
After arriving in Osaka, we will drop off the luggage at the hotel and leave for Nara Park.
Hotel check-in is not until 15:00 hrs.

itinerary.title: Full Day Kyoto Tour (Private tour)
itinerary.description:
Discover Kyoto on a full-day private vehicle tour, starting at 8 AM. Visit the famous Fushimi Inari Taisha, explore Kyoto's renowned shrines and landmarks, and enjoy its scenic parks during cherry blossom season. Conclude the day with a visit to the beautiful Arashiyama Bamboo Forest before returning to your hotel.
Notes
We will have our own private vehicle today.
A lot of walking is involved so please be prepared.
Today designated lunch stop will not be there, so you will have snack around and carry food. Arashiyama has good restaurants.
We’ll be visiting the best cherry blossom spots in the city based on peak bloom conditions. To ensure you get the most beautiful experience, the itinerary may be adjusted slightly.

itinerary.title: Universal Studios Osaka
itinerary.description:
Spend the day exploring Universal Studios Japan in Osaka, enjoying its exciting rides and attractions at your own pace. Try some of the delicious local food available inside the park. You may also receive a free pass for Super Nintendo World upon entering, subject to availability. Guaranteed entry requires a separately purchased pass.
Notes
You can get Super Nintendo World park passes free of cost upon entering if they have availability.
If you need guaranteed entry, then purchase the passes separately.

itinerary.title: Welcome To Japan: Arrival in Tokyo
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Haneda Airport Terminal 3, where a group pickup will be arranged. Travel to your centrally located hotel by local train, complete your check-in and spend the rest of the day relaxing or exploring the area around your hotel.

Room sizes are small in Japan in general, so please be prepared for it.

itinerary.title: Full-day Tokyo City Tour + Kimono Experience
itinerary.description:
Begin your Tokyo exploration with a traditional kimono-wearing experience in Asakusa. Visit some of the city's best cherry blossom spots, followed by visits to Meiji Shrine and Harajuku. Enjoy the beauty of Tokyo during sakura season before returning to the hotel by local train.
Notes
Expect alot of walking today, so wear comfortable shoes and keep your Suica card handy for local transfers. You'll use local transportation (train) today to explore.
Please note, we’ll be visiting the best cherry blossom spots in the city based on peak bloom conditions. To ensure you get the most beautiful experience, the itinerary may be adjusted slightly.

itinerary.title: Full day Mt. Fuji trip with Indian lunch
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a full-day private van tour to the Mount Fuji region and take in panoramic views of Japan's iconic mountain. Visit Oshino Hakkai, a UNESCO village, where you can explore the surroundings and try local street food. Enjoy an Indian lunch with vegetarian and Jain options, followed by visits to Lake Kawaguchiko and Oishi Park.
Notes
This is a private van tour to ensure a comfortable and seamless experience.
Please be ready to depart at 8:00 AM sharp from the hotel lobby.

itinerary.title: Kamakura Visit
itinerary.description:
Explore the historic coastal town of Kamakura, known for its cultural heritage and scenic surroundings. Visit the iconic Great Buddha (Daibutsu), enjoy a scenic train ride along the ocean and discover real-life Ghibli locations around Kamakura. Later, experience TeamLab Planets before returning to your hotel.
Notes
All transfers via local transportation (bus/train)
For lunch there are many cafes around and Indian restaurant is also there.
Please be prepared to walk a minimum of 20K-25K steps on average.

itinerary.title: Free Day or DisneySea
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a free day to explore Tokyo independently, discover local cafés, enjoy a cup of coffee or experience the beauty of cherry blossoms at your own pace. Alternatively, opt for an exciting visit to DisneySea, where you can explore the park and enjoy its rides. DisneySea is an optional add-on experience and is not included in the regular itinerary.
Notes
This will be a free day for you to explore at your own pace. Visiting DisneySea is an optional add-on experience and is not included in the regular itinerary. Kindly note that the trip leader will not be accompanying the group on this day.
Please be prepared to walk a minimum of 20K- 25K steps on average.
You can take the Disney Resort Line (a special train for DisneySea).
Transportation cost is not included in the package cost on this day.
Please keep your big luggage ready by evening. We will send it directly to the Osaka Hotel. So, you need to pack one small backpack or trolley for 3 days (2 outfits for Osaka and 1 outfit for universal studios )

itinerary.title: Tokyo to Osaka by Shinkansen | Nara Tour
itinerary.description:
Travel from Tokyo Station to Shin-Osaka aboard Japan's famous Shinkansen bullet train. After arriving in Osaka and dropping off your luggage at the hotel, head out for an afternoon visit to Nara Park and Todai-ji Temple. Explore these famous attractions before returning to your Osaka hotel for the evening.
Notes
We will take a local train to Tokyo Station and then take the Shinkansen to ShinOsaka.
We will send your large luggage a day before, and you will get it at the Osaka hotel.
You can carry a backpack or carry-on luggage with you on the Shinkansen.
After arriving in Osaka, we will drop off the luggage at the hotel and leave for Nara Park.
Hotel check-in is not until 15:00 hrs.

itinerary.title: Full Day Kyoto Tour (Private tour)
itinerary.description:
Discover Kyoto on a full-day private vehicle tour, starting at 8 AM. Visit the famous Fushimi Inari Taisha, explore Kyoto's renowned shrines and landmarks, and enjoy its scenic parks during cherry blossom season. Conclude the day with a visit to the beautiful Arashiyama Bamboo Forest before returning to your hotel.
Notes
We will have our own private vehicle today.
A lot of walking is involved so please be prepared.
Today designated lunch stop will not be there, so you will have snack around and carry food. Arashiyama has good restaurants.
We’ll be visiting the best cherry blossom spots in the city based on peak bloom conditions. To ensure you get the most beautiful experience, the itinerary may be adjusted slightly.

itinerary.title: Universal Studios Osaka
itinerary.description:
Spend the day exploring Universal Studios Japan in Osaka, enjoying its exciting rides and attractions at your own pace. Try some of the delicious local food available inside the park. You may also receive a free pass for Super Nintendo World upon entering, subject to availability. Guaranteed entry requires a separately purchased pass.

trips.title: Kerala Tour: Kochi, Munnar, Thekkady, Alleppey & Varkala

itinerary.title: Arrival in Cochin & Kochi & local sightseeing
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Kochi Airport, where you will be welcomed and transferred to the hotel. After check-in and some time to freshen up, explore Fort Kochi, Chinese Fishing Nets, St. Francis Church, Santa Cruz Basilica, Mattancherry Palace, Jew Town, Jewish Synagogue and Marine Drive before returning to the hotel for an overnight stay in Kochi.
Notes
Check-in is not until 14:00 hrs.
Book your flight only after consulting with us.

itinerary.title: Kochi to Munnar
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out and travel towards Munnar through Kerala’s lush landscapes. En route, visit Cheeyappara Waterfalls, Valara Waterfalls and spice and tea plantation viewpoints before arriving in Munnar, checking into the hotel and spending the evening at leisure. Overnight stay in Munnar.

itinerary.title: Munnar Sightseeing
itinerary.description: After breakfast, enjoy a full day of sightseeing in Munnar, visiting Mattupetty Dam, Mattupetty Lake, Echo Point, Kundala Lake, Kundala Dam, tea garden and tea plantation viewpoints, and Photo Point. Take in the mountain views and lush tea gardens before returning to the hotel for an overnight stay in Munnar.

itinerary.title: Munnar to Thekkady
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out and proceed towards Thekkady / Periyar. Enjoy the scenic drive through the Western Ghats and arrive in Thekkady. After check-in, you may enjoy optional activities depending on time and availability, including a Spice Plantation Visit, Kathakali Show (pay on your own), Kalaripayattu Show (pay on your own), and an evening walk around Kumily Market. Relax and enjoy the natural charm of Thekkady. Overnight stay in Thekkady.

itinerary.title: Thekkady to Alleppey
itinerary.description:
Enjoy breakfast before checking out and proceeding towards Alleppey, the heart of Kerala’s famous backwaters. On arrival, check in to your premium houseboat and settle in. Relax and enjoy the serene backwaters, beautiful landscapes and peaceful surroundings as Kerala’s countryside passes by. You can also enjoy a speedboat ride and a small boat ride, which take you into the small canals to witness the scenic villages (pay on your own). Overnight stay in a premium houseboat in Alleppey.
Notes
You can also enjoy a speedboat ride and a small boat ride, which take you into the small canals to witness the scenic villages (Pay on your own)

itinerary.title: Alleppey to Varkala
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out and travel towards the coastal town of Varkala. After checking into the hotel, explore Varkala Cliff, Varkala Beach, Janardhana Swamy Temple and Papanasam Beach. End the day by enjoying the beautiful sunset from Varkala Cliff before an overnight stay in Varkala.

itinerary.title: Varkala to Trivandrum Drop
itinerary.description:
Enjoy your final breakfast in Kerala before checking out. Proceed towards Trivandrum Airport for your departure. The distance is approximately 45 km, with a travel time of approximately 1.5–2 hours. Your beautiful Kerala journey comes to an end with wonderful memories to take back home. You can book your return flight for 3 PM and onwards.
Notes
You can book your return flight for 3 PM & onwards.

trips.title: Meghalaya and Kaziranga Adventure – Mawlynnong, Riwai and Guwahati

itinerary.title: Guwahati – Kaziranga (220 KMS / 5 HRS)
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Guwahati Airport for a meet and greet before driving to Kaziranga. After checking in at the hotel, the evening is free for leisure, followed by an overnight stay in Kaziranga.
Notes
Please consult us before booking any flight to Guwahati. You need to reach Guwahti by 10-10:30 AM maximum.

itinerary.title: Kaziranga – Shillong
itinerary.description:
Start with an early morning wake-up call for the safari, followed by breakfast and check-out. Enjoy a Jeep Safari in Kaziranga National Park through the Central or Western Range, with opportunities to spot the One-horned Rhinoceros, Swamp Deer, Hog Deer, Elephants, Wild Water Buffaloes and, if lucky, Tigers. Later, drive to Shillong with a quick photo stop at Umiam Lake, followed by free time to explore the local market and shop for souvenirs.
Notes
For those looking for a more unique way to experience the wilderness, an early-morning Elephant Safari can be arranged before the group jungle safari.
Safari Timing: 5:00 AM – 7:00 AM
Wake-up Time: Around 4:00 AM to reach the safari point on time Approx. Cost: ₹2,000–₹3,000 per person The Elephant Safari needs to be booked in advance and is subject to availability.
Please inform us at the time of booking if you would like to include this activity.
Please note that safaris are subject to change without prior notice due to operational or other unforeseen circumstances. In case the safari is cancelled or unavailable, the applicable amount will be refunded to you.
The Elephant Safari is not included in the package. Only the Jeep Safari is included in the itinerary.

itinerary.title: Shillong – Mawlynnong – Dawki – Cherrapunjee
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, drive towards Mawlynnong Village and visit Riwai Village, home to the famous Single Decker Root Bridge. Continue to Balancing Rock at Mawlynnong before travelling to Dawki for boating on the Umngot River, payable directly. Later, drive to Cherrapunjee for your overnight stay. The walk to the root bridge involves forest paths and uneven trails, so comfortable walking shoes are recommended.
Notes
This is a relatively easy trek involving a walk through the forest and uneven trails. Participants are advised to wear comfortable, sturdy walking shoes and carry a water bottle.

itinerary.title: Cherrapunjee Local Sightseeing – Shillong
itinerary.description: After breakfast, explore Cherrapunjee’s natural attractions, beginning with Mawkdok Dympep Valley, followed by Garden of Caves and Mawsmai Cave. Continue to the spectacular Nohkalikai Falls and Seven Sister Falls, before visiting Elephant Falls. After completing the sightseeing tour, drive back to Shillong for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Shillong – Guwahati
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and drive towards Guwahati. On arrival, check in at the hotel and enjoy the evening at leisure, followed by an overnight stay in Guwahati.

itinerary.title: Kamakhya temple & Guwahati tour
itinerary.description:
Begin with an early morning visit to Maa Kamakhya Devi Temple at Nilachal Hill. Return to the hotel to freshen up before heading out for Guwahati city sightseeing, covering Nabagraha Temple, Basistha Ashram and Balaji Temple. In the evening, enjoy a Brahmaputra River Cruise before spending the night in Guwahati.
Notes
Travellers will need to manage their own Garbh griha darshan arrangements.
As the temple does not follow a fixed system for VIP passes, we are unable to guarantee or arrange these passes for any traveller in advance.
The trip leader will check the latest updates with locals a day before and guide you on the current temple timings and any information regarding VIP passes.
Please note that temple timings may vary depending on the season.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel and drive to Guwahati Airport or Railway Station for your departure, taking back sweet memories of the trip.
Notes
Airport Pickup and drop-off services will be provided only at Lokpriya Gopinath Bordoloi International Airport (GAU), Guwahati.

itinerary.title: Delhi to Shimla (Overnight Journey)
itinerary.description:
Meet your fellow travellers and Wovoyage trip leader at the designated meeting point in Delhi. Board the shared Volvo bus for an overnight journey towards Shimla, with scheduled stops for dinner and refreshments along the way.
Notes
This is a shared Volvo bus service. While we coordinate the bookings, the bus schedule is managed by the operator. Occasionally, your pickup may be delayed due to traffic or route congestion, which is beyond our control. We appreciate your understanding and patience in such situations.
The bus will make 3 stops (1 dinner break right after an hour, the journey starts, and 2 Washroom breaks at midnight)
You have to reach the meeting point on 23rd January by 8 or 8:30 PM. The exact location will be shared on the WhatsApp group a day before.

itinerary.title: Shimla to Sarhaan (Overnight stay in Sarhaan)
itinerary.description:
Arrive in Shimla early in the morning and continue towards Sarahan by Tempo Traveller, passing through the scenic mountain roads of Narkanda, surrounded by pine forests and apple orchards. Enjoy breakfast and scenic stops along the way before reaching Sarahan by evening. After checking in, unwind, enjoy a warm dinner and spend the evening getting to know fellow travellers through introductions, travel stories, spooky tales and stargazing.
Notes
A little heads-up: The drive to Sarhaan is long (approx. 5 hours). Pack your favourite snacks, some patience, and essentials.
This is a leisure day to relax from the overnight journey.

itinerary.title: Sarhaan to Sangla, via Chitkul | 5.5h (189 km)
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, begin the scenic drive through the beautiful Kinnaur region towards Sangla. Stop at Sangla Market to explore the local surroundings before continuing to Chitkul, popularly known as the last inhabited village near the Indo-Tibetan border. Enjoy breathtaking views of the Baspa Valley, snow-covered peaks and traditional Himalayan architecture before checking into your accommodation. End the day with a warm dinner and a bonfire, subject to weather conditions and local permissions.
Notes
A little heads-up: The drive to Sangla is long (approx. 5.5 hours). Pack your favourite snacks, some patience, and essentials.
Winter alert: Roads beyond Sangla towards Chitkul may experience snow accumulation, black ice or temporary closures. If road conditions do not permit, the group may stay in Sangla or an accessible nearby location.

itinerary.title: Chitkul to Tabo via Nako | 3h 30m (126 km)
itinerary.description:
Enjoy breakfast before heading towards Tabo through the dramatic landscapes of Kinnaur and the cold desert region. Stop at the iconic Khab Bridge, where the Sutlej and Spiti rivers meet, and continue towards Nako Village to visit Nako Lake and the ancient Nako Monastery, subject to accessibility. Proceed to Gue Village, home to the mysterious Gue Monastery and its naturally preserved 500-year-old mummy. Arrive in Tabo by evening, check into your accommodation and enjoy dinner.
Notes
Winter alert: Dhankar is located at a higher elevation and may experience heavy snow or icy roads. The visit may be modified or skipped if conditions are unsafe.

itinerary.title: Tabo to Kaza via Dhankar | 3.5h (110 km)
itinerary.description: Begin the day with a visit to the ancient Tabo Caves, offering panoramic views of Tabo Village and the surrounding mountains, subject to accessibility. Return for breakfast before exploring the historic Tabo Monastery, dating back to 996 AD, known for its ancient murals and traditional architecture. Continue towards Kaza, stopping at Dhankar Village and the spectacular Dhankar Monastery, perched dramatically on a cliff overlooking the confluence of the Spiti and Pin rivers. Reach Kaza by evening and settle in for dinner.

itinerary.title: Exploring Kaza (Overnight stay in Kaza)
itinerary.description: After breakfast, set out to explore the iconic high-altitude villages of Spiti Valley. Visit Langza Village, famous for its giant Buddha statue and fossil heritage, followed by Hikkim, home to the famous high-altitude post office where you can send postcards to your loved ones. Continue to Komic Village and explore its ancient monastery amid dramatic mountain landscapes. Later, visit the iconic Key Monastery and enjoy panoramic views of the surrounding mountains before heading to Chicham Bridge, connecting remote Himalayan villages across a deep gorge. Return to Kaza in the evening for a leisurely stroll through Kaza Market, local shopping and free time with fellow travellers.

itinerary.title: Kaza to Kalpa (Overnight stay in Kalpa)
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast before beginning the scenic drive back through the beautiful landscapes of Spiti and Kinnaur towards Kalpa. Take a stop at a beautiful waterfall, subject to seasonal conditions and accessibility, and enjoy the mountain scenery along the way. Arrive in Kalpa by afternoon or evening, depending on road conditions, and take in the magnificent views of the Kinner Kailash mountain range, weather permitting. Spend the evening relaxing before enjoying a special group dinner, music and conversations with fellow travellers.

itinerary.title: Kalpa to Shimla (Overnight journey to Delhi)
itinerary.description: Wake up to the beautiful Himalayan surroundings and enjoy breakfast before checking out. Begin the scenic drive towards Shimla through the mountain landscapes of Kinnaur, with comfort stops and short scenic breaks along the way. Arrive in Shimla by evening and board the overnight bus or Tempo Traveller for the return journey to Delhi.

itinerary.title: Early morning arrival in Delhi
itinerary.description:
Arrive in Delhi early in the morning, subject to traffic and road conditions, marking the end of your Winter Spiti Expedition. Return home with unforgettable Himalayan memories, beautiful experiences and new friendships.

trips.title: Sikkim Darjeeling Tour Gangtok Pelling Tiger Hill

itinerary.title: Arrival at Bagdogra Airport | Transfer to Gangtok
itinerary.description: Arrive at Bagdogra Airport, where our representative will welcome you and assist with your transfer to Gangtok. After checking in at your hotel, relax and enjoy the rest of the day at leisure, with an overnight stay in Gangtok.

itinerary.title: Tsomgo Lake and Baba Mandir Full day tour
itinerary.description:
After an early breakfast, set out for a full-day excursion to the beautiful Tsomgo Lake, surrounded by spectacular mountain scenery. You may enjoy an optional yak ride near the lake before visiting Baba Harbhajan Mandir, built in memory of Indian soldier Baba Harbhajan Singh. Nathula Pass is an optional sightseeing point, subject to weather conditions and additional charges.
Notes
Please carry 4 passport-size photographs and photocopies of valid government photo IDs (voter’s ID or passport).
For children, school ID cards or birth certificates are required.
Aadhaar Card is not accepted as valid ID proof under the Sikkim Government rules mentioned for this excursion.
Nathula pass is an optional sightseeing point, the cost will be additional and dynamic and visit is completely weather dependent.

itinerary.title: Gangtok – Namchi – Ravangla – Pelling
itinerary.description: After breakfast, travel towards Pelling through the scenic landscapes of Namchi and Ravangla. Visit the magnificent Char Dham in Namchi and enjoy the beautiful surroundings and Greater Himalayan views of Ravangla. Continue your journey through tea gardens, pine forests and mountain scenery before arriving in Pelling, where you can check in and relax for the evening.

itinerary.title: Pelling Full Day Local Sightseeing – Sky Walk – Transfer to Darjeeling
itinerary.description:
Explore Pelling’s scenic attractions, beginning with Kanchenjunga Waterfalls, followed by Pema Yangtse Monastery, Rimbi Waterfalls, Khecheopalri Sacred Lake, Khecheopalri Monastery and the impressive Pelling Sky Walk. Later, travel to Darjeeling, check in at your hotel and enjoy some time exploring Darjeeling Mall and the local bazaars, known for Tibetan artefacts and regional tea varieties. Pelling sightseeing is subject to time availability due to the onward transfer. Singshore Bridge is listed as an optional activity in the PDF exclusions, not as a scheduled sightseeing stop.
Notes
Pelling sightseeing on this day is subject to time availability, as you will be travelling to Darjeeling on the same day. Every effort will be made to cover the listed attractions. So be considerate of the timings.

itinerary.title: Darjeeling Full-Day Local Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Begin early with a visit to Tiger Hill to witness the spectacular sunrise over the Himalayan ranges. On the return journey, stop at Ghoom Monastery and the iconic Batasia Loop. After breakfast, continue with a full-day Darjeeling sightseeing tour covering the Japanese Temple, Peace Pagoda, Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park, Himalayan Mountaineering Institute, Tenzing Rock and an outer view of the Tea Garden. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay in Darjeeling.

itinerary.title: Departure - Drop to Bagdogra airport.
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out from your hotel and proceed to Bagdogra Airport for your onward journey. Depart with lasting memories of the scenic landscapes, cultural attractions and Himalayan beauty of Sikkim and Darjeeling.
