itinerary.description: Arrive at Leh Airport, where our representative will welcome you and transfer you to your hotel. Complete the check-in formalities and spend the day resting to allow your body to acclimatise to the high altitude. Avoid strenuous activities and keep yourself hydrated. You can explore Leh Market in the evening, subject to your health and comfort.

After breakfast, explore some of the most popular attractions around Leh. Visit Hall of Fame, a museum dedicated to the Indian Armed Forces, followed by Gurudwara Pathar Sahib and the fascinating Magnetic Hill. Continue towards the scenic confluence of the Indus and Zanskar Rivers, popularly known as Sangam. Visit Spituk Monastery before returning to Leh.

After breakfast, begin your journey towards Nubra Valley via the spectacular Khardung La Pass, one of the world's highest motorable mountain passes. Enjoy panoramic views of the surrounding Himalayan ranges before descending into the beautiful Nubra Valley. Visit Diskit Monastery and the impressive Maitreya Buddha statue overlooking the valley. Later, explore the famous Hunder Sand Dunes, where you can enjoy the unique landscape and optional double-humped Bactrian camel rides.

After breakfast, embark on a scenic drive towards Turtuk Village, located close to the Indo-Pakistan border. Known for its unique Balti culture, traditional architecture and beautiful natural surroundings, Turtuk offers a fascinating glimpse into a lesser-explored side of Ladakh. Walk through its charming village lanes, visit traditional homes, explore apricot orchards and experience the local culture. Later, return to Hunder for your overnight stay.

After breakfast, check out and proceed towards the mesmerising Pangong Tso via the scenic Shyok route. Enjoy spectacular views of rugged mountains, river valleys and dramatic landscapes along the way. On arrival at Pangong Lake, witness its extraordinary blue waters surrounded by towering mountains. Spend the evening exploring the lakeside and enjoying the beautiful sunset.

Wake up to the beautiful views of Pangong Lake. After breakfast, begin your return journey to Leh via Chang La Pass, another spectacular high-altitude mountain pass. En route, visit the magnificent Thiksey Monastery, known for its impressive architecture and resemblance to the Potala Palace of Tibet. Continue towards Shey Palace, the former royal residence of Ladakh, before reaching Leh.

After breakfast, check out from the hotel and transfer to Leh Airport for your onward journey. Depart with unforgettable memories of Ladakh's breathtaking landscapes, monasteries and unique cultural experiences.

itinerary.title: Departure from Mumbai/Pune - Delhi/Chandigarh
itinerary.description:
The beautiful jouney to Himachal will commence from Mumbai. Assemble at Bandra/Vasai railway station and Meet our Co-ordinates. Departure by Train no. 12925/12217/12909.
Pune people will travel by Shivshahi bus/Train & then Board the train from Mumbai.

itinerary.title: Delhi/Chandigarh - Shimla (4 hours)
itinerary.description: Pickup from Chandigarh by around 2:00 PM in a private tempo. As we begin our drive, watch the scenery slowly transform, winding roads, cool mountain air, and snow-capped peaks drawing closer with every turn. in the evening we will be taking a snacks break on the way at a restaurant Soon, we arrive in Shimla, the Queen of Himachal (or Shoghi). Check in to the hotel, unwind, and enjoy a warm dinner as the hills welcome you.

itinerary.title: Shimla - Kufri - Narkanda - Kalpa ( 8 - 9 hours)
itinerary.description:
After B/F, check-out from the Hotel, Today We’ll be passing through the beautiful towns of Narkanda & Sarahan before entering the spectacular Kinnaur Valley.
Before entering Kalpa at 7500 feet, you might catch a glimpse of the famous Kinnaur Kailash Peak – said to be the summer adobe of Lord Shiva while it’s covered in snow.

itinerary.title: Kalpa - Nako - Kaza ( 8 - 9 hours)
itinerary.description:
After a restful night in Kalpa, we begin our journey along the legendary Hindustan–Tibet Highway, known for its dramatic landscapes and proximity to Tibet.
En route, we stop at Khab, the confluence of the Spiti and Sutlej Rivers, where the contrasting colors of the two rivers are clearly visible.
We then visit Nako, the last village of the Kinnaur district, famous for its picturesque frozen lake. By evening, we arrive in Kaza, the headquarters of Spiti Valley, and check in to a homestay.

itinerary.title: Kaza - Key - Kibber - Hikkim - Langza - Chicham (6 - 7 hours)
itinerary.description:
We start the day with high-altitude circuit of Spiti Valley, visiting Hikkim, home to the world’s highest post office, followed by Langza and Komic, where vast landscapes and snow-draped views create a surreal mountain experience.
We also stop at the engineering marvel of Chicham Bridge, suspended high above the gorge.
Later with a scenic drive to the iconic Key Monastery, perched dramatically at 13,668 ft. Our vehicle stops at the base of the hill for that classic Spiti postcard photograph, before we explore this 1,000-year-old monastery steeped in history and spirituality. Return to Kaza by evening for a warm meal and well-earned rest.

itinerary.title: Kaza - Dhangkar Monastery - Tabo (4 hours)
itinerary.description:
We start the day with a relaxed stroll through Kaza Market, perfect for picking up souvenirs and local handicrafts.
By Early afternoon, we hop into our tempo and drive onward, stopping at the stunning Dhankar Monastery (subject to road conditions), one of Spiti’s most dramatic cliffside monasteries.
En route, we pause at a scenic Spiti River viewpoint to soak in the raw beauty of the valley before continuing our journey. By evening, we arrive at the serene village of Tabo, ready to unwind after the day’s explorations.

itinerary.title: Tabo - Gue Monastery - Sangla (7 hours)
itinerary.description:
Wake up to stunning snow-clad mountain views in Tabo. After breakfast, visit the UNESCO-listed Tabo Monastery, one of the oldest monasteries in the Himalayas.
Gue Monastery, nestled in the remote Spiti Valley of Himachal Pradesh, is famous for its 500-year-old naturally preserved mummy of a Buddhist monk.
Later, we bid farewell to Spiti Valley and re-enter Kinnaur Valley, driving through scenic towns such as Pooh and Spello, before continuing towards Sangla. Arrive by evening and check in to the hotel.

itinerary.title: Sangla - Chitkul - Sarahan (5 - 6 hours)
itinerary.description:
In the morning, we proceed towards Chitkul (subject to road conditions), known as the last inhabited village in India before the Indo–Tibet border.
The village offers unmatched natural beauty and a truly magical Himalayan experience. As Chitkul may remain inaccessible during peak winters, Rakcham will be visited as an alternative if the road is open till there.

itinerary.title: Sarahan - Chandigarh
itinerary.description:
The final chapter of this unforgettable Winter Expedition begins today. After breakfast, we explore Sarahan and seek blessings at the revered Bhima Kali Temple, soaking in the peaceful mountain vibes one last time.
Later, we drive towards the vibrant city of Chandigarh, carrying along a heart full of memories, laughter, and stories from the mountains.
We will arrive at Chandigarh Railway Station around 11:00 PM and wait there for our train, 12450, which is scheduled to depart at 2:15 AM.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Mumbai
itinerary.description:
We arrive at Vasai Railway Station around 11:30 PM, followed by Panvel Railway Station at approximately 12:40 AM (Day 11). (Train no. 12450/12626)
Mumbai people can continue their way back to home either by Train/Cab on personal expense Travellers heading to Pune can continue their journey by bus or train from Vasai.

trips.title: Vietnam with Phu Quoc 9 Days Group Trip

itinerary.title: Fly from India - Arrival at Phu Quoc Airport
itinerary.description:
Arrival & Check-In: Arrive at Phu Quoc Airport and take your transfer to the hotel. After check-in, relax for a bit, freshen up.
Later in the day, you can head out to explore the pretty canals, gondola ride, see the Bamboo Legend structure, explore small shops, and enjoy the lively atmosphere.
If you feel like keeping it more relaxed, spend some time at Long Beach, enjoy the sea. In the evening, you can also visit Duong Dong Night Market to trylocal food and pick upsome souvenirs.

itinerary.title: Vin World & Vin Safari
itinerary.description:
Begin your day with a relaxed breakfast at the hotel, visit VinWonders Amusement Park to enjoy a variety of fun rides, games, and entertainment.
Later head to Vinpearl Safari Park, Vietnam’s largest wildlife park, where you can take a safari ride in a bus and watch animals like giraffes, tigers, and rhinos moving freely.
After spending a fun-filled day exploring and enjoying the activities, return to your hotel in the evening. Relax and unwind after the day’s experiences, followed by an overnight stay in Phu Quoc.

itinerary.title: Phu Quoc 4 Island Speedboat Tour + Cable Car & Aquatopia Water Park
itinerary.description:
Island-Hopping by Speedboat:
After breakfast, proceed to An Thoi Port and embark on an exciting speedboat adventure. Visit
Hon San Ho to relax, take photos, or enjoy the optional Sea Walking experience at an additional cost.
Snorkeling & Beach Relaxation:
Continue to Hon Gam Ghi for an enjoyable snorkeling experience, followed by May Rut Ngoai Island, where you can swim, unwind, and relax on the beautiful beach.
Aquatopia Water Park & Hon Thom Cable Car:
Head to Hon Thom Island and enjoy an exciting day at Aquatopia Water Park, featuring thrilling rides and attractions. Later, experience the spectacular Hon Thom Cable Car, one of the world's longest overwater cable car rides, offering breathtaking views of the surrounding islands.
Kiss Bridge & Sunset Town:
Continue to Kiss Bridge, an iconic architectural landmark, and explore the charming Sunset Town, known for its Mediterranean-inspired streets, cafés, vibrant atmosphere, and stunning ocean views.

itinerary.title: Phu Quoc - Da Nang - My Khe Beach
itinerary.description:
Arrival & Hotel Check-In:
Arrive in Da Nang from Phu Quoc and transfer to your hotel. Check in, freshen up, and take some time to relax after the journey.
Explore Da Nang at Your Own Pace:
Spend the afternoon unwinding or exploring the city on your own. You can stroll along My Khe Beach, enjoy the sea views, or relax at one of the beachfront cafés.
Optional Scooty Ride – Coastal Road & Linh Ung Pagoda:
For those looking for a little adventure, rent a scooty and take a scenic ride along Da Nang’s beautiful coastal road towards Linh Ung Pagoda on Son Tra Peninsula. Enjoy panoramic views of the coastline and stop at scenic viewpoints along the way.
Evening by the Han River:
Return to the city and spend the evening around the Han River, exploring the riverside promenade and nearby cafés and restaurants. Enjoy a relaxed dinner and return to the hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Ba Na Hills
itinerary.description:
Post Breakfast transfer to Ba Na Hills.
Ba Na Hills : Marvel at the stunning mountain and coastline views and take the world’s longest cable car ride to the summit.
Golden Bridge & More: Explore the iconic Golden Bridge and the enchanting French Village.
Enjoy the thrilling rides and games at Fantasy Park. (Note: The Alpine Coaster is available for an additional cost of approximately 250 INR, payable on-site.)
Return to Da Nang: Head back to Da Nang in the evening and transfer to your hotel for a restful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Da Nang - Marble Mountains - Coracle Boat - Hoi An
itinerary.description:
Marble Mountains: Check out from your Da Nang hotel and transfer to Hoi An enroute visit Marble Mountains famous limestone hills.
Basket Boat Ride: Experience the charming Basket Boat Tour (Coconut Boat Tour) in the afternoon.
Hoi An Ancient Town : Spend your evening exploring the beautifully preserved Hoi An Ancient Town.
Lantern Experience : For an extra touch of magic, consider a lantern boat ride on the river for just $3 or $4. Enjoy the serene ambiance under the softly glowing lanterns.
Overnight in Hoi An: Conclude your day with an overnight stay in Hoi An.

itinerary.title: Hoi An - Da Nang - Hanoi
itinerary.description:
Flight to Hanoi: After breakfast, take a domestic flight to Hanoi.
Check-In & Leisure Time: Check in to your hotel (standard check-in time is between 14:00 and 15:00). Enjoy the afternoon at your leisure, whether for sightseeing or shopping.
Old Quarter & Train Street:
Explore the bustling Old Quarter’s narrow streets, vibrant food markets, and unique souvenir shops. Don’t miss the train market where a train passes through a narrow street at 18:30. Overnight in Hanoi: Stay overnight in Hanoi.

itinerary.title: Halong Bay Cruise + Kayaking
itinerary.description:
Journey to Halong Bay: Start your day with breakfast before embarking on a scenic journey to Halong Bay, a UNESCO World
Heritage Site.
Cruise Experience: Board a comfortable & Luxury cruise ship for a captivating tour of Halong Bay’s stunning limestone islands. Enjoy a delicious lunch onboard as you sail through the bay.
Ti Top Island: Visit Ti Top Island for a swim at the beach or hike up Ti Top Mountain for panoramic views.
Kayaking & Caving: Explore the tranquil waters and hidden caves of Halong Bay with included kayaking.

itinerary.title: Shopping & Departure
itinerary.description:
Final Day in Hanoi: Take some time for last-minute shopping or relaxation in Hanoi.
Departure: Bid farewell to Vietnam, carrying with you unforgettable memories and experiences from your journey.

itinerary.title: Guwahati - Kaziranga
itinerary.description:
Reach Guwahati by 9:00 am, freshen up at the station, and kickstart your day with a hearty breakfast.
12:00 PM: Airport pickups begin for flyers joining the adventure. Head to Kaziranga: Enjoy a scenic drive through Assam’s lush landscapes as we make our way to the legendary Kaziranga National Park, home to the iconic One-Horned Rhino.
Arrive and check in at your Kaziranga stay, where a cozy overnight stay awaits.

itinerary.title: Kaziranga Safari - Shillong (7 - 8 hour drive)
itinerary.description:
Morning Safari: Kickstart your day with an exciting early-morning Jeep Safari in Kaziranga National Park. Keep your eyes peeled—you might spot the iconic One-Horned Rhino, majestic elephants, vibrant birdlife, and if you're lucky, even a tiger!
After a hearty breakfast at the hotel, settle in for a beautiful drive to Shillong, the charming capital of Meghalaya known for its rolling hills and refreshing climate. (7 hours)
Reach Shillong late in the evening and check into your hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Laitlum Canyons - Phe Phe Waterfall - Dawki (5 hour drive)
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, drive to the Laitlum Canyons. The name “Laitlum” translates to “End of Hills,” and the views here are absolutely mesmerizing—lush green valleys, cascading waterfalls, and sweeping vistas.
Next, visit Phe phe Falls, a serene and lesser known waterfall nestled amidst the hills. Dawki & Shnongpdeng: Continue your journey to Dawki, a small town on the India-Bangladesh border.
Here, you’ll check into your campsite at Shnongpdeng for a night under the stars.

itinerary.title: Dawki - Mawlynnong - Cherrapunji (6 hour drive)
itinerary.description:
Start the day with a boat ride on the crystal-clear waters of the Umngot River, famously known as the cleanest river in Asia. If you’re feeling adventurous, you can opt for cliff jumping into the river! Enjoy a hot, local lunch at a nearby restaurant.
Indo-Bangladesh Border: Visit the Indo-Bangladesh border at Dawki and enjoy the beautiful panoramic views from the viewpoint.
Proceed to Mawlynnong, Asia’s cleanest village. Stroll through the village, explore its vibrant markets, and admire the meticulously maintained surroundings.
Later, drive to Cherrapunji, famous for its stunning waterfalls and rich natural beauty. Check-in to your hotel or guesthouse for an overnight stay

itinerary.title: Nongriat Double Decker Bridge - Blue Lagoon (31st Dec in Shillong)
itinerary.description:
(25th Dec Batch Itinerary we will be covering Kaziranga on 1st January so that 31st Night Stay will be in Shillong)
After breakfast, head to Tyrna Village, the starting point for the Nongriat trek. Hike through dense forests to reach the breathtaking Double Decker Living Root Bridges (1.5 hour). Relax by the natural pools nearby, and if time permits, continue for an additional 45-minute hike to the beautiful Blue Lagoon.
Post trek, return to Cherrapunji for an overnight stay at a cozy homestay with a warm meal.

itinerary.title: Explore Cherrapunji - Shillong
itinerary.description:
Begin your day with a visit to the stunning Wei Sawdong Waterfalls, known for its picturesque beauty and peaceful surroundings. Late we explore the Arwah Caves, famous for their limestone formations and historical significance.
Continue to Nohkalikai Falls, the tallest waterfall in Meghalaya, which plunges from a height of 1,115 feet, offering spectacular views. Drive back to Shillong, where you’ll check into your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Shillong - Guwahati drop
itinerary.description:
Start your day with an early breakfast before we head to Guwahati Railway Station to board our train back to Mumbai—time for one last round of window-seat views and farewell vibes!
Our Guwahati package travellers will be dropped at the airport & Railway station by 3/5 PM for their onward journey. (Return Train No. 15946/15660)

itinerary.title: Arrival in Ho Chi Minh, Vietnam
itinerary.description:
Arrival & Check-In: Arrive in Ho Chi Minh City and experience local breakfast. check in to your hotel around 14:00.
Explore Bui Vien Street: After resting, venture out to Bui Vien Walking Street. Discover the vibrant nightlife at your own pace, exploring lively cafes, pubs, and party spots.
Sightseeing: If time permits, self explore nearby attractions such as the Independence Palace, War Remnants Museum, Notre Dame Cathedral, Central Post Office, and the Opera House.

itinerary.title: Cu Chi Tunnel Tour | Fly to Da Nang
itinerary.description:
Cu Chi Tunnels Tour: Experience a fascinating tour of the Cu Chi Tunnels, an extensive network of underground passages used during the Vietnam War.
Flight to Da Nang: Fly to Da Nang and check in to your resort, enjoying the scenic coastal views.
Relaxation: Spend the remaining of the day unwinding and taking in the serene environment of your beachfront accommodation.

itinerary.title: Ba Na Hills | My Khe Beach
itinerary.description:
Ba Na Hills Exploration: Begin with a hearty breakfast before heading to Ba Na Hills. Marvel at the stunning mountain and coastline views and take the world’s longest cable car ride to the adventure park.
Golden Bridge & More: Explore the iconic Golden Bridge, the Linh Ung Pagoda, and the enchanting French Village. Enjoy the thrilling rides and games at Fantasy Park. (Note: The Alpine Coaster is available for an additional cost of approximately 300 INR, payable on-site.)
Return to Da Nang: Head back to Da Nang in the evening and transfer to your hotel for a restful overnight stay. Self explore My Khe beach of Da Nang

itinerary.title: Marble Mountains | Basket Boat ride | Hoi An
itinerary.description:
Marble Mountains : Check out from your Da Nang hotel and transfer to Hoi An enroute visit Marble Mountains famous limestone hills.
Basket Boat Ride: Experience the charming Basket Boat Tour (Coconut Boat Tour) in the afternoon.
Hoi An Ancient Town: Spend your evening exploring the beautifully preserved Hoi An Ancient Town. (Self Explore)
Lantern Experience: For an extra touch of magic, consider a lantern boat ride on the river for just $3 or $4. Enjoy the serene ambiance under the softly glowing lanterns.
Overnight in Hoi An: Conclude your day with an overnight stay in Hoi An.

itinerary.title: Flight to Hanoi | Train Street
itinerary.description:
Flight to Hanoi: Wake up with a view of the Vietnam’s Countryside
After breakfast, Travel to Da Nang Airport - take a domestic flight to Hanoi.
Check-In & Leisure Time: Check in to your hotel (standard check-in time is between 14:00). Enjoy the afternoon at your leisure, whether for sightseeing or shopping.
Old Quarter & Train Street:
Explore the bustling Old Quarter’s narrow streets, vibrant food markets, and unique souvenir shops. Don’t miss the train market where a train passes through a narrow street at 18:30.
Overnight in Hanoi: Stay overnight in Hanoi.

itinerary.title: Halong Bay | Luxury Cruise | Kayaking
itinerary.description:
Journey to Halong Bay: Start your day with breakfast before embarking on a scenic journey to Halong Bay, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
Cruise Experience: Board a comfortable & Luxury cruise ship for a captivating tour of Halong Bay’s stunning limestone islands. Enjoy a delicious lunch onboard as you sail through the bay.
Ti Top Island: Visit Ti Top Island for a swim at the beach or hike up Ti Top Mountain for panoramic views.
Kayaking & Caving: Explore the tranquil waters and beautiful caves of Halong Bay with included kayaking.
Get back to Hanoi Hotel late in the evening.

itinerary.title: Hanoi Explore | Departure to India
itinerary.description:
Final Day in Hanoi: Take some time for last-minute shopping or relaxation in Hanoi or visit the beautiful Hoan Kiem Lake in Hanoi.
Departure: Bid farewell to Vietnam, carrying with you unforgettable memories and experiences from your journey. Drop back to Hanoi Airport for your onward flight.
( You can add 1 Day for a day Visit to Ninh Binh & Trang an boating, Kindly contact our team Approx Expense INR 6000)

itinerary.title: Departure from Mumbai
itinerary.description:
The beautiful jouney to Himachal will commence from Mumbai. Assemble at Bandra railway station and Meet our Co-ordinates. Departure by Train no. 22451/12903
Pune people will travel by Shivshahi bus/train/cab to Mumbai & then Board the train from Borivali.

itinerary.title: Ambala/Chandigarh - Kasol
itinerary.description: Upon arriving in Ambala, we’ll enjoy a delicious Dinner enroute entering the beautiful state of Himachal Pradesh. we’ll embark on our overnight journey to Kasol, enlivened with fun games and lively interactions along the way.

itinerary.title: Explore Kasol
itinerary.description:
Arrive in Kasol, After checking in at our river side Camp and Freshen up, it’s time to explore this vibrant town. Whether you’re fulfilling your travel dreams or simply relaxing, Kasol offers something for everyone.
Spend the day chilling by the Parvati River, you can take a short trek to Chalal Village, and indulging in local delicacies like Himachali momos, Maggi, and brownies.
Visit the Manikaran Gurudwara and experience the soothing hot springs. After a day of exploration at your own pace, regroup for dinner + Bonfire

itinerary.title: Kasol - Manali via Kullu
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out and begin the journey to Manali. On the way, stop in Kullu for an exhilarating white water rafting experience. Arrive in Manali by evening and visit the Hadimba Devi Temple if time permits.
The rest of the evening is free for you to explore Mall Road and the famous cafes of Old Manali.

itinerary.title: Manali sightseeing
itinerary.description:
Start the day with a hearty breakfast before heading out to Solang Valley and the Atal Tunnel, weather permitting. Spend the afternoon enjoying adventure activities, and if time allows, visit the Vashisht Temple and its hot springs on the way back to Manali.
Return to the hotel by evening and relax for the rest of the day.

itinerary.title: Manali - Bir
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out and depart for Bir. Arrive in the evening and take some time to explore the lively cafes with live music.
Gather around with your group for some fun games and enjoy the evening.

itinerary.title: Explore Bir - Overnight to Amritsar
itinerary.description:
Rise early for a chance to experience paragliding at Asia’s highest paragliding site, subject to weather conditions (at your own cost).
After checkout, Spend the rest of the day exploring Bir on Cycle/Bike (by your own) visit Tibetan monasteries, hiking to nearby scenic spots, and enjoying cafe hopping.
Later in the evening, embark on an overnight journey to Amritsar. (Breakfast)

itinerary.title: Explore Amritsar
itinerary.description:
Arrive in Amritsar early in the morning and check in to your hotel (early check-in subject to availability). Visit the Golden Temple followed by a lunch of local delicacies.
In the afternoon, head to Wagah Border to witness the Parade & Flag Ceremony, a truly patriotic experience. Return to Amritsar by evening.

itinerary.title: Departure from Amritsar
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out and head to Amritsar Railway Station to catch your train back to Mumbai.
Spend the day on the train reminiscing about the trip, sharing photos, and making plans for future adventures. (11058 / 12926 / 12904)

itinerary.title: Arrival in Mumbai
itinerary.description: Arrival in Mumbai with Sweet memories and it’s time for farewell. Pune people will board bus/Train/Cab from Mumbai to pune.

itinerary.title: Departure from Mumbai
itinerary.description:
The beautiful jouney to Himachal will commence from Mumbai. Assemble railway station and Meet our Co-ordinates. Departure by Train no. 19019/12909/12216
Pune people will travel by Shivshahi bus/Train & then Board the train from Mumbai.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Haridwar/Delhi - Jim Corbett
itinerary.description:
Upon arrival in Delhi/Hairdwar, we continue our journey by road to Jim Corbett National park.
Late evening, we reach our hotel. After freshening up, ice breaking session & fun games with your fellow travelers (Dinner included)

itinerary.title: Morning Safari - Rishikesh
itinerary.description:
Early morning, proceed for an exciting jungle safari in Jim Corbett National Park, where you may spot wildlife such as the Bengal Tiger, Asian Elephant, Spotted Deer, Wild Boar, Leopard, and a variety of exotic birds.
After the safari, return to the resort, check out, and begin your scenic drive to Rishikesh.
Enjoy some free time to explore the vibrant local markets of Rishikesh before returning to the hotel for dinner. (Breakfast + Dinner included)

itinerary.title: Explore Rishikesh (Self Explore)
itinerary.description:
Wake up to the soothing sounds of the Ganges and enjoy a relaxed day exploring Rishikesh at your own pace. Adventure enthusiasts can opt for thrilling activities such as white-water rafting, bungee jumping, zip-lining, or cliff jumping.
Those seeking a slower, more soulful experience can walk across the iconic Laxman Jhula and Ram Jhula, unwind at scenic riverside cafés, or visit the renowned Beatles Ashram.
Evening witness Ganga Aarti & The day concludes with an overnight stay in Rishikesh. (Breakfast & Dinner included)

itinerary.title: Rishikesh - Chopta (10 hour)
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, we set out for Chopta, often referred to as the “Mini Switzerland of India.” The scenic journey of approximately 8–10 hours unfolds through winding mountain roads, dense forests, and refreshing mountain air, offering breathtaking views along the way.
Upon arrival, we check into our cozy campsite nestled amidst pine and deodar trees. The evening is reserved for unwinding in nature, followed by a warm bonfire under a starlit sky. (Overnight camping at Chopta | Breakfast & Dinner included)
Note : If our vehicles are restricted to enter the valley due to Snowfall/Traffic, local taxi’s will be arranged at Additional cost & you need to pay on the spot to our Trip Captain.

itinerary.title: Chopta - Tungnath
itinerary.description:
Rise early and begin your scenic trek to Tungnath, the highest Shiva temple in the world. For those seeking an extra dose of adventure, the trail continues onward to Chandrashila Peak, where you’re rewarded with breathtaking 360-degree views of majestic snow-clad peaks such as Nanda Devi, Trishul, and Chaukhamba.
Later, we descend back to the base, spending the evening at leisure—resting, sharing stories, and soaking in the mountain calm. (Overnight camping | Breakfast & Dinner included)
Note 1) Local taxi’s till Tungnath start point from Camp is Included 2) Tungnath Temple remains closed during the Winter months, We will just be Trekking to Tungnath & Visit Temple from outside

itinerary.title: Chopta - Mussoorie (12 hour)
itinerary.description:
We bid farewell to Chopta and drive towards the charming hill station of Mussoorie, fondly known as the “Queen of Hills.” The scenic journey of approximately 10 - 12 hours leads us through winding mountain roads and lush landscapes.
Upon arrival, we check into our hotel and unwind. Rest for the night as we will be reaching late. (Overnight stay in Mussoorie | Breakfast & Dinner included)

itinerary.title: Self Explore Mussoorie
itinerary.description:
Post breakfast & Checkout from the hotel, Today is dedicated to exploring the highlights of Mussoorie. Begin the day with a visit to the picturesque Kempty Falls, followed by the serene Dalai Hills, adorned with colorful prayer flags and offering sweeping panoramic views.
Later Self explore by Scooty/Bike/local taxi - the lush Company Garden or enjoy a peaceful walk along Camel’s Back Road or head to Landour, soaking in the town’s cool climate and old-world charm. post Dinner we begin our overnight journey to Delhi. (Breakfast included)

itinerary.title: Departure from Delhi/Haridwar
itinerary.description:
Arrive in Haridwar/Delhi by road and proceed to board your return train or flight to Mumbai.
As the journey comes to an end, carry back a heart full of mountain memories, soulful experiences, and cherished friendships formed along the way. (Train No.: 12215 / 19020)

itinerary.title: Arrival in Mumbai
itinerary.description: Arrive in Mumbai, marking the conclusion of an unforgettable 9-day journey through the majestic landscapes and spiritual heartlands of North India. A trip filled with adventure, serenity, and awe-inspiring natural beauty—memories that will stay with you long after the journey ends.

trips.title: Bali with Gili & Nusa - Group Trip

itinerary.title: HELLO BALI 🌴
itinerary.description:
Touch down in Bali, meet the group and head straight to Kuta.
After checking in, take it easy. Grab some food, walk around Kuta Market, explore the nearby streets or simply chill at the hotel after your flight.
The trip officially starts here — no packed schedule, no rushing around.

itinerary.title: Surf, Cliffs & a Bali Sunset or a Beach Club
itinerary.description:
Start the morning with a surfing session at Kuta Beach. Whether you're standing on a board for the first time or already know your way around the waves, this is meant to be a fun introduction to Bali's surf culture.
Visit
Uluwatu Temple, perched dramatically on the cliffs overlooking the Indian Ocean. Take in the views, explore the temple surroundings and stick around for one of Bali's most famous sunset experiences.
As the sun goes down, watch the Kecak Fire Dance, a traditional Balinese performance set against the ocean backdrop.
Its time to head back towards Kuta for dinner, drinks or a night out with the group.

itinerary.title: Nusa Penida Full Day Tour 🏝️
itinerary.description:
Head to Sanur Harbour and board a fast boat to Nusa Penida. Once on the island, we're heading straight for some of its most famous landscapes.
📍
Kelingking Beach
The famous T-Rex-shaped cliff and one of the most recognisable views in Bali.
📍
Broken Beach
A naturally formed coastal arch with turquoise water surrounded by dramatic cliffs.
📍
Angel's Billabong or Crystal Bay
A natural infinity-pool-style formation overlooking the ocean.
(harbour fee to be paid additionally on spot)
After exploring, return to the harbour and take the fast boat back to Bali.

itinerary.title: Bye Bali, Hello GIli Islands
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, transfer towards the port and board your fast boat to Gili Trawangan.
Once you arrive, check in and forget about traffic for a while, Gili T is made for slowing down — no cars, sandy paths, bicycles, turquoise water and some seriously good sunsets.
Spend the afternoon exploring the island by bicycle, finding your favourite beach spot or simply doing absolutely nothing.
As evening arrives, Gili T comes alive. Grab dinner, watch the sunset and head out with the group for the island's famous nightlife/Pub Crawl (harbour fee to be paid additionally on spot)

itinerary.title: Gili Day in Islands 🤿
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, head out on a Gili snorkelling trip and explore the waters around the neighbouring islands.
Look out for: 🐢 Turtle Point
🤿 Snorkelling spots 🌊 Gili Meno
🗿 Underwater statues 🏝️ Island beaches Spend the afternoon back on Gili T — grab a drink, chill on the beach, go cycling or just hang with the group.
It's sunset time again. Because one Gili sunset is obviously not enough.

itinerary.title: Islands to Jungle (Gili T - Ubud)
itinerary.description:
Say goodbye to Gili and head back towards mainland Bali.
Once you reach Bali, continue towards Ubud, one of the greener and more laid-back parts of the island.
Check into the hotel and spend the rest of the evening at your own pace, Explore the local streets, grab some good food, visit Ubud Market or find a café surrounded by greenery.
Tonight is deliberately slower. Tomorrow isn't.

itinerary.title: ATV RIde - Alas Haram Swings - RIce Fields
itinerary.description:
Start with an ATV adventure through Bali's countryside. Expect muddy tracks, rice fields, water crossings and plenty of moments where you'll wonder why you wore clean clothes.
After the ride, freshen up and head to Alas Harum.
Take in the lush rice terrace landscapes, explore the property and get your camera ready for the famous Bali swings and viewpoints.
Spend the evening with the group in Ubud — good food, drinks, conversations and the inevitable "how is tomorrow already the last day?" moment.

itinerary.title: Until Next time, Bali ✈️
itinerary.description:
Have breakfast, pack your bags and enjoy some free time depending on your flight schedule.
Your Bali adventure ends with a transfer to the airport, And yes, you're probably going to leave with way too many photos.

itinerary.title: Guwahati - Bomdila/Shergaon
itinerary.description:
Pickup from Guwahati Airport and begin our 8–9 hour scenic drive towards Bomdila, passing through the charming towns of Tezpur and Bhalukpong.
Along the way, enjoy refreshing landscapes and rich greenery.
We’ll make a short stop for photographs if time permits before continuing our journey.
After a long yet beautiful drive, the day concludes with a warm dinner and a comfortable stay at a hotel/cottage, giving you ample time to relax and unwind.

itinerary.title: Bomdila - Sela Pass - Tawang
itinerary.description:
After a comfortable night’s stay in Bomdila/Shergaon, we start the morning with a visit to the serene Bomdila Monastery, known for its peaceful atmosphere and scenic views. We then continue our journey towards the iconic Sela Pass, a high altitude mountain pass offering breathtaking alpine landscapes along the way.
From there, we proceed to the beautiful Jung Falls, located near Jang, where the refreshing sight of the cascading waterfall makes for a perfect stop. We then drive further into the mountains, arriving at the picturesque town of Tawang for an overnight stay. Breakfast and Dinner included.

itinerary.title: Tawang Sightseeing
itinerary.description:
After a delicious breakfast, dive into the vibrant charm of Tawang
! Start with a stroll through Tawang Market, where you can shop for local souvenirs and explore the town’s lively side.
Next, visit the magnificent Tawang Monastery, followed by the iconic Buddha Statue and the Tawang War Memorial. Along the way, discover a few beautiful offbeat spots and hidden corners that add an extra touch of adventure to the day.
After a day packed with culture, history, stunning views and local experiences, head back to the hotel and unwind.

itinerary.title: Bum La Pass - Indo China Border
itinerary.description:
After an early morning departure from Tawang, we drive towards the legendary Bum La Pass, located close to the Indo–China border.
The journey offers awe-inspiring views of dramatic mountain passes and high-altitude landscapes, making it one of the most thrilling drives of the trip. En route, we visit the stunning PT Tso lake & Sangetsar Lake (formerly known as Shongatser Lake and popularly called Madhuri Lake), perched at an altitude of around 3,708 metres. Surrounded by rugged mountains and serene waters, the lake is truly a sight to behold.
After an unforgettable day, we return to Tawang for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Tawang - Sangti Valley - Dirang
itinerary.description:
Today, we depart from Tawang and journey through the scenic mountain roads, passing through beautiful stretches of the national reserve as we make our way towards Dirang.
En route, we visit the breathtaking Sangti Valley, known for its sweeping landscapes, open meadows, and serene surroundings a perfect place to pause and soak in the beauty of the region.
Continuing our drive, we arrive at the charming Dirang Valley, often called the gateway to Tawang, where calm landscapes and fresh mountain air offer the perfect setting to unwind. We settle in for an overnight stay in Dirang. Breakfast and Dinner included.

itinerary.title: Dirang - Guwahati
itinerary.description:
We depart from Dirang early in the morning and begin our scenic journey towards Guwahati, enjoying changing landscapes as we move from the mountains to the plains. The long drive offers beautiful views and peaceful moments along the way.
By evening, we arrive in Guwahati and check in for an overnight stay, giving you time to relax and unwind after the journey. (Self dinner to explore Cafe’s / Restaurants)

itinerary.title: Departure from Guwahati
itinerary.description:
After a delicious breakfast, we check out by 11:00 AM and bid goodbye to the mountains and valleys that made this journey so special. The rest of the day is for self-exploring Guwahati.
You may choose to visit the renowned Kamakhya Devi Temple, explore the city or market. Our team will assist you with guidance and planning wherever needed.
Guests travelling by train will board the late-evening Mumbai-bound train (Train No. 12520) from Guwahati Railway Station, while those flying can opt for evening flights.
Please note: Drops to the Kamakhya Temple, Railway Station, or Airport are not included and will be at personal expense, as this is a self-explore day.

itinerary.title: Departure from Mumbai
itinerary.description:
Our adventure begins with our departure from Mumbai, where we gather at LTT, Thane, or Panvel Railway Station. After meeting the team, we board the 12619 Matsyagandha Exp.(3:10pm fromLTT)/ 12133 Mangaluru Exp. (10:00pm)
For those coming from Pune, you will arrive in Mumbai by bus, train, or cab and join the group to board the train to Murdeshwar.

itinerary.title: Murdeshwar - Honnavar - Gokarna
itinerary.description:
We arrive in Murdeshwar/Kumta around 11 AM and post late breakfast we head to Honnavar for a serene experience of mangroves boardwalk and backwater boating. (Depends on weather)
Later we drive to to Murudeshwar. After checking in a guesthouse and freshening up, we visit the iconic Murudeshwar Temple.
After returning, drive to Gokarna & we have our dinner in a Restaurant & then check into our hotel and enjoy a lively evening with stories, music, and dance, making for a fun night.

itinerary.title: Exploring Beaches
itinerary.description:
Following breakfast, you will have time to self explore Gokarna Market & visit Mahabaleshwar temple on own.
Post Lunch we set out for a beach trek that starts from Belekan Beach, Paradise Beach, Half Moon Beach, and Om Beach. A late lunch awaits us at a renowned café, where we savor local flavors.
After relaxing on the beach and watching the sunset, we drive to Gokarna town for some souvenir shopping & followed by Dinner.

itinerary.title: Explore Yana Caves & Departure
itinerary.description:
After a vibrant night, we drive to the Yana Caves, known for their striking natural formations. A short Hike through the scenic landscape leads you to this unique geological marvel, making it a must-visit for adventure lovers.
We then head back to Kumta/Gokarna to board our return train either Train No.12620/12202, concluding our journey with a wealth of new experiences. (Breakfast)

itinerary.title: Arrival in Mumbai
itinerary.description:
We arrive back at Thane/LTT concluding our memorable journey filled with new friends and enriching experiences.
For those traveling from Pune, you will board your return train, bringing an end to a remarkable adventure.

itinerary.title: Departure from Mumbai
itinerary.description:
Board the train from Mumbai to Jammu and begin your exciting Kashmir winter journey.
Settle in for the overnight train journey and get ready for the breathtaking landscapes that await.
(Train no. 19027)

itinerary.title: Arrival in Jammu
itinerary.description:
Arrive in Jammu late at night and transfer to your accommodation.
Freshen up, check into your room, and rest overnight (4 - 5 hrs) in preparation for your journey to Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Jammu - Srinagar (5 - 6 hour)
itinerary.description:
Proceed from Jammu to Srinagar, enjoying scenic mountain landscapes along the way.
Check in to your hotel and take some time to relax.
In the evening, experience the timeless charm of Kashmir with a peaceful Shikara ride on Dal Lake, surrounded by majestic mountains and beautiful houseboats.

itinerary.title: Srinagar Sightseeing - Sonmarg (3 hours)
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, explore the beautiful Mughal Gardens, with their landscaped lawns, fountains, and stunning mountain views.
Visit the historic Shankaracharya Temple, perched on a hilltop overlooking Srinagar.
Later, drive to Sonmarg, check in to your hotel, and soak in the magical winter atmosphere of the snow-covered mountains.
In the evening you can head for a walk in the snowy town of Sonmarg

itinerary.title: Gulmarg Gondola - Winter Activities
itinerary.description:
Checkout from Sonmarg early in the morning & proceed to Gulmarg
Gulmarg Gondola – Phase 1 & Phase 2:
Experience the world-famous
Gulmarg Gondola, beginning with Phase 1 from Gulmarg to Kongdoori, where you’ll ascend through beautiful pine forests and snow-covered slopes. Continue to Phase 2 from Kongdoori to Apharwat Peak, reaching the higher Himalayan terrain with spectacular panoramic views of snow-capped mountains and surrounding valleys.
Snow Fun & Mountain Experience:
After your adventure, spend time playing in the snow, enjoying the spectacular winter landscape, and capturing memorable photographs against the Himalayan backdrop. Later, return to the hotel, relax, and unwind after an action-packed day in the snow.
Skiing and snowboarding activities are subject to snow conditions, weather, and local operational guidelines.

itinerary.title: Gulmarg - Drung Waterfall & Self Explore Gulmarg
itinerary.description:
Drung Frozen Waterfall: After breakfast head towards Drung Waterfall, a spectacular winter wonderland where the cascading waterfall transforms into dramatic layers of ice. Enjoy the snowy surroundings, capture beautiful photographs, and experience the magical charm of Kashmir in winter.
New Year’s Eve in Gulmarg:
Spend the evening soaking in the peaceful mountain atmosphere. Enjoy a music, dinner, and New Year celebrations in Gulmarg, followed by a memorable countdown to welcome the New Year amidst the snow-covered mountains.

itinerary.title: Gulmarg- Pahalgam
itinerary.description:
A Fresh Start in Gulmarg:
Begin the first morning of the New Year surrounded by the peaceful beauty of Gulmarg. Enjoy breakfast with stunning mountain views.
Scenic Journey to Pahalgam:
Check out and drive towards Pahalgam, one of Kashmir’s most picturesque destinations. Enjoy the beautiful journey through winding mountain roads, charming villages.
On arrival, check in to your hotel and relax. Later, step out to explore the peaceful surroundings of Pahalgam, take a leisurely walk by the river, or simply enjoy the views from your hotel.

itinerary.title: Explore Pahalgam - Betaab Valley - Aru Valley
itinerary.description:
Explore Betaab Valley: After breakfast, head out to Betaab Valley, surrounded by towering mountains, lush meadows, and the beautiful Lidder River. Spend time walking around, enjoying the scenery, and capturing stunning photographs against the winter landscape.
Aru Valley & Local Exploration:
Continue towards the picturesque Aru Valley, a peaceful mountain village known for its scenic landscapes and snow-covered surroundings. Depending on weather and road accessibility, you can also explore Chandanwari and enjoy some snow activities along the way.
Relaxed Evening in Pahalgam:
Return to Pahalgam by evening and enjoy some well-deserved leisure time. Take a peaceful walk along the Lidder River, explore the local market for Kashmiri handicrafts and souvenirs, or relax at a cozy café while enjoying the mountain views. End the evening with a warm dinner and your final night in beautiful Pahalgam.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam - Jammu - Delhi
itinerary.description:
Pahalgam – Jammu: Check out from the hotel. Depart from Pahalgam around 10:00 AM and proceed towards Jammu by road. Enjoy the scenic mountain landscapes along the way and reach Jammu in time for your evening train.
Pahalgam - Srinagar : People Traveling by Flight will be dropped by 10am at Srinagar Airport
Jammu – Delhi by Train: Board
Train No. 22402/12414 from Jammu and begin your approximately 9-hour Overnight journey to Delhi.

itinerary.title: Delhi - Mumbai Train
itinerary.description:
Early Morning Arrival in Delhi:
Arrive at DEE (Delhi Sarai Rohilla Railway Station/Old Delhi)
around 4:00 AM after your overnight journey from Jammu. Freshen up at the station and relax at the waiting hall for approximately 4 hours. Those who wish to book a room for freshening up or resting may do so at their own expense.
Delhi – Mumbai by Train: Around
9:00 AM, board your connecting BDTS Garib Rath Express (Train No. 12215)
from Delhi and settle in for the onward journey to Mumbai.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Mumbai
itinerary.description: Arrival in Mumbai: Arrive in Mumbai in the early morning, marking the end of your memorable Kashmir journey filled with snow, mountains, adventure, and unforgettable moments.

itinerary.title: Departure from Mumbai
itinerary.description:
Our unforgettable journey to Kedarkantha begins in Mumbai. Assemble at the railway station where you will meet our coordinators and prepare to board Train No. 19019/12171
Travelers from Pune will board bus/Train till Dadar/Borivali, where they will join us on the train.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Haridwar & Self Explore
itinerary.description:
Arrive in Haridwar 9am/1pm Later check into our hotel. (Standard check in time 11)
Self Explore : Head to Rishikesh for River Rafting & Evening Ganga Aarti if Time permits You’ll have some leisure time in the evening to explore the local market. (Dinner Included)

itinerary.title: Haridwar - Joshimath (10 hours)
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, we set off to Joshimath at 6:30 AM in a Bolero/Tempo or similar vehicle. The journey covers a distance of 256 km and takes approximately 10 hours. During the drive, you’ll pass through some of the most scenic landscapes of the Indian Himalayas, including the Panchprayag, where five holy confluences of the Ganges River—Devaprayag, Rudraprayag, Karnaprayag, Nandaprayag, and Vishnuprayag.
As you travel, keep your camera ready for the breathtaking views that will unfold before you. By the evening, you’ll arrive in Joshimath, where you’ll settle into your accommodation for a restful overnight stay.(Overnight stay in a homestay with breakfast and dinner included)

itinerary.title: Joshimath - Guling Camp
itinerary.description:
Today’s journey continues with a drive from Joshimath to Dhak Village, which is approximately 12 km away. From Dhak Village, you’ll embark on a trek of about 5 km to reach Gulling, which sits at an altitude of 9,600 feet. The trek involves gradual and steep ascents through charming villages and lush meadows.
We’ll pause for lunch before continuing our hike. The views of the Dronagiri, Hathi Parvat, and Gori Parvat peaks will reward your efforts with their majestic presence. Upon reaching Gulling Top, we’ll set up camp for the night, enjoying the serene environment and the stunning mountain vistas. (Overnight stay in Tents & All Meals included).

itinerary.title: Guling - Guling Top - Tali Forest Camp
itinerary.description:
Today’s trek will take you from Gulling Top to Tali Forest Camp, located at an altitude of 11,000 feet. This trek covers approximately 5.5 km and takes about 5 hours. As you hike through rhododendron, oak, and walnut forests, you’ll witness the evolving beauty of the high-altitude flora.
The trail, although moderately challenging, offers plenty of opportunities to soak in the tranquil forest surroundings. A delicious pack lunch will be served at a scenic spot. Take some time to relax and enjoy the natural beauty of the area before settling into your tents for an overnight stay.(Overnight Stay in Tents & All Meals Included)

itinerary.title: Tali Forest Camp - Kuari Pass & return
itinerary.description:
Today is the highlight of the trek, featuring a challenging yet rewarding ascent to Kuari Pass. After breakfast at the camp, we’ll begin our trek, heading towards Khullara Top before reaching Kuari Pass. This trek covers between 7 to 10 km and will take approximately 5 to 6 hours. The ascent is strenuous, with sections requiring significant effort due to snow and ice.
The views from the Kuari Pass are spectacular, offering panoramic vistas of some of the highest peaks in the Garhwal region, including Kedarnath, Chaukhambha, and Nanda Devi. After taking in the stunning scenery and perhaps a well-deserved break at Jhandi Dhar, we’ll return to Tali Forest Camp.

itinerary.title: Tali - Joshimath via Gurson Bugyal & Auli
itinerary.description:
We trek back through snow and pine forests, descending the slushy slopes to Dhak village. The journey now descends towards Auli, India’s renowned skiing destination, along a scenic 4.5 km trail. The route passes through the picturesque meadows of Gorson Bugyal, offering a gentle and leisurely walk compared to the challenging climbs earlier in the trek. Situated at an altitude of 2,900 metres, Auli welcomes you with breathtaking views of snow-covered mountain slopes and expansive alpine landscapes.
During winter, this charming hill destination transforms into a spectacular ski resort, attracting adventure enthusiasts and snow lovers from across the globe. February and March are equally enchanting, as the snow gradually begins to melt, creating a beautiful seasonal landscape while offering excellent opportunities to enjoy skiing and other snow activities. The return journey is both relaxing and rewarding. Spend the evening exploring Joshimath.

itinerary.title: Joshimath - Rishikesh
itinerary.description:
We wake up early morning by 6:00 am & drive back to Rishikesh, where we celebrate the successful trek with an evening of music, food, and dance.
This celebration honors your endurance and trust in us throughout the journey. Reflecting on the remarkable experiences and connections made. (Overnight Hotel Stay Breakfast + Dinner).

itinerary.title: Rishikesh - Haridwar & Board Train
itinerary.description:
Wake up to majestic views and reminisce about the trek. After a delightful breakfast, check out from the hotel and bid farewell to Rishikesh.
We board Train No. 19020/12172 for the return journey, Bid farewell to Haridwar.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Mumbai
itinerary.description:
Arrive back in Mumbai, concluding our journey with cherished memories.
Pune travelers will board the bus/train from Mumbai/Vasai to Pune. Though the journey ends, the experiences and friendships forged will last a lifetime.

itinerary.title: Departure from Mumbai
itinerary.description:
Mumbai - Mumbai (AC Bus, 6 hours) :

12:00pm: Post dinner its our Campfire time! Its time to unfold your own life and know others life as well.

itinerary.title: Explore Sandhan Valley & Departure to Mumbai
itinerary.description:
05:30am: Wake up & Proceed for a Short Trek to Sandhan Valley. The famous Valley of Shadows is beautiful to witness, after clicking some beautiful picture we head back to village. Experience a crazy 100ft Rappelling at Sandhan Valley (Optional)
9:30am: Proceed back to the base village 11:00 Am
– We have some delicious Maharashtrian breakfast (Poha & Tea) & It’s going to be hard to leave the Valley but will surely be taking the memories with us. Bid farewell with a promise to meet again.

trips.title: Chandrashila: Deoriatal Lake & Summit Views of Himalaya

itinerary.title: Arrive Dehradun · Trek Briefing
itinerary.description:
Rishikesh arrival Trek prep +
Take a direct flight to Dehradun (preferred over overnight bus). Arrive in Rishikesh by evening. Walk through Laxman Jhula bridge, enjoy riverside snacks, and gather for trek briefing. Meet your guides, review itinerary, and prepare gear.

itinerary.title: Rishikesh → Sari Village
itinerary.description:
Ganges & Alaknanda rivers 20 min trek +
Travel along the Ganges and Alaknanda rivers to Sari village. Twenty-minute hike to our first campsite. Learn practical trekking skills and observe the night sky far from city lights.

itinerary.title: Trek to Deoriatal Lake
itinerary.description:
2-hour trek Mt. Chaukamba views +
Two-hour trek to one of the Himalayas' finest campsites. Deoriatal lake at 2400m offers views of Mt. Chaukamba (7138m). Learn tent pitching, navigation, and fire-building skills under clear Himalayan skies.

itinerary.title: Trek to Chopta
itinerary.description:
Kedarnath Wildlife Sanctuary
Stream crossings +
Trek through Kedarnath Wildlife Sanctuary's dense jungle. Wade in streams and enjoy breaks at scenic spots. Option to send your heavy backpack ahead. Reach Chopta, the Indian Meadows, with 360° mountain views.

itinerary.title: Chandrashila Peak · Summit Sunrise
itinerary.description:
3690m summit 5km trek +
Early rise for a scenic 5km trek to Chandrashila Peak (3690m). Summit at sunrise. Witness panoramic views: Mt. Kedar, Mt. Chaukhamba, Mt. Nandadevi. Visit Tungnath Temple, the world's highest Shiva temple. Return to Chopta for the night.

itinerary.title: Chopta → Rishikesh
itinerary.description:
Scenic drive Community outreach +
Drive back from Chopta to Rishikesh. Visit a local school to distribute supplies and connect with the community. Celebrate trek completion with the crew.

itinerary.title: Rishikesh → Fly Home
itinerary.description:
Departure day +
One last morning by the Ganges in Rishikesh, then head to Dehradun for your flight home. Book flights after 11 AM.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Auckland
itinerary.description: Kia ora! Touching down in New Zealand's largest city, we'll meet you at our centrally located hotel to settle in. This evening you'll meet up with the rest of your travel crew and get excited for all the adventures to come in Aotearoa.

itinerary.title: Hobbiton & Redwoods
itinerary.description:
This afternoon we tick off a major highlight as we head to Hobbiton to wander the real-life lush pastures of the Shire as featured in The Lord of The Rings and The Hobbit trilogies. After exploring the set and learning all about movie magic, we'll enjoy a drink at the Green Dragon Inn before departing for Rotorua.
​
Once in Rotorua, you can head out with the squad to the redwood forest discovering the extensive walking trails in this 5600 hectare forest.

itinerary.title: Thermal Spa & Gloworm Kayaking
itinerary.description:
Today we'll get muddy at Hell's Gate with a warm geothermal mud bath, followed by a relaxing soak in the sulphur spa & plunge pool. With your skin pampered, enjoy a free afternoon to recharge.
​
After dark, we Kayak into small caves illuminated by thousands of glowworms. This glowworm species is found only in New Zealand—a little local magic that feels like kayaking beneath the stars.

itinerary.title: Shotover Jet Ride
itinerary.description:
You've seen the North Island, now it's time to explore the South Island! After driving back to Auckland we will take a short flight to Queenstown, where we'll get oriented with the high - octane adventure capital of NZ (and dare we say, the world!).
​
Later we'll get a splash of adrenaline with a shotover jet-boat ride. Feel the thrill as the highly skilled driver keeps things pumping with 360-degree spins and speeds more than 80km/h gliding through narrow canyons.

itinerary.title: Queenstown Adventures
itinerary.description: Free time to explore is all you've got today - and oh gosh, there's no end to what you can do here. Bungy jumping, canyon swings, climbing waterfalls, vineyard tours, zip lining, skydiving - we bet you'll wanna do it all! Afterwards, you can grab some dinner with your crew before resting your travel-tired limbs for round two of the adventure tomorrow.

itinerary.title: Milford Sound Cruise
itinerary.description: Today we will visit New Zealand's most stunning attraction - the natural wonder of Milford Sound. Jumping on a fjord cruise, we'll experience the spellbinding combination of mountain peaks, forested cliffs, resident seals, and plummeting waterfalls up close and personal. Pick your jaw up off the floor, this is mother nature at her finest!

itinerary.title: Wanaka Lake
itinerary.description:
Today we'll pick our cars and start the South Island road trip. Our first stop is the charming lakeside town of Wanaka, nestled beneath towering snow-capped peaks. We can kayak on the beautiful Wanaka lake & discover the famous Wanaka tree. ​
​
Later, we'll find a spot by the lake, have a picnic, and kick back as the sun sets over Mount Aspiring National Park. What a way to end the day.
Lake Tekapo
1 night stay

itinerary.title: Hooker Valley Trek & Lake Tekapo
itinerary.description:
This morning we'll make our way to the stunning Lake Tekapo. Along the way, we'll visit the Tasman glacier viewpoint and then take a beautiful hike that leads us to unbeatable views of Aoraki/Mount Cook - the tallest mountain in New Zealand! ​
​
As night falls, keep your fingers crossed for clear skies. Because stargazing in Tekapo is simply out of this world.

itinerary.title: Church of Good Shepherd
itinerary.description:
First, we'll visit the charming Church of the Good Shepherd, one of the most photographed spots in all of New Zealand. Then we will begin our drive to Christchurch where we'll take an inspiring walk of the city that was totally rebuilt after the Christchurch earthquake. ​
​
Later in the evening we'll head out with the squad to explore the city's vibrant food & nightlife!

itinerary.title: Explore Christchurch
itinerary.description:
Christchurch is yours to explore today! Hop aboard the historic tram, wander through the Botanic Gardens, browse Riverside Market or settle into a cosy caf . For something extra, take the gondola for sweeping views, get your adrenaline fix with ziplining or experience a taste of polar life at the International Antarctic Centre.
​
Come evening, reunite with the gang for our final night in New Zealand—one last cheers to the adventures and friendships made along the way!

itinerary.title: Goodbyes
itinerary.description:
This morning your Kiwi adventure comes to an end. You can either check out and journey home, stay on longer in Queenstown or continue your travels in New Zealand. If you need any assistance planning onward travel, we're here to help!
Fly out of Christchurch on day 11

itinerary.title: Arrival & Meet Your Crew
itinerary.description:
Welcome to Finland, the ultimate winter destination! Touch down in Helsinki, drop your bags at the hotel, and say hello to your legendary trip mates!
Today, take a stroll with your trip leader and uncover the city's hot spots. Tick off Rock Church & White cathedral, show off your mad bartering skills at Market Square, and warm yourself up with a delicious Gl gi.
In the evening: quiz your Trip Leader on where to find the best leip juusto – the squeakiest cheese in the kingdom.

itinerary.title: Tallinn Day Trip
itinerary.description:
New day, new country - hello, Estonia! Today, we sail across the Baltic Sea from Helsinki to Tallinn. Think cobbled lanes, medieval towers and colourful buildings as we explore its charming Old Town. We'll visit Alexander Nevsky Cathedral and head up to Toompea's viewpoints for sweeping views over the rooftops.
Enjoy free time to grab lunch, browse local shops or warm up in a cosy caf before we catch our ferry back to Helsinki.

itinerary.title: Rovaniemi & Northern Light
itinerary.description:
Today, say goodbye to Helsinki and hop on a train bound for Rovaniemi in the northern region of Finland. Rovaniemi is Finland's Arctic playground, where Santa Claus resides, frozen magic happens, and the Northern Lights paint the sky in mesmerising colours!
Passing through breathtaking scenery, we'll arrive in Rovaniemi by evening. Settle in and recharge your batteries for tonight's epic adventure. Bundled up in thermal suits, we'll head further up north to chase the magical Northern Lights. Gather around the bonfire with a warm drink in hand and be awestruck by nature's dazzling show.

itinerary.title: Santa Claus Village & Husky Ride
itinerary.description:
Get set for a whirlwind of adventures as we cross the arctic circle (yes, literally!) to reach the Santa Claus Village! Take in the festive vibes, it's Christmas here throughout the year. First meet the big guy, Santa himself and share your wishes. Then hop on a husky/reindeer sleigh for a wild ride through snowy landscapes.
You can also send a postcard to your family from the Santa Claus post office anytime of the year and the elves will make sure that it's delivered on Christmas.

itinerary.title: Snowmobiling & Ice Floating
itinerary.description:
Need some time to explore at your own pace? Today is 100% up to you. But if you need suggestions, ride a snowmobile through breathtaking Arctic Circle forests, go swimming in an icy lake, or learn the art of ice fishing from a local.
In the evening, you can warm yourself up in the hostel Sauna, party with your trip mates at the Halfmoon nightclub or go on an aurora chase one more time.
Optional Addons: + Snowmobile
+ Ice Floating
+ Ice Fishing
+ Second Aurora Chase
Transfer by train on day 6
Helsinki
Country: Finland | 1 N ight

itinerary.title: Cafes & Nightlife
itinerary.description:
Ready for one more dose of Helsinki? Today we are taking a train back to where the adventure began. But this time only as a brief but delightful pitstop on our journey from Lapland to Sweden.
After checking in by evening, make the city your own. Try hot chocolate at Fazer's, peek inside the striking Oodi Library or browse Kallio's quirky shops. Then reunite with the crew for dinner and see where Helsinki's nightlife takes us!
Board from Helsinki on day 7

itinerary.title: Helsinki to Stockholm Cruise
itinerary.description:
We'll start the day the Finnish way! Unwinding at Helsinki's best voted sauna, with four distinct types of sauna rooms before braving an icy cold plunge!
Later, we're hopping on an overnight cruise bound for Stockholm. Often dubbed as a booze cruise by locals, this 1000 cabin ship transforms into a floating party paradise as soon as the sun sets. Its lively nightclubs, casino, bars, and themed parties create a non-stop dancing and live music extravaganza. It's more than a journey; it's a high-seas all night party you won't forget!

itinerary.title: Foodhall & Vasa Museum
itinerary.description:
Wake up, you are in the iconic Scandi city of Stockholm! Fun fact: this place is built on an archipelago of fourteen islands where Lake M laren flows out to the Baltic Sea. Cool, right?
First stop, Östermalm food hall—time to dive into some legendary Swedish meatballs. If you're an Avicii fan, the Avicii Museum is a must-see. And for all you history buffs, the Vasa Museum is calling your name with its amazingly preserved 17th-century wooden warship. Get ready for an unforgettable day!
Optional Addon: + Vasa Museum ~ 16

itinerary.title: Old Town & Nightlife
itinerary.description:
Today, we'll wander through the narrow cobblestone streets of the old town - Gamla Stan. Our local guide will lead us through vibrant squares, past colourful facades, and into hidden alleyways bursting with history and charm. Get ready for Viking stories, hidden gems, and a few quirky surprises along the way!
Later, head to the ultra-hip S dermalm with your trip mates, we're going to give this Nordic adventure the send-off it deserves!

itinerary.title: Goodbyes
itinerary.description:
Our trip finishes after breakfast today but it will live on in our memories for years to come. Swap those socials and start planning your next adventure!
Fly out of Stockholm on day 10

trips.title: Vietnam with Sapa

itinerary.title: Arrival + Walking Tour + Train Street
itinerary.description:
Welcome to Hanoi. A capital with nearly 9 million people, Hanoi is a bubbling pot of energy, excitement and hidden gems.
After meeting your fellow travellers, we'll head out for an orientation walk through the buzzing Old Quarter. Our Trip Leader will show you the city's hidden gems, iconic Train Street, and the best local spots for Vietnamese coffee.
​
Then: We head to Ta Hien (aka beer street) to experience Hanoi's nightlife. Oh yes, this is the right way to get the Vietnam party started.

itinerary.title: Halong Bay Junk Cruise + Caving + Kayaking
itinerary.description:
Halong Bay: a jewel in Vietnam's crown and one of the New 7 Wonders of Nature — is every bit as magical as people say. Today, we'll cruise through its emerald waters on a traditional junk boat, enjoy lunch on board, explore stunning caves, and kayak between towering limestone islands.
Later tonight, we board an overnight bus to the mountains of Sapa. Time to relax, catch up on sleep, and bond with your trip mates as we head deeper into Northern Vietnam.
Meals: + Breakfast
+ Lunch

itinerary.title: Cat Cat Village + Rainbow Slide + Alpine Coaster
itinerary.description:
We arrive in the dreamy mountain town of Sapa early in the morning and head straight for breakfast at a scenic caf overlooking misty valleys, and the iconic mountain train gliding through the clouds.
Later, we'll explore the charming Cat Cat Village on a guided tour, where traditional wooden houses, waterfalls, terraced fields, and local Hmong people make it feel like stepping into another era.
And then, it's time to turn up the adrenaline with Sapa's famous Rainbow Slide and the thrilling Alpine Coaster ride through the mountains. Expect fast turns, insane views, and pure fun all the way down.

itinerary.title: Fansipan Peak + Monorail + Cable Car
itinerary.description:
Today, we're heading to the Roof of Indochina — the legendary Fansipan Peak, the highest mountain in Vietnam at 3,143 metres. But getting there is half the fun.
We begin with a scenic monorail ride through the mountains, passing valleys, and clouds floating at eye level. Then comes the highlight: one of the world's most stunning cable car rides, soaring above deep valleys and endless mountain landscapes straight towards the peak.
At the top, expect stunning viewpoints, giant Buddha statues, cool mountain air, and the surreal feeling of standing above the clouds. Easily one of the most iconic experiences in Vietnam..
Meals: + Breakfast

itinerary.title: Bike rides + Glass bridge + Waterfalls
itinerary.description:
Today is all about exploring Sapa your way — and trust us, it might just become your favourite day of the trip. Rent a bike and cruise through the mountains, discover Sapa's unreal cafes, walk across the thrilling Glass Bridge, chase hidden waterfalls, and visit Moana for some of the most insane photos of the entire trip.
Feeling adventurous? You can also go trekking through the beautiful mountain trails around Sapa.
And by night, we switch gears completely as we head out to experience the surprisingly fun nightlife of this otherwise peaceful mountain town.
Meals: + Breakfast
Transfer by bus & flight on day 6
Hoi An
3 nights stay

itinerary.title: My Khe Beach + Hoi An Old Town
itinerary.description:
Today, we leave the mountains behind as we take an early morning bus back to Hanoi, followed by a short flight to Da Nang. We'll stop by the beautiful My Khe Beach and soak in Vietnam's coastal vibes before heading to the charming town of Hoi An.
In the evening, we explore the magical Hoi An Old Town, with its lantern-lit streets, riverside caf s, and timeless yellow buildings. And of course, we'll end the night by trying one of Hoi An's famous local specialities at our favourite restaurant.
Meals: + Breakfast

itinerary.title: Ba Na hills + Cable Cars + Golden Hand Bridge
itinerary.description:
Today we'll visit the Ba Na Hills - a mountaintop resort complex that looks like a mediaeval castle. Take a ride on one of the longest cable cars in the world, enjoy the panoramic views from the Insta famous Golden Hand Bridge and explore the mini French village built on the mountaintop.
n the evening, head to Hoi An's buzzing night market. Make sure you wear your fat pants because with Banh Mi, rose shaped dumplings and a whole lot of draught beers, you might need some extra space.
Meals: + Breakfast

itinerary.title: Basket Boat Ride + An Bang Beach + Karaoke Night
itinerary.description:
This morning we're going crab fishing in traditional bamboo basket boats which are absolutely wild! How? You'll know when you get there. The rest of the day is free for you to explore Hoi An your way. Go caf hopping, shop through the lantern-filled streets, get custom clothes stitched by local tailors (a popular thing to do here), or join your Trip Leader for an epic local food tour.
​
Tonight, we celebrate the end of this unforgettable adventure at a private Karakaoke Club, singing the night away!
Meals: + Breakfast

itinerary.title: Goodbyes
itinerary.description:
Enjoy one final breakfast with the squad this morning before the trip wraps up. On your way back to Danang airport you'll realise that for the rest of your travels, you will automatically compare it to Vietnam. A special country, full of special people, places and now, memories.
Meals: + Breakfast
Fly out of Danang on day 9

trips.location: Ho Chi Minh, Hoi An, Hanoi, Halong Bay, Ninh Binh
trips.title: Vietnam Escape

itinerary.title: Arrival + Walking Tour + Backpacker Street
itinerary.description:
Welcome to Ho Chi Minh city (HCMC). A capital with nearly 9 million people, HCMC is a bubbling pot of energy, excitement and hidden gems.
Meet the gang and head out to Ben Thanh Market. Our in-the-know Trip Leader will take us to all the local spots for pho, spring rolls and egg coffee – trust us, it's good. Then: head to Bui Vien (aka backpacker street) to experience HCMC's nightlife. Oh yes, this is the right way to get the Vietnam party started.

itinerary.title: Cu Chi Tunnels + Fire AK47 + Skybar
itinerary.description:
Pull out your history hat – we're off to visit the Cu Chi Tunnels. Surrounded by jungle that was once a stronghold of the Viet Cong, take a guided tour of the area and learn all about how this underground network was used by guerilla fighters during the Vietnam War. The most adrenaline pumping experience at the tunnels is the option to fire real AK-47s/M16s in the shooting range.
Later tonight, gather your squad and head to one of the highest rooftop bars and enjoy the panoramic views of this city in all its glory.
Meals: + Breakfast

itinerary.title: Hoi An Old Town + Marble Mountains
itinerary.description:
After a zippy flight north & a short coastal drive we find ourselves in Hoi An - a canal town overflowing with beauty and ancient history. We'll stop by the iconic Marble mountains before checking into our hotel.
Later, head out with the squad to explore the lantern-filled magic of Hoi An Old Town and tuck into a bowl of Cao lau (a local specialty) along the river.
Meals: + Breakfast

itinerary.title: Ba Na hills + Cable Cars + Golden Hand Bridge
itinerary.description:
Today we'll visit the Ba Na Hills - a mountaintop resort complex that looks like a mediaeval castle. Take a ride on one of the longest cable cars in the world, enjoy the panoramic views from the Insta famous Golden Hand Bridge and explore the mini French village built on the mountaintop.
In the evening, head to Hoi An's buzzing night market. Make sure you wear your fat pants because with Banh Xeo, rose shaped dumplings and a whole lot of draught beers, you might need some extra space :p
Meals: + Breakfast

itinerary.title: Basket Boat Ride + An Bang Beach + Karaoke Night
itinerary.description:
Today, we're going crab fishing in traditional bamboo basket boats which are absolutely wild! How? You'll know when you get there.
Rest of the day is yours, go shopping or perhaps visit a local tailor to get a custom suit or dress made (a popular thing to do here).
Later you can visit the nearby beach for swimming and watching those sunset hues. But make sure are back in time for our legendary Karaoke night at traditional Vietnamese Karaoke club tonight!
Meals: + Breakfast

itinerary.title: Old Quarter + Train Street
itinerary.description:
Snag a window seat and wave goodbye to Hoi An – we're setting the flight path for Hanoi. With an epic fusion of French, Chinese & Vietnamese influence, you'll be nothing short of ecstatic as we check-in to our Hanoi hotel, right in the middle of the bustling Old Quarter.
We'll explore the Old Quarter walking through narrow streets, trying a unique local cofffee. Later, ask your trip leader for directions to the hidden entrance of the infamous train street, where a train runs through a busy narrow market street!
Meals: + Breakfast

itinerary.title: Halong Bay Junk Cruise + Caving + Kayaking
itinerary.description:
Halong Bay: World Heritage Site. The jewel in Vietnam's crown. One of the New 7 Wonders of Nature'. Whichever way you look at it, Halong Bay is pretty damn special. So, today we're gonna do it properly with a junk boat day cruise. Start with a lunch on board and spend the day cruising through glittering turquoise water, exploring the ancient caves and kayaking between the limestone islands.
We'll get back to Hanoi for our last night of the trip. Let's finish the trip off in style with a massive party at the beer street!
Meals: + Breakfast

itinerary.title: Goodbyes
itinerary.description:
Enjoy one final breakfast with the squad this morning before the trip wraps up. On your way back to Hanoi airport you'll realise that for the rest of your travels, you will automatically compare it to Vietnam. A special country, full of special people, places and now, memories.
Meals: + Breakfast
You can choose to extend your trip for 1 more day, if you plan to visit Ninh Binh also.
​
Ninh Binh Extension
Includes: 1N stay in Hanoi + Guide day tour to Ninh Binh
Additional Cost: ₹8,500
​
​
Today, say goodbyes to some of your group members who might be heading back home. As rest of us head east into Vietnam's countryside. First stop: Hoa Lu, Vietnam's ancient capital, where history comes alive. Then, we'll hop on a sampan boat and glide through the dreamy Trang An valley - think mystical caves, emerald forests, and endless rice paddies straight out of a postcard.
​
To top it off, we'll conquer the Hang Mua Dragon cave for a breathtaking sunset over Ninh Binh.
Meals: + Breakfast

itinerary.title: Goodbyes (for extension group)
itinerary.description:
Time to finally say goodbyes to the last ones standing. See you next time!
Meals: + Breakfast
Fly out of Hanoi on day 8 or 9
