Meals: + Breakfast

itinerary.title: Hoi An Old Town + Marble Mountains
itinerary.description:
After a zippy flight north & a short coastal drive we find ourselves in Hoi An - a canal town overflowing with beauty and ancient history. We'll stop by the iconic Marble mountains before checking into our hotel.
Later, head out with the squad to explore the lantern-filled magic of Hoi An Old Town and tuck into a bowl of Cao lau (a local specialty) along the river.
Meals: + Breakfast

itinerary.title: Ba Na hills + Golden Hand Bridge + New Year's Eve
itinerary.description:
Today we'll visit the Ba Na Hills - a mountaintop resort complex that looks like a mediaeval castle. Take a ride on one of the longest cable cars in the world, enjoy the panoramic views from the Insta famous Golden Hand Bridge and explore the mini French village built on the mountaintop.
Tonight, we'll head to the Old Town to bring in the new year with our crew and believe us, this will be a night you'll never forget.
Meals: + Breakfast

itinerary.title: Basket Boat Ride + An Bang Beach + Karaoke Night
itinerary.description:
Today, we're going crab fishing in traditional bamboo basket boats which are absolutely wild! How? You'll know when you get there.
Rest of the day is yours, go shopping or perhaps visit a local tailor to get a custom suit or dress made (a popular thing to do here).
Later you can visit the nearby beach for swimming and watching those sunset hues. But make sure are back in time for our legendary Karaoke night at traditional Vietnamese Karaoke club tonight!
Meals: + Breakfast

itinerary.title: Old Quarter + Train Street
itinerary.description:
Snag a window seat and wave goodbye to Hoi An – we're setting the flight path for Hanoi. With an epic fusion of French, Chinese & Vietnamese influence, you'll be nothing short of ecstatic as we check-in to our Hanoi hotel, right in the middle of the bustling Old Quarter.
We'll explore the Old Quarter walking through narrow streets, trying a unique local cofffee. Later, ask your trip leader for directions to the hidden entrance of the infamous train street, where a train runs through a busy narrow market street!
Meals: + Breakfast

itinerary.title: Halong Bay Cruise + Caving + Kayaking
itinerary.description:
Halong Bay: World Heritage Site. The jewel in Vietnam's crown. One of the New 7 Wonders of Nature'. Whichever way you look at it, Halong Bay is pretty damn special. So, today we're gonna do it properly with a junk boat day cruise. Start with a lunch on board and spend the day cruising through glittering turquoise water, exploring the ancient caves and kayaking between the limestone islands.
We'll get back to Hanoi for our last night of the trip. Let's finish the trip off in style with a massive party at the beer street!
Meals: + Breakfast
+ Lunch

itinerary.title: Goodbyes
itinerary.description:
Enjoy one final breakfast with the squad this morning before the trip wraps up. On your way back to Hanoi airport you'll realise that for the rest of your travels, you will automatically compare it to Vietnam. A special country, full of special people, places and now, memories.
Meals: + Breakfast
Fly out of Hanoi on day 8

trips.location: Seminyak, Nusa Penida, Gili T, Ubud
trips.title: Bali New Year

itinerary.title: Arrival & Meet Your Crew
itinerary.description:
You made it! Prepare yourself for the next 9 days of pure Bali Bliss! Fly into Denpasar Airport, we'll meet you there and take you to our hotel in Seminyak. Later, join forces with the rest of the group and make way to nearby Double six beach to catch a beautiful pink sunset.
​
In the evening, we head out for a welcome dinner and see where the night takes us..
Meals: + Dinner

itinerary.title: Uluwatu Temple + Beach + Nightlife
itinerary.description:
Wake up you're in paradise, no really you are. Our day begins with a visit to a secluded, pristine beach nestled in the southernmost part of Bali. Later we'll head off to the famous Uluwatu temple. Perched on the edge of a cliff, it offers stunning views of the Indian ocean. Here we will learn about the Balinese culture & witness the captivating traditional Kecak fire dance show!
​
Later tonight, gather your squad head out to La Favela to indulge in Seminyak nightlife one more time!
Meals: + Breakfast

itinerary.title: Gili Overwater Swings
itinerary.description:
Wave goodbye to Bali as we speedboat our way to Gili Trawangan. An island so small, you can't even spot it on a map and no vehicles here at all! Check in to your hotel and begin to explore this tiny paradise on foot.
​
Then: the rest is up to you. Relax & unwind with a massage. Hunt down Pituq cafe for a refreshing fresh-fruit smoothie. Or smoke a Shisha at the beachfront bar - you won't have to venture far.
Meals: + Breakfast

itinerary.title: Scuba Dive & New Year Party
itinerary.description:
Today, you've got 24 hours to do what you want! Suggestions? Opt for scuba diving to get enchanted with the underwater world. Rent a paddleboard and hit the beach. Cafe-hop your way around the island. Or treat yourself to a massage.
In the evening, put on your dancing shoes and get ready to bring in the new year with our crew and believe us, this will be a night you'll never forget.
Meals: + Breakfast
Optional Addons: + Scuba Dive ~ ₹6000

itinerary.title: Island Hopping & Snorkelling
itinerary.description:
Today, channel your inner Little Mermaid as we head out on a snorkelling boat trip. We'll check out the other islands of the Gili family: Gili Meno (aka tropical paradise) and Gili Air (hippy vibes) and uncover the best snorkelling spots around the islands. You'll see stunning coral, beautiful fish, turtles and maybe even a shark or two. Don't worry though, these reef sharks love to cuddle.
​
Head out this evening to enjoy the stunning sunset and an ice-cold cocktail at some of the best beach bars on the island. Unless you were eaten by a cuddly shark earlier. Then no cocktails for you.
Meals: + Breakfast

itinerary.title: Ubud + Waterfall
itinerary.description:
Post breakfast, we bid adieu to tropical Gili and make our way to lusciously green Ubud. Ubud doesn't need much of an introduction; it's full of famed terraced rice paddies, temples, waterfalls and of course, monkeys. Upon reaching Ubud we'll first visit the Tegenungan waterfall. Take a dip in the freshwater pool and sip on some Poop Coffee at a cafe overlooking the falls.
For dinner tonight, we'll head out to one of Bali's coolest live music destinations where they'll play hits such as Going Back to Bali'.
Meals: + Breakfast

itinerary.title: Volcano Hike + Spa + Rice Terraces + Quad Biking
itinerary.description:
Today, you have an option to do a once-in-a-lifetime active volcano trek. Starting at 2 a.m, we'll hike under the moonlight and reach the summit just as the sun peaks over the horizon. Take in the breathtaking views as we treat you to a volcanic steam-prepped snack. To relax those strained muscles from the hike, we have a Balinese massage session scheduled for you today. ​
​
Later we will visit the Cretya lounge with its lush pools, overlooking the rice terraces. And just when you thought it couldn't get any cooler, it's quad biking time! Gear up to zoom through forests, conquer caves, splash through rivers, chase waterfalls, and tear up rice fields on you ATVs. It's like stepping into the real-life game of Jumanji!
Meals: + Breakfast

itinerary.title: Finns Club or Nusa Penida
itinerary.description:
Today is 100% up to you. Shop your heart out at the art market, do a day trip to Nusa penida, or hit up the Finn's beach club with your crew.
​
Whatever you fancy, it's our last day of the trip, so it's only right we go big!
Meals: + Breakfast

itinerary.title: Goodbye Bali
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, it's time for goodbyes. Bali, it's been emotional, we're sad to say goodbye - but we'll never forget your beauty, your charm, and your ridiculously delicious food.
Meals: + Breakfast
Fly out of Bali on day 9

itinerary.title: Arrival & Eiffel Tower
itinerary.description:
Epic trips don't just start - they start in Paris. Check in, freshen up, and meet the crew you'll be travelling with for the next two weeks.
We'll kick things off in style, head out with our trip leader to explore this city of lights. Prepare to see the Eiffel Tower & Seine river looking all twinkly!
​
Later, take to the cute cobbled streets of the Latin Quarter to find some delicious French eats and get to know your squad over a delicious french wine!

itinerary.title: Guided Tour & Nightlife
itinerary.description:
We'll start off this day by taking a guided tour of Paris. From the Louvre and the Mus e d'Orsay to the Notre Dame and the Eiffel Tower, you'll be sure to make a solid dent in your bucket list with this tour.
​
Post lunch, we'll head to the mighty Arc de Triomphe for breathtaking 360-degree views of the city. Then it's time to stroll down the legendary Champs-Élys es - Paris' most glamorous avenue. Pick up some macarons and a bottle of wine as we wind down with a relaxed picnic in the gardens by the Eiffel Tower.
​
As night falls, let's dive into Parisian nightlife and see how the French really party at a buzzing local nightclub.
Meals: + Breakfast

itinerary.title: Disneyland & Louvre Museum
itinerary.description:
Today's all yours to explore however you like! If you're up for a day trip, head to Disneyland and live out those childhood dreams.
​
Or stick around in Paris and start your morning by saying hi to the Mona Lisa at the Louvre, then treat yourself to some legendary desserts at the Angelina tearoom. Then wander through the beautiful streets of Marais, it is as fancy as it gets.
For dinner, hit up our favorite local spot that serves amazing food without breaking the bank. You've earned it.
Meals: + Breakfast
Optional Addons: + Louvre Museum ~ 22

itinerary.title: Canal Booze Cruise & Nightlife
itinerary.description:
Hello Amsterdam! Fun fact: the city has 1539 bridges, 165 canals, and 2500 houseboats. Yes, you read that right, and it's all here for you to explore.
After a high-speed train journey from Paris, travelling at nearly 300 kmph, we will reach Amsterdam in just 3 hours.
​
First up, we'll do a truly unique booze cruise across this pretty canal-lined city. Zigzaging through the waterways on our cosy boat we'll enjoy unlimited drinks, listening to fascinating stories, as we pass through various iconic locations of Amsterdam.
​
​ Later, we'll head to the famous Red Light District, explore Amsterdam's coffee shop culture, and experience the nightlife of this eclectic city.
Meals: + Breakfast

itinerary.title: Dutch Food & Brewery Experience
itinerary.description:
Amster-Dam! It's going to be a good day. After a lazy morning, join your Trip Leader to hunt down the best local bites or explore the city's charming streets on a bicycle.
​
Next, we'll visit Heinikin's oldest brewery to discover how a small Amsterdam brewery went on to become the world's favourite beer. Learn the brewing process and try a couple of freshly brewed beers yourself!
The rest of the evening is free for you to explore. You can catch the sunset from our favourite spot or continue with your biking expedition.
Meals: + Breakfast

itinerary.title: Zaanse Schans Windmills & Zaandam
itinerary.description:
Today, we will step back in time to experience the charm of a traditional Dutch countryside. We'll visit Zaandam & Zaanse Schans village, where captivating sight of operational windmills, a rustic wooden clog workshop, a quirky looking hotel and picturesque Dutch houses along the river will undoubtedly leave you mesmerised.
​
In the evening, we'll head to Foodhallen, with its eclectic bars, live music and art exhibitions and sample some of the best food in Europe.
Meals: + Breakfast

itinerary.title: East Side Gallery & Nightlife
itinerary.description:
On the world map of party vibes, Berlin has a gold star. We've got two nights to explore every inch of this iconic city, and we'll kick it off with a visit to the east side gallery - longest open-air gallery in the world.
The nightlife is also yours for the taking, so this is your chance to check out some of the underground raves or cocktail-lounge-in-the-basement scenarios that make this city a world famous party spot.
Meals: + Breakfast

itinerary.title: City Tour & Iconic Points
itinerary.description:
Today, we will visit the most iconic spots of Berlin with our local guide who will tell us more about the dark days of the Nazis, WWII and how Germany was split into two. We will also do a snack stop along the way, trying the famous berliner donut and a coffee.
Later you can have your own Oktoberfest style party with the squad at our favourite beer hall. Think: long communal tables, loud singing, dancing & big beer mugs.
​
Tonight, you can try your luck at getting an entry into Berghain - world's most popular techno club, where only the coolest of cool are let in!
Meals: + Breakfast

itinerary.title: Old Town & Pub Crawl
itinerary.description:
Moving from one beer capital to another, today we're headed for the charming and historic city of Prague. Upon arrival, our trip leader will lead us through the old town – complete with pretty cobblestone streets, gothic buildings & a quirky clock tower – and point out all the must-dos for our free time later.
Tonight, we're diving headfirst into Prague's legendary pub crawl. Picture this: 1 hour open bar, free shots & exclusive entry to the coolest bars and clubs in town – it's a wild ride you won't want to miss!
Meals: + Breakfast

itinerary.title: Charles Bridge & Prague Castle
itinerary.description:
Get into the mood of exploration as we head out on a walking tour with our local guide today. We'll visit the likes of Charles bridge, Prague Castle, John Lennon wall & a vantage point with the best views of the town.
​
Later, it's time to explore this storybook city, wandering through the maze of cobbled streets, discovering tucked away cafes and hunting for the best chimney cake in town. You can also paddle a boat across the Vltava river and see Prague from a whole new angle.
Meals: + Breakfast

itinerary.title: Explore & Skydive
itinerary.description:
Need some free time to explore? Here's a free day we kept for you. Go skydiving and jump from a height of 13000ft. Checkout the New Town, known for its architecture and visit the famous Dancing House & Rotating Head of Franz Kafka. Or go beer tasting across different local bars. Czech beers + tapas = good times guaranteed. ​
Meals: + Breakfast

itinerary.title: Goodbyes
itinerary.description:
The best 2 weeks of your life has come to an end - you have our complete sympathy. If anyone understands the pain of ended travels, it's us (and your new Metanoia crew). Hug it out after breakfast & make plans to reunite back in India.
Meals: + Breakfast
Fly out of Prague on day 12

itinerary.title: Land in Chandigarh. Drive to Shimla
itinerary.description:
Arrivals
Drive: 2-3 hrs Local attractions Land in Chandigarh by 12.30PM. Drive to Shimla. Reach Shimla by evening. Stroll around “The Mall” road of Shimla. Overnight at Shimla.
Our all-women trip to Kinnaur, is a ROAD TRIP, to one of the most treacherous routes in the country, no less. The rewards are unbelievable but the journey will prove tiring. This region sees cold weather throughout the year. Please prepare yourself well for the weather. We start our days as early as possible, especially on the days of long travel.
The weather in March is moderately cold during the day in this region. Nights will be very cold. Temperature will range from 5 to 15 degree C. Being in the mountain area also be prepared for untimely rains.

itinerary.title: Drive to Batseri.
itinerary.description:
Drive: 7-8 hrs After breakfast, start towards Sangla valley. It will be a long road journey today. Soak yourself in a mesmerizing road journey with different stop overs on the way. Reach Sangla by the evening & relax. Overnight at Batseri.
Simple Indian food such as rotis/dal, rice etc. Toast/Omelettes will be available. If you have special dietary requests, please let us know beforehand. It would also be a good idea to carry some meal packets with you if you have special requirements.

itinerary.title: Chitkul.
itinerary.description: Drive: 2-3 hrs Local sightseeing Walk: 1-2 hrs Wake up to the beautiful surroundings. Today, visit the beautiful “last inhabited village on the Indo-Tibetan border” Chitkul. Spend evening at leisure. Overnight at Batseri.

itinerary.title: Kamru Fort. Roghi Village. Drive to Kalpa.
itinerary.description:
Drive: 5-7 hrs Walk: 1-2 hrs Local attractions Today we will start towards the heavenly & mesmerizingly beautiful Kinner Kailash, the abode of Shiva. Visit Kamru Fort on the way. Enjoy the view of Roghi village ( (A village built on the slope of the mountain). Roam around in Reckong Peo in the evening. Overnight at Kalpa.
Ina Aramandla
We had a lovely trip to Kinnaur, Sangla, and Bushahr. Everything was really well organized and the group we traveled with was wonderful! It was overall a great experience.

itinerary.title: Drive to Shoghi.
itinerary.description: Drive: 7-8 hrs We will start our journey back today , after breakfast drive towards Shoghi. Reach Shoghi by evening. Overnight at Shoghi.

itinerary.title: Drop At Chandigarh.
itinerary.description:
Drive: 3-4 hrs Flyout
Start from Shoghi after breakfast, get dropped at Chandigarh airport for your evening flight. Our Kinnaur all women group trip ends.

itinerary.title: Arrival, Chitrakote, local dinner
itinerary.description:
Arrivals
Drive: 1-2 hrs Local cuisine Arrive at Jagdalpur by 4PM and proceed to Chitrakote. Check in and relax. Enjoy local tribal cuisine for dinner, at a beautiful spot with the massive Chitrakote waterfalls as the backdrop. Overnight at Chitrakote.
For our Bastar group trip, you will get basic North Indian and Central Indian food with local delicacies wherever possible.
The weather would be pleasant to cold with temperatures ranging between 10 and 25 degrees C. Because of a solid forest cover and myriad waterfalls, mornings and evenings will be cold and misty.
Bastar, although completely safe, is still developing as a tourist destination. The services, especially during a peak season like year end, may be slower.
Please read the Bastar trip itinerary thoroughly. Consider asking questions if needed.

itinerary.title: Chitrakote Falls, Narayanpal Temple, Ghumar
itinerary.description:
Local sightseeing Temples
Tribal dance Go for an early morning river walk around the waterfalls. After breakfast, go for a boat ride. Visit Tambda and Mendri Ghumar, two gorgeous plunge waterfalls of the region. Savor local tribal cuisine and a tribal dance performance by the Bison Horn Madiya tribe, amidst stunning vistas. Also visit the Narayanpal Temple which dates back to the 11th century and is the only Vishnu Temple in the Bastar region. Overnight at Chitrakote.

itinerary.title: Heritage Walk, Danteshwari Temple, Kondagaon
itinerary.description:
Heritage walk Temple
Craft work The day starts early today. Check out and visit Barsur for a heritage walk. Considered a heritage city with temples every step of the way, Barsur was the erstwhile capital of the Nagvanshi kings. Proceed to visit the Ma Danteshwari Temple in Dantewada. One of the 52 Shaktipeeths in India, this is the most revered shrine of Bastar. Danteshwari is the kuldevi of Bastar.
On the way stop to see memory pillars, a tribute to deceased residents of the village, with stories of their life carved in the stone.
Head on to a craft spree at Kondagaon and observe the making of various indigenous craft like terracotta and wrought iron. Marvel at the terracotta contraptions like the earth lamp that burns for days. Visit the artisans to see live the making of Bell Metal Handicrafts, through wax technique, resembling the one used during the Harrappan civilization. Overnight at Jagdalpur.
FUN FACT!
The stone megaliths and memory pillars across Bastar are not just graves; they are personalized ancestral histories. The tribal artisans carve intricate symbols directly onto the stone to illustrate the deceased individual's life achievements, favorite hobbies, profession, or status.

itinerary.title: Tirathgarh falls, Kanger Valley National Park
itinerary.description:
Bamboo raft Haat bazaars Walk: 2-3 hrs After breakfast, visit the beautiful Tirathgarh falls, which are actually a cluster of waterfalls, located in Kanger Valley national park.
Visit kutumsar natural caves – million years old stalactite and stalagmite. Head to Dhurwa Dera for a serene bamboo raft experience and enjoy traditional food.
Visit a local haat bazaar. Haat bazaars in Bastar give you a glimpse on the life of locals. They have their own food court and you would find it not just interesting but very eco-friendly. The most interesting thing about the set up is, it is not just a commercial set up but is looked upon as an occasion for local people as a weekly get together. You can try snacks and their locally brewed alcohol, made and served by women of the community. Overnight at Jagdalpur.

itinerary.title: Bamboo Rafting, Bastar Palace, Fly out
itinerary.description: Local sightseeing Drive: ~2 hrs Return flights Experience bamboo rafting on the serene Tiriya river. After breakfast, check out and visit the Bastar Palace. After lunch, proceed to the airport for your return flight. Our Bastar Chhattisgarh group tour ends here.

itinerary.title: Reach Aurangabad. Explore the city.
itinerary.description:
Arrivals
Walk: 2-3 hrs Half-day sightseeing Reach Aurangabad by morning flight. Relax and have lunch. Known as the “City of Gates” with its “52 gates,” each with a local history, Aurangabad has its own charm to explore. We will be visiting Daultabad Fort & Bibi Ka Maqbara. Explore the city for half a day today. Overnight at Aurangabad.
Food will be simple local affair - both veg and non-veg options will be available.
The weather usually is pleasant in the month of December. Day temperature would be around 28-30°C, and the nights would be pleasant.
There will be considerable walking in our Ajanta and Ellora group trip, especially for exploring the caves in Ajanta and Ellora and exploration in Aurangabad.
Leena Appicatlaa
We had an extensive sight seeing tour, with a very knowledgeable guide. The features of F5 which stand out are meticulous organization, timely pickup and drop, all the important venues were covered in detail and good hotel stay with all arrangements taken care of.

itinerary.title: Explore Ajanta Caves.
itinerary.description:
Drive: 5-7 hrs Walk: 2-3 hrs UNESCO World Heritage Site
Considered to be a masterpiece of Buddhist religious art, the largest Buddhist cave temples with their finest architecture, explore the Ajanta caves today (~ 105 km). Built in the period between the 2nd century BC and the 6th century AD, these hand-carved and frescoed caves are the finest surviving examples of ancient Indian art, particularly expressive paintings that present emotion through gesture, pose, and form. Overnight at Aurangabad.
We will be covering ~105 km today (roughly 3 hrs drive one-way). So please maintain time as per the trip lead’s instructions to reach places on time and enjoy exploring the places. Also, carry some light munchies for the road. There will also be considerable walking required to explore the caves.
FUN FACT!
Did you know? The official logo/emblem for the 1996 Miss World Contest held in Bengaluru (then Bangalore) was inspired by the painting of the Flying Apsara at Ajanta Caves.

itinerary.title: Grishneshwar Jyotirlinga. Explore Ellora Caves.
itinerary.description:
Drive: 3-5 hrs UNESCO World Heritage Site
Jyotirlinga temple Today would be an early morning start to Grishneshwar Jyotirlinga by 5.30AM, one of the 12 jyotirlingas of Lord Shiva. After darshan, we will traverse across Ellora caves (~60 kms), which illustrates the characteristics of ancient India, and exhibits the monuments of Jainism, Buddhism and Hinduism. The Kailash or Kailashanatha temple is the world's largest monolith rock-cut Hindu temple. Back to Aurangabad. Overnight at Aurangabad.
Being a year end, please do expect a lot of crowd around.
Devina Saraf
Everything from the airport pickup, to the itinerary, the guide, the trip lead, hotels and food was top notch. The team takes great efforts to ensure the travellers have a comfortable trip and take back only good memories. I am a loyal customer for life now.

itinerary.title: Flyout. Trip ends.
itinerary.description:
Return flights After breakfast, catch your return flight. Let the memories linger. Our Ajanta Ellora women only group trip ends.
Please book your return tickets anytime today. The hotel check out is at 11 AM.
Uma J
Very conveniently arranged trip. Had a detailed insight into Ajanta and Ellora. The tour with a formal guide and an amazing female coordinator helped a lot. Thank you F5 for fulfilling my dream of visiting these places.
Important
Our Ajanta and Ellora all-women group trip is to ex-Aurangabad. There will be considerable walking during this trip. Also, considering it's the year-end holiday season, expect crowd especially around the caves and temple.

If you are arriving early or want to extend your stay, reach out to us to help you plan your accommodation and transport at an additional cost.

itinerary.title: Drive from Bangalore. Arrival in Coorg.
itinerary.description:
Drive: ~6 hrs Local sightseeing Road trip Drive to Coorg, enjoying the scenic route. Visit the Talacauvery temple, the source of the Cauvery River. Take a peaceful walk along the stream within the farm. Overnight at Coorg.
The Theyyam women group trip is to ex. Bangalore. We will start by 6:30 AM from Bangalore, with multiple pickup points along the Outer Ring Road. Please be on time for your pickup. It will be a long drive. Please carry some snacks/munchies for the road. Days will start early in this trip, please cooperate with the trip lead to maintain time.
Please be dressed modestly while visiting the Talacauvery temple and the Theyyam shrine. Knees and shoulders should be covered.
Vijayalatha Ramesh
Malabar trip was my first experience with F5. It turned out to be awesome. The places were offbeat and the trip had an eclectic mix of sea, a historical monument and culturally rich Theyyam performances.

itinerary.title: Bekal Fort and Backwaters
itinerary.description:
Drive: 2-3 hrs Backwaters stay Local sightseeing Start early today and proceed to Kerala. Explore Bekal Fort with a guided walk. Tour a rubber plantation. Check-in to your backwater resort and enjoy a local lunch. In the evening a boat ride will take you to Valiyaparamba beach. Overnight at Padne.
Weather will be pleasant in North Kerala. You may get odd showers. It will be chilly near the backwaters and you may want to carry a sweatshirt/light jacket for the evenings, especially during the Fire Theyyam.
Food will be local cuisine - veg and non veg FUN FACT!
You may recognise the Bekal fort from the song 'Tu Hi Re' from the movie, 'Bombay', but did you know? Unlike most forts in India, the Bekal fort does not house any majestic palaces or royal residences. This is because it was built as a military fortress with observation towers, underground tunnels and more.

itinerary.title: Theyyam Performances
itinerary.description:
Theyyam
Spend the day witnessing vibrant Theyyam performances. Experience the captivating post-midnight fire Theyyam ritual. Return to your accommodation around 5 AM after the evening's events. Overnight at Payyannur.
You may want to carry a sweatshirt/light jacket for the evenings, especially during the Fire Theyyam.
You are forbidden to smoke or show up under the influence during the Theyyam performances.
Timings of Theyyams are not decided in advance, so the schedule of Day 3 will be fluid to accommodate the visits.
Please be dressed modestly while visiting the Theyyam shrine. Knees and shoulders should be covered.
Usha Acharya
Experiencing Theyyam in three different temples each depicting different energies & forms was an amazing and moving experience. A shoutout to [...] our trip lead who flawlessly managed a diverse group and on ground coordination, to the wonderful local guide with his knowledge and amazing humour

itinerary.title: Travel to Mysore
itinerary.description: Drive: 5-6 hrs Check out from your accommodation after 11 AM. Begin your drive to Mysore. Evening to relax and catch up on sleep. Overnight at Mysore.

itinerary.title: Srirangapatna. Trip ends.
itinerary.description:
Local sightseeing Drive: ~3 hrs Return to Bangalore
Visit Ranganathittu Bird Sanctuary to observe diverse avian species. Explore the historical sites of Srirangapatna with a guided tour. Depart for Bangalore after lunch. Our girls trip to Theyyam North Kerala concludes with drops back at Bangalore.
We will try to complete all Bangalore city drop offs by 8 PM. Drop offs will be along the same route as the pickup points. There will be no airport/railway station drop offs. For those traveling further, please plan your return after 10 PM.
Important
Our North Kerala & Theyyam all-women group trip is a road trip to ex-Bangalore. We will have multiple pickup and drop-off points usually along the ORR. Pickups will start by 6:30 AM on 23 DEC and we will try to complete all drop-offs by 8 PM on 27 DEC along the same route. If you are joining from a different city, reach Bangalore by the evening of 22nd DEC and plan your return after 10PM on 27th DEC.

If you are arriving early or extending your stay for the women-only Theyyam and North Kerala trip, we can help you plan your stay and accommodation at an additional cost. Please reach out to us for the same.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Madurai. Meenakshi Amman Temple. Thirumalai Nayakkar Mahal.
itinerary.description:
Arrivals
Walk: 2-3 hrs Local sightseeing Arrive and settle in Madurai. Set out to explore the city after lunch. Understand the city’s history and explore the attractions, including the Thirumalai Nayakkar Mahal, Meenakshi Amman Temple, and the shopping complexes. A plethora of sensory experiences await you. Overnight at Madurai.
This is a woman only group tour to Madurai, Tanjore and Rameshwaram. There will be a lot of temple visits and will require sufficient walking/climbing of stairs. Also, we will try keeping it as non-religious, and as story-oriented and culture oriented, as possible.
The end of November will be pleasant (about 25-30 degree Celsius) in Madurai, but given that Madurai weather is ‘hot, hotter, hottest’ all through the year, brace yourself for some humidity in the coastal region, with occasional showers.
Sujata Jadhao
The best part of traveling with F5 Escapes is their thoughtfully designed offbeat itineraries. They go beyond sightseeing — highlighting local art, artists, culture, and carefully chosen accommodations that reflect the soul of the place… It’s not just a tour — it’s a well-thought-out experience.

itinerary.title: Tanjore Big Temple. Palace complex. Chola style bronze sculpting and Tanjore paintings.
itinerary.description:
Drive: 3-4 hrs Walk: 2-3 hrs UNESCO site - Brihadeeswara Temple
After breakfast, proceed towards Tanjore. Today you will experience one of the most inspiring and imposing pieces of architecture – The 11th-century Brihadisvara Temple complex in Tanjore. It is the largest temple complex in India and one of the largest in the world, bearing testimony to the great Chola dynasty. We will also visit the Tanjore Palace complex, which presents the region’s rich Maratha and Tamil history. Also, get to understand some of the famed local arts and crafts. Overnight at Tanjore.
The Tanjore/Thanjavur Brihadeeswara Temple is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, known for its architectural brilliance, sculpture and Chola engineering precision.
Interior Tamil Nadu has a very scant number of people who can understand or communicate in Hindi. Our tour lead and guide will manage the language barrier.
FUN FACT!
Did you know? The Brihadisvar temple is known by many names. Its builder called it ‘Rajarajesvaram’ (meaning Lord of Rajaraja), while locally it's called ‘Peruvudaiyar Kovil’ (translating to Temple of the great lord), though most popularly it’s known as ‘Thanjai Periya Kovil’ or Thanjavur Big Temple.

itinerary.title: Dhanushkodi. Rameshwaram Temple.
itinerary.description:
Drive: 4-5 hrs Walk: 2-3 hrs Local sightseeing We will proceed to Rameshwaram after an early breakfast. We will visit Pamban bridge on the way. Check in and proceed to visit Dhanushkodi. Post the disastrous 1964 cyclone, Dhanushkodi was declared unfit for living by the government and was referred to as a ghost town. Did you know the story behind the train that disappeared into the sea? Know it all today. We will also visit the Rameswaram temple. Overnight at Rameshwaram.
In most places, we will get authentic Chettinad and Madurai/Tamil style food, which will include non-veg options. However, we cannot guarantee availability of non-vegetarian food in Rameshwaram.
The Ramanathaswamy Temple (or Rameswaram temple) is one of the 12 Jyotirlinga and a Char Dham site. Please expect crowd at the temple.
Sucheta Chakraborty
We were given excellent local guides in both Thanjavur and Rameshwaram who led us through the heady temple experiences in both places with skill, knowledge and plenty of humour. The grand Chettinad mansion…was the cherry on the cake!

itinerary.title: Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Memorial. Saree Weaving. Tile making. Chettinad Mansions.
itinerary.description:
Drive: 3-4 hrs Walk: 2-3 hrs Local experiences After an early breakfast, visit the wonderful Memorial built for our great missile man, Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam. If time permits, visit Devipattinam. Continue the journey onward to the Chettinad region. Have the local tour of the region with experiences of saree weaving and tile making added in. Explore the huge mansions of Chettinad, stay in a mansion, and enjoy your grand dinner. Stay in Kadiapatti.
Roopa P
This is my 4th Trip with F5, what stands as highlight is; Trip itinerary is well curated its executed as it is provided out on the website. Trip leads are coached well, lead travelers as one group. Tour communications, booking process is transparent, any other queries are addressed immediately.

itinerary.title: Drive to Madurai. Take a train/bus/flight back home.
itinerary.description:
Drive: 2-3 hrs Return flights After breakfast, leave for Madurai, take a bus/train/flight to your respective destinations. Our Madurai all-women trip ends.
Please book your return flights/trains any time after 3 PM.
Anjali Pancholy
It was a very enjoyable trip. The itinerary was thoughtfully worked out...Of the places we visited were well curated and we got to see some unique places! The group was amazing and got along well, which is a very important part of group travel.
Important
Our Madurai-Rameswaram women only trip will have a lot of temple visits and require a fair bit of walking as all temple complexes are huge. We will also try to keep it as non-religious, and as story-oriented and culture oriented, as possible.
Add ons Single Occupancy Supplement:
INR 18,500 + 5% GST
Child Pricing (5 to 10 years old) – INR 40,000 + 5% GST
Adolescents (Children between 11 and 17 years of age) pay the same price as adults.
If your child is less than 5 years old, please reach out to us.

trips.title: Western Ghats – Soak In Stream Of Joy!

itinerary.title: Drive to Dharamsthala.
itinerary.description:
Drive: 6-7 hrs Local Attraction
Fish Feeding
Leave Bangalore early (by 7 AM) for Dharmasthala. Breakfast on the way. Reach the homestay by lunch & relax. Step out in the evening and feed the numerous fishes. Enjoy a campfire in the evening and a delicious dinner.
Our Western Ghats women only tour is a road trip to ex-Bangalore. We will start pick-ups by 7 AM across multiple points usually along the ORR. The exact point name will be shared closer to the date of travel based on the group. To avoid delays, please be on time and cooperate with your lead.
Your stay is a beautiful homestay. Please do come with the view of respecting the sanctity of a home and appreciating the warmth and hospitality.
Simple local vegetarian food. A home cooked vegetarian meal would be served.
Shalini Eswaran
I went on a mom and kids tour...The homestay we stayed in was right in the middle of fresh, lush and green surroundings. Our host was extremely friendly and knowledgeable and ensured activities to keep all of us engaged well: adults and children alike…I look forward to more such trips both for myself and my kids.

itinerary.title: Bahubali Statue, Bamboo Rafting.
itinerary.description:
Drive: 1-2 hrs Walk: 2-3 hrs Local Sightseeing
Have an early hearty breakfast and set out to explore Dharmasthala town. Explore the vintage car museum, visit the statue of Bahubali & Manjunath Temple as time permits. Return to the homestay for lunch & relax. Jump on the Bamboo raft to head towards the waterfall. Splash and have fun! Today will be an eventful day.
Weather in Dharmasthala would be pleasant but will be cold in mornings and evenings.
FUN FACT!
If you want to experience a true taste of vintage automobiles, the car museum is a must visit - home to some of the rarest and most exquisite car collections, along with classics like Pontiac, Cadillac, Morris, Austin and more.

itinerary.title: Bird Watching, Drive back to Bangalore.
itinerary.description:
Drive: 5-7 hrs Bird Watching
Return to city Start early, after morning cuppa, go for bird watching and plantation walk. Check-out after breakfast. Lunch on the way. Reach Bangalore by 8 PM in the evening. Our Western Ghat women trip ends.
We will be returning along the same route and will have multiple drop-off points. We expect to complete all drop-offs by 8 PM. If you have to travel further, please plan your return after 10 PM. If you require airport or railway station drops, it can be arranged at an extra cost.
Swati Sharma
The Western ghat … trip was wonderful and lots of great memories were made. All the arrangements ( traveler, homestay, hotel, tour guide) were well thought. This was my first solo trip and couldn't ask for a better experience. Looking forward to make such more memories.
Important
This is an ex-Bangalore women group tour to Western Ghats. There will be multiple pickup and drop-off points across the city. If you are joining us from a different city, please reach Bangalore by the evening of 26 November, and plan your return after 10 PM on 29 November.
Add ons Single Occupancy Supplement (if you don’t want to share the room) – INR 8,000 + 5% GST
Child Pricing (5 to 10 years old) – INR 15,000 + 5% GST
Children between 11 and 17 years of age) pay the same price as adults. If your child is less than 5 years old, please reach out to us.
Additional Service: If you are joining the trip from a different city and want to arrive early or extend your stay, please let us know and we can help you arrange for transport and stay at an additional cost.

itinerary.title: Land in Guwahati, Pobitora Wildlife Sanctuary.
itinerary.description:
Arrivals
Drive: 2 hrs Jeep Safari
Assemble at Guwahati airport and after lunch, proceed to Mayong, a village close to Pobitora Wildlife Sanctuary. Pobitora Sanctuary holds Assam’s second largest population of the Indian rhinoceros. Go for an evening jeep safari. Settle into your hotel and relax. Overnight at Mayong.
For our Meghalaya all women tour, simple Indian food such as rotis/dal, rice etc. Toast/Omelettes will be available. Most of the local cuisine in Meghalaya is non-vegetarian. However, please note that there is no dearth of vegetarian food, but please do not expect an all-vegetarian (only vegetarian) place to eat. Those are almost impossible to find in Meghalaya.
Our stay today is a well reviewed resort close to the Wildlife Sanctuary.
Gayathri Gopinath
Just finished the Meghalaya trip. I had a blast and met so many wonderful women. All the accomodations were very well researched and coordination by trip lead was on point. All major places of interest were covered during this trip. F5 escapes is highly recommended and looking forward to many such trips in future.

itinerary.title: Mawphlang Sacred Grove. Cherrapunjee.
itinerary.description:
Drive: 4-5 hrs Walk: 2-3 hrs After breakfast, leave for Cherrapunjee. On the way, stop at the Umiam lake view point. Proceed to Mawphlang Sacred Grove and listen to the stories of Khasi culture. The 78 hectare of land protected by the deity Labasa, is one of the many sacred forests across Meghalaya. Reach Cherrapunjee late evening and settle into your stay. Overnight at Cherrapunjee.
The sun rises very early in the North East. It will be very bright by 7am, and absolutely dark by 5 PM. So the days will have to start early. Please cooperate with the trip lead. Being rural areas, Cherrapunjee, Mawlynnong and Nongriat don’t offer any night life. So it will be early to bed and early to rise.
Majority of the dishes available in Meghalaya contain pork. We will request those dishes only if you want to try.
Our stay is a locally run boutique property with great views, close to the Nongriat trek.
FUN FACT!
Did you know? It's a taboo to remove anything from the Mawphlang Sacred Grove. Not even a leaf or pebble. Doing so is believed to invite misfortune or illness.

itinerary.title: Arwah caves. Garden of Caves. Water Falls.
itinerary.description:
Walk: 2-3 hrs Waterfalls
Caves
Explore Cherrapunjee today. Visit the beautiful waterfalls. Explore Arwah caves and walk in the Garden of caves. Cherrapunjee has no dearth of scenic spots and we will explore as much as time and energy permit. Overnight at Cherrapunjee.
Our winter all-women Meghalaya tour is an active trip. Even waterfalls, and other points of interest will require hiking and walking. If you are involved in some sort of physical exercise regularly, you should be fine with the activity. If you have any pre-existing conditions, please let us know in advance.
Jisha Krishnan
As someone who loves to travel solo, I was apprehensive about travelling with a women's group. Nonetheless, I wanted to give it a try. And I am so glad that I did!...What I cherish the most though is the company - seven women from diverse backgrounds bound by the love for travel, laughter & unending conversations!...F5 Escapes organised the trip so beautifully & efficiently that it a breeze,...Whether you are a seasoned solo traveller or a first-timer, F5 Escapes offers the perfect experience!

itinerary.title: Day trek to Nongriat Double Decker Root Bridge
itinerary.description:
Trek: Full day Living root bridges Living root bridges are one of the most enticing factors of Meghalaya. Today we trek to the double decker bridge to Nongriat. It is around 3000 steps but totally worth the exercise. Spend some time at the mountain pool where the water is crystal clear and a colour of absolutely mesmerising azure. Climb back up to the parking area by evening. Rest the aching calves and call it an early night. Overnight at Cherapunjee.
Trekking to Nongriat will require a certain level of fitness. It is around 3000 stairs one way to the double decker bridge downhill and the 3000 stairs back to the parking lot. If you are involved in some sort of physical exercise regularly, you should be fine with the activity. If you want to sit out of the Nongriat trek, we can arrange for your stay and taxi for the day at extra cost.
FUN FACT!
Living Root Bridges are exclusive to Meghalaya. These roots (i.e., stem roots of a species of Indian Rubber), takes 20-25 years to mature, but can live up to 500 years. What’s more - these are often used by villagers as bridges and can support almost 50 people.

itinerary.title: Shnongpdeng on the banks of Umngot.
itinerary.description:
Safari Tents
Boatride
Bonfire Dinner
Have a relaxed start of the day. Our destination today is Shnongpdeng, where we will be staying in safari tents on the banks of Umngot river tonight. Reach Shnongpdeng. Get into a boat ride where your boat appears to be suspended mid-air, so clear is the water. Cross the crystal clear waters of Umngot and reach the campsite. Enjoy the bonfire and the dinner. Overnight at Shnongpdeng.
Our stay is safari tents pitched on the shore of the Umngot river. The location is remote and the power is completely solar. So hot water is not to be expected.

itinerary.title: Krang Suri Falls. Nartiang Shaktipeeth. Shillong.
itinerary.description:
Drive: 3-4 hrs Water Activities
Temple Visit
Indulge in water activities on the river like SCUBA diving, snorkelling, cliff jumping and kayaking. Later proceed towards Shillong. On the way visit the Krang Suri waterfalls. We will take a slight detour to visit the Nartiang Durga Temple, a 600 year old temple which is also a Shaktipeeth. Reach Shillong late in the evening. Overnight at Shillong.
We will stay in a beautiful, locally run BnB built in the 1960s, with all modern conveniences.
Divya Bhat
Just got back from my Meghalaya trip with F5 Escapes, and I’m still smiling every time I think about it…They somehow find the perfect spots, the kind you’d never discover on your own. Every viewpoint, every trail, every little detour felt magical. And the stays were such a highlight - safe, unique, scenic, super clean, and paired with genuinely tasty food. It all felt so thoughtfully chosen…Huge thanks to F5 Escapes for making the trip feel comfortable, safe, and full of heart.

itinerary.title: Laitlum Canyons. Shillong
itinerary.description:
Drive: 2-3 hrs Walk: 1-2 hrs Local Attractions
After breakfast, visit the Laitlum Canyons. Return to Shillong town. Walk through the town area, go around the Ward Lake. Shop, try some street food. Overnight at Shillong.
FUN FACT!
Bollywood fun fact - Parts of the movie Rock On 2 was filmed at the Laitlum Canyon.

itinerary.title: Fly Out Of Guwahati.
itinerary.description:
Drive: 2-3 hrs Return Flights
After breakfast, get dropped at Guwahati airport for your afternoon flights. Get dropped at the airport by 1:30 PM. Our Meghalaya group trip ends.
Please book your return flights after 3 PM.
Important
Our Meghalaya women trip is to ex-Guwahati. It's an active trip of moderate to intense activity. There will be walking and some amount of fitness is required for the treks especially to the Double Decker bridges.
Add ons Single Occupancy Supplement (if you don’t want to share the room) – INR 23,000 + 5% GST
Child Pricing (5 to 10 years old) – INR 54,000 + 5% GST
Children between 11 and 17 years of age) pay the same price as adults. If your child is less than 5 years old, please reach out to us.
If you want to visit Kamakhya temple in Guwahati, we can arrange the logistics. Reach out to the team.

itinerary.title: Varanasi, Kashi Vishwanath.
itinerary.description:
Arrivals
Drive: ~2 hrs Walk: 2-3 hrs Reach Varanasi by 12 PM. In the evening, visit Kashi Vishwanath and other temples of Varanasi. Try some chats and Indulge in some shopping. Overnight at Varanasi.
For our Varanasi and Ayodhya women only tour, we will explore the local fare including street food, albeit in select popular, hygienic places. Food will mostly be vegetarian in Varanasi & Ayodhya. Food exploration is an important part of this trip. If you have any dietary restrictions, please let us know well in advance.
While we will try to keep the Varanasi group trip as culturally inclined and secular as possible, please remember Varanasi & Ayodhya are known for their temples. Every temple has a story. If you are someone who can enjoy temples from a cultural perspective, then this trip is for you. This is not a pilgrimage trip.
Subhashini Subramani
Unlike my solo trip, here i just sat back , relaxed and enjoyed the six days thorughly thanks to the F5 team. Their organisation skills are commendable. The entire trip be it the stay, the food both at the hotels and outside, the travel vehicle, the guides and so on, every aspect was well organized. The best part was they were not rigid , they just allowed us to enjoy the tour. It was simply outstanding.

itinerary.title: Subah-E- Banaras, Boat Ride.
itinerary.description:
Walk: 2-4 hrs Cultural Experience (Ganga Arati)
Monuments
Wake up early for a divine early morning with Subah-E-Banaras and boat tour to see Kashi coming alive in the morning time. Today, you will get to understand the ancient city better along with an early breakfast of traditional Kachori Jalebi. After this, visit one of the most recognised monuments of India, the national emblem - The Ashoka Pillar at Sarnath. Witness Evening Ganga Aarti at Dashashwamedh Ghat. Overnight at Varanasi.
Most of the places in the itinerary are best explored by foot. This tour will require you to walk a lot, say 3-4 kms a day. There are steps everywhere in the Ghats area in Varanasi. If you have issues walking, then this tour may not be for you.
FUN FACT!
Did you know? At Manikarnika Ghat, funeral pyres (the flames representing the cycle of life and death) burn 24/7, 365 days a year, with no interruptions—even during floods or storms.

itinerary.title: Prayagraj, Triveni Sangam
itinerary.description:
Drive: 5-6 hrs Walk: 2-3 hrs Local attractions After breakfast leave for Prayagraj. Visit Triveni sangam, Bade Hanuman ji madir (20 foot long reclining idol of Lord Hanuman). Drive further to Ayodhya. Reach Ayodhya by late evening. Overnight at Ayodhya.
FUN FACT!
Did you know? The word ‘triveni' translates to triple confluence, while ‘sangam’ refers to the meeting point of the three holy Indian rivers - The Ganges (clear and muddy), the Yamuna (dark green-blue), and the Saraswati (mythical and invisible). Because of the difference in colors, you can actually see the point where the two rivers meet.

itinerary.title: Ayodhya
itinerary.description:
Walk: 2-4 hrs Temples and Ghats
Visit Ram mandir, Kanak Bhavan, Hanuman Garhi temple. Evening at Saryu ghat. Overnight at Ayodhya.
FUN FACT!
Did you know? The 51-inch idol of Ram Lalla in the Garbh grah is carved from a single black stone. Known as the Krishna Shila, the stone is sourced from a village in Mysuru, Karnataka and believed to be over 3 billion years old.

itinerary.title: Flyout.
itinerary.description:
Local signtseeing Return Flights
After breakfast visit Guptar ghat and get dropped at the airport for your return flight. Our Varanasi all women group trip ends.
Hotel check-out is at 11 AM. Please book your flights accordingly.
Asha Ramesh
It was a wonderful trip to Varanasi organized by F5 Escapes...the group travel was very safe and in order, was in safe hands all along whilst traveling to certain locations, it was my first trip with them and surely won’t be my last as there are many more to come!!
Important
Our year-end Varanasi women trip starts in Varanasi & ends in Ayodhya.
Add ons Single Occupancy Supplement (if you don’t want to share the room) – INR 17,500 + 5% GST
Child Pricing (5 to 10 years old) – INR 39,000 + 5% GST
Adolescents (Children between 11 and 17 years of age) pay the same price as adults.
If your child is less than 5 years old, please reach out to us.
If you want to explore Lucknow as well, we can arrange an excursion with an extra night’s stay in Lucknow. You will then fly out of Lucknow. Reach out to the team for more details.

itinerary.title: Amritsar, Golden temple
itinerary.description:
Arrivals
Street food Golden Temple
Arrive at the heritage city of Amritsar. After lunch, visit the Jallianwala Bagh. Indulge in a leisurely walk, shop and savour the city’s delicious street food. Proceed towards the Golden Temple in the evening. If time permits, get the blessing in the form of langar at the Golden Temple. Overnight at Amritsar.
January will be really cold in Punjab and Dalhousie. You can expect the lowest temperature around 3°C and the highest around 20°C.
Authentic Punjabi food wherever possible will be available. Simple Indian food such as rotis/dal, rice etc. Toast/Omelettes will be available during the Amritsar Dalhousie women only trip.
We will be visiting multiple places and covering some distances. Please coorperate with the trip lead to maintain time.
FUN FACT!
Did you know? The langar at the Golden Temple is often regarded as the world’s largest community kitchen, and serves over 1,00,000 people in a single day!

itinerary.title: Partition Museum, Attari-Wagah Border
itinerary.description:
Local sightseeing Retreat Ceremony
Walk: 2-3 hrs Explore more of Amritsar today. Visit the Gobindgarh Fort, Partition museum. Proceed to Attari-Wagah Border to witness the retreat ceremony. Overnight at Amritsar.
The retreat ceremony at Attari-Wagah is something you need to prepare for, expect it to be crowded. You need to be there well in time to grab the seats.
Kavitha Rangaswamy
A beautifully planned Amritsar trip from start to finish. Thoughtful details, smooth coordination, and zero stress made it truly enjoyable.

itinerary.title: Dalhousie
itinerary.description:
Drive: 3-4 hrs Walk: 1-2 hrs Local attractions After breakfast, start your journey towards Dalhousie. This will be a long and picturesque ride. Visit some local churches and explore the Mall Road in the evening. Overnight at Dalhousie.
Dalhousie will be very cold. It can have a temperature ranging from 1°C to 14°C. However, if it snows, temperatures will dip further (sub zero).

itinerary.title: Khajjiar
itinerary.description:
Drive: 2-3 hrs Walk: ~1 hr Sightseeing
After breakfast, visit the mini Switzerland of India, Khajjiar, if weather permits. Khajjiar Lake, situated in Chamba district of Himachal Pradesh, takes its name from Khajji Nag, the deity in the temple nearby, with evergreen cedar trees surrounding it from all sides. Drive back to Dalhousie by evening. Evening at leisure. Overnight at Dalhousie.
Snow disrupts plans in the Himalayas. So if there is a snowfall in or around Dalhousie, we may not be able to visit all the places. However, there will be snow! And that itself will be pretty amazing. Those days are best for unwinding, reading or just soaking in the Himalayas.

itinerary.title: Lohri Celebration, Village Walk
itinerary.description:
Drive: 3-4 hrs Local attractions Lohri celebrations Today is Lohri day. Get ready for the celebrations. Start your journey towards Nawanpind village in Gurdaspur. Enjoy a tractor ride, taste the fresh gur, and engage yourself in Lohri festivities. If you feel like, get dressed up in your traditional attire and enjoy a hearty Lohri with bonfire, food, dance and more in an authentic Punjabi environment. Overnight at Nawanpind.
Snehal Chaitanya
Another great trip with F5 Escapes. Full marks to lead who did a wonderful job managing the trip and being a great travel companion.

itinerary.title: Flyout
itinerary.description:
Drive: 2-3 hrs Return flights After breakfast, get dropped at Amritsar airport for your flight. Our women group trip to Amritsar-Dalhousie ends.
Please book your return flights after 1 PM.
Important
This trip is to ex-Amritsar. This is the winter season and it will be very cold, with the possibility of snow in some areas.
Add ons Single Occupancy Supplement (if you don’t want to share the room) – INR 16,500 + 5% GST
Child Pricing (5 to 10 years old) – INR 38,500 + 5% GST
Children between 11 and 17 years of age pay the same price as adults. If your child is less than 5 years old, please reach out to us.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Bagdogra. Drive to Phuentsholing.
itinerary.description:
Arrivals
Drive: 4-5 hrs Reach Bagdogra and start for Phuentsholing. We are doing this road trip to avoid uncertainties and scarcity of flights to Paro. Check in to your stay and relax. While we process the route permit, explore the little border town on foot. Overnight at Phuentsholing.
Indians do not require a visa for Bhutan but a permit is required. We will be arranging the permit for you. Documents required for the issuance of route permit: Valid Indian Passport (with validity of more than 6 months at the time of travel) or Indian Voter’s identity card. Aadhar, Driving License or OCI etc are not valid. Also, we will need two passport size photos.
Alokeparna Chaudhury
I traveled with F5 for the first time to Bhutan, and it was a really refreshing experience. No compromise on safety and hospitality...They covered all major sight seeing places…It was a lot of fun and I would definitely be travelling with them again in the future.

itinerary.title: Drive To Thimpu. Craft Market. Clock Tower area.
itinerary.description:
Drive: 4-5 hrs Local Attractions
After breakfast, start your journey for Thimphu, stopping at the villages and scenic spots to enjoy and photograph the landscape which is replete with bounties of nature. Thimphu has a thriving local culture. Upon arrival in Thimphu, check in at the hotel. Take a walking tour in the capital city visiting Bhutanese Crafts market and Clock Tower Square area. Overnight at Thimphu.
This is the Winter season in Bhutan. Paro and Thimphu, will have temperatures ranging between -5°C to 10°C. Carry sweaters/thermals etc. Room heaters will be available at hotels.
Indian food will be available in Thimphu and Paro, but not always. We will try a lot of local Bhutanese delicacies. Cafes in Thimphu and Paro will serve continental food as well.
FUN FACT!
In Bhutan, when you meet people, smile and say ‘Kuzu zangpo la’ (hello); and when you have to thank someone, say ‘Kadrinche la’!

itinerary.title: Explore Thimpu. Museum. View points. Markets. Monasteries
itinerary.description:
Walk: 3-4 hrs Local Attractions
Explore Thimphu today. Visit Simply Bhutan – a living Museum/studio showcasing the age old culture and traditional heritage. Fine peace at Buddha Dordenma Statue. Visit the incense and handmade paper factory. Visit the National Post Office and get stamps with your pictures on. Later in the evening, explore Takin Preserve and soak yourself in beautiful surroundings. Overnight at Thimphu.
You've seen stamps featuring famous people, landmarks, wildlife, and more - but how about a stamp with your own photo on it? At the National Post Office in Thimphu, you can get personalised stamps with your photo on it and use them to send postcards back home.
You cannot wear shorts while visiting monasteries, temples, and Dzongs, though they’re fine for trekking.
FUN FACT!
Did you know? The Buddha Dordenma Statue is not only regarded as one of the largest Buddha stupas in the world, but also houses over 125,000 smaller Buddha statues, all made of bronze and gilded in gold!

itinerary.title: Punakha. Suspension Bridge. Punakha Dzong. Fertility Temple
itinerary.description:
Drive: 3-4 hrs Walk: 2-3 hrs Sightseeing
After breakfast, start for Punakha. From Thimphu, the road climbs up to Dochula pass (3,050m), where you have the opportunity to view the peaks of the eastern Himalayas. Descend into the Punakha valley (1450m above sea level).
Visit Chimi Lhakhang temple or the fertility temple, dedicated to Lama Drukpa Kunley. Later visit the impressive Punakha Dzong, built at the confluence of two major rivers in Bhutan, the Pho Chhu and Mo Chhu, which converge in this valley. Walk on the longest suspension bridge of Bhutan. Overnight in Punakha.
The fertility temple is dedicated to Lama Drukpa Kunley, popularly known as ‘the divine madman‘ - a folk hero and cultural icon around whom countless yarns of stories and legends have been spun.
Chandana Karuna
I thoroughly enjoyed the recent trip to bhutan with F5. The trip lead and the host ensured the trip is smooth and everything is taken care of.

itinerary.title: Hike to Khamsum Yulley Namgyal Chorten. Paro via Dochu La.
itinerary.description:
Moderate hike Local Attractions
Shopping
In the morning, drive a short distance through the idyllic countryside and walk a short distance uphill to Khamsum Chorten on Nyenzangang hill. The view of the terraced rice fields, dotted with traditional houses, the river and the valley surrounded by mountains is amazing!
Start your journey towards Paro, crossing the Dochu La. Arrive in Paro, and explore the market. Try traditional dresses and get clicked. Shop and relax. Overnight in Paro.

itinerary.title: Trek to Tiger’s Nest Monastery
itinerary.description:
Trek: 6 kms (one-way)
Duration: 7-8 hrs We will be climbing to the most identifiable and spiritual icon of Bhutan – the Taktsang Monastery or the Tiger’s Nest Monastery. It is blessed and sanctified as one of Bhutan’s most sacred religious sites. It hangs on a cliff and stands above a beautiful forest of blue pine and rhododendrons. The trek will take up the whole day. Later, return to the stay and indulge in a hot stone bath if you like. Overnight at Paro.
The trek will take up the whole day. The last part of the trek consists of climbing at least 400 stairs. Please reconsider if you have knee issues. We will take it at our own pace, but you will need stamina. If you do not exercise regularly, this may be challenging for you.
At the base of the Tiger nest trek, there are horses available for rent for a fee. You can sit somewhat comfortably on horseback to reach the cafeteria about mid-way up the trail, then continue hiking from there. To descend the mountain though, you’ll have to do it on foot – horse rides are not available for descent. While some will probably not make it all the way to the monastery, it is worth getting till the first viewpoint.
In case you want to skip the trek, we will plan an alternate sightseeing expedition for you. It will be charged if it is outside Paro city limits. Within the city, it would be free of charge but without a guide.

itinerary.title: Drive Back to Bagdogra.
itinerary.description: Drive: ~10 hrs After breakfast, start your return journey to Bagdogra. This will be a long drive and we will make stops on the way to make this journey comfortable and interesting. Overnight at Bagdogra.

itinerary.title: Fly out. Trip ends.
itinerary.description:
Return flights Fly out Of Bagdogra. Our Bhutan women group trip ends.
Book your return tickets anytime today. Hotel check-out is at 10 AM.
Important
Our Bhutan all women group trip is only for Indian Passport holders / Indian Voter's Card holders. International travellers / OCI card holders please reach out to us. For kids below 17 years of age with no Voter cards and passports, Birth certificate and school identity card is imperative.

itinerary.title: FLY INTO COLOMBO; O/N COLOMBO
itinerary.description:
Please arrive at Colombo airport latest by 2 PM. Upon your arrival, a cab will transfer the group to the hotel.
Check in to the hotel, and after freshening up we will go out and explore the city with your new travel mates!

TRANSFER TO NUWARA ELIYA. ENROUTE VISIT ELEPHANT ORPHANAGE. O/N NUWARA ELIYA
Today after breakfast, we drive to the beautiful hill station. But before we reach this pretty town, we will make a stop at an Elephant Orphanage. This place was a sanctuary to the orphaned baby elephants that were found in the wild. To see an elephant taking bath in the river, spraying water all around is the best feeling. And I am sure we are going to see that.
Post lunch we will resume our journey. Also known as the “Little England‟ of Sri Lanka, Nuwara Eliya gives you the feel of an old British country village, what with its colonial era bungalows, the neat hedges in the gardens, and the vintage architecture of its hotels and buildings. The weather is pleasant, there are tea gardens everywhere around you, the air itself feel fresher, and it makes for the perfect start to the holiday! We can walk around the town. Walk into little cafes, talk to the locals, buy a souvenir, and immerse yourself in the beauty of Nuwara Eliya!

itinerary.title: HIKE TO WORLD’S END; O/N NUWARA ELIYA
itinerary.description:
Today we are hiking to World's End. Nice sounding name, eh!
Situated at one end of Horton Plains National Park, World’s End is the name of a view point about four kilometers from the starting point, in the forest and wildlife conservation area. We start very early in the morning. The hike is easy, there is a beautiful mist blowing all around and once you reach the top, the views are gorgeous with hills spread in all directions and villages and tea plantations looking like dots and Lego creations down below in the valley.
After spending some time in this pretty place, we will go to Baker Falls. It’s a small waterfall where the falls run over a small set of rocks.In the evening, let’s walk around the beautiful tea

NUWARA ELIYA TO ELLA. O/N ELLA
After breakfast, we'll set off to explore a charming new town nestled in the Sri Lankan hills. Our first stop is the Seetha Amman Kovil, the only temple of its kind in the world, dedicated to Seetha and built in the Dravidian architectural style. According to the epic Ramayana, this is the sacred spot where King Rama kept Seetha hidden to protect her from the demon king Ravana. Nearby, a stream flows, believed to be the place where Seetha bathed, and a rock beside it is said to to be where she sat in prayer. Let's take in the beauty of this serene and historic site.
After the temple visit, those interested can hop on the famous train ride from Nuwara Eliya to Ella (not part of the trip inclusions, but highly recommended). This ride is often dubbed one of the most scenic train journeys in the world. You'll pass through rolling tea plantations, misty hills, old tunnels, and charming little villages. Locals wave from the tracks, the air smells of fresh leaves, and it’s pure magic through and through. It’s a slow ride, but trust us – you won’t want it to go any faster.
After this we will heading back and check-in at the hotel, later you can explore the beautiful town Ella– a place that truly steals hearts. Think cozy cafés with dreamlike views, happy backpackers from all over the world, and a laid-back vibe that makes you want to stay longer. Ella is all about sipping coffee with a view, chasing sunsets, and soaking in that fresh mountain air. Whether it’s strolling through its cute streets, checking out the local shops, or just finding a quiet spot to read – Ella lets you slow down and vibe, one chill scene at a time.

itinerary.title: Post the Falls we will be heading towards Yala National Park.
itinerary.description:
ELLA TO MIRISSA. ENROUTE VISIT RAVANA FALLS & YALLA NATIONAL PARK . O/N MIRISSA
After breakfast, we will leave for the beach town of Mirissa, at the southern end of this coastal country. On the way we will stop at the massive Ravana Falls. The falls are gigantic and a beauty to watch.
The chance to go on safari and see a wild boar or majestic Sri Lankan leopard, the winding trails, and the fact that in some places the park even touches the Indian Ocean. However, two of the most popular reasons to visit are Sithulpauwwa, a Buddhist rock temple, and Magul Maha Viharaya, where folklore says an ancient king wed an abandoned princess. The history and artifacts found here transport you back to those ancient times.
We will reach our hotel in the evening, and after freshening up, let's head up to the beach. Feel free to follow your heart, stroll by yourself for with friends, have a drink at a local bar, or read a book near the sea, it is but your holiday.

itinerary.title: OPTIONAL WHALE WATCHING OR SNORKELLING; DAY TRIP TO GALLE FORT O/N MIRISSA
itinerary.description:
Today we can indulge in what I feel is probably the best part of the trip. Whale watching!!!!
How many people in the world can say that they swam with a whale– the largest mammal in the world. Very few people!
This is an optional activity for those who are interested.Mirissa is one the very few places in South Asia where you can go on a sighting tour to spot whales. It would be an incredible experience. Even at the world level, it is said that Mirissa is one of the top places to spot a blue whale! The tour starts early in the morning, where a boat takes you into the Indian Ocean and you can spot different kind of whales and dolphins, including the largest mammal on Earth - The Blue Whale.
We could even do a fun beach photo shoot among ourselves. You can be your funniest, silliest whatever you want to be.
We will be doing a day trip to Galle fort. The route is along the western coast and very pretty. In the 18th century, the Dutch build their headquarters, Galle Fort, on the Sri Lankan coast. In present day times, the fort’s walls are home to museums, churches, trendy shops, cafes, and restaurants. Walk around, preferably along the coastal walls and ramparts and you get a stellar view of the sea and the Galle cricket ground. Wandering around in some of the narrow streets of Galle Fort makes you forget that you are in Sri Lanka. It looks like you are in a European city instead. Even if you’re not a culture driven person, the buildings inside Galle Fort will be something refreshing.

itinerary.title: package).
itinerary.description:
DRIVE FROM MIRISSA TO BENTOTA. RIVER SAFARI. O/N BENTOTA
After breakfast, we will leave for Bentota. It will be a drive of 2 hrs. Have you ever cruised among the lush mangroves while the bird chirp happily? It’s an experience to cherish! You can view exotic animals like herons, kingfishers, crocodiles (Yep!!). Another interesting thing to do during the safari is the fish spa (not included in the Post River safari we will checkin in our hotel. Today is the last day of the trip, let‟s go to the beach chill & discuss about the past few days. :)

itinerary.title: DEPARTURE FOR AIRPORT
itinerary.description:
The Tour ends today, people! A cab will transfer us to the airport and from there fly back to India. Hope you had a great trip, and we shall meet somewhere some time again soon.
Au revoir!
Land in Bali, and join the squad at Seminyak! Enjoy a sunset at Double Six Beach, followed by a group dinner and a night out to experience Bali’s vibrant nightlife.
Embark on an exciting day with a surfing lesson at Kuta Beach, then explore the scenic Uluwatu Temple before ending with a breathtaking sunset at a famous beach.
Travel to Gili Trawangan via speedboat. Catch a stunning sunset, enjoy the white beaches, and the renowned nightlife!
Snorkel or scuba in Gili’s vibrant waters, spotting sea turtles and colorful fish. Enjoy evening at your pace - either some beach time or some nightlife.
Farewell Gili, Hello Ubud! Catch a speedboat and head to Bali’s cultural heart, Ubud. The evening is yours to explore or simply enjoy some pool time.
Hike Mount Batur volcano for a breathtaking sunrise, then unwind with a Balinese massage. Later, explore more of Ubud, visit a waterfall or catch a Kecak dance, and enjoy a night out.

Visit Cretya lounge, overlooking Bali’s rice terraces. Go on the swings, into pools, or take in the views. Later, enjoy a thrilling ATV ride through jungle trails, caves, and muddy tracks with the squad.
Farewell to Ubud and make your way to Seminyak! Opt for a Nusa Penida day trip or relax before heading to Finns Beach Club for an unforgettable last night with squad!
Say your goodbyes and catch your airport transfer, taking only good vibes and epic plans for the next adventure with the squad!
Xin Chao, Ho Chi Minh City - also called Saigon! Meet your squad and get settled in the city's popular District 1. Kickstart the trip with Saigon’s electric nightlife on Bui Vien Street!
Explore the Cu Chi Tunnels, test your aim at the shooting range, and visit the War Remnants Museum. In the evening, enjoy local food, shop, or relax at a rooftop bar!
Take a flight to Hoi An, a charming fusion of Asian and European influences. Wander its vibrant streets, then dive into the island’s night market, street food, and buzzing nightlife!

Start your day relaxing or soaking up the sun at An Bang Beach. In the afternoon, enjoy a thrilling basket boat ride through lush coconut groves. In the evening, shop, explore, and get some quality time with the squad!
Spend the day at Ba Na Hills, visiting the Golden Bridge, French Village, and a fun theme park. In the evening, wander through Hoi An’s charming old town.
Head to Da Nang in the morning to explore the Marble Mountains, then fly to Hanoi and settle into the Old Quarter. Visit Train Street and end the night at street markets and Beer Street!
The trip’s highlight awaits! Cruise Halong Bay, explore caves, hike to scenic viewpoints, and kayak on tranquil waters. Back in Hanoi, wrap up with an epic squad party!
