Depart for Koh Samui with a mix of road and boat journeys. In Samui, enjoy a relaxing Thai spa session before heading to Chaweng Beach for fire shows and beach parties.

Explore Samui’s beautiful viewpoint, waterfall and more local spots. By evening, get ready for the ultimate party - we head to Koh Phangan for the most awaited Full Moon Party! Party it out till sunrise!
Take it slow this morning - sleep in or relax at your own pace. If you're up for more adventure, your TM has some great recommendations.

Depart for Krabi and reach by late afternoon. Post check-in at the hotel in Krabi, enjoy a stunning beachside sunset or a dip in the pool, evening is at leisure for you to explore some local nightlife.
Island exploration mode ON! Go island hopping across Koh Phi Phi’s breathtaking islands, snorkel in crystal waters, and soak in stunning views. End the day with one last epic night out!
No goodbyes, just good vibes! Cherish the last moments with your squad and start planning your next adventure.

Welcome to Sri Lanka! Meet your squad in Colombo, explore local cafés and city hotspots, and catch a stunning sunset at Port City. End the day with a stroll through Fort’s lively streets and buzzing nightlife.

Welcome to Ella! Journey through lush green hills to scenic Ravana Falls and a local tea plantation to discover Sri Lanka’s famous Ceylon tea. Spend the evening exploring Ella’s charming town, and laid-back mountain vibes.

Hike up Little Adam’s Peak for breathtaking mountain views, followed by a visit to the iconic Nine Arch Bridge. Opt to unwind at Ravana Pool Club, then spend the evening exploring Ella’s charming cafés and laid-back vibes.

Embark on an exciting wildlife safari at Yala National Park - spot elephants, crocodiles, exotic birds and maybe even the elusive Sri Lankan leopard. Head to the south coast, end the day with island beats and a night of partying!

Catch your first wave on a surf session, then unwind at Kai Beach Club and hit Sri Lanka’s iconic beach rope swing for Insta-worthy shots. At night, indulge in great music, drinks and coastal party vibes @ Doctor’s House!

Ease into the day with a chill coffee/brunch scene at Ahangama’s cute cafés. Later, visit a turtle hatchery. Explore Galle Dutch Fort’s iconic lighthouse, charming streets and boutiques, then wind down with local food and drinks!
Swim into Sri Lanka’s clear blue waters for an unforgettable snorkelling experience with sea turtles and colourful marine life. Wrap up the trip with a stunning South Coast sunset with your squad!

itinerary.title: Enjoy breakfast, plan a reunion, and head to the airport - no goodbyes, just good vibes!

itinerary.description: Hello Amsterdam! Meet your squad at the hostel and step out to explore this iconic city. Explore its renowned spots, towering Christmas tree and famous Red Light District.

Cruise through Amsterdam’s scenic canals, then dive into the Heineken Experience with fresh brews and fun challenges. Then visit a festive Christmas market with beautiful backdrops and an ice skating.
Spend your morning exploring or shopping, then head to Zaanse Schans in the afternoon - a picturesque village with historic windmills and charming Dutch houses!
Today, we travel to Berlin! In the evening, visit the iconic East Side Gallery, indulge in local flavors, and dive into Berlin’s legendary nightlife.

Merry Christmas! Head out with the squad to see some of Berlin’s top highlights. Post that, visit a couple of iconic Christmas markets. Did you know that Germany is the birthplace of Christmas markets?
Say goodbye to Berlin and head to Prague! Explore the medieval Old Town in the afternoon, then join an epic pub crawl, ending at a massive 5-story club with a unique vibe on each level!
Discover Prague’s old world charm on a guided walking tour and uncover its hidden gems! Later, explore more iconic spots in the city with the squad.

Explore Prague your way - from the Dancing House and Vltava river to Czech favourites like fried cheese and Trdelník. Visit it's Old Town, which is home to one of the busiest Christmas markets of the city!
Arrive in Budapest, the stunning city by the Danube. Settle in, explore the lively Jewish Quarter, and head out for a fun pub crawl with the squad!
Explore iconic landmarks like Chain Bridge, St. Stephen’s Basilica, and Fisherman’s Bastion on a guided tour. Enjoy a free evening before regrouping for a night out at Budapest’s famous ruin pubs!

Start your morning at charming cafés or shopping for souvenirs. Later, maybe unwind at the scenic Szechenyi Baths. At night, head out to join the New Year fireworks and unforgettable after-parties across the city.
Happy New Year! On your final morning, bid farewell to Europe and your amazing squad - until next time!
Hello Helsinki! Meet your squad at the hostel and begin your Nordic adventure. Explore the capital’s highlights - from the White Cathedral to Kauppatori Market - and soak in the city’s charm.

New day, new country! Sail across the Baltic Sea to Tallinn, Estonia, and discover its enchanting Old Town. See famed sights including Viru Gates, Toompea Hill, and Alexander Nevsky Cathedral. Return to Helsinki in the evening after exploring.
Board the train to Rovaniemi, the capital of Lapland and home of Santa Claus. In the evening, reach Rovaniemi, check-in and head out for an unforgettable night chasing the beautiful Northern Lights.

Get ready for a magical day at the Santa Claus Village, where you’ll officially cross the Arctic Circle! Meet Santa himself, then choose between a reindeer or husky sleigh ride for the ultimate Lapland experience.
Spend the morning unwinding or go snowmobiling for an adrenaline rush. In the evening, enjoy a traditional Finnish sauna before heading out to a local pub for a taste of the Long Drink.
Say goodbye to Lapland as we take the train back to Helsinki. After checking in, enjoy dinner and drinks to celebrate your final night in Finland before the next adventure begins!

Start the day with a quick trip to the UNESCO-listed Suomenlinna Sea Fortress, known for its scenic trails and historical landmarks. Later, board an overnight cruise to Stockholm - your own budget-friendly Dil Dhadakne Do moment.

Welcome to Stockholm! Explore this vibrant island city, a mix of colourful streets and Scandinavian. Check-in and relax. Later, head out with the squad to discover iconic spots & experiencing the city's buzzing nightlife.

Explore Stockholm's highlights on a guided walking tour through Gamla Stan, passing landmarks like the Royal Palace and Stockholm Cathedral. Spend the afternoon at leisure before wrapping up the trip with a fun night out with your crew.
Check out and say goodbye to your squad as your epic trip comes to an end. Plan a re-union soon!

itinerary.title: Athens (2 Nights)
itinerary.description:
Welcome to Athens, the historic heart of Greece, a city of ancient ruins, magnificent temples and timeless beauty. Our wonderful journey begins as we meet our Veena World Tour Manager and fellow travelers.
Today we walk through Plaka- the old historical neighborhood of Athens, with narrow cobblestone streets lined with tiny shops selling jewellery, clothes and local ceramics. Here we have some free time for shopping.
Later we will proceed to our hotel.
Tonight you have that chance to get entertained by live music and dance. Enjoy a buffet dinner with Greek wine. Sing along and tap your feet while you watch classic dances performed to traditional music. Opa!

itinerary.title: Athens
itinerary.description: Today we explore Athens through the orientation tour including Hadrian’s Arch Monument – part of a wall separating the old and new cities, Royal Palace- the neoclassical building that now houses the Parliament of Greece, Olympic stadium - home of the first modern Olympic Games in 1896. Later we pass by the Temple of Zeus – a former colossal temple dedicated to Zeus God, the chief of the Olympian Gods. We then visit Acropolis site- an ancient citadel located on a rocky outcrop, Parthenon (Temple of Athena)– The temple that dominates the hill of the Acropolis. Further we visit Acropolis Museum- a collection spanning over 1,500 years.

itinerary.title: Athens – Santorini (2 Nights)
itinerary.description: Today we travel from Athens to Santorini by ferry. Upon arrival, we walk through Fira- the capital of Santorini, a combination of natural beauty, social life, night life, shopping. We then visit one of the local winery and learn about wine production in the area.

itinerary.title: Santorini
itinerary.description: Today we explore Santorini village. We enjoy views of Red Beach and the sea. We then visit Akrotiri archeological site - one of the oldest sites offering insights into the prehistoric settlement. Further we visit Lost Atlantis Experience Museum – The first museum in the world dedicated to the myth of Atlantis. Here you can re-live the cataclysmic destruction of Atlantis with extraordinary 9D experience. Later we take a photo stop at Prophet Ilias Monastery. Further we visit Black Beach - Here we enjoy some mouth-watering Greek cuisine. We then visit Megalochori village- one of the most picturesque villages on the island and Oia village – the most famous in Santorini. Here we walk through the village and admire its and its beautiful sunset.

itinerary.title: Santorini – Athens (1 Night)
itinerary.description: Today we travel from Santorini to Athens by ferry.

itinerary.title: Athens – Istanbul (2 Nights)
itinerary.description: Today we travel from Athens to Istanbul by flight. Istanbul - a major city in Turkey that straddles Europe and Asia across the Bosphorus Strait. Upon arrival we visit Grand Bazaar – the largest and oldest covered markets in the world. Here we can shop for famous flavored Turkish tea, Turkish Ceramics, Carpets, textiles. Further we enjoy Turkish dinner with show.

itinerary.title: Istanbul
itinerary.description: Today we enjoy Istanbul city, we visit Topkapi Palace – the largest and oldest palace in the world, Hippodrome square - also known as Atmeydani (Horse Square), we then visit Sultan Ahmet Tsami popularly known as Blue Mosque- a historical mosque in Istanbul, Hagia Sofia Museum – once the former Greek Orthodox Christian patriarchal cathedral. Later we experience the most scenic cruise through Bosphorus strait – a natural strait and an internationally significant waterway boundary between Europe and Asia.

itinerary.title: Istanbul – Pamukkale (2 Nights)
itinerary.description: Today we proceed to Pamukkale – known for the mineral-rich thermal waters.

itinerary.title: Pamukkale
itinerary.description: Today we visit the beautiful snow-white 'Cotton Castle,' one of the most visited places in Turkey. Later, we explore the ancient city of Hierapolis, a UNESCO World Heritage site. During our visit, we explore its masterpiece theatre.

itinerary.title: Pamukkale – Konya – Cappadocia (2 Nights)
itinerary.description: Today we proceed to Cappadocia – best known for its moon-like landscape, underground cities, caves, churches and houses in the rocks. En route, we visit the Mevlana Mausoleum in Konya, also known as the Green Mausoleum or Green Dome. Upon arrival, we enjoy whirling dervish show – the part of the Turkish history, tradition, culture and beliefs.

itinerary.title: Cappadocia
itinerary.description: Today we explore Cappadocia, we visit the famous valleys of Cappadocia like Devrent Valley – also known as Imagination Valley, Pasabag Valley – also known as Monk Valley, Goreme open air museum - the UNESCO World Heritage site which hosts the most important Byzantine cave churches in the world, Kaymakli underground city - the widest Underground city of the Cappadocia. Later we visit Ceramic Workshop - the area is famous for the artwork, souvenirs and household utensils all made from the red clay of the Avanos River.

itinerary.title: Cappadocia – Istanbul – Departure
itinerary.description:
Today we proceed to Istanbul by flight.

itinerary.title: Arrival at London (2 Nights)
itinerary.description:
Welcome to London, a city of royal palaces, iconic landmarks and timeless charm! Our wonderful journey begins as we meet our Veena World Tour Manager and fellow travellers.
After dinner, we proceed to our hotel.

itinerary.title: London
itinerary.description:
Today we explore London city, we visit Tower of London Museum – a UNESCO World Heritage Site and a Powerful symbol of the Monarchy. Here we see Koh-I-Noor Diamond. Then we pass by Tower Bridge, Piccadilly Circus, Westminster Abbey, Big Ben, River Thame, Trafalgar Square, Houses of Parliament, Buckingham Palace, Hyde Park.
Later we have free time at Oxford Street.
In the evening, we enjoy panoramic views of the city through London Eye – Europe’s tallest cantilevered observation wheel.

itinerary.title: London – Amsterdam (1 Night)
itinerary.description:
Today we board the Eurostar train from London and travel to Amsterdam – the capital city of Netherlands with a greater number of canals than roads. Upon arrival we visit miniature park of Holland – Madurodam Or during spring we visit Keukenhof tulip gardens – beautiful Tulip gardens where we enjoy photography at various statues, pavilions, beautiful ponds and colourful flower fields (According to the Keukenhof declarations, the gardens are open from (18th March 2027 – 9th May 2027).
Then we pass by Holland’s famous Windmills. Later we enjoy Canal cruise tour through Amsterdam waterways to get stunning views of century’s old architecture, charming houses and beautiful monuments.

itinerary.title: Amsterdam – Brussels – Paris (2 Nights)
itinerary.description: Today we proceed to Paris – a city well known for its fashion. Enroute, we explore Brussels – the capital city of Belgium, we pass by Grand Place – the central square, Town Hall, and the Guild Houses. We also see the Monument of Everard Serclaes – the hero who liberated the city during the 14th-century war, and Belgium’s famous Manneken Pis Statue – a small bronze statue of a little peeing boy. Upon arrival, we enjoy mesmerising tour of Paris by night.

itinerary.title: Paris
itinerary.description:
Today we enjoy we enjoy a city orientation tour of Paris. We pass by Champs-Élysées – the most famous avenue in the world. We also pass by Place de la Concorde – one of the major public squares in Paris. We then see L’Arc de Triomphe – commissioned by Napoleon in 1806 to celebrate his victory at Austerlitz.
Then we get mesmerized by the amazing view of Paris city from the top level of the Eiffel Tower. Later we admire the iconic sights of Paris on a relaxing Seine River Cruise.

itinerary.title: Paris – Reims – Luxembourg (1 Night)
itinerary.description:
Today we proceed to Luxembourg – a small European country famed for its fortified medieval old town situated on cliffs. Enroute, we explore Reims – the unofficial capital of France's historic Champagne region. Upon arrival, we explore Reims. We see Carnegie Library of Reims and Cathedral of Notre-Dame, strolled around Cryptoportique followed by photostop at the backdrop of La Porte de Mars.
Then we enjoy an experience of champagne tasting.
Upon arrival at Luxembourg, we enjoy a city tram ride of Luxembourg.

itinerary.title: Luxembourg – Titisee – Rhine Falls – Lucerne/Zurich (2 Nights)
itinerary.description:
Today we drive through the Black forest region – a mountainous region in Germany, known for its dense evergreen forests and picturesque villages. Here we visit Cuckoo clock shop at Titisee followed by visit to yet another natural beauty at Schaffhausen (Neuhausen), Rhine Falls – the most powerful waterfall in Europe. Here we enjoy Boat ride for a spectacular view of the falls.
Later we proceed to Lucerne/Zurich, Switzerland – a beautiful city in the heartland of Switzerland.

itinerary.title: Mt. Titlis – Engelberg – Lucerne
itinerary.description:
Today we proceed to Engelberg. From here we do half day excursion to Mt Titlis – Central Switzerland’s highest peak. We take ‘Titlis Rotair’ – world’s first cable car with revolving gondolas to the summit Station, enjoying panoramic views of the Swiss Alps along the way. Upon arrival at the summit, we visit Ice Grotto, enjoy thrilling Ice Flyer ride (Ice Flyer ride will be subject to operation).
Further we take a stroll on the Mt. Titlis Cliff walk.
Later we proceed to Lucerne. Upon arrival we explore Lucerne city, we take a photo stop at Lion Monument – a giant dying lion monument which commemorates the Swiss Guards who were massacred during the French Revolution, Kappelbrucke Wooden Bridge – world's oldest covered wooden bridge.
In the evening we enjoy Lake Lucerne Cruise.

itinerary.title: Lucerne – Vaduz – Wattens – Innsbruck (1 Night)
itinerary.description:
Today we proceed to Innsbruck – one of Europe’s most picture-perfect old towns. Enroute, we enjoy a City Tram ride at Vaduz – the capital of the principality of Liechtenstein. Followed by visit to Swarovski crystal world and Museum at Wattens in Austria. Here we enjoy some shopping.
Upon arrival at Innsbruck, we walk through the bridge over the Inn River, see the Golden Roof – Innsbruck's most famous landmark that shines in the heart of the historic old town and Maria Theresien Strasse – one of the busiest streets in the city.

itinerary.title: Innsbruck – Venice – San Marino (1 Night)
itinerary.description:
Today we proceed to Venice – the city of canals and bridges. Upon arrival we enjoy Vaporetto water bus ride to Venice Island and the Gondola ride in the famous canals of Venice. Further we walk through Venice Island, we pass by the Bridge of Sighs – an enclosed limestone bridge in baroque style, Doge’s Palace – the residence of the Doge of Venice, Bell Tower – 98.6 meters tall bell tower of St Mark's Basilica, St. Mark's Square – principal public square of Venice and St Mark's Basilica – one of the examples of Italian-Byzantine architecture.
Later we proceed to San Marino – one of the smallest countries in Europe, dating back to the fourth century AD.

itinerary.title: San Marino – Rome (1 Night)
itinerary.description:
Today we explore San Marino, we walk through Piazza della Libertà Square – the main plaza of San Marino, followed by a photo stop at the Basilica of St. Marino – an architectural masterpiece. Further, we also visit a viewpoint from where we get a nice view of San Marino.
Then we proceed to Rome – the Eternal City, renowned for its ancient wonders, magnificent architecture and rich history!

itinerary.title: Rome – Vatican – Pisa
itinerary.description:
Today we explore Rome city. We visit Trevi Fountain – the largest Baroque fountain in the city, Piazza Venezia – the central hub of Rome, where we see Mussolini's Balcony – the spot where the fascist dictator made some of his most famous speeches, we also see the Roman Forum – a rectangular forum surrounded by the ruins of several important ancient government buildings, Here we see the statue of Julius Caesar, whose remains were buried at the site. We also pass by the Tiber River – the third longest river in Italy, followed by a photo stop at the backdrop of the Colosseum, also known as the Flavian Amphitheatre. Further we proceed to Vatican City – the world’s smallest country where the Pope lives. Here we take a photo stop at the largest church in the world, St. Peter's Basilica. We then stroll around Vatican Square.
Then we proceed to Pisa – a city in Italy's Tuscany region best known for its iconic Leaning Tower.

itinerary.title: Pisa – Milan – Departure
itinerary.description:
Today we visit the Square of Miracles – a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Here we walk around the Baptistery and Pisa Cathedral. Further we take a photo stop at the background of Leaning tower of Pisa – a freestanding bell tower, known worldwide for its nearly four-degree lean.
Every wonderful holiday comes to an end, but the memories stay with us!
It’s time to say goodbye to our fellow travellers, taking home beautiful memories, new friendships and stories to share.
Until we meet again on another exciting journey with Veena World, Phir Milenge!

Upon arrival we see the breath-taking view of snow-capped mountains, Ice sculptures, Ice Palace and Sphinx Terrace.
Later we explore Interlaken city – a traditional resort town built on a narrow stretch between the emerald-colored lake Thun and Lake Brienz.

Further we proceed Vaduz – the capital of the principality of Liechtenstein. Upon arrival, we enjoy a City Tram ride which takes us through historical part of old city.
Later we proceed to Innsbruck – one of Europe’s most picture-perfect old towns. Upon arrival, we walk through the bridge over the Inn River, see the Golden Roof – Innsbruck's most famous landmark that shines in the heart of the historic old town and Maria Theresien Strasse – one of the busiest streets in the city.

itinerary.title: Innsbruck – Wattens – Hallein Salt Mine – Salzburg (1 Night)
itinerary.description: Today we visit Swarovski crystal world and Museum at Wattens in Austria. Here we enjoy some shopping. Later we proceed to the baroque city of Salzburg – a UNESCO World Heritage Site and Mozart's birthplace Upon arrival we visit Hallein Salt Mine – an underground salt mine. Further we walk through Salzburg city and pass by Salzburg Cathedral – a masterpiece of early baroque art, Residenz Fountain – most beautiful fountain in Salzburg, Love lock bridge over Salzac river – a symbol of eternal love. Getreide Gasse – known as the birthplace of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart at No. 9. Later we visit Mirabell Gardens – horticultural masterpiece.

itinerary.title: Salzburg – Vienna (1 Night)
itinerary.description: Today we proceed to Vienna – capital of Austria and one of the most visited cities of Europe. Upon arrival, we visit Schonbrunn Palace – an 18th century Baroque palace. Later we explore Vienna city, we pass by Opera House, Parliament Building – the monumental neoclassical building, City Hall – the city's administrative centre, Hofburg Palace – the official residence and workplace of the President of Austria, Heldenplatz – a public square and Ring Boulevard – also known as Ringstrasse, is a circular boulevard that surrounds Vienna's historical centre.

Let’s stay connected via email, phone, WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram, and more. We look forward to seeing you again on another memorable Veena World tour.
Group Guests: Guests traveling on the scheduled group flight will proceed to the airport as per the group’s departure time.
Joining & Leaving (J&L) Guests:
J&L guests will proceed to the airport after the scheduled group tour concludes.
If your flight timing and airport match the group’s, you may join the group airport transfer. Otherwise, the cost of reaching the airport, cruise terminal, railway station, or bus terminal will be borne by the guest.
Tour Concludes. Safe travels and see you soon!

itinerary.title: Arrival at Paris (3 Nights)
itinerary.description:
Welcome to Paris, a city of art, culture, magnificent architecture and unforgettable experiences! Our wonderful journey begins as we meet our Veena World Tour Manager and fellow travellers.
Later in the evening, we admire the iconic sights of Paris on a relaxing Seine River Cruise.

itinerary.title: Paris
itinerary.description: Today we enjoy a city orientation tour of Paris. We pass by Champs-Élysées – the most famous avenue in the world. We also pass by Place de la Concorde – one of the major public squares in Paris. We then see L’Arc de Triomphe – commissioned by Napoleon in 1806 to celebrate his victory at Austerlitz. Then we get mesmerized by the amazing view of Paris city from the top level of the Eiffel Tower. We then enjoy mesmerizing Paris by night illumination tour.

itinerary.title: Paris – Disneyland – Paris
itinerary.description: Today we visit Disneyland, where we enjoy a fun-filled day exploring exciting rides, attractions and shows such as It’s a Small World, Mickey's philharmagic, Indiana Jones and the Temple of Peril, Big Thunder Mountain, Pirates of the Caribbean, Star Wars Hyperspace Mountain etc. We also get a chance to meet our favourite Disney characters like Mickey, Minnie, Donald, Pluto and Goofy.

itinerary.title: Paris – Geneva (1 Night)
itinerary.description: Today we proceed to Geneva, popularly known as the 'Capital of Peace', as it is home to the headquarters of the Red Cross and the European headquarters of the United Nations. Upon arrival, we enjoy a city orientation tour, passing by Jet d’Eau Fountain – a 140-metre-high water fountain, Geneva Lake – Switzerland’s largest lake, and the Flower Clock – a beautiful floral clock. We also pass by the UN Building, Broken Chair, Red Cross Headquarters and WHO Building.

itinerary.title: Geneva – Vevey – Gruyere – Bern – Zurich/Lucerne (3 Nights)
itinerary.description: Today we proceed to Vevey, one of the pearls of the Swiss Riviera. Here we visit Chaplin’s World, dedicated to Charlie Chaplin. Further, we drive to the village of Gruyères and visit the Cheese Factory. Later, we proceed to Bern, the capital of Switzerland. Upon arrival enjoy the walking tour of the city. We pass by Bear Pits, Bern Clock Tower (Zytglogge), Old Town, Einsteinhaus and the Aare River. Later, we proceed to Zurich/Lucerne.

itinerary.title: Mt. Titlis – Engelberg – Lucerne
itinerary.description: Today we proceed to Engelberg for an excursion to Mt. Titlis, Central Switzerland’s highest peak. We take the Titlis Rotair revolving cable car to the summit, where we visit the Ice Grotto, enjoy the Ice Flyer ride and snow sliding (subject to operation), and stroll along the Mt. Titlis Cliff Walk. Later, we proceed to Lucerne. Upon arrival, head for the city tour with photo stops at the Lion Monument and Kappelbrücke Wooden Bridge, the world’s oldest covered wooden bridge spanning the River Reuss. In the evening we enjoy Lake Lucerne Cruise.

itinerary.title: Jungfraujoch – Interlaken
itinerary.description: Today we enjoy a full-day excursion to Jungfraujoch – Top of Europe. We proceed to Grindelwald and board the Eiger Express gondola to Eiger Glacier station. Further, we take a Cogwheel Train to Europe’s highest railway station at 3,454 metres, enjoying spectacular views of the Eiger, Mönch and Jungfrau peaks along the way. Upon arrival we see the breath-taking view of snow-capped mountains, Ice Sculptures, Ice Palace and Sphinx Terrace. Later, we explore Interlaken, a picturesque resort town in the Swiss Alps

itinerary.title: Zurich/Lucerne – Departure
itinerary.description:
Today we visit Lindt Home of Chocolate, where we explore the world of chocolate and visit the world’s largest Lindt Chocolate Shop. Further, we proceed to Rhine Falls at Schaffhausen (Neuhausen), Europe’s most powerful waterfall, and enjoy a boat ride offering spectacular views of the falls. We then drive through Lake Zurich, a popular attraction in the city.
Every wonderful holiday comes to an end, but the memories stay with us!
It’s time to say goodbye to our fellow travellers, taking home beautiful memories, new friendships and stories to share.
Until we meet again on another exciting journey with Veena World, Phir Milenge!

itinerary.title: Drive from Dehradun to Raithal
itinerary.description:
Drive Distance: 183 km; 7-8 hrs Altitude: 5,905 ft On the first day of the Dayara Bugyal trek, we will start our trek from Dehradun to Raithal early in the morning. The scenic drive takes us through the road alongside the Bhagirathi River. We will cross Landour and Uttarkashi as we drive. After a few hours of driving, we will stop at Pahadi Dhaba and enjoy the Grahwali Thali.
Mo riana Top (Tingling Point)
is also a major attraction on this route. We will have clear views of peaks like Bandarpunch, Black Peak, Srikanth and Gangotri Peaks are clearly visible from here.
On clear days, you can even see Chaukhamba or Nanda Devi from here. The drive then takes us towards Chinyalisaur from where we can have a clear view of Tehri Dam reservoir.
And then, our journey towards Uttarkashi begins. In Uttarkashi, take time to visit Kashi Vishwanath temple and purchase any necessary items. Remember, this is the last town where you will have the ATM service, so it is recommended to withdraw the essential cash from here. By the evening time, we will already be reaching Raithal. Tonight we will stay at Raithal enjoying a local meal.

itinerary.title: Trek from Raithal to Gui Campsite
itinerary.description:
Trek Distance & Time: 5 km, 4-5 hours Altitude: 9,630 ft We will start our day with a warm breakfast and then prepare for the trek to Gui. Click the photo on the Dayara Bugyal trek entry point and start towards Gui. In between you will find Nag Devta temple, water point, and a tree dedicated to Naag Devta, where locals and trekkers stick their coins and offer several religious assets.
The
4-5 kilometer trek through lush green forests, which offers a close view of the local flora and fauna. The forest area gets beautiful and colorful during the Spring season. The rhododendron forests are in full bloom during spring offering trekkers a very relaxing journey.
The trail is well-maintained, so there will not be any issues in navigating. After a few hours of trekking, we will finally reach Gui, where we will rest overnight. Upon reaching Gui, enjoy the sunset over Srikanth and Gangotri Peaks.

itinerary.title: Trek from Gui to Dayara Top and Back to Gui
itinerary.description:
Trek Distance: 12 km, 7-8 hours Altitude: 12,000 ft at Dayara Top, and 12,400 ft at Bakariya Top
Today, we will begin our journey from Gui to Dayara Top. The trek spans approximately 12 kilometers (to and fro).
The trail stretches towards Dayara Bugyal after crossing Chilapada. The alpine meadows and the grasslands will welcome you with its beautiful surroundings, which will be very attractive to watch during the daytime.
After a last push, we will finally reach Dayara Top via a steep ascent. From the top, you will experience the 360 views of the peaks like Bandarpunch, Kala Naag, Srikanth, and Gangotri ranges. The whole Dayara Bugyal is visible from Dayara top. Additionally, if time permits, explore the meadow further to Bakariya Top, the highest point of Dayara. From here, the view is even more incredible.
Dayara looks different in every season. During spring, summer, and monsoon, the bugyal gets covered with grass and wildflowers. Huge herds of sheep can be seen from the end of June through the monsoon. In autumn, the bugyal turns an orangish color, and during winter, snow covers the entire landscape, making it a perfect place for snow trekking and skiing.
We will spend a few hours exploring the meadow and then return to Gui Campsite in the evening.

itinerary.title: Trek from Gui to Raithal and Back to Dehradun
itinerary.description:
Trek distance & Time: 5 km, 2-3 hrs Altitude: 5,905 ft Today, we will bid farewell to Gui and then return to Raithal. We will descend through the 5 kilometer trail at around 2 to 3 hours of descent.
We will retrace the trails through forest and then reach Raithal crossing the same path we traversed before. After reaching Raithal, rest a bit and we will then drive back to Dehradun, which takes around 6 to 7 hours.
Note | Return Journey: Plan your return journey after 9 PM. Sometimes due to traffic, we can get late, that’s why it’s advisable to have your return tickets booked after 9 PM
Dayara Bugyal Trek Package

itinerary.title: Drive from Dehradun to Ranachatti
itinerary.description:
Drive Distance: 175 km; 5-6 hrs Altitude Gain:
666 m (2,186 ft) to 2,086 m (6,844 ft)
On day 1, you will be picked up from your hotel in Dehradun for a 5 to 7-hour drive to Ranachatti. The ride will wind through the Garhwal foothills, and you will pass through the famous hill station, Mussoorie. You will pass through dense pine and oak forests, and deep valleys with terraced agricultural fields on NH 507.
Further, on NH 134, you will follow the route towards Yamunotri. On a clear day, you can catch a glimpse of the Banderpunch massif. Gradually, you will see Dinnala Bugyala from a distance, with its two pointy tops (Jhandi Top and Ancha Top). After reaching the small village of Ranachatti, you will check in at a local homestay. If time permits, you can also visit the Someshwar Mahadev Temple, dedicated to Someshwar Devta (a form of Shiva). This will also help you acclimatise to the trek.

itinerary.title: Trek from Ranachatti to Bamsingh
itinerary.description:
Trek Distance & Time: 4 km, 3-4 hours Altitude Gain: 2,134 m (7,000 ft) to 2,804 m (9,200 ft)
We will start our trek today from Ranachatti Village after having a warm breakfast. Initially, the trail will take you through the terraced agricultural mountains. Gradually, you will leave the village settlement behind and enter into sparse patches of forests. Do not forget to refill your bottle at various water points (Chhanis or shepherd huts) on the way.
After the second chhani, around the 1.5 km mark, the trail becomes steeper and rockier. You will be climbing a 300-meter section of rocky terrain, so be mindful of your stance. On your left, you will see Banderpuch stand tall among the blanket of clouds. Below, you will see the Yamuna River cutting through the valley, making it a beautiful landscape. Climbing further, you will again notice a slight elevation gain through the 50+ years old oak trees.
After 2 km of hard trek, following a forest clearing, you will reach Ganga Ram Ji’s Chhani, a semi-permanent shepherd’s hut. This serves as the halfway point of today’s trek. Here, you can catch your breath by resting and refilling water bottles if needed.
From here, you will see an almost flat terrain for the next 600 m. Climbing through this, you will reach the “Coin Tree” (named so because trekkers historically left coins at its base for good luck). Here, you will see the first clear visuals of Dinnala Bugyal, with Ancha Top to the left. Further, the trail gains elevation again, and you will walk for 200 m along the side of a spur. Finally, you will notice the gradient becomes slightly easier, leading you towards a large clearing. Crossing this section for the next 30 to 40 minutes, you will arrive at Bamsingh Campsite, your stop for the night. Set up your tents, have a warm meal, and enjoy the peaceful night in the mountains.

itinerary.title: Trek from Bamsingh to Dinnala Camp
itinerary.description:
Trek Distance: 5 km, 4 hours Altitude
Gain: 2,086 m (6,844 ft) to 3,277 m (10,750 ft)
We will start early today after having our breakfast. Begin by taking the descent towards the forest for the next 150 m. You will gradually enter a small valley. This descent is steep and becomes very slippery during the monsoon months. The trail winds through a dense forest, and after crossing about 1 km, you will enter a small clearing where you can rest briefly.
Further, take the right trail and descend through the forest to arrive to reach a small stream. This is the Daloti Gad, which flows into the Yamuna River. This water is drinkable after filtering. From here, the path will transition into a thinner forest. You will take on a steep section for the next 1 hour of the climb.
After 1 km of difficult climbing, the gradient will become slightly flat. You will cross a small stream to reach an open clearing, known as Sannodi. This indicates that you have covered half of the distance for the day. halfway point for the day. Relax and refill your bottles here.
You will notice that the forests are less dense from Sannodi onwards. You will start getting clearer views of the Banderpunch mountain towards your south. Notice the Swargarohini massif standing tall, and Kedarkantha Peak and Phulara Ridge shining in the daylight towards your left.Ascending gradually, the treeline will eventually fade, giving way to an alpine meadow. Walking 500 m on this alpine terrain, you will pass a chhani. Here at Dinnala Bugyal, you will find many camping stops near various water streams. Choose a suitable space to set up your camp for the night. You will be surrounded by a panorama of mountains. Enjoy the views and retire for the night.

itinerary.title: Trek from Dinnala Bugyal to Ancha Camp via Ancha Top
itinerary.description:
Trek distance & Time: 8 km, 7-8 hrs Altitude
Gain: 3,277 m (10,750 ft) to 3,818 m (12,525 ft, summit) and descent to 3,475 m (11,400 ft at Aancha Camp)
Today, you will finally get to see the Ancha top. Wake up early to enjoy the surreal sunrise at the Dinnala Bugyal. After having a warm meal and a short trek briefing, begin by gradually ascending through the Rhododendron shrubs in the meadow. After about 600m of climbing, take on a rocky gully and then turn right.
Once you have trekked for the first 1.5 km, you will encounter the first of the three glacial lakes on the trek. If the day is less cloudy/foggy, you may see Swargrohini peak reflected in its icy cold waters. From here, take the left trail and hike for around 1 km to reach two more glacial lakes amidst the open meadow. Explore this photogenic region for the next 30 minutes and relax.
Return to the first lake, and take the right trail, and you will gradually catch glimpses of the Gangotri and Yamunotri ranges. These peaks include Gangotri III, Jogin Peak, Kedarnath, and Jaonli.
Towards the right, you can also catch the views of vast alpine meadows, Dayara, and Gidara.
Take the trail towards a mountain ridge and follow the path to view the gigantic peaks up close. The ascent will feel a bit difficult as you will be crossing the narrow trails. After 2 km, you will finally arrive at the Ancha Top summit. The trail ends here, so catch a breath and enjoy the expansive views of some of the greatest peaks of the Garhwal Himalayas. You will also see peaks like Srikantha, Jogin Peak, and Jaonli, and the beauty of the Yamuna Valley stretching across the landscape.
After taking pictures and absorbing the ethereal views at the summit, start your descent back towards the first lake. Instead of going back to our Dinnala Bugyal campsite, we will trek towards its other end. You will cross a small stream called Jajar Gad. On the far edge, you will arrive at another vast meadow, known as the Ancha Camp.
Choose a suitable sit

itinerary.title: Trek from Aancha Camp to Ranachatti
itinerary.description:
Trek distance & Time: 6 km, 5-6 hrs Altitude
Loss: 3,475 m (11,400 ft) to 2,086 m (6,844 ft)
Wake up to the beautiful views at the campsite. Today, we will descend back to the base camp of the Ancha Top trek. After having your breakfast, move gradually through the open meadows. As you lose altitude, you will be surrounded by rhododendron shrubs. In spring, these shrubs are full of flowers, coloured in light pink and red.
The distant views of Banderpunch will keep you company throughout your descent. Here, the terrain is easy on the knees. However, after covering a patch of Pine and Birch trees, you will experience a sharp descent. The forest area will become denser with each progressive step.
After about 1.5 km, you will come across a small clearing, followed by an oak forest. After another km, you will arrive at another clearing, known as Pokhar Thattar. Gradually, descending for the next 2 km, you arrive at Ganga Ram Ji’s Chhani again (you passed this ascending on Day 2). Refill your water bottles here.
Another 2 km will give way to a thinner forest area transitioning to terraced farmlands. This marks your entry into the Ranachatti Village. The final section of the descent is easier as the trail becomes almost flat. You will arrive at your homestay, where you can rest, recover, and retire for the night.

itinerary.title: Drive to Dehradun from Ranachatti
itinerary.description:
Dive distance & Time: 160 km, 5-6 hrs Day 6 marks the last day of your Ancha Top trek. Have your breakfast early to leave for Dehradun. You can also visit the Someshwar Mahadev temple today, if you could not visit on Day 1.
Driving back to Dehradun, the entire route will feel nostalgic. Do not forget to take pit stops and admire the beauty of the Garhwal Himalayas on your way. If you have a few extra days in your itinerary, you can also visit Mussorie. However, the long trek may cause fatigue, so it is best to relax in Dehradun on this day.
Ancha Top Trek Package

itinerary.title: Drive from Rishikesh to Lohajung
itinerary.description:
Drive Distance: 246 km Drive Time: 7-8 hrs Altitude: 7,600 ft at Lohajung
Highlights: Scenic drive through Devprayag, Rudraprayag, Karnaprayag, and Nandaprayag
Our journey will begin from the Yoga Capital of the world – Rishikesh; pickup is included in our Brahmatal package. Reach Natraj Square in the early morning so that we can cover the distance and have ample time for you to rest and recharge for the trek on day 2.
The drive would be filled with the beautiful scenery of mountains, hills, colorful homes and meandering roads. On our way, we will cross 3
Prayags, which means the confluence of 2 rivers. First, we will encounter Devprayag, the last Prayag, where river Alaknanda meets river Bhagirathi to form the holy river Ganga. Then, we cross Rudraprayag, where Alaknanda joins the Mandakini River. The last prayag we encounter is Karnaprayag, where Alaknanda meets Pindarganga.
At Devprayag, you can clearly see Alaknanda’s greenish-blue water and Bhagirathi’s brownish water mixing; it is a site to behold.
We will reach Lohajung by evening, and after that, you’ll be free to explore the surroundings.
After a delicious dinner, we will rest for the night and charge up for the trek the next day.

itinerary.title: Trek from Lohajung to Bekaltal
itinerary.description:
Trek Distance & Time: 6 km, 4-5 hours Altitude: 9,875 ft Today marks the beginning of our trek; after an energy-packed breakfast, we will start walking going through the hustle of the Lohajung Market area towards Bekaltal.
As we walk deeper, the terrain will change into a rocky and slightly steep climb, testing your fitness level. After a short distance, you will come across Mandoli village on your left side.
After walking for 1.5 – 2 km, you can spot Gwaldam Ranges, on your right, which is situated in Gwaldam village, between the Kumaon and Garhwal regions of the state.
Further in the trek, you will find tatches and small water streams made up of Kali and Pindari rivers, and later, you can spot Kali Valley, the confluence of these two rivers as well. After a while, you will reach Khop Tal or Khopariya Tal, a small seasonal lake; after a quick rest, proceed again, as Bekal Tal is not far away.
After a short walk, you will reach Bekal Tal, our first campsite. This is a beautiful, entire lake dedicated to Nag Devta; you can also spot a stone-arranged temple of Nag Devta near the lake.
We will spend the night here under sparkling stars beside this peaceful lake.

itinerary.title: Trek from Bekaltal to Brahmatal via Jhandi Top
itinerary.description:
Trek Distance: 8 km, 7-8 hours Altitude Gain: 11,150 ft Be ready for a day filled with long hours of hike to reach the Brahmatal, the 2nd most anticipated part of the trek, 1st being the summit of Brahmatal.
After a steep hike of 1 km, you will reach Telandi Top; the area resembles a bugyal, plain grassland type. From this vantage point, you can spot Trishul I & II on your left and peaks like Devtholi Mrigthuni on the right.
After walking 7 kilometres, with short breaks in between, we will reach Jhandi Top, our highest ridge point. Jhandi Top is known as it because you will find a Mahadev Temple here with a huge Trishul here (Trident-like) with, a tied Damroo (Power Drum), and many flags.
From this point, many peaks that were far away now look closer, like Nanda Ghunti, Bethartoli, Trishul (I & II), Mrigthuni, Devtoli, and Maiktoli.
Brahmatal is situated after a short descent of 1.5 km from Jhandi Top at an elevation of 10,190 ft. Be more cautious, as the trail down is filled with rocks. The long hours will feel all worth it once you reach Brahmatal; the beauty and serenity will leave you in awe.
No wonder it is believed that Lord Brahma, the creator, chose to meditate on this site for a while as it provides the perfect place for it.
Reflect back on life, rejuvenate beside the lake, and rest for the night after a well-deserving hot dinner.

itinerary.title: Trek from Brahmatal to Summit & Back to Brahmatal
itinerary.description:
Total Trek distance & Time: 6 km, 4 hrs Altitude Gain: 12,500 ft Today, we will cover the most anticipated trek part, the Summit Top. Though the climb is technical, it is steep, and during winter, snow takes the difficulty a level up.
The way to the summit is through ridge walking via two ridges, though it is not a narrow walk.
The first ridge will be inclined as we go upwards, and the second one open up to an open space at the top. From the top, you can spot all the peaks mentioned before, like Mt. Nanda Ghunti and Trishul, but a closer look just hits differently. The summit provides you with perfect and closer views of the Himalayan ranges.

itinerary.title: Trek from Brahmatal to Lohajung
itinerary.description:
Total Trek distance & Time: 11 km, 7-8 hrs Altitude Gain: 12,500 ft Today marks our trek’s last descent as we return to Lohajung. The trek distance is long, and we will cover it via the same route we came from.
After a healthy breakfast, we start our descent early in the morning so that we can reach Lohajung in the evening. Don’t miss out on the beautiful sunset, reflecting the orangish glow of the Himalayas.
Sign off after a hot dinner and a stroll through the town.

itinerary.title: Drive to Lohajung to Rishikesh
itinerary.description:
Drive Distance & Time: 246 Km, 7-8 hrs After breakfast, we begin our return journey from Lohajung to Rishikesh, covering around 246 km. As the mountain roads wind down through the valleys of Uttarakhand, the towering Himalayan peaks slowly disappear from view, leaving behind unforgettable memories of snow trails, frozen lakes, and summit views.
The drive back feels reflective a quiet time to relive the highlights of the trek and the sense of achievement from standing at Brahmatal Top. By evening, we reach Rishikesh, marking the end of a beautiful Himalayan adventure.
Brahmatal Trek Package

itinerary.title: Dehradun to Pantwari via Mussoorie and Trek to Kathian Campsite
itinerary.description:
Drive Distance & Time: 104 km; 3-4 hours Trek Distance
& Time: 5 km; 2-3 hours Altitude: 6,400 ft Today’s Difficulty: Easy
Highlights: A scenic drive via Mussoorie, and Pantwari Village
Day 1 of the Nag Tibba Trek will begin in Dehradun as our base village Pantwari is 104 km away. Dehradun to Pantwari road is well-paved and cemented, you will arrive in Pantwari after 3-4 hours. En route, you will encounter markable points like Kempty Fall and Nainbagh. On Gradually ascending from Dehradun to Pantwari Road, you will observe a slow shift in development. The more you move towards Nag Tibba, the more interior places you will get to look at.
Kempty Fall
And with the excitement of Pre-Adventure, as soon as you reach Pantwari, the Nag Tibba trek will begin.
When you head from Pantwari to Nag Tibba, the best trek views will start coming in front of your eyes. Initially, you might feel a bit nervous and out of place, but as soon as your body warms up within 15 minutes of trekking, the excitement of being at Nag Tibba summit and motivation will step up.
After trekking for 2 Km, when you look back, the first thing you will see is the beautiful Pantwari Village amid green and comparatively elevated areas. Enjoying these beautiful, rare views of Uttarakhand, as you proceed, you will see a small cemented water reservoir alongside the trail. In this reservoir, a pipe flows out the fresh water. Beyond this point, there will be no such water stream, so you must fill your water bottle for the further trek.
Pantwari Village
Thereafter, passing through the grasslands and forests, you will trek for about 1.5 Km, and reach your tonight’s base camp at the Kathian Campsite, which also known as Goat Village. In this region, there is a plain Plateau, which is a kind of elevated land on which high-scale camping is possible. And so there are multiple camps in this location. Most likely, you will reach there during sunset, so do not miss this precious chance to watch the sunset from here.
Tonig

itinerary.title: Kathian Campsite to Nag Tibba Summit and return to Dehradun
itinerary.description:
Trek Distance & Time: 13 km; 6-7 hours Altitude: 9,100 ft Drive: 104 km; 3-4 hours On Day 2 of the Nag Tibba trek, if you want to reach the Nag Tibba summit during sunrise, then you must leave the Goat Village/Kathian Campsite before 3 hours of the predicted sunrise time. Ideally, you should wake up at 2:30 am, and get freshen up for the trek. To overcome sleepiness, you can drink tea or coffee before beginning the trek. Then, with the Trekking guide, you should leave the Goat Village Campsite at 3 am and just follow your guide’s instructions. You must wear the headtorch on this trek for better visibility in the early dark hours.
On the way to Nag Tibba Summit
Passing from the curvy, zig zag, ascent and descent trail, you will reach your destination, Nag Tibba Summit, in 2 to 3 hours. The beauty of sunrise at this point of 3022 m altitude is truly beautiful and something very precious but unexplainable. There, you’ll see a Trishul embedded at the final point of Nag Tibba Summit, and it looks so enchanting to see the Trishul of Lord Shiva and the rising sun over the horizon.
Besides this, if you have no desire to watch the sunrise from the summit, then you can start trekking at 6 am. You will reach the summit by 9 am, and then the time and moment at Nag Tibba summit will be yours. From this Nag Tibba summit point, you will see many famous peaks like Kalanaag, Swargrohini, Bandarpoonch, also Doon Valley.
Garhwal Himalayas from Nag Tibba
After the Nag Tibba Summit climax experience, we will start descending for the Pantwari. Passing from forests of Rhododendrons, Oak, and Sal trees, you will reach the Nag Tibba temple. This is the main temple dedicated to Nag Devta, which is why this summit is known as Nag Tibba. Here, you can spend 15 to 20 minutes.
After a short break, we will resume trekking down and reach the Pantwari after about 4 hours. From Pantwari to Dehradun, there is a motorable road, so you can return to Dehradun by taxi or two-wheeler or choose to travel b

itinerary.title: Dehradun to Sankri Drive
itinerary.description:
Drive Distance: 190 km; 9-10 hrs Altitude: 6,400 ft at Sankri
The pickup is included in our Kedarkantha trek package, so you just have to reach Dehradun. For the convenience of everyone coming through different modes of transport, the pickup point is Prince Chowk.
As the journey is long for Sankri, we will start our day early in the morning while enjoying the scenic drive. On our way, we will cross famous hill stations like Mussoorie, and from there, the Yamuna River will accompany us to Naugaon. Don’t worry, another ethereal beauty River Tons, will join us from Mori to all the way till Sankri.
Sankri is a beautiful village surrounded by Himalayas and forest, creating a picture-perfect atmosphere. The village serves as a base for various other treks like Har Ki Dun, Ruinsara Tal, Bali Pass, etc. After reaching Sankri by the evening, you are free to explore.
We will end our day with a hot dinner and rest well for tomorrow.

itinerary.title: Trek from
itinerary.description:
Sankri to near Juda Ka Talab Campsite
Trek Distance & Time: 4 km, 3-4 hours Altitude: 9,100 ft at Juda ka Talab
Today marks the starting day of our trek as we will leave our cozy beds and head out for our first campsite – Juda ka Talab via Saud. After a delicious breakfast, we will start our ascend. The hike will be covered in snow, greenery, and different colours, depending on your chosen time of the year.
Juda ka Talab is a high-altitude lake surrounded by a thick forest of oaks, maple and pine. The lake is said to have formed when Lord Shiva opened a strand of hair from his bun, and water droplets fell from it, creating this lake. There are several other interesting tales related to this beautiful lake, but the fact that it is a lovely lake remains true.
We will finish off our day with a hot dinner while sharing stories and rest for the night.

itinerary.title: Trek from Juda Ka Talab to Kedarkantha Base Camp
itinerary.description:
Trek Distance: 4 km, 2-3 hours Altitude: 11,250 ft at Kedarkantha Basecamp
The next day, wake up early to enjoy the glow of sunrise and freshen up for the day. Today, we will head for Kedarkantha Base Camp & closer to the summit.
The hike won’t be tiring, but it is not a cakewalk. Giant trees and the Himalayas will accompany you while motivating you to be strong. After walking through the dense forest, the trail will open to an open field, which will be our campsite.
We will have our dinner early and sleep because the next day, we have to wake up at 3 am to chase the sunrise on the peak.

itinerary.title: Trek from Kedarkantha Base Camp to Peak (Summit Climb) & Descend back to Juda Ka Talab
itinerary.description:
Trek distance & Time: 12 km, 7-8 hrs Max Altitude: 12,500 ft at Kedarkantha Peak
As mentioned earlier, we will begin our day early at 3 am and get ready for the most exciting part of the trek – Summit Climb. Whichever season you choose, it will still be a bit cold in the morning, even in summer or spring, so pack your clothes accordingly. During winters, the weather will be harsher, and the snow will reach your knees; it is advised that you rent proper gear and equipment like crampons and gaiters.
After hiking for around 4 km with a final inclination climb of 40° to 60°, you will finally reach the summit. Seek blessing from the small Kedarkantha temple made of stone arrangement of Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati. Relish in the most beautiful sunrise from a Himalayan Mountain Peak and discover yourself.
From the summit, enjoy the 360° views of the Himalayas and try to identify peaks like Swargrohini 1,2,3, Bandarpunch & Kalanag. You can also see Har Ki Dun and Rupin Valley from the top.
We do believe in living in the moment, but capturing them to preserve the memories forever is also essential. After clicking on many photos and videos, we will start our descent.
We will head for our favourite Juda ka Talab and spend another beautiful night under twinkling stars after a hot & delicious supper.

itinerary.title: Trek from Juda ka Talab to Sankri and then drive to Dehradun
itinerary.description:
Trek distance & Time: 4 km, 3 hs | Drive: 185 km; 9-10 hrs After the well-deserved night’s rest and breakfast, we will start our final block of descent and head back to Sankri. From Sankri, we will bid final goodbye to the mountains with a promise to return back soon and leave for Dehradun via the same route we came.
Kedarkantha Trek Package (Dehradun to Dehradun)

itinerary.title: Drive from Rishikesh to Tugasi
itinerary.description:
Drive Distance: 265 km Drive Time: 10-11 hours Altitude: 6,150 ft Highlights: A scenic drive with a view of the Uttarakhand Himalayas
Tugasi is 260 km away from Rishikesh, which takes around 10-11 hours to reach. We will start our journey early in the morning to cover the distance in daylight and have ample time to acclimatise to higher altitudes.
The road journey will be filled with incredible Himalayan mountain views, rivers and their confluence, which, in Sanskrit, is called “Prayag”. During our drive, we will encounter 4 out of 5 prayags.
First, we will come across “Devprayag” (the last one), where the Alaknanda River meets the Bhagirathi to form the holy river Ganga. Next, we will see Rudraprayag (4th), where Alaknanda meets the Mandakini River. At Karnaprayag (3rd), Alaknanda meets the Pindar River. Lastly, at Nandprayag(2nd), Alaknanda meets the Nandakini River.
We will spend the night at Joshimath and get recharged for the trek the next day.
Tip – It is advised that trekkers reach Rishikesh on Day 0, which is the day prior, to avoid delays. The bonus point is that by reaching Day 0, you can take a short tour of Rishikesh. Another option is to experience thrilling water activities available, like river rafting in Rishikesh.

itinerary.title: Tugasi Village to Gulling Top
itinerary.description:
Trek Distance: 5 km Trek Time: 2-3 hours Altitude Gain: 2,850 ft ↗
Altitude: 9600 ft The trail will be a bit steep from the beginning as we hike up and a few abrupt “T” turns will add fun to the twisting ways. The route towards Gulling is filled with trees of oaks, maple, pine, and walnuts, giving you a chance to enjoy fresh nuts right off the tree. The gulling top is a vast open field providing beautiful views of various snow-covered mountain peaks like Mt. Dronagiri.
Look out for the sparkling stream of Dhauli Ganga in the nearby chasm and Vishnugad Tapovan Power Station on the way. We will reach the upper Tugasi region via Kharchi village and, after another short hike, be welcomed by a calm forest and colourful bed of flowers at Gulling Top, given the season you decide to trek.
After our hike for the day, we will stretch and enjoy a delicious hot dinner.

itinerary.title: Trek from Gulling to Khullara Top
itinerary.description:
Trek Distance: 5 km Trek Time: 4-5 hours Altitude Gain: 1,400 ft ↗
Altitude: 11,000 ft After a delicious breakfast, we will head for Khullara Top. The ascent climb of 3.5 km is a little bit steep but after yesterday’s hike, you will feel more comfortable and confident.
The whole trail will go through the deep forest of Oak, Thunder, and Cedars. Throughout the hike, Mt. Dronagiri will follow you along other peaks. You will find small clear water streams here for drinking water.
Khullara Top provides a grand space for camping, like a small bugyal, with the Himalayan Peaks as a one-of-a-kind backdrop in any real-life scenery.

itinerary.title: Trek from Khullara to Kuari Pass Back to Khullara
itinerary.description:
Trek Distance: 5 km (to & fro)
Trek Time: 7-8 hours Altitude Gain: 1,500 ft ↗
Altitude: ~12,516 ft We will cover the most awaited part of the trek today, which is the summit of Kuari Top and Kuari Pass. Both Kuari Top and Kuari Pass are at the same altitude at a short distance between them.
The trek today will be long but worth every step. After a steep climb of 1.5 km, you’ll walk on a ridge famously known as “Lord Curzon Trail”. Our trek will continue on this ridge and inclines, finally leading to Kuari Top. From here, you can clearly see many peaks like Dronagiri, Hathi Parvat, Chaukhamba, Neekanth, and so on.
After a short descent from the top and a few kms, you’ll reach Kuari Pass. The trail remains the same for both Kuari Top and Kuari Pass, as both are at the same altitude.
You will see the trail covered in thick sheets of snow during winter, with enchanting scenery of the surroundings. Be prepared with warm layers of clothing and all the necessary items to enjoy the snow the best.
We will retrace back to our campsite – Khullara, and rest well after today’s moderate hike.

itinerary.title: Trek from Khullara to Tugasi
itinerary.description:
Trek Distance: 12 km Trek Time: 5-6 hours After taking a well-deserved rest, we will start our descent back to Tugasi via the same route, enjoying everything all over again. It will take us around 5-6 hours to reach back.
Upon reaching back, you are free to take a stroll through the village or rest and relax your muscles.

itinerary.title: Drive back from Tugasi to Rishikesh
itinerary.description:
This is the final day of the trek, with only a drive of around 9–10 hours. We are expected to reach Rishikesh by 8-9 p.m., although this may vary depending on the road conditions along the route.
Kuari Pass Trek Package

itinerary.title: Drive from Manali to Jobra and Trek to Chika
itinerary.description:
Pick Up & Drive: From Manali 16 km drive, 1-2 hours Trekking Distance &
Duration: 3 km, 2 hours Altitude Gain: From Manali (2,100 m / 6,400 ft) to Jobra(3,000 m / 9,800 ft):
3,400 ft/ 1,036 m ↗ | Jobra to Chika (3,100 m / 10,100 ft):
300 ft/ 91 m ↗
Difficulty Grade of The Day: Easy | Mostly flat with mild uphill Highlight/s of the Day: Scenic drive through Manali | A short trek amidst the forest of pine, deodar, maple etc.
To begin our trek, you must first reach Manali, a famous city in the Kullu district Himachal Pradesh. Manali is known for its lush forests, snow-capped mountain peaks and ancient trade routes that cross through various passes like Rohtang and Baralacha.
After reaching Jobra, we will start our trek marking the official beginning of our trek. The trail will be filled with tiny rocks, small streams, and tall trees of Deodar, maple, pine, etc. Once we hit the trail, it won’t take long before you come across a small shop offering eatables and other essential items. By just walking a few more metres you will be greeted by the sight of the Rani Nallah, a charming stream winding its way through a lush meadow. You will see many cattle like sheep, calves, cows grazing in these verdant meadows.
Keep walking along the left side of the stream; it will be filled with boulders and rock, but it will not be too difficult to walk on. Whereas, on the right side you will see small trees of rhododendrons and birch. While there are several routes, this is the best way to climb over a hill and descend into the vast, open expanse of meadows where Chika lies.
Chika is the most favourable campsite for night stay, providing a constant water source, the Rani Nallah stream encircled by the Pir Panjal mountain range.
A little far on the right of Chika campsite, you will see many waterfalls marking another campsite, Jwara. After a light snack and dinner, we will rest for the day.

itinerary.title: Trek from Chika to Balu ka Ghera
itinerary.description:
Trekking Distance &
Duration: 9 km, 6-7 hours Altitude Gain: Chika to Balu ka Ghera (3,800 m/ 12,400 ft):
2,300 ft/ 701m
↗
Difficulty Grade of the Day: First half – Moderate/Steep Ascent
Highlight/s of The Day: Rani Nallah river crossing Today, we will start our trek early by having breakfast at 8 am and then start the hike. Our campsite for today, Balu ka Ghera literally translates into “Land of Sand” or “Bed of Sand.” The site is formed over the years when the river carries the debris after a landslide and deposits it here.
The trail today will be of rough gradient filled with big boulders that are spaced far from each other, making the jump between them difficult. Instead, we will hike cautiously while indulging in the nature as our path is also steep today.
After walking for a while, be prepared to feel the cold water of the gushing stream as you have to cross the stream of Rani Nallah stream. Our trek leader will first cross the stream to check for any danger and then you all will follow.
Crossing the chilling stream will refresh you and fill you up with the new enthusiasm. For some time the rough terrain will continue and after a while the flat surface of Jwara will begin. On your way you will find many colourful flowers on the trail like marigold, blue poppies, and a bunch of other cluster of flowers in red, pink, orange, etc. amidst tall snow-covered Himalayan peaks creating a postcard perfect image.
After hiking for another 3-4 km, the terrain gradient will slowly start to change into a land covered in sand and other debris, which the river carried over here and created this beautiful site, now our perfect campsite of Balu ka Ghera.

itinerary.title: Trek from Balu ka Ghera to Shea Goru by crossing Hampta Pass
itinerary.description:
Trekking Distance &
Duration: 9 km, 8-9 hours Altitude Gain: Balu ka Ghera to Hampta Pass (14,100 ft/ 4,300 m):
1,700 ft ↗
Altitude Loss: Hampta Pass to to Shea Goru (12,900 ft/ 3,900 m):
1,200 ft ↙
Difficulty Grade of the Day: Moderate to Difficult | The ascent of Hampta Pass is steep and the descent from there is equally challenging Highlight/s of the Day: Rocky Terrain | Crossing the Hampta Pass | Changing terrains from vibrant meadows of Kullu to rocky & cold desert of Lahual, Spiti Valley.
Today’s trek is an exciting mix of challenges and rewards. The trek can be divided into two parts, first, you’ll tackle the hike and the mountain climb to Hampta Pass, a moderate yet steady ascent. Then comes the steep descent to Shea Goru, which requires careful footing, especially if snow’s there.
Your goal? Reach the pass by lunchtime, take a well-deserved break, soak in the views, and then start your way down to Shea Goru campsite.
We will start our day early, given our goal for today. After having a delicious breakfast, we will walk along the river. If you are trekking in summer, then you’ll be surprised by the delightful flowers varying in colours beside the riverbank, resembling the “Valley of Flowers”. For an hour you will continue on this gentle and beautiful trail.
Note: Remember to fill your water bottles here and carry at least two bottles of 1 litre each with you as the next water source in quite far from here.
But soon you will be above it and the terrain will change into a more tricky and rocky grade. The trail will not be marked well from here, so hike accordingly, and be with your group or you might get lost.
After passing a rocky section, the climb for your first incline will begin. It will take around 30 minutes to cross and then you’ll reach a plateau like space – a perfect spot to catch your breath. If you are trekking in early season, then you will witness this entire stretch blanketed in snow, giving out Narania vibes.
After the short break, the next cl

itinerary.title: Trek from Shea Goru to Chatru and Drive to Chandra Tal & Return to Chatru
itinerary.description:
Trekking Distance &
Duration: 7 km, 5 hours Drive: 50 km, 3-4 hours (one way)
Altitude Loss: Shea Goru to Chatru (3,350 m/ 11,900 ft):
1,000 ft/ 304 m ↙
Altitude Gain: Chatru to Chandratal Lake (4,300 m/ 14,100 ft):
2,200 ft/ 670.5 m ↗
Difficulty Grade of The Day: Easy
Highlights of the Day: Witnessing the infamous Chandra Taal, a high-altitude lake located in the Spiti Valley
Today marks another important day in our trek as we will descend down and drive to the Chandra Tal. As we have to cover the long distance of a drive twice a day, it is advised to start your day early in the morning so that you reach Chandratal in the morning itself or noon.
The downward hike today will be of easy grade of 7 kms which can easily be covered in 4-5 hours. Though due to different weather conditions, you may find some patches muddy and sloshy, so be careful while descending.
The drive will be filled with a bumpy road and coiling roads with an altitude gain. Be prepared by hydrating yourself, and if in case of AMS (Acute Mountain Sickness) take the necessary medicine like avomine.
After the drive, lay your eyes on the majestic yet graceful destinatoin-
Chandra Taal.
The crescent moon shaped lake lies in the watershed of the Chandra river in Lahaul Valley. Even in the rugged terrain, the lake maintains the flora and fauna nearby. You may spot fauna like blue sheep, Himalayan Ibex, Chukor, red fox, etc, and in the summer season you might spot a migratory species like Ruddy Shelduck.
After spending soaking in the beauty of the lake, we will head back to Chatru and rest for the night.
Interesting Facts: Chandratal was designated as a Ramsar Site in 2005. It is a list of important wetlands across the globe.
Chaturu village marks the intersection of 3 major pass roads –
Rohtang, Spiti and Hampta. Making it an extraordinary place to be at.

itinerary.title: Chataru to Manali Drive
itinerary.description:
Drive: 83 km, 2-3 hours Altitude Loss: 5500 ft/ 1676m↙
Highlight/s of the Day: A picturesque drive from Chatru to Manali via Rohtang Pass
Today marks the final drive of our trek, and our journey back to Manali will pass through Rohtang Pass. We will drop you off at Manali Mall Road, leaving you with amazing memories and thrilling stories to share. The rest of the day is yours to explore the charming town of Manali, head back to your hometown, or continue your journey to the next destination in the Indian Himalayas.
Hampta Pass Trek Package

Drive Distance: 76 km; 3-4 hrs The journey begins early from Rishikesh. Starting early helps avoid traffic and allows you to enjoy the drive. The route moves through Tehri Garhwal, passing towns like Chamba and skirting the edges of Tehri Lake.
We will have our night stay in Tehri.

itinerary.title: Tehri to Khait Parvat and Back to Rishikesh
itinerary.description:
Drive Distance: 60 Km (Tehri to Musankiri) + 75 km (Rishikesh Return)
Trek Distance: 10 km (Both Sides)
The trek starts after breakfast. After crossing the Tehri Dam and entering the Bhilangana Valley, the road becomes quieter. The final stretch passes through narrow village roads.
Musankiri Village is a small and peaceful settlement where life moves slowly. The trail gradually climbs through That village with pine and deodar forests. The path is mostly clear, though some sections are slightly steep for short distances.
It usually takes 1.5 to 2 hours to reach the main open area of Khait Parvat. As you gain height, views of the Bhagirathi Valley start opening up.
At the top, there is an open patch where people usually stop and rest. Locals often share stories related to fairies and Jeetu Bagdwal at this spot. Many trekkers prefer to sit quietly here for some time before heading back.
After spending time at the top, the group descends the same route and starts the return journey to Rishikesh.

itinerary.description:
Arrival at Guwahati Airport, upon arrival transfer to the hotel and check in. Later, visit the famous Kamakhya Temple premises (Garbh Grah darshan not included), one of the largest and most sacred Shakti shrines in the country. Perched atop the Nilachal Hills, the temple is an important pilgrimage centre for tantric worshippers and Hinduism alike. If time permits, also visit the Assam State Museum. Begin your memorable journey with the WOW Club, known for creating safe women group tours and unique women travel experiences across India and beyond. Dinner and overnight stay in Guwahati.
Bougainvillea Retreat & Spa or similar (4)*

itinerary.title: Guwahati - Kohima
itinerary.description:
After an early breakfast, check out and transfer to Guwahati Airport to board a flight to Dimapur (at extra cost). Upon arrival at Dimapur Airport, proceed by road to Kohima (78 kms / approx. 3 hours). Kohima, the capital of Nagaland, is one of the most scenic and culturally rich destinations in Northeast India. Surrounded by lush hills and untouched landscapes, it offers an ideal blend of nature, history, and local traditions. On arrival, check into the hotel and relax. This journey is perfect for women travel together experiences, where travellers can connect, explore, and create life-long friendships through travel. Overnight stay in Kohima.
Hotel Cimorb or similar (3)*

itinerary.title: Hornbill Festival at Kisama Village
itinerary.description:
After breakfast today you will drive to Kisama Heritage village (12.2 Km / 1hr) to witness the vibrant dances and performances at the Hornbill Festival. This festival of festival, exhibits the living culture of sixteen Naga tribes , allowing you a glimpse of their colourful way of life. The exotic headgears and ivory armlets are other famous traditional things of Nagas which steal the show. In the evening return to the hotel and enjoy your dinner. Overnight stay in Kohima.
Hotel Cimorb or similar (3)*

itinerary.title: Excursion to Khonoma
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, visit the World War II Cemetery, a solemn memorial to the 1944 Battle of Kohima. Continue to Khonoma (35 km / 1.5 hrs), India’s first green village, known for its terraced fields, eco-conscious practices, and the vibrant culture of the Angami tribe. Walk through the village, meet locals, and admire the artistry of skilled basket and shawl weavers. Later enjoy other day at Hornbill festival , return to hotel and enjoy your dinner. Overnight stay in Kohima.
Hotel Cimorb or similar (3)*

itinerary.title: Drive from Kohima to Dimapur
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out and drive to Dimapur. Upon arrival, check in to the hotel and unwind after the journey. In the evening, explore the nearby local markets for some last-minute shopping and pick up traditional handicrafts and local specialties to take back home. Spend the rest of the evening relaxing and enjoying the resort facilities. As part of the trusted WOW women travel community, discover unusual travel destinations worldwide. Later, visit the historic Kachari Ruins, known for their ancient mushroom-shaped stone monoliths that reflect the rich heritage of the region. As the day comes to an end, gather around a cozy bonfire and enjoy a memorable farewell dinner with the group. These women bonding trips offer adventure, culture, and unforgettable memories. itinerary.title: Welcome to Hanoi, Vietnam!
itinerary.description:
Xin Chào! Welcome to Hanoi, Vietnam. Arrival on your comfort, transfer to the Hotel. Enjoy rest of the day at leisure as you begin your journey with WOW, featuring unique women travel experiences, meaningful connections, and life-long friendships through travel. Overnight stay in Hanoi.
Heritage Ham Long Hotelor similar (5*)

itinerary.title: Hanoi, Vietnam!
itinerary.description:
In the afternoon, visit the Ho Chi Minh Complex from the outside. Continue to the nearby Presidential Stilt House, where President Ho Chi Minh lived and worked from 1958 to 1969. Stroll through the peaceful grounds, taking in the scenic poetry fishpond that reflects the simplicity of his lifestyle. Your next stop is the iconic One Pillar Pagoda,one of Hanoi’s most beloved landmarks renowned for its unique lotus-inspired architecture and spiritual significance. Later in the evening walk around the Old Quarter and visit Hoan Kiem Lake, and enjoy watching a water puppet show which is a representation of a traditional Vietnamese theatre show. Relish a warm & hospitable welcome dinner at a local Vietnamese restaurant. Overnight stay in Hanoi.
Heritage Ham Long Hotelor similar (5*)

itinerary.title: Halong Bay cruise
itinerary.description:
After an early breakfast, cover a three hour scenic drive crossing paddy fields and villages in the Red River Delta. On arrival in Halong Bay, we take a 4-hour fantastic cruise on a traditional junk through the clear emerald waters between the limestone outcrops and long corridors. We visit Dau Go Cave “Grotto of the Wooden Stakes” and the Thien Cung Cave “Grotto of Heavenly Palace”, famous for its stalagmites and stalactites. Both the caves require one to climb about 100-150 steps. A seafood lunch will be served on-board before journeying back to Hanoi. Transfer back to Hanoi by evening. Overnight stay in Hanoi.
Heritage Ham Long Hotelor similar (5*)

itinerary.title: Hanoi city tour
itinerary.description:
Begin your day with breakfast at the hotel and check out. start a city tour of Hanoi. Visit Train Street, a unique and famous check-in spot known for its nostalgic charm and vibrant vintage photo opportunities (please note that access may be restricted due to government regulations, and any café expenses are on your own). Continue to Tran Quoc Pagoda, a historic Buddhist site located on the scenic West Lake, followed by the Temple of Literature, Vietnam’s first university dedicated to Confucius, where you’ll gain insight into the country’s rich educational heritage and feudal history.After the tour, transfer to the airport for your flight to Da Nang. Upon arrival, proceed to Hoi An (approximately 40 km / 1 hour) for hotel check-in. Overnight stay in Hoi An.
Amina Lantana Hoi An Hotel & Spa or similar (4*)

itinerary.title: Ba Na Hills excursion
itinerary.description:
After breakfast at the hotel, depart for a full-day excursion to Ba Na Hills. Enjoy a scenic cable car ride to By Night Station to explore Vong Nguyet Hills, Linh Ung Pagoda, and the Old French Villas. Continue by cable car to Nui Chua Mountain, visiting Nghinh Phong top, Le Nim Villas, and the Orchid Garden. Experience Vietnam’s first and only hill-climbing train, tour the historic French wine cellar and stroll through the beautiful flower garden. After lunch at Ba Na Hills, walk across the iconic Golden Bridge with its breathtaking views of Da Nang City. In the afternoon, enjoy free time at Fantasy Park—Vietnam’s third-largest indoor games zone featuring 4D–5D films, thrill rides, and themed attractions (at own cost). Descend by cable car and transfer back to Hoi An. Overnight stay in Hoi An.
Amina Lantana Hoi An Hotel & Spa or similar (4*)

itinerary.title: Hoi An Ancient Town
itinerary.description:
After breakfast at the hotel, enjoy the morning at leisure. In the afternoon, visit the Cam Thanh Coconut Forest and take a unique 30-minute basket boat ride through its tranquil waterways. Continue to Hoi An Ancient Town to explore the Japanese Covered Bridge, Sa Huynh Cultural Museum, and an Ancient House. Stroll along Lantern Street, shop at Nguyen Hoang Night Market, and end the evening with a peaceful lantern boat ride on the river. Return to the hotel for an overnight stay in Hoi An.
Amina Lantana Hoi An Hotel & Spa or similar (4*)

itinerary.title: Ho Chi Minh City
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out and transfer to Da Nang. Visit the Marble Mountains, then explore the nearby Non Nuoc Stone Carving Village, renowned for its intricate marble sculptures and handicrafts. Continue to My Khe Beach, celebrated for its calm waves, clear blue waters, soft white sand, and swaying palm trees. Later, transfer to Da Nang Airport (arriving 3 hours prior to departure) for your flight to Ho Chi Minh City (flight at own cost). Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel for check-in. Overnight stay in Ho Chi Minh City.
Muong Thanh Grand Saigon Hotel or similar (4*)

itinerary.title: Cu Chi Tunnels
itinerary.description:
After early breakfast, visit the famous Cu Chi Tunnels (1.5 hours), an incredible underground tunnel network constructed by Vietnamese resistance fighters during the long struggle for independence. The tunnels, over 250 km in length and up to three levels deep in places, played a huge part in the Viet Cong’s victory over the Americans, allowing them to control a large rural area surrounding Ho Chi Minh City. Return back to the city. After Lunch we visit the Post Office and continue with lade Emperor Pagoda dating from 1909. After some time to relax at the hotel, head out to experience the vibrant nightlife at Bui Vien Walking Street, known for its lively atmosphere, street performances, music, and a wide variety of bars and eateries. At around 9:00 PM, return to your hotel. Overnight stay in Ho Chi Minh City.
Muong Thanh Grand Saigon Hotel or similar (4*)

itinerary.title: Departure!
itinerary.description:
After breakfast at the hotel, check out and enjoy some free time for shopping at Ben Thanh Market, Diamond Plaza, or Takashimaya. Lunch will be on your own. Later, you will be transferred to Tan Son Nhat International Airport for departure.
