trips.title: Christmas in Macau & Hong Kong

itinerary.title: HONG KONG - MACAU
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Hong Kong International Airport and transfer to Macau by Ferry. After Immigration, take Free Hotel Shuttle Bus to Hotel for Check-In. Day free at leisure until evening. In the evening, proceed for a welcome dinner at a local restaurant . Overnight stay in Macau.
Crowne Plaza Macau (5*) or similar

itinerary.title: MACAU - ‘THE VEGAS OF CHINA’
itinerary.description:
After breakfast at the hotel, get ready to explore the beautiful city of Macau. Delve into the history of one of Macau's most famous landmarks, the iconic Ruins of St. Paul’s. Next, visit Fisherman’s Wharf, a popular waterfront attraction featuring themed architecture, shopping, and entertainment. Continue to the historic A-Ma Temple, dedicated to the sacred sea goddess. Visit the Kun Iam Statue and Lotus Square, known for its iconic Golden Lotus Flower monument. Later, explore Senado Square, a UNESCO World Heritage-listed area famous for its colourful pastel buildings, traditional Chinese restaurants, shopping centres, and Portuguese-inspired architecture. Afterwards, visit the famous Venetian Hotel, where you can explore the shopping mall. After the city tour, transfer back to the hotel. In the evening, proceed for the Macau Night Tour, visiting the spectacular Diamond Show, Wynn Palace Water Show, and Eiffel Tower (outside view). Overnight stay in Macau.
Crowne Plaza Macau (5*) or similar

itinerary.title: MACAU TO HONG KONG
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, transfer to the Pier to board the ferry from Macau to Hong Kong. Proceed to hotel for check-in. After arrival, Relax and rewind and enjoy your leisure time you can explore on own Madame Tussauds , Ocean Park A crossover between an amusement park, a marine park, an oceanarium, and an animal theme park, Ocean Park Hong Kong is definitely one of a kind! It’s home to a diverse range of marine life, the famous giant pandas – Le Le and Ying Ying, and some of the island’s most hair-raising thrill rides!, Hong Kong Disneyland The whimsical wonderland has seven distinctly themed zones – Adventureland, Grizzly Gulch, Mystic Point, Toy Story Land, Fantasyland, Tomorrowland and Main Street, U.S.A – all of which are perfect to relive those childhood dreams with your favourite Disney characters. Overnight stay in Hong Kong.
Harbour Plaza Metropolis (4*) or similar

itinerary.title: SAMPAN RIDE
itinerary.description:
Have Leisurely breakfast and proceed for full day tour in Sai Kung with Sampan ride ,Located on the Sai Kung Peninsula, Sai Kung District is the second largest by area in Hong Kong, though the area is largely rural. Sai Kung town, a former fishing village, has become a hotbed of seafood restaurants, many located on the waterfront along a stretch of road known as Seafood Street.Besides the food, Sai Kung is also known for having some of the most beautiful beaches in Hong Kong.By day, visitors come to soak up the sun on the beaches lining Clear Water Bay.When you think of Hong Kong, the first images that come to mind might be of towering skyscrapers, bustling city streets, and a skyline that sparkles like a jewel at night. But nestled within this metropolis lies a hidden gem that offers a rich tapestry of history, culture, and natural beauty – Aberdeen. After a long day return and overnight stay in Hong Kong.
Harbour Plaza Metropolis (4*) or similar

itinerary.title: HONG KONG TOUR!
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, get ready to explore the vibrant city of Hong Kong. Visit Golden Bauhinia Square, home to the famous golden Bauhinia statue, followed by Victoria Peak with a one-way Peak Tram ride, offering spectacular panoramic views of Hong Kong's skyline. Continue to Man Mo Temple, a historic temple dedicated to the gods of literature and war, and Avenue of Stars, known for its waterfront views and tributes to Hong Kong's film industry. In the evening, enjoy the spectacular Symphony of Lights Show, a dazzling display of lights illuminating Hong Kong's skyline and harbour. Take in the incredible views as you soak up all the wonder of this memorable night on the water. Afterwards, proceed to the hotel. Overnight stay in Hong Kong.
Harbour Plaza Metropolis (4*) or similar

itinerary.title: EXPLORE LANTAU ISLAND
itinerary.description:
Buddhist architecture; a long sandy beach; a mall of shopping outlets — Lantau Island has it all. Whatever your persuasion, Hong Kong’s largest outlying island brings solace to the soul, senses and shopping bags. Visit the Ngong Ping Village by Ngong Ping 360 Cable Car which is an attraction in itself, providing some of the most beautiful views of Lantau Island and beyond as far as the South China Sea. Thereafter, travel the winding mountain road to the impressive Big Buddha statue and the nearby Po Lin Monastery. Popularly known as the Big Buddha or Giant Buddha, the statue reaches more than 111 feet (34 meters) high, making it the world's largest seated, outdoor bronze Buddha.Return to hotel and relax later , transfer to central market for shopping & bar hopping, return on own. Overnight stay in Hong Kong.
Harbour Plaza Metropolis (4*) or similar

itinerary.title: BYE HONG KONG
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, transfer to the Hong Kong Airport to catch your flight back home after this fun filled fiesta.

itinerary.description:

Overnight stay in Hanoi.
Heritage Ham Long Hotel or similar (5*)

itinerary.title: HALF DAY CITY TOUR - WATER PUPPET SHOW
itinerary.description:
In the afternoon, visit the Ho Chi Minh Complex from the outside. Continue to the nearby Presidential Stilt House, where President Ho Chi Minh lived and worked from 1958 to 1969. Stroll through the peaceful grounds, taking in the scenic poetry fishpond that reflects the simplicity of his lifestyle. Your next stop is the iconic One Pillar Pagoda,one of Hanoi’s most beloved landmarks renowned for its unique lotus-inspired architecture and spiritual significance. Later in the evening walk around the Old Quarter and visit Hoan Kiem Lake, and enjoy watching a water puppet show which is a representation of a traditional Vietnamese theatre show. Relish a warm & hospitable welcome dinner at a local Vietnamese restaurant. Overnight stay in Hanoi.
Heritage Ham Long Hotel or similar (5*)

itinerary.title: THIEN CUNG CAVE DAY TRIP
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, set out on a scenic drive through the Red River Delta to the breathtaking Halong Bay. Board a traditional junk boat for a 4-hour cruise through emerald waters dotted with dramatic limestone karsts and iconic islets. Enjoy a seafood lunch on board before visiting the stunning Thien Cung Cave (Grotto of Heavenly Palace) and, if time permits, Dau Go Cave (Grotto of the Wooden Stakes). Return to Hanoi by evening and enjoy an overnight stay..
Heritage Ham Long Hotel or similar (5*)

itinerary.title: HANOI CITY TOUR
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel and set out to explore the highlights of Hanoi. Visit the famous Train Street, a unique lane known for its charming old-world atmosphere and vibrant local life (subject to government regulations and access restrictions). Continue to Tran Quoc Pagoda, a serene Buddhist pagoda located on the shores of West Lake, followed by the historic Temple of Literature, Vietnam’s first university and a symbol of the country's rich educational heritage.Later, transfer to the airport for your flight to Da Nang. Upon arrival, proceed to Hoi An (approximately 1 hour drive) for check-in. Overnight stay in Hoi An.
Amina Lantana Hoi An Hotel & Spa or similar (4*)

itinerary.title: BANA HILLS - FRENCH WINE CELLAR - HOI AN
itinerary.description:
Have breakfast and drive to (40kms/ 1 hour) Ba Na Hills . Take a Cable Car ride from Ba Na Hills station, and stop at By Night station to visit Vong Nguyet Hills, Linh Ung Pagoda, and The Old Villas of France. Continue moving up by cable car to the Nui Chua Mountain - the top of Ba Na range, visiting Nghinh Phong top, Le Nim Villas, Orchid Garden… Experience the hill climbing train (the first and unique funicular in Vietnam) and visit an old French cellar and flower garden Le Jardin D’amour. Buffet Lunch in Bana Hills. Continue to the famous Golden Bridge hanging in the foggy hills of the mountain, witnessing the amazing and gorgeous view of Da Nang City.In the afternoon, free to join games in Fantasy Park - the third biggest indoor games zone in Vietnam with a series of interesting games: 4 - 5D film, skiver, The Death Race, Dinosaur Par (own expense) Return to Hoi An. Overnight stay in HoiAn.
Amina Lantana Hoi An Hotel & Spa or similar (4*)

itinerary.title: EXPERIENCE HOI AN
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, enjoy a leisurely morning at the hotel or explore Hoi An at your own pace. In the afternoon, visit the picturesque Cam Thanh Coconut Village, where you'll experience a traditional basket boat ride through the serene coconut palm waterways, offering a glimpse into local village life. Later, continue to the enchanting Hoi An Ancient Town, a UNESCO-listed heritage town renowned for its well-preserved architecture and rich cultural heritage. Explore highlights including the iconic Japanese Covered Bridge, historic ancient houses, and charming streets adorned with colorful lanterns. Browse local shops and soak in the lively atmosphere of the night market before ending the evening with a peaceful lantern boat ride along the river, a beautiful local tradition symbolizing wishes for happiness and good fortune. Return to the hotel and enjoy an overnight stay in Hoi An.
Amina Lantana Hoi An Hotel Spa or similar (4*)

itinerary.title: MARBLE MOUNTAIN - DA NANG BEACH
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel and proceed to Marble Mountains, a stunning cluster of limestone hills known for its ancient pagodas, fascinating caves, and panoramic views of the coastline. Continue to My Khe Beach, one of Vietnam’s most beautiful beaches, famous for its soft white sands, clear blue waters, and scenic coastal charm. Later, transfer to Da Nang Airport for your flight to Ho Chi Minh City. Upon arrival, transfer to the hotel for check-in. Overnight stay in Ho Chi Minh City.
Muong Thanh Saigon Hotel or similar (4*)

itinerary.title: CU CHI TUNNELS - HO CHI MINH CITY TOUR
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, visit the historic Cu Chi Tunnels, an extensive underground network that played a significant role during the Vietnam War. Explore the tunnels and learn about the resilience and daily life of the Vietnamese people during wartime. Enjoy a local lunch before returning to the city. Later, discover the highlights of Ho Chi Minh City, including the Saigon Central Post Office, Notre-Dame Cathedral Basilica of Saigon (outside view), and the beautiful Jade Emperor Pagoda. In the evening, soak in the vibrant atmosphere of Bui Vien Walking Street before returning to the hotel. Overnight stay in Ho Chi Minh City.
Muong Thanh Saigon Hotel or similar (4*)

itinerary.title: HO CHI MINH & SIEM RIEP
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel and enjoy free time for shopping at Ben Thanh Market, Diamond Plaza, or Takashimaya Vietnam, where you can browse for local souvenirs, fashion, and specialty products.
Later, transfer to the airport for your flight to Siem Reap. Upon arrival, meet your guide and transfer to the hotel for check-in. Overnight stay in Siem Reap.
Empress Angkor Resort & Spa or similar (5*)

itinerary.title: ANGKOR WAT COMPLEX
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, visit the magnificent Angkor Wat, the world’s largest religious monument and a masterpiece of Khmer architecture, showcasing the grandeur of the ancient Khmer Empire. Explore its intricate carvings, majestic towers, and fascinating history as you discover one of Southeast Asia’s most iconic landmarks.
In the evening, experience the vibrant atmosphere of the Siem Reap Night Market and stroll along the famous Pub Street, known for its lively cafés, local handicrafts, souvenirs, and energetic nightlife. Return to the hotel for an overnight stay in Siem Reap.
Tara Angkor Hotel or similar (4*)

itinerary.title: ANGKOR THOM & TA PROHM
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, continue your exploration of the remarkable Angkor Archaeological Park. Enter through the South Gate of Angkor Thom and discover the iconic Bayon Temple, famous for its captivating stone faces. Visit the historic Terrace of the Elephants and Terrace of the Leper King, before continuing to the enchanting Ta Prohm, where ancient ruins are intertwined with giant tree roots, creating one of Angkor’s most photogenic sights.
Tara Angkor Hotel or similar (4*)

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description:
Enjoy breakfast at the hotel and some free time at leisure before checking out. Later, transfer to the airport for your onward flight, carrying wonderful memories of your journey through Vietnam and Cambodia. Return with unforgettable memories, life-long friendships through travel, and unique women travel experiences with WOW Club women travel.

itinerary.title: Hello Hampi!
itinerary.description:
We arrive at Hubballi Airport and transfer to the hotel in Hampi (175 km/3.5 hrs). Hampi is a village and temple town recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in northern Karnataka, India. It was one of the richest and largest cities in the world during its prime. Spend the day at your leisure. Overnight stay in Hampi.
Royal Orchid Hotel or similar (4*)

itinerary.title: Hampi Sightseeing
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, we start our trip with sightseeing of Hampi. We visit the majestic Virupaksha Temple, dedicated to Virupaksha, an incarnation of Lord Shiva. This is followed by a visit to the underground Shiva temple, Royal centre (Queen’s Bath, Lotus Mahal) and the Elephant Stables. The intricate design and emphasis on little details of these stables indicate the importance that was attached to the royal elephants of the empire. Dinner and Overnight stay in Hampi.
Royal Orchid Hotel or similar (4*)

itinerary.title: Heritage Drive to Badami, Aihole & Pattadakal
itinerary.description:
Early morning, we head with packed breakfast to Badami (135 km/3 hr). Here, we visit the famous Badami Cave Temples, considered as UNESCO’s world heritage site. One is completely mesmerized by the charms of these caves. There are four caves, all carved out of the soft Badami sandstone on a hill cliff in the late 6th to 7th centuries. Later, we head for Pattadakal (22 km/30 mins). Pattadakal is yet another UNESCO world heritage site and has some amazing temples that we can look forward to seeing. This is followed by a visit to Aihole (14 km/20 mins), also a UNESCO world heritage site. Aihole has historical significance and is called as cradle of Hindu rock architecture. After a long day of wandering, we head back to our hotel in Hampi.
Royal Orchid Hotel or similar (4*)

itinerary.title: Vittala Temple
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, we head for the Coracle ride across the river (weather permitting & at extra cost). We visit the Vittala Temple, the most extravagant architectural showpiece of Hampi. Highlight of Vittala temple is its impressive pillared halls and the stone chariot. Post lunch (on your own), we head to Tungabhadra Dam. Located on the Tungabhadra River, remains a popular attraction where locals and tourists alike go to relax. Head back to the hotel for overnight stay in Hampi.
Royal Orchid Hotel or similar (4*)

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, we check-out from the hotel and head to the airport, leaving this land of mystique and magic with stories for life.
Email me the Daily Schedule

trips.title: Fifty Shades of Blue - Andaman

itinerary.title: Arrival at Port Blair
itinerary.description:
Arrival at Port Blair airport in morning and transfer to the hotel. First half of the day is leisure. Later in the noon, visit to Cellular Jail followed by Light and Sound Show. Declared as a national memorial, this three storey prison constructed by Britishers in 1906, has witnessed the atrocities borne by freedom fighters. As evening falls, immerse yourself in one of the unique women travel experiences that combines history, culture, and companionship in a supportive women-only travel community.Dinner and Overnight stay at Port Blair hotel.
Heritage MNR or similar (4*)

itinerary.title: Port Blair - Havelock
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, departure by ferry to the most popular and alluring Island- The Havelock Island. It takes about 1.5 hours to reach Havelock Island and you can spend your time taking in the vastness of the cerulean waters of the Bay of Bengal. On arrival at the island check into the hotel. Towards late afternoon, experience the stunning sunset at the beautiful Radhanagar Beach. Stretches of fine white sand, turquoise blue waters, and a sense of peace and serenity are the hallmarks of this beautiful landmass. Dinner and Overnight stay at Havelock hotel.
Aparupa Sands Marina or similar (4*)

itinerary.title: Elephant & Kalapathar Beach
itinerary.description:
Early morning, go for Scuba diving (at your own expense), return to the hotel for breakfast proceed to the mesmerizing Elephant Beach by speed boat (30 mins). Famous for snorkeling and glass bottom boat rides, this beautiful beach is equipped with amazing coral reefs that start at a depth less than a metre, a feature unique only to the Andaman Islands. At the beach you can choose to experience water sports activities like jet ski, parasailing and underwater sea walk (at your own expense) or relax. Transfer back to our hotel. In the evening visit to Kalapathar beach. Dinner and Overnight stay at Havelock hotel.
Aparupa Sands Marina or similar (4*)

itinerary.title: Havelock - Neil Island
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check-out and proceed to board the ferry towards Neil Island(1.5 hours). Upon arrival, check-in at the hotel and freshen up. Later, visit Bharatpur Beach and spend some time until late afternoon and continue to visit Natural Bridge (depends on high tide/low tide). After that, head to Laxmanpur beach to see one of the best sunsets. Evening return to the hotel. Dinner and Overnight stay at Neil hotel.
Pearl Park Beach Resort or similar (3*)

itinerary.title: Neil Island - Port Blair
itinerary.description:
Breakfast at the hotel. Check-out from the hotel. Travel to Port Blair by ferry which takes about 1 hour 20 min. En-route stop for shopping and then, check-in at hotel. Overnight stay at hotel.
Heritage MNR or similar (4*)

itinerary.title: Ross Island and Chidiya Tapu
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, embark on the way to proceed to Ross Island. Magnificent man-caves, the old church and grim history associated with this place gives out a unique vibe that can’t be found anywhere else in Andaman. After the lunch (at your own expense), proceed to Chidiya Tapu to see the mesmerizing sundowner as the name suggests. Chidiya Tapu is also known as “Sunset Point” . Chidiya Tapu is the perfect haven for unseen migratory birds and common native birds found in the Andaman Islands. Dinner and Overnight stay at Port Blair.
Heritage MNR or similar (4*)

itinerary.title: Arrive at Rajkot
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Rajkot airport before noon. Upon arrival, drive towards Sasan Gir (approx 4.5 hrs), the only Asiatic lion sanctuary in the world. Enroute stop at Junagarh, visit Girnar mountain (Ambika Mata Temple) through cable car. It is Asia's second longest ropeway. Mount Girnar has garnered attention from tourists worldwide because of the presence of the Dattatreya Shrine, the Amba Temple and several Jain temples lining the foothills. Post Lunch (at own expense), continue your drive to Gir and check-in to the Resort & relax. Dinner & overnight stay at Gir.
Araiya Gir A Mavintara Resort (4*) or similar

itinerary.title: Say hello to the Lions!
itinerary.description:
Early morning (before breakfast) get ready for the Lion safari in the Lion reserve. Gir National Park consists of a mixed deciduous forest interspersed with semi-evergreen and evergreen trees, scrub jungle, large patches of grasslands and rocky hills. It is the largest dry deciduous forest in Western India. On return , have breakfast and enjoy leisure time and enjoy lunch (at own expense). In evening, we will head for evening Gypsy Safari. If you are lucky enough, you may see Asiatic Lion, leopards, and many other wild animals, birds & rich flora and fauna. Return to the resort. Dinner & overnight stay at Gir.
Araiya Gir A Mavintara Resort (4*) or similar

itinerary.title: Excursion to Somnath
itinerary.description:
Wake up early morning and get ready to, transfer to Somnath (93 km / 2 hr). Somnath is one of the most sacred pilgrimage sites for Hindus and is believed to be first among the twelve jyotirlinga shrines of Shiva. On arrival visit to Bhalka Tirth, Geeta Mandir, Triveni Sangam and Pandav Caves. Later have lunch (at own expense) and then proceed to Somnath temple and get a chance to see the Aarti in Somnath temple and enjoy laser show. The Light & Sound Show of Somnath Temple depicts its historical, religious and cultural importance. It represents the ups and down of Hindu religion in the history. Later return back to the resort for dinner & overnight stay in Gir.
Araiya Gir A Mavintara Resort (4*) or similar

itinerary.title: Dwarka
itinerary.description:
Early morning after breakfast depart for Dwarka (290km / 5hrs) . The city's name literally means the “gateway to heaven” in Sanskrit, as Dwar means “gate” and ka references “Brahma” . On the way, visit Porbandar sightseeing Kirti Mandir and Sudama Temple. Porbandar is a coastal city in the state of Gujarat, best known for being the birthplace of Mahatma Gandhi. The coastal city is also believed to be the birthplace of Sudama, Lord Krishna's friend and devotee. Then depart for Dwarka and visit to Dwarkadhish temple, Gomti Ghat. Later transfer to the hotel and check in. Dinner & overnight stay in Dwarka.
The Fern Sativa Resort, Dwarka (4*) or similar

itinerary.title: Bet Dwarka
itinerary.description:
Today early morning after breakfast we depart for Bet Dwarka (2hrs approx.), Bet Dwarka is considered to be part of the ancient city of Dwarka. In Indian epic literature such as the Mahabharata and the Skanda Purana, this city is the abode of Krishna. Enroute to Bet Dwarka, we visit Nageshwar Jyotirling. Sometimes known as Nagnath Temple, the main deity here is Lord Shiva, also known as Nageshwar Mahadev. According to the Shiva Purana, those who pray at the Nageshwar Jyotirlinga become free from all poisons, snake bites and worldly attractions. Also visit Rukmani temple and Gopi Talav. Return back to dwarka after lunch (at own expense) and rest. In the evening visit Shivrajpur beach. Dinner and overnight stay at Dwarka.
The Fern Sativa Resort, Dwarka (4*) or similar

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description:
After a leisurely breakfast, head towards to Jamnagar Airport ( 137 kms / 2.5 hrs approx.) for your flight back home.

trips.location: gujarat - dwarka, jyotirlinga, nav dwarka jamnagar
trips.title: Gujarat - Dwarka, Jyotirlinga, Nav Dwarka

itinerary.title: Arrive at Jamnagar
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Jamnagar Airport in the morning. Begin your scenic drive to Dwarka(150 kms/3 hours), the legendary kingdom of Lord Krishna and one of the sacred Char Dham pilgrimage sites. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and take some time to refresh. Later, visit the revered Dwarkadhish Temple, dedicated to Lord Krishna, followed by a peaceful walk along the sacred Gomti Ghat, where the Gomti River meets the Arabian Sea. Soak in the spiritual atmosphere and witness the evening aarti (subject to timings). Return to the hotel for dinner and an overnight stay in Dwarka.
The Fern Sattava (5*) or similar

itinerary.title: Dwarka Sightseeing
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, set out to explore the spiritual treasures of Dwarka. Begin with a visit to Bet Dwarka(reached by a ferry/boat ride ), an island believed to be the ancient residence of Lord Krishna, followed by the revered Nageshwar Jyotirlinga, one of the twelve sacred Jyotirlingas dedicated to Lord Shiva. Continue to the serene Rukmini Devi Temple and the sacred Gopi Talav, associated with the legends of Lord Krishna and the Gopis. In the evening, unwind at the picturesque Shivrajpur Beach, one of Gujarat's Blue Flag-certified beaches, known for its crystal-clear waters and pristine shoreline. Return to the hotel for dinner and an overnight stay in Dwarka.
The Fern Sattava (5*) or similar

itinerary.title: Dwarka - Porbandar - Somnath
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out and drive towards Somnath(250 kms/5 hours), with fascinating stops along the way. Visit Mul Dwarka, believed to be the original abode of Lord Krishna before he established the kingdom of Dwarka. Continue to Porbandar, the birthplace of Mahatma Gandhi, and explore Kirti Mandir, his ancestral home and memorial, along with the revered Sudama Temple, dedicated to Lord Krishna's childhood friend. Upon arrival in Somnath, check in to your hotel and relax. Later, visit the magnificent Somnath Temple, one of the twelve sacred Jyotirlingas of Lord Shiva. Continue to Bhalka Tirth followed by Triveni Sangam and Gita Mandir. Return to the hotel for dinner and an overnight stay in Somnath.
Hotel Lords Inn (3*) or similar

itinerary.title: Somnath - Sasan Gir
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out and drive to Sasan Gir, the only natural habitat of the majestic Asiatic Lion. Upon arrival, check in to your resort and spend some time at leisure, soaking in the serene surroundings. In the afternoon, embark on an exhilarating Jeep Safari through Gir National Park (approximately 3:00 PM – 6:00 PM), where you may spot Asiatic lions, leopards, deer, antelopes, crocodiles, and a variety of bird species in their natural habitat. Return to the resort for dinner and an overnight stay in Sasan Gir.
AraiyaGir A Mavintara Resort (5*) or similar

itinerary.title: Sasan Gir - Bhavnagar
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out and drive to Bhavnagar. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and relax. Later, visit the revered Nishkalank Mahadev Temple, a unique shrine dedicated to Lord Shiva, believed to have been established by the Pandavas after the Mahabharata. Located amidst the Arabian Sea, this sacred temple is accessible only during low tide, making it a truly one-of-a-kind spiritual experience. Return to the hotel for dinner and an overnight stay in Bhavnagar.
Hotel Efcee Sarovar Premiere(4*) or similar

itinerary.title: Bhavnagar - Ahmedabad
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out and drive to Ahmedabad(220 kms / 4 hours), Gujarat's vibrant cultural and commercial capital. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and relax. Later, visit the iconic Sabarmati Ashram, the former residence of Mahatma Gandhi and a symbol of India's freedom movement, followed by the magnificent Adalaj Stepwell, an architectural masterpiece renowned for its intricate carvings and Indo-Islamic design. In the evening, enjoy free time to explore Ahmedabad's bustling local markets and indulge in some shopping. Return to the hotel for dinner and an overnight stay in Ahmedabad.
Hotel Fortune Landmark (4*) or similar

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel and transfer to Ahmedabad Airport for your onward journey. As your memorable Gujarat holiday comes to an end, take back cherished memories of sacred temples, rich heritage, breathtaking wildlife, and the wonderful friendships made along the way. We look forward to welcoming you on another unforgettable journey with WOW!

trips.location: the soul of tamil nadu trichy
trips.title: The Soul of Tamil Nadu

itinerary.title: Welcome to Trichy !
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Tiruchirappalli (Trichy), the gateway to the historic Chola heartland of Tamil Nadu. Upon arrival, enjoy a traditional South Indian lunch/brunch. Later, visit Kallanai (Grand Anicut) 20 km/ 30 min Approx, one of the oldest functioning dams in the world and a remarkable engineering marvel built by Karikala Chola nearly 2,000 years ago across the Kaveri River. Thereafter, proceed to Kumbakonam (110 km /2hr approx), a historic temple town celebrated for its spiritual heritage, ancient temples, and deep connection to the Chola dynasty. Upon arrival, check in to the hotel and relax. Rest of the day is at leisure to soak in the charm of this culturally rich town. Later, enjoy the Pink Evening followed by dinner and overnight stay in Kumbakonam with the WOW women travel community, creating safe and enriching travel experiences for women who love to explore together.
Mantra Koodam or similar (4*)

itinerary.title: Chola Heritage Trail
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, visit the magnificent Airavatesvara Temple at Darasuram (5 km /15 min), a UNESCO World Heritage Site celebrated for its exceptional Chola architecture, intricate stone carvings, and beautifully sculpted pillars.Enjoy lunch at a local restaurant (lunch on your own).Later, proceed to Maligaimedu (35 km/1 hr), an important archaeological site offering fascinating insights into the Chola Empire’s royal heritage and urban planning. Continue to Gangaikonda Cholapuram (25 km /40 min), the historic capital established by Rajendra Chola I after his victorious expedition to the Ganges. Visit the magnificent Shiva temple, renowned for its towering vimana, exquisite sculptures, and architectural brilliance.hereafter, drive back to Kumbakonam. Dinner and overnight stay in Kumbakonam.
Mantra Koodam or similar (4*)

itinerary.title: Chola to Chettinad Journey
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, proceed to Thanjavur (40 km / 1 hr approx) and visit the magnificent Brihadeeswarar Temple, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of India’s greatest architectural masterpieces, built by Rajaraja Chola I. lunch at a local restaurant (lunch on your own).Later, continue towards the Chettinad region and visit Athangudi Village (95 km /2 hr), famous for its handcrafted Athangudi tiles and rich artistic heritage. Witness skilled artisans creating these vibrant tiles using traditional techniques. Optional visits include Chettinad Basket for local handicrafts and Athangudi Palace Periya Veedu, one of Chettinad grand heritage mansions.Thereafter, proceed to Karaikudi (15 km/30 mins), the heart of the Chettinad region known for its palatial mansions and rich cultural heritage. Upon arrival, check in and relax. Dinner and overnight stay in Karaikudi.
Chidambara Vilas Resort or similar (4*)

itinerary.title: Chettinad Heritage Experience
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, immerse yourself in the timeless charm of the Chettinad region, renowned for its grand mansions, rich cultural heritage, and distinctive architectural style. Begin the day with a guided exploration of magnificent Chettinad Mansions, showcasing ornate wooden carvings, Belgian mirrors, Italian marble, Athangudi tiles, and impressive courtyards that reflect the refined lifestyle and global trading legacy of the Chettiyar community. Enjoy lunch at a local restaurant (lunch on your own).The afternoon is dedicated to discovering the artistic traditions of Chettinad. Browse through local boutiques, antique stores, and handicraft shops featuring handcrafted décor, textiles, traditional baskets, and heritage collectibles. Return in the evening and enjoy time at leisure. Dinner and overnight stay in Karaikudi.
Chidambara Vilas Resort or similar (4*)

itinerary.title: enroute Rameshwaram
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, depart from Karaikudi and journey towards Rameswaram via Sivagangai. En route, visit the fascinating Keeladi Museum (90 km / 2 hr approx), showcasing remarkable discoveries from one of India’s most significant archaeological excavations and offering insights into the ancient Tamil civilization that flourished along the Vaigai River over 2,000 years ago.Enjoy lunch at a local restaurant (lunch on your own).Later, continue your drive to Rameswaram (160 km / 3hr 30 min Approx), the sacred island town renowned for its spiritual significance, scenic coastal beauty, and connection to the epic Ramayana. Upon arrival, check in and relax. Dinner and overnight stay in Rameswaram.
The Residency Towers Rameswaram or similar (4*)

itinerary.title: Rameshwaram sightseeing
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, explore the sacred island of Rameswaram, one of India’s most important pilgrimage destinations. Visit the renowned Ramanathaswamy Temple, famous for its magnificent corridors, intricate architecture, and deep spiritual significance. Continue to Agni Theertham and Panchamukhi Hanuman Temple, both closely associated with the legends of the Ramayana. Enjoy lunch at a local restaurant (lunch on your own). Later, visit Dhanushkodi (20 km/ 30 min approx), the historic ghost town located at the tip of the island, and stop at the iconic Pamban Bridge for breathtaking views of the sea and coastline.
Return to the hotel in the evening. Dinner and overnight stay in Rameswaram.
The Residency Towers Rameswaram or similar (4*)

itinerary.title: Temple Trail to Madurai
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, bid farewell to Rameswaram and proceed to Madurai (175 km / 3 hrs 50 min approx), the cultural capital of Tamil Nadu.Upon arrival, visit the iconic Meenakshi Amman Temple, renowned for its stunning Dravidian architecture, vibrant gopurams, and spiritual significance. Continue to the famous Thousand Pillared Hall, known for its exquisite carvings and architectural brilliance. Enjoy lunch at a local restaurant (lunch on your own).Later, check in to the hotel. Rest of the day is at leisure to relax or explore Madurai at your own pace. Dinner and overnight stay in Madurai
The Residency Signature or Similar (5*)

itinerary.title: Departure !
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel and transfer to Madurai Airport for your onward flight. Your unforgettable Tamil Nadu heritage journey with WOW comes to a memorable close, filled with rich culture, timeless temples, meaningful connections, and beautiful travel experiences with like-minded women travellers.

itinerary.title: Welcome to Varanasi
itinerary.description:
On arrival at the Varanasi Airport, meet and transfer (group transfers only) to the Hotel to freshen up. Varanasi mentioned in the scriptures as Kashi, is less of a city and more of a dreamy experience. It is among the Sapta Puris, meaning seven sacred cities of Ancient India. After check-in we witness Ganga Aarti while on the Bajra Boat .Afterwards proceed for dinner followed by Pink Evening. Overnight stay at the hotel.
Hotel Dolphin Grand, Varanasi (4*) or similar

itinerary.title: Discover Varanasi
itinerary.description:
Early morning (5:30 Am) proceed to visit Old Kashi Vishwanath temple, Annapurna Temple and Vishalakshi Temple. On the way back we visit the Kal Bhairav Temple. Transfer back to the hotel to have breakfast. We will drive out for the city tour and visit New Kashi Vishwanath Temple(BHU) also known as Birla Temple, Sankat Mochan Temple, Durga Temple and Tulsi Manas Mandir. Post lunch (at your own expense) we will proceed for excursion to Sarnath. We will visit the Mulagandhakuti Vihara (Main Temple), Archeological Museum, Chaukhandi Stupa, Dhamekh Stupa, Dharmarajika Stupa. After that we will go for shopping in Varanasi Silk market. Transfer to the hotel and have dinner. Overnight stay at the hotel.
Hotel Dolphin Grand, Varanasi (4*) or similar

itinerary.title: Varanasi - Prayagraj
itinerary.description:
After an early breakfast proceed towards Prayagraj (3 hours). After reaching Prayagraj we will start our sightseeing. We will be visiting Holy Triveni Sangam, Hanuman Temple, Alopi Devi Temple, Anand Bhawan and Akshayavat. After sightseeing, have lunch (at our own expense) we will check in the hotel and rest of the day is leisure time. Dinner and overnight stay at Prayagraj.
Hotel Kanha Shyam , Prayagraj (3*) or similar

itinerary.title: Prayagraj - Ayodhya
itinerary.description:
After a leisurely breakfast , Proceed to Ayodhya, Ayodhya is regarded as one of the seven sacred cities of the Hindus, revered because of its association in the great Indian epic poem Ramayana with the birth of Rama and with the rule of his father, Dasharatha. We explore the city of lord Rama visit Saryu River, Hanuman Garhi, Shri Ram Janmabhoomi and Kanak Bhawan. We will be having VIP Darshan with Golf cart in Ayodhya. After sightseeing we check in the hotel . Dinner and overnight stay in Ayodhya.
Ira by Orchid (4*) or similar

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description:
After breakfast we check out from the hotel for Ayodhya airport for our flight back home.

itinerary.title: Welcome to Ranthambore
itinerary.description:
Meet up at Jaipur international airport. Transfer to our resort at Ranthambore (175 kms/4 hrs). Ranthambore National Park is a vast wildlife reserve near the town of Sawai Madhopur in Rajasthan, northern India. It is a former royal hunting ground and home to tigers, leopards and marsh crocodiles. Lunch at the hotel and relax. Enjoy High tea and the evening get ready for bonfire with cultural programme (06:00 PM to 08:30 PM). Dinner and Overnight stay at the resort.

itinerary.title: Safari
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, head out for an exciting safari at Ranthambore National Park, one of the largest and oldest national parks in Northern India, renowned for its Bengal Tigers and diverse wildlife, including leopards, sloth bears, and more. Return to the resort and unwind before getting ready for a lively DJ Night from 6:00 PM to 9:30 PM. Dance under the stars, enjoy dinner, and create unforgettable memories with women who travel together before relaxing at the resort for an overnight stay.
Aangan Resort Ranthambore or Similar 3.5*

itinerary.title: Sightseeing
itinerary.description:
After breakfast proceed embark on a scenic drive (55 km/1.5 hours one way) to the National Chambal Gharial Sanctuary. The sanctuary is famous for its unique Gharial crocodile species, along with other crocodile varieties. Enjoy a boat ride along the Chambal River to get a closer look at these fascinating creatures in their natural habitat, creating memorable moments with women who travel together. Dinner and Overnight stay at the resort.
Note: In the morning, we will visit Palighat Chambal for the crocodile safari. Tickets are not included in the package cost, as the authorities may suspend operations without prior notice due to the inherent risks of interacting with wild animals. This is why tickets have not been included — instead, the group can purchase them individually at the site. Transport will be provided by WOW.

trips.title: Offbeat Trails of Kaziranga & Meghalaya

itinerary.title: Guwahati - Shillong
itinerary.description:
Arrival at Guwahati airport, upon arrival drive to Shillong (121 kms/ 5 Hrs approx) which is the capital of Meghalaya and an ideal place to unwind amidst natural beauty and serenity. En route, we take a short break at Umiam Lake, also known as “Bara Pani” or the Big Water, known for its picturesque and panoramic setting. Dinner & overnight stay in Shillong.
Hotel Tripura Castle or Similar (3*)

itinerary.title: Excursion to Dawki River
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, drive to Dawki (2 hrs approx) on the Indo Bangladesh border. The drive from Shillong to Dawki is a thrilling experience passing through deep gorges and ravines with the Umngot river running through. Enjoy the scenery and take a ride in local boats. After lunch (at own expense), drive up to the village of Mawlynnong in East Khasi Hills of Meghalaya, The cleanest village in Asia. Walk through this picturesque village and visit the single root bridge in the neighboring village of Riwai (time permitting). Later, by evening drive back to Shillong. Overnight stay in Shillong.
Hotel Tripura Castle or Similar (3*)

itinerary.title: Trek to Double Decker Root Bridges
itinerary.description:
After early morning Breakfast at the Hotel & Checkout & drive to the trek starting point Laitkynsew Village (2 hrs 35 mins approx). We undertake a trek to see the unique Double Decker root bridges (involves approx. 3500 steps one way). Living Root Bridges are unique live bridges found only in the Khasi Hills of Meghalaya. The secondary roots of a species of Indian Rubber Tree Ficus Elastica- are trained over 20-25 years to form these living bridges to cross ​fast-flowing rivers and streams. The Double Decker Root Bridge has two levels. They are very strong, can carry many people at a time and perhaps can last 500 years. The trek passes through some verdant slopes, ​crisscrossed by streams. At some places the stream has made some natural ponds, containing emerald blue water where you can take a dip. The trek is moderately difficult since one needs to descend 2500 feet into the valley and then climb up the same altitude again.​ Transfer to the resort and & Check In. In the evening get ready for Pink Evening followed by Dinner & Overnight stay at Cherrapunji.
Jiva Resort or Similar (3*)

itinerary.title: Exploring Caves
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, visit the breathtaking Nohkalikai Falls, ranked among the 100 best waterfalls in the world, followed by the fascinating Mawsmai Caves known for their stunning stalagmite and stalactite formations. Later, explore the beautiful Garden of Caves, a hidden gem surrounded by lush greenery and waterfalls. This experience perfectly reflects the spirit of WOW Club women travel — bringing women travel together through unique women travel experiences and offbeat destinations for women. Return to the resort and relax. Dinner & overnight stay in Cherrapunji.
Jiva Resort or Similar (3*)

itinerary.title: Cherrapunji to Kaziranga
itinerary.description:
After breakfast,check out and drive to Kaziranga (330 kms/ 8.5 Hrs Approx). Kaziranga is famed as a haven for the one-horned rhinoceros, one of India’s great wildlife emblems. Kaziranga National Park is a World heritage site and one of the prides of India, located on the banks of the mighty Brahmaputra River in the far North East of India, Assam, Kaziranga National Park covers an area of approximately 430-sq-kms with its swamps and tall thickets of elephant grass. On arrival, check – in. Dinner and overnight stay at Kaziranga.
IORA Retreat or Similar (4*)

itinerary.title: Rendezvous with The Wild and Nature
itinerary.description:
Wake up early in the morning for an elephant safari in the grasslands of Kaziranga which is sure to leave you mesmerized. After safari head back to resort for breakfast and freshen up. Later, proceed to visit the biodiversity park to learn about the rich biodiversity and culture of Assam. In the afternoon, enjoy the jeep safari in the wilderness of Kaziranga. This journey perfectly reflects the essence of women travel together, combining wildlife, adventure, and meaningful connections. Return to the resort after an exciting day in the wild. Overnight stay at Kaziranga.
IORA Retreat or Similar (4*)

itinerary.title: Departure!
itinerary.description:
After an early breakfast, check out from the resort and begin your scenic drive to Guwahati Airport (approx. 250 kms / 6 hrs). As your journey comes to an end, take back wonderful memories of new bonds of sisterhood and enjoying the breathtaking landscapes, wildlife adventures, and unforgettable moments shared together. Board your flight back home with cherished memories and new friendships to treasure forever.

itinerary.title: Welcome to Gangtok!!
itinerary.description:
Arrival at Bagdogra Airport, upon arrival drive to the Queen of the Hills nestled among the Himalayan foothills - Darjeeling (75 Kms / 03 Hrs approx) . Upon arrival check-in at the hotel. In Evening you can choose to go out and explore the Local Area (on your own) or just relax and explore the property. Dinner & overnight stay at Darjeeling.
Hotel Yashshree Sanderling or similar (4*)

itinerary.title: Exploring Darjeeling
itinerary.description:
Early morning proceed to experience the iconic Joy Train Ride (Toy Train Experience), a delightful journey through Darjeeling’s scenic landscapes and colonial charm. Also visit the incredible and Batasia Loop, one of the oldest Tibetan Buddhist Monasteries in Darjeeling. Drive back to your hotel for a hearty breakfast after breakfast visit Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park, Himalayan Mountaineering Institute (closed on Thursday), Tea Garden (outer view), Japanese Peace Pagoda, & Tenzing rock. Overnight stay at a hotel in Darjeeling.
Hotel Yashshree Sanderling or similar (4*)

itinerary.title: Darjeeling to Gangtok
itinerary.description:
Today, after enjoying breakfast and checking out, begin your drive to Gangtok, the "Land of Peace" (100 km/4 hrs). Along the way, be treated to stunning views of the majestic mountains, the flowing Teesta River, lush green hills, and the beauty nature has to offer. Upon arrival in Gangtok, check in to the hotel and freshen up before heading out to explore. Visit the Namgyal Institute of Tibetology, the Do-Drul Chorten Stupa, Flower Park, and enjoy a ride on the Gangtok Ropeway Ride (tickets not included). After sightseeing, return to the hotel for an overnight stay in Gangtok.
Hotel Yashshree Blossom or Similar (4*)

itinerary.title: Gangtok - Lachung
itinerary.description:
In the morning, after breakfast, check out from the hotel and proceed to Lachung (120 km/6 hrs). Along the way, witness the beautiful Seven Sisters Waterfall, so keep your camera ready to capture every charming moment of nature and the majestic snow-capped peaks of the Himalayan range. In the evening, upon arrival, check in to the hotel and freshen up. Afterward, you have free time to explore the picturesque village. Overnight stay in Lachung.
Hotel Yashshree Lachung or Similar (4*)

itinerary.title: Excursion Day Trip to Yumthang Valley
itinerary.description:
Early in the morning, after breakfast, start your excursion to Yumthang Valley. En route, visit the Singba Rhododendron Sanctuary. The natural beauty of the Sivi Yumthang Valley is stunning and perfect for photography. Afterward explore Zero Point(availability of permits from army to weather & road conditions) which is near the Tibet border, at an altitude of 15,000 ft and located 23 km from Yumthang. Visit Yumthang Valley, situated at an altitude of 12,000 ft and about 135 km from Gangtok, snow generally covers the region from late November to March. After the excursion, return to Lachung for lunch (on your own) with a visit to Lachung Monastery(If time permits)and Spend the evening at leisure. Overnight stay at the hotel in Lachung.
Hotel Yashshree Lachung or Similar (4*)

itinerary.title: Lachung - Gangtok
itinerary.description:
In the morning, after breakfast, check out from the hotel and transfer to Gangtok ( 120 km / 7 hours). Gangtok, the capital of Sikkim, is a picturesque hill station nestled in the Eastern Himalayas. Known for its vibrant Buddhist culture, stunning views of Mount Kanchenjunga, and lush greenery, Gangtok offers a serene escape with a blend of natural beauty and urban charm. From monasteries to bustling markets, it's a perfect blend of tradition and modernity. Upon arrival, check in to the hotel and relax. Overnight stay at the hotel in Gangtok.
Hotel Yashshree Blossom or Similar (4*)

itinerary.title: Excursion of Nathula Pass & Tsomgo lake
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, proceed to Tsomgo Lake (12,210 ft.) and Baba Mandir, ( 40 km/2.5 hrs). The lake is located near Nathula Pass (availability of permits from army to weather & road conditions), part of the historic "Silk Route" to China, and remains frozen for most of the year. Tsomgo Lake is home to Brahminy ducks and various migratory birds. Nearby is the revered Baba Mandir, known for its spiritual significance. After sightseeing, return to the hotel for an overnight stay in Gangtok.
Hotel Yashshree Blossom or Similar (4*)

itinerary.title: Arrival in Jaisalmer
itinerary.description:
Arrive in Jaisalmer, famously known as the Golden City for its sweeping sand dunes and honey-hued sandstone architecture. Enjoy a seamless check-in at your hotel before heading out for a serene sunset visit to Gadisar Lake, offering picturesque views of the water and the adjacent Jaisalmer Fort. Conclude your evening with dinner and an overnight stay in Jaisalmer.
Rang Mahal, Jaisalmer (4*) or similar

itinerary.title: From Forts to Bada Bagh: Explore Jaisalmer
itinerary.description:
Following breakfast, set out for a full-day guided exploration of Jaisalmer’s timeless wonders. Begin at the majestic Jaisalmer Fort, a massive golden sandcastle and UNESCO World Heritage Site where history lives on within its bustling bazaars, ornate temples, and echoing stone pathways. Continue to Patwon Ki Haveli, a stunning ensemble of five historic mansions famous for their lace-like jharokha balconies, spacious corridors, and exquisite artwork from a bygone era. After savoring a traditional Rajasthani lunch (at extra cost) , head to Bada Bagh, a serene complex of royal memorials built by Maharawal Jait Singh in tribute to the region's valiant nobles. Enjoy a contemplative walk among the domed sandstone pavilions, where quiet desert breezes and scenic green surroundings create a deeply peaceful atmosphere. Return to your hotel as dusk settles for dinner and an overnight stay in Jaisalmer.
Rang Mahal, Jaisalmer (4*) or similar

itinerary.title: Adventures at Dhora
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, embark on a scenic drive to Dhora (approx. 3 hr 30 min), a secluded desert paradise nestled deep in the heart of the Thar Desert. This enchanting retreat invites you to disconnect from the world and immerse yourself in the vast wilderness and soul-soothing serenity of the dunes. Following lunch (at extra cost), check in to your camp and unwind amidst tranquil, windswept surroundings. As the afternoon cools, set out on a camel safari across the undulating golden sands to witness a mesmerizing desert sunset. Later, gather under a canopy of stars for an intimate cultural evening featuring soul-stirring traditional folk music and vibrant local dance. End your day with dinner and a comfortable overnight stay at the camp.
Dhora Desert Resort & Spa (4*) or similar

itinerary.title: Welcome to Jodhpur
itinerary.description:
Kick off your morning with an exhilarating desert jeep safari across the undulating Thar dunes—a thrilling hour-long ride with expert drivers over golden sands. After breakfast, check out and begin your journey to Jodhpur (approx. 2 hrs), famously known as the Blue City of Rajasthan for its striking sea of indigo-washed houses, temples, and historic havelis. Post lunch (on own), embark on a guided city tour starting with a deeper exploration of the mighty Mehrangarh Fort, one of Rajasthan’s largest and most formidable citadels. Continue to the Jaswant Thada, an architectural marvel crafted from intricately carved sheets of white marble, often referred to as the "Taj Mahal of Marwar." In the evening, gather for a memorable dinner at a local restaurant, toasting to the flavors and magic of Jodhpur. Overnight stay at the hotel.
Polo Heritage Hotel (3*) or similar

itinerary.title: Jashn-e-Sufiyana
itinerary.description:
After an early breakfast at the hotel, head back to the majestic Mehrangarh Fort for a full-day immersion in the World Sacred Spirit Festival. Bringing together extraordinary musicians, mystics, and poets from across the globe, this iconic celebration showcases the transcendent power of sacred music to unite communities, cultures, and creeds. Throughout the day, the towering sandstone courtyards and ancient ramparts of the fort reverberate with soul-stirring , hypnotic rhythms, and devotional melodies filled with ecstasy, joy, and spiritual euphoria. After a deeply moving day of music and cultural connection, transfer back to your hotel in the evening for a restful overnight stay in Jodhpur.
Polo Heritage Hotel (3*) or similar

itinerary.title: Jodhpur Sightseeing
itinerary.description:
For early risers wishing to experience the festival's dawn magic, begin your day with soul-stirring Sufi morning ragas as the first light illuminates the white-marble domes. Enjoy a packed breakfast before immersing yourself in late-morning folk, bhajan, and roots ensemble sessions at the fort. Afterward, break for lunch on your own transfer back to the hotel, rest and recharge. In the evening, return to Mehrangarh Fort for the grand finale and the high-energy Main Stage After-Party featuring master drummers and percussionists. Carrying the magic of soulful melodies and timeless heritage with you, transfer back to your hotel to unwind for an overnight stay in Jodhpur.
Polo Heritage Hotel (3*) or similar

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description:
Catch the final morning devotional concert at sunrise, or enjoy a leisurely breakfast at your hotel. After breakfast at the hotel, check out and transfer to Jodhpur Airport for your onward flight home, concluding your memorable Rajasthan journey.

itinerary.description:

Get ready for the next adventure! witness the majestic view of the Famous Abbey Falls. Later get ready for adventures off-roading ride to Mandalpatti Peak. The Peak is 4050 feet above the sea level and offers some of the exquisite views in South India. Mandalpatti Peak is famous for bumpy Jeep trails to witness stunning scenes of high Western Ghats. Head towards Raja's Seat. The place is called as Raja’s Seat because it was the place where Coorg’s kings used to visit and enjoy the scenic beauty around. The sunset and sunrise make for a mesmerising view which is worth captivating in your cameras. later get back at the stay. Bonfire, dinner. Rest !

Then we’ll head to the Elephant Camp to spend some time with the gentle giants. If time permits, we’ll also explore Nisargadhama. Later, enjoy some time at the local market to experience Coorg’s famous coffee and spices. Dinner and rest back at the stay!

itinerary.title: Coffee Plantation, Omkareshwar, Madikeri fort, Board your train

Widely known as ‘The Coffee County” a visit to Coorg incomplete without experiencing a walk through the coffee plantation trails. If time allows Visit Madikeri Fort. Then leave for mangalore station. itinerary.title: CHANDIGARH - JIBHI
itinerary.description: We will arrive in Chandigarh by 3-4 PM, where we will begin our scenic journey to Jibhi. Along the way, enjoy a lively atmosphere with engaging games and pleasant interactions, making the ride both fun and memorable. We are expected to reach Jibhi by 11 PM, where we will check in and unwind for the night, preparing for the adventures that lie ahead.

itinerary.title: EXPLORE JIBHI
itinerary.description: After a delicious breakfast, we will embark on a scenic exploration of Tirthan Valley. Our first stop will be the picturesque Jalori Pass, followed by a visit to the serene Serolsar Lake, nestled amidst stunning landscapes. In the evening, we will return to the hotel to relax and unwind, reflecting on the day’s adventures. (Breakfast & Dinner included)

itinerary.title: KASOL & PARVATI VALLEY EXPLORATION
itinerary.description:
Arrive in Kasol, After checking in and freshening up, it’s time to explore this vibrant town. Whether you’re fulfilling your travel dreams or simply relaxing, Kasol offers something for everyone. Spend the day chilling by the Parvati River,and indulge in local delicacies like Himachali momos, Maggi, and brownies.
Visit the Manikaran Gurudwara and experience the soothing hot springs. After a day of exploration at your own pace, regroup for dinner. Overnight stay in Kasol. (Breakfast + Dinner Included)

itinerary.title: KASOL TO MANALI VIA KULLU
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out and begin the journey to Manali. On the way, stop in Kullu for an exhilarating white water rafting experience. Arrive in Manali by evening and visit the Hadimba Devi Temple.
The rest of the evening is free for you to explore Mall Road and the famous cafes of Old Manali. Overnight stay in Manali. (Breakfast + Dinner Included)

itinerary.title: MANALI SIGHTSEEING

Start the day with a hearty breakfast before heading out to Solang Valley and the Atal Tunnel, weather permitting. Spend the morning enjoying adventure activities, and if time allows, visit the Vashisht Temple and its hot springs on the way back to Manali.
Return to the hotel by evening and relax for the rest of the day. Breakfast & Dinner included.

itinerary.title: EXPLORE BIR BILLING

Rise early for a chance to experience paragliding at Asia’s highest paragliding site, subject to weather conditions (at your own cost). Spend the rest of the day exploring Bir on Cycle/Bike (by your own) visiting Tibetan monasteries, hiking to nearby scenic spots, and enjoying cafe hopping. Later in the evening, embark on an overnight journey to Amritsar. (Breakfast included)

itinerary.title: (Saturday): Delhi to Shimla, overnight bus
itinerary.description:
Departure: 22:00 | Meals: none Your Spiti winter adventure begins in Delhi. Report at the pickup point Kashmere Gate at least 45 minutes before departure. Meet your fellow travellers and board the overnight Volvo AC bus to Shimla.
Tip: Keep a toothbrush, face wash and a warm layer in a small bag with you. You'll want them when you freshen up the next morning.

itinerary.title: Sunday: Shimla to Narkanda to Rampur to Sarahan
itinerary.description:
Shimla
+
170 km, 6–7 hrs | Meals: dinner | Stay: Sarahan
You reach Shimla early in the morning. Shimla to Shimla travellers join the group here. Board the Tempo Traveller and head up the old Hindustan–Tibet Road to Narkanda, a small hill town known for apple orchards and views of snow-capped peaks. Stop at a dhaba to freshen up and have breakfast (own cost).
The road then drops down to the Sutlej River and follows it to Rampur Bushahr, once the capital of the Bushahr princely state. From here, climb to Sarahan, home of the Bhimakali Temple. It's one of the 51 Shakti Peethas, built in a striking mix of Hindu and Buddhist styles with wood and stone.
Check in, then join the ice-breaker session with dinner.

itinerary.title: Monday: Sarahan to Karcham to Sangla
itinerary.description:
Sangla
+
95 km, 4–5 hrs | Meals: breakfast, dinner | Stay: Sangla
After breakfast, drive deeper into Kinnaur as the valley narrows and the mountains rise higher. Stop at Karcham, where the Baspa River meets the Sutlej at the Karcham Wangtoo dam. Then turn into the Baspa Valley towards Sangla.
Reach Sangla by early afternoon and spend a quiet evening in a village surrounded by snowy peaks, with the Baspa River rushing past below.
Note: If snow is likely to close the Sangla road, we'll stay in Kalpa instead.

itinerary.title: Tuesday: Sangla to Chitkul to Khab Sangam to Nako to Tabo
itinerary.description:
Tabo
+
200 km, 8–9 hrs | Meals: breakfast, dinner | Stay: Tabo
Start before dawn for Chitkul, the last inhabited village on the Indian side of the border with Tibet. Watch the sunrise light up the peaks around the Baspa River, and walk among the old wooden houses and the village temple.
Then head back down the valley and on towards Spiti. At
Khab, stop at the Khab Sangam, where the Spiti River meets the Sutlej, one of the most dramatic river meetings in the Himalayas. The road climbs past Nako, a high village with a small lake, and enters the Spiti Valley at Sumdo.
Reach
Tabo by evening and check in to your homestay for your first night in Spiti.

itinerary.title: Wednesday: Tabo to Dhankar to Langza to Komic to Hikkim to Kaza
itinerary.description:
Kaza
+
Full day of sightseeing | Meals: breakfast, dinner | Homestay: Kaza
Begin with Tabo Monastery, founded in 996 AD. It's one of the oldest working monasteries in the Himalayas, famous for its ancient murals and often called the "Ajanta of the Himalayas".
Drive on to Dhankar, the old capital of Spiti.
Dhankar Monastery sits on a cliff edge above the meeting point of the Spiti and Pin rivers.
Then climb above Kaza into the high villages:
Langza: a fossil village where rocks hold marine fossils millions of years old, watched over by a large Buddha statue facing the peaks Komic:
one of the highest villages in the world reachable by road, at about 4,500 m, with its old monastery. Lunch stop (own cost).
Hikkim: home to the world's highest post office, at about 4,400 m. Send a postcard home from here.
Descend to Kaza, Spiti's main town, and check in to your homestay.

itinerary.title: Thursday: Kaza sightseeing: Key Monastery, Kibber, Chicham Bridge
itinerary.description:
Kaza
+
Full day of sightseeing | Meals: breakfast, dinner | Stay: Kaza
Wake up to the snow-covered peaks around Kaza. After breakfast, drive to Key Monastery, the largest monastery in Spiti and about a thousand years old. It stands on a hill above the Spiti River and is an important training centre for Buddhist monks.
Continue up to Kibber, a high village at about 4,200 m on the edge of the Kibber Wildlife Sanctuary. In winter, snow leopards come down to lower slopes here, and Himalayan ibex and blue sheep are often spotted.
Finish at Chicham Bridge, Asia's highest bridge, which spans a deep gorge between Kibber and Chicham villages. Return to Kaza for dinner.

itinerary.title: Friday: Kaza to Nako to Khab to Kalpa
itinerary.description:
Kalpa
+
200 km, 8–9 hrs | Meals: breakfast, dinner | Stay: Kalpa
Leave Kaza after breakfast and drive back down the Spiti Valley, passing Tabo, Sumdo and Nako (drive past). Take in one last view of the Spiti and Sutlej rivers meeting at Khab.
Reach
Kalpa, a village above Reckong Peo with orchards and a full view of the Kinner Kailash range. In the evening, visit Suicide Point, a sheer drop with views over the valley. It's much safer than the name suggests, but stay behind the railing.

itinerary.title: Saturday: Kalpa to Kufri to Shimla, overnight bus to Delhi
itinerary.description:
Shimla
+
230 km, 9–10 hrs | Meals: breakfast After breakfast, begin the long drive back along the Sutlej through Kinnaur. Pass
Narkanda and Kufri, and reach Shimla in the evening. Shimla to Shimla travellers leave the group here.
Delhi travellers board the overnight Volvo AC bus from Shimla at 8:00PM approx.

itinerary.title: Sunday: Arrive in Delhi, trip ends
itinerary.description:
Delhi Kashmeri Gate
+
Arrival: 8:00 AM
Reach Delhi early in the morning at the same drop points as pickup. Say goodbye to your group and take home memories of a snowy Spiti winter that few travellers ever see.

itinerary.title: Rishikesh to Tugasi Base Camp (drive)
itinerary.description:
Rishikesh
+
Pickup 7:00 am, 60s Tapovan Cafe, Rishikesh · 255 km · 9–10 hours · Tugasi ≈ 8,000 ft / 2,450 m Meet your group at 60s Tapovan Cafe in Tapovan, Rishikesh. The bus leaves at 7:00 am sharp. If you are travelling alone, this is where you meet the people you will share the next five days with.
The road follows the Ganga upstream and then the Alaknanda, passing four of the five sacred river confluences of Garhwal: Devprayag, Rudraprayag, Karnaprayag and Nandprayag. We stop for breakfast and lunch along the way. After Chamoli the road climbs to Joshimath, and a short drive beyond it brings you to Tugasi village by around 5 pm.
Settle into your tent at base camp. In the evening your trek leader gives a briefing on the days ahead, checks your gear and medical certificate, and records everyone's first oxygen and pulse reading. Go to bed early, because you have climbed nearly 7,000 ft by road today.
Meals: Dinner at camp (breakfast and lunch on the road are at your own cost)
Stay: Tents at Tugasi base camp

itinerary.title: Tugasi to Gulling (trek)
itinerary.description:
Tugasi
+
Start ≈ 8,000 ft · 3 km · 2–3 hours · Gain ≈ 1,400 ft · Gulling ≈ 9,400 ft / 2,850 m After breakfast, the trek begins from Tugasi. The trail leaves the village past terraced fields and village houses and soon enters the forest. Mt Dronagiri rises above the valley.
This is a short day, but it is the steepest climb on the trek. You gain about 1,400 ft in just 3 km, crossing small streams on the way. Walk slowly, at a pace where you can still talk, and keep drinking water.
You reach Gulling camp by around lunchtime. Use the afternoon to rest and let your body adjust to the height. Your trek leader may take you for a short walk above camp, which helps with acclimatisation. Evening tea, then dinner.
Meals: Breakfast, lunch, evening snacks, dinner Stay:
Tents at Gulling

itinerary.title: Gulling to Khullara (trek)
itinerary.description:
Gulling
+
Start ≈ 9,400 ft · 6 km · 5–6 hours · Gain ≈ 1,600 ft · Khullara ≈ 11,000 ft / 3,350 m Today is longer but gentler. The trail climbs steadily through oak and rhododendron forest. In spring the rhododendrons are in bloom; in winter the forest floor is white.
As you gain height, the trees thin out and the mountains start to show through the gaps. Near the treeline the forest opens into the wide meadow of Khullara. In front of you are Dronagiri, Hathi Parvat and Ghori Parvat.
Khullara is the coldest camp on the trek, so put on your warm layers as soon as you arrive. If the sky is clear, step out after dinner for a few minutes: the night sky at Khullara is full of stars.
Meals: Breakfast, lunch, evening snacks, dinner Stay:
Tents at Khullara

itinerary.title: Khullara to Kuari Pass and Back (summit day)
itinerary.description:
Khullara
+
Start ≈ 11,000 ft · 8–10 km round trip · 5–6 hours · Gain ≈ 1,500 ft · Kuari Pass 12,516 ft / 3,815 m Summit day starts early, because the morning sky is clearest. Leave your big backpack in the tent and carry only a daypack with water, snacks, a warm layer and your rain jacket.
The first 1 to 1.5 hours out of Khullara are a steep climb up the slope above camp. As you reach the ridge, the big peaks of Garhwal line up across the horizon. From here a gentler walk of about 40 minutes brings you to Kuari Pass, a wide, open saddle at 12,516 ft.
From the pass you see Nanda Devi, the highest mountain entirely within India, with Kamet, Dronagiri, Chaukhamba, Trishul, Hathi Parvat and Ghori Parvat around it. Lord Curzon stood here in 1905, and so did the explorers Shipton and Tilman in 1934. Spend time at the top for photos, then walk back down the same trail to Khullara by early afternoon. Because you sleep at the same camp again, there is no packing up and you have the evening to rest.
In winter the upper trail is under snow. We provide microspikes and gaiters, and your trek leader decides how far the group goes based on snow and weather.
Meals: Breakfast, lunch, evening snacks, dinner Stay:
Tents at Khullara (second night)

itinerary.title: Khullara to Tugasi (trek), drive to Rishikesh
itinerary.description:
Rishikesh
+
9 km downhill · about 4 hours · Descent ≈ 3,000 ft · Reach Tugasi by 11:00 am · 255 km drive · Drop around 9:00 pm An early breakfast and an early start: the group needs to reach Tugasi by 11 am to make the drive back the same day. The trail retraces your route down through the forest via Gulling. Going down is quicker but harder on the knees, so use your trekking pole and take small steps on the steep sections.
From Tugasi, the bus drives back down the Alaknanda valley to Rishikesh. You are dropped at 60s Tapovan Cafe around 9:00 pm, five days after you set out as strangers. Book any onward train, bus or flight for the next day, because mountain roads can be slow.
Meals: Breakfast at Khullara (lunch and dinner on the road are at your own cost)
Note: the itinerary can change because of weather, snow, road conditions or the health of the group. Your trek leader makes the final decision on the day, with everyone's safety first.

itinerary.title: Dehradun to Sankri
itinerary.description:
Dehradun
+
Drive: 8 to 9 hours, about 239 km Sankri altitude:
1,967 m / 6,455 ft Stay: Guesthouse in Sankri
Meals: Dinner
Pickup is at 7 am from Prince Chowk, near Dehradun Railway Station. The road runs through Mussoorie, Purola and Mori, then follows the Tons River valley to Sankri. You reach Sankri by evening and meet your trek leader for a briefing on the days ahead. If you booked the Sankri package, report at the guesthouse by 6 pm.

itinerary.title: Sankri
itinerary.description:
+
Trek: 4 km, 4 to 5 hours Altitude:
1,967 m to 2,775 m (6,455 ft to 9,100 ft)
Stay: Tents at Juda ka Talab
Meals: Breakfast, lunch, dinner This is the steepest climb of the trek, gaining about 800 m. The trail leaves Sankri through village fields, then climbs steadily through pine and oak forest, crossing small streams. You camp beside Juda ka Talab, a lake that often freezes over from late December to February.

itinerary.title: Juda Ka Talab
itinerary.description:
+
Trek: 2.5 km, 3 to 4 hours Altitude:
2,775 m to 3,430 m (9,100 ft to 11,250 ft)
Stay: Tents at Kedarkantha base camp Meals:
Breakfast, lunch, dinner A short day, so your body can adjust to the altitude. The forest thins into open meadows and shepherd huts, and the summit ridge comes into view. You reach base camp by early afternoon. Your trek leader checks everyone's fitness and oxygen levels before summit day.

itinerary.title: Kedakantha Base Camp
itinerary.description:
+
Trek: About
[X] km, 7 to 8 hours Altitude:
3,430 m to 3,810 m (11,250 ft to 12,500 ft), then down to Hargaon at 2713 m ( 8900 feet)
Stay: Tents at Hargaon
Meals: Breakfast, packed lunch, dinner You start at 2 am to reach the summit for sunrise. The final climb is steep and usually under snow, which is where the microspikes and gaiters are needed. From the top you see Swargarohini, Bandarpoonch, Black Peak and the Kinner Kailash range, with the Har Ki Dun valley below. After the summit you descend to Hargaon, a wide meadow campsite.

itinerary.title: Dehradun
itinerary.description:
+
Trek: 4 km, 2 to 3 hours Drive:
8 to 9 hours to Dehradun
Meals: Breakfast
A gentle descent through forest brings you back to Sankri by late morning, and the drive to Dehradun starts from there. Expected drop at Prince Chowk is 7 pm. If you're travelling home the same night, book trains or flights after 8 pm, or plan to stay overnight in Dehradun.

itinerary.title: Delhi to Dharamshala
itinerary.description:
The trip leaves Akshardham Metro Station in Delhi at 9:00 PM on Friday. The AC Tempo Traveller covers about 500 km overnight and reaches Dharamshala in the morning, 10 to 12 hours later.
Dharamshala is the headquarters of Kangra district and the winter capital of Himachal Pradesh. The town sits on a spur of the Dhauladhar range in two parts. Lower Dharamshala, at around 1,380 m, is the busy commercial centre, with the HPCA stadium and the tea gardens nearby. Upper Dharamshala includes McLeodganj, Bhagsu and Dharamkot. It became a hill station under British rule, and much of the old cantonment was destroyed in the Kangra earthquake of 1905.

itinerary.title: Bhagsunag temple and waterfall
itinerary.description:
Bhagsu, also called Bhagsunag, is a village about 2 km from McLeodganj, at around 1,800 m. Its old temple is dedicated to Bhagsu Nath, a form of Lord Shiva. A short walk beyond the temple brings you to Bhagsu waterfall, about 20 m high, which is fullest during and just after the monsoon. The rocks around the falls are slippery, so wear shoes with a good grip.
McLeodganj, named after Sir Donald Friell McLeod, a Lieutenant Governor of Punjab under British rule, is the heart of upper Dharamshala. Its main square is at about 1,750 m (5,750 ft). In 1960 the 14th Dalai Lama and the Tibetan government-in-exile settled here, which is why it’s known as Little Lhasa.
Tsuglagkhang complex and Namgyal Monastery:
the main temple complex of McLeodganj. Tsuglagkhang, the Dalai Lama’s temple, holds statues of Shakyamuni Buddha, Avalokiteshvara and Padmasambhava. Namgyal Monastery, inside the complex, is the personal monastery of the 14th Dalai Lama.
McLeodganj market: the lanes around the main square sell Tibetan handicrafts, thangka paintings, carpets and woollens. Cafés serve momos, thukpa and Tibetan bread.

itinerary.title: Triund
itinerary.description:
Triund is a grassy ridge on the Dhauladhar range, directly above McLeodganj. It’s not a village: apart from a few tea stalls and an old Forest Rest House, built by the British forest department in 1899–1900, it’s open ground with a view. Gaddi shepherds still use it as a halt on the way to Indrahar Pass in summer.
Altitude: about 2,850 m (9,350 ft)
Start of the trek: Galu Devi temple above Dharamkot, about 2,100 m. A second trail climbs from Bhagsu and joins it below Magic View Café.
Distance: about 5.5 km one way from Galu Devi temple (11 km return), or about 9 km one way if you walk from McLeodganj
Climb: about 750 m from Galu Devi temple Time:
around 5 hours up at a relaxed group pace with breaks, 2 to 3 hours down Difficulty:
easy to moderate. The trail climbs gently through oak, deodar and rhododendron forest for about 4 km, with a tea stop at Magic View Café (about 2,400 m). Then the last kilometre, known as the 22 curves, climbs steeply over rocks to the ridge.
Entry and camping: the Forest Department charges an entry fee at the Gallu check post, where every trekker registers. It allows up to 40 people and 20 tents on the ridge overnight.
From the top, the Dhauladhar rises about 1,800 m straight up behind camp to Moon Peak (4,650 m), with Indrahar Pass (4,342 m), the crossing into Chamba, to its left. To the south, the Kangra Valley stretches out below. Sunset over the valley is the reason to stay the night, and on clear nights the sky is full of stars. In spring, rhododendrons flower red and pink along the trail, and the forest is full of Himalayan birds.

itinerary.title: Back down to Bhagsunag
itinerary.description:
After sunrise and breakfast on top, the group walks back down past Magic View Café and takes the trail to Bhagsu. It’s 2 to 3 hours downhill, reaching Bhagsunag in the afternoon, in time for a late lunch.
Tea has been grown in the Kangra Valley since the mid-19th century. Production peaked in the late 1800s, when Kangra tea was sold across north-west India and exported to Central Asia, and fell after the 1905 earthquake. Kangra tea got a Geographical Indication tag in 2005. The gardens lie around lower Dharamshala, with the Dhauladhar behind the rows of tea bushes.
The Himachal Pradesh Cricket Association Stadium is about 8 km below McLeodganj, 25 to 30 minutes by road. It’s the home ground of the Himachal Pradesh cricket team, has hosted IPL matches as a home ground for Punjab Kings, and hosted five matches of the 2023 Cricket World Cup. It’s best known for the snow-capped peaks behind the stands.

itinerary.title: Back to Delhi
itinerary.description:
The overnight drive leaves in the evening on Day 4 and reaches Akshardham Metro Station at about 8:00 AM on Tuesday.
Best time to visit McLeodganj and Triund
McLeodganj is open all year. The Triund trek is open all year too, except on days when winter weather orders close it.
October and November (best):
dry, clear days and the sharpest views of the Dhauladhar. Nights at Triund fall to about 4 °C in October and just below freezing in November.
December to February (snow):
McLeodganj is cold but often sunny, and Triund is usually under snow from late December, with nights at −5 to −7 °C. The Kangra administration can close the trail on bad-weather days, and everything above 3,000 m is closed under its winter orders.
March and April (spring):
rhododendrons flower along the trail. Early March can still bring snow at Triund.
May and June (summer): McLeodganj is a cool escape from the plains, at 26 to 27 °C by day, and weekends are busy. Batches from April to June cost ₹1,000 more.
July to mid-September (monsoon):
Dharamshala is one of the wettest places in Himachal. It rains on most days, the trail is slippery and clouds hide the peaks.
