itinerary.title: Dehradun to Sankri
itinerary.description:
Distance
About 190 to 200 km (8 to 10 hrs drive)
Altitude
About 1,450 ft to 6,400 ft Meals
Evening snacks and dinner Stay
Sankri hotel, shared Leader tip:
Prone to motion sickness? Take a tablet prescribed by your doctor about 30 minutes before the drive.
Meet us at Prince Chowk, Dehradun, at 6:30 AM. The drive to Sankri is about 190 to 200 km and takes 8 to 10 hours, through Mussoorie, Purola, Mori and the Tons valley. We stop for tea and photos on the way. Please carry snacks for lunch on the road.
The road climbs out of the Doon valley and follows the Tons river through pine forest and villages of wooden houses. You reach Sankri (6,400 ft), the last big village before the trek. We serve tea, snacks and dinner, and your trek leader briefs the group on the route and the weather.
Charge your phone and power bank tonight. The network is weak at Sankri and there is no charging on the trail.

itinerary.title: Sankri to Dharkot, then trek to Osla via Gangar
itinerary.description:
Altitude
Osla about 9,000 ft Meals
Breakfast, packed lunch, evening snacks and dinner Stay
Homestay, Osla
Drive
About 16 km, Sankri to Dharkot (about 1 hr)
Trek
About 4 km (3 to 4 hrs)
Leader tip: Walk slowly, drink water and keep rain gear and a warm layer in your daypack.
After breakfast we drive about 16 km from Sankri to Dharkot, where the walk begins. The trail follows forest and riverside paths through Gangar village to Osla. It is about 4 km and 3 to 4 hours of easy to moderate walking.
Osla is a traditional Garhwali village of wooden houses. It has a Someshwar temple, and local people worship Duryodhana as a local deity. You spend the night in a village homestay, which is a good way to see how people live here.
This is a short day on purpose. It starts your acclimatisation, so walk slowly and drink water.

itinerary.title: Osla to Boslo
itinerary.description:
Altitude
Boslo about 10,400 ft Meals
Breakfast, packed lunch, evening snacks and dinner Stay
Boslo campsite, twin sharing tents Trek
About 8 km (6 to 7 hrs)
Leader tip: Trekking poles help on the steep and rocky sections. Carry quick-energy snacks.
This is the first long day, about 8 km and 6 to 7 hours. The trail leaves Osla and climbs through steep ascents, rocky sections and narrow paths to the high meadow at Boslo.
As you gain height you see the Swargarohini peaks and the valley below, and Hata Peak comes into view near Boslo. Camp is at Boslo, in twin sharing tents.
Keep warm layers, water and snacks in your daypack. Trekking poles help on the rocky parts.
Highest point of the trek

itinerary.title: Boslo to Har Ki Dun and Maninda Lake, back to camp
itinerary.description:
Altitude
Har Ki Dun about 11,600 ft; Maninda Lake about 12,500 ft Meals
Breakfast, lunch, evening snacks and dinner Stay
Boslo campsite, twin sharing tents Trek
About 9 km (6 to 7 hrs)
Leader tip: Start early and turn back on time if the weather changes. Follow your trek leader at all times.
This is the highlight of the trek, about 9 km and 6 to 7 hours. The trail from Boslo to Har Ki Dun is gradual and goes through alpine meadows. The valley opens up below Swargarohini, with Hata Peak and the Jaundhar glacier area in view.
From here we continue to Maninda Lake, a glacial lake at about 12,500 ft. This stretch is steeper and rockier, so watch your footing. Then we walk back to camp for the night.
Go slowly at this height. Carry only water, rain gear, sunscreen and a first aid kit in your daypack.
A short halt every 40 to 50 minutes, with water and a snack, makes the 900 ft climb easier on your body.

itinerary.title: Har Ki Dun to Devsu Thatch
itinerary.description:
Altitude
Devsu Thatch about 10,200 ft Meals
Breakfast, packed lunch, evening snacks and dinner Stay
Devsu Thatch, twin sharing tents Trek
About 8 km (4 to 5 hrs)
Leader tip: Use poles on the descent to protect your knees, and keep rain gear handy.
We start the return today. We walk about 8 km and 4 to 5 hours from Har Ki Dun back through Boslo and on to Devsu Thatch. The path is mostly a gentle descent, with some rocky and uneven sections through meadow and forest.
Camp is at Devsu Thatch, in twin sharing tents.

itinerary.title: Devsu Thatch to Dharkot, then drive to Sankri
itinerary.description:
Altitude
Devsu Thatch about 10,200 ft down to Sankri at 6,400 ft Meals
Breakfast, lunch, evening snacks and dinner Stay
Sankri hotel, shared Trek
About 10 km (4 to 5 hrs)
Drive
About 16 km, Dharkot to Sankri (about 1 hr)
Leader tip: Careful footing helps on the uneven and rocky sections before Dharkot.
The last trekking day is about 10 km and 4 to 5 hours, down through mountain trails, forest and valley to Dharkot. A vehicle then takes us about 16 km to Sankri for the night. You can wash up, rest and share a last evening meal with the group.

itinerary.title: Sankri to Dehradun
itinerary.description:
Distance
About 190 to 200 km (8 to 10 hrs drive)
Altitude
6,400 ft to about 1,450 ft Meals
Morning tea or coffee only Leader tip:
Keep your onward travel for the next day, because mountain roads can run late.
After morning tea or coffee we drive from Sankri back to Dehradun, about 190 to 200 km, through Mori, Purola, Naugaon, Damta and Mussoorie. The scenery changes from pine and deodar forest to the greener lower hills.
We are expected back in Dehradun between 5 PM and 6 PM, and the trek ends there.

itinerary.title: Rishikesh to Sari
itinerary.description:
Drive
About 190 km, Rishikesh to Sari (7 to 8 hrs)
Meals
Evening tea, snacks and dinner Altitude
Rishikesh about 1,100 ft to Sari 6,560 ft Stay
Guesthouse, Sari
Leader tip: Drink plenty of water on the drive and take a short walk in the evening.
We pick you up from Natraj Chowk, Rishikesh, and drive about 190 km to Sari village. The road follows the Ganga and the Alaknanda rivers, passes Devprayag and Rudraprayag, and then turns up the Mandakini valley. The drive takes 7 to 8 hours with stops.
We reach Sari in the evening and check in at the guesthouse. You get evening tea, snacks and dinner. Your trek leader gives a briefing and checks your documents and gear. Sleep early, because Day 2 starts early.
Highest point of the trek

itinerary.title: Sari to Chopta, then trek to Tungnath and Chandrashila and back to Sari
itinerary.description:
Drive
Sari to Chopta and back (about 1 to 1.5 hrs each way)
Trek
About 10 km there and back (6 to 8 hrs)
Meals
Breakfast, lunch, evening snacks and dinner Altitude
Chopta about 9,000 ft up to Chandrashila 12,083 ft Stay
Guesthouse, Sari
Leader tip: Start slowly and keep a warm layer and rain jacket in your daypack. The top is windy.
After an early breakfast we drive to Chopta, where the trek starts. The paved path climbs through meadow and rhododendron forest for about 3.5 km to the Tungnath temple at about 12,073 ft. This takes about 2 hours.
From the temple a steeper path climbs about 1.5 km to Chandrashila at about 12,083 ft. On a clear day you see Nanda Devi, Trisul, Kedarnath and Chaukhamba. We stay for a short time, take photos and walk back down to Chopta, then drive to Sari for dinner.
The whole day is about 10 km on foot and 6 to 8 hours. If the weather or snow is bad, your leader may change the plan or turn the group back. Safety comes first.
Plan on about 6 to 8 hours of steady walking, with the effort concentrated in the 3,083 ft of height gain.

itinerary.title: Sari to Deoriatal (optional) and drive to Rishikesh
itinerary.description:
Drive
About 190 km, Sari to Rishikesh (7 to 8 hrs)
Trek
Optional: about 2.5 km each way to Deoriatal (about 1.5 hrs each way)
Meals
Breakfast only Altitude
Sari 6,560 ft, Deoriatal 7,810 ft, Rishikesh about 1,100 ft Leader tip:
Book your onward travel for the next day. Mountain roads can run late.
After breakfast you can join the optional walk from Sari to Deoriatal lake, about 2.5 km each way and about 1.5 hours each way. The lake is at about 7,810 ft, and on a clear morning the Chaukhamba peaks show in the water. The Deoriatal walk costs ₹500 extra.
We then drive about 190 km back to Rishikesh, which takes 7 to 8 hours with a lunch stop at your own cost. We drop you at Natraj Chowk in the evening, so please book your onward travel for the next day.

itinerary.title: Dehradun to Raithal
itinerary.description:
Altitude
Dehradun about 1,500 ft to Raithal 7,100 ft Meals
Evening snacks and dinner Stay
Guesthouse, Raithal
Drive
About 184 km, Dehradun to Raithal (8 to 9 hrs)
Leader tip: Drink plenty of water on the drive and sleep early. Day 2 starts after breakfast.
We drive about 184 km from Dehradun to Raithal, a village near Uttarkashi. The drive takes 8 to 9 hours with stops on the way. If you book our vehicle, pickup is from Prince Chowk, Dehradun, at 6:30 AM.
We reach Raithal in the evening and check in at the guesthouse. You get evening snacks and dinner, and your trek leader gives a briefing and checks your gear.
Raithal is at about 7,100 ft, so you start getting used to the height. Drink water and sleep early.

itinerary.title: Raithal to Gui
itinerary.description:
Altitude
7,100 ft to 9,500 ft Meals
Breakfast at Raithal, lunch, evening snacks and dinner Stay
Dome tents, Gui
Trek
About 4 to 4.5 km (4 to 5 hrs)
Leader tip: Walk slowly and drink water. The walk is short, so use the afternoon to rest.
After breakfast we walk from Raithal through the village fields and into a forest of oak and rhododendron. The trail climbs steadily for about 4 to 4.5 km. It takes 4 to 5 hours at an easy pace.
We reach the Gui campsite at about 9,500 ft and set up camp in a clearing in the forest. This is a short day on purpose. It starts your acclimatisation, so rest well in the afternoon.
Plan on about 4 to 5 hours of steady walking, with the effort concentrated in the 2,400 ft of height gain.
Highest point of the trek

itinerary.title: Gui to Dayara Bugyal top and back to Gui
itinerary.description:
Altitude
9,500 ft up to about 12,100 ft, then back to 9,500 ft Meals
Early breakfast, packed lunch, evening snacks and dinner Stay
Dome tents, Gui
Trek
About 10 km there and back (about 8 hrs)
Leader tip: Start early, keep a warm layer and rain jacket in your daypack, and turn back if your leader says the weather is bad.
We start early with a hot breakfast and a packed lunch. The trail climbs through forest and then opens into the Dayara Bugyal meadow. The climb is about 2,600 ft in all.
At the top you get wide views of Bandarpoonch, Black Peak and the Gangotri peaks on a clear day. We spend time on the meadow and then walk back down to Gui for dinner. The day is about 10 km and 8 hours.
In bad weather the leader may shorten the walk or turn back. Safety comes first.
At 12,100 ft the air is about 5.2°C cooler than at 9,500 ft, so keep your warm layer at the top of your daypack.

itinerary.title: Gui to Raithal and drive to Dehradun
itinerary.description:
Altitude
9,500 ft down to 7,100 ft Meals
Breakfast at Gui, lunch at Raithal
Trek
About 4 to 4.5 km (4 to 5 hrs)
Drive
About 184 km, Raithal to Dehradun (8 to 9 hrs)
Leader tip: Use your trekking poles on the descent. Book your onward travel for the next day.
After breakfast at Gui we walk about 4 to 4.5 km down to Raithal, which takes 4 to 5 hours. We have lunch at Raithal and then start the drive of about 184 km back to Dehradun.
We reach Dehradun around 8 PM to 9 PM, so please book your onward travel for the next day.

itinerary.title: MUMBAI TO DELHI | Board the Train & Meet the Tribe 🚆
itinerary.description: Board the train from Mumbai to Delhi (Mumbai to Mumbai 3AC Train CNF or RAC ticket provided). Meet your fellow travellers and trip captain at the railway station. Kick off the journey with fun ice-breaking games, conversations, music, and new friendships! Included Today: Meetup & Ice Breaking games session. Meals: Not Included.

itinerary.title: DELHI TO SHIMLA | Overnight Semi-Sleeper AC Volvo 🚍
itinerary.description: Arrive in Delhi and assemble at Kashmiri Gate / R K Ashram boarding point. Our exciting journey to Shimla begins at 8:00 PM. Get ready to board our Semi-Sleeper AC Volvo bus for an overnight ride to the enchanting Queen of Hills. Relax, unwind, and enjoy the winding mountain roads as we ascend towards Himachal. Meals: Not Included.

itinerary.title: SHIMLA TO CHITKUL | Journey to the Last Village of India 🏡
itinerary.description: As the first light of day breaks, we arrive in Shimla, and the real Himalayan adventure begins! Hit the road in our dedicated tempo traveler as we journey from Shimla to the mystical Chitkul. Follow the Sutlej River, taking a thrilling turn towards Chitkul along the mesmerizing Baspa River. Chitkul, the last inhabited village before the Indo-China border, awaits us for an unforgettable overnight stay. Enjoy a piping hot, delicious dinner in the quaint village of Chitkul. Meals: Dinner Included.

itinerary.title: CHITKUL TO TABO | Baspa River, Last Dhaba & Khab Sangam 🍲
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head out to explore the picturesque Chitkul village. Trek down to the Baspa riverside or enjoy some hot Maggi at the "Hindustan ka Aakhri Dhaba" (Last Dhaba of India). Move towards Tabo, halting on the way at Khab Sangam (confluence of Sutlej and Spiti rivers). Arrive in Tabo and check into our warm, welcoming homestay. Enjoy a delicious, freshly prepared local home-cooked meal. Meals: Breakfast & Dinner Included.

itinerary.title: TABO TO KAZA VIA DHANKAR | 1,025-Year-Old Monastery & Cliffs 🛕
itinerary.description: Tabo, with its 1,025-year-old history, holds ancient Himalayan secrets waiting to be uncovered. Today, dive into the village's soul, exploring its meditation caves and the awe-inspiring Tabo Monastery. Our journey then takes us to the dramatic cliffside Dhankar Monastery before we head to Kaza, the heart of Spiti. Arrive in Kaza, where we will spend the following three days. Check-in at our homestay and savor a warm group dinner. Meals: Breakfast & Dinner Included.

itinerary.title: KAZA, LANGZA, HIKKIM & KOMIC | World's Highest Post Office 📮
itinerary.description: After enjoying delicious local breakfast at the homestay, get ready to explore the highest post office of the world in Hikkim (14,567 ft). Post handwritten letters with official postal stamps to your loved ones from the top of the world. Visit Komic Village (15,027 ft) — the world's highest motorable village. Explore Langza, the fossil village of India, guarded by the iconic giant Golden Buddha statue overlooking snow peaks. Come back to Kaza by evening, explore the vibrant local market, and enjoy dinner at the stay. Meals: Breakfast & Dinner Included.

itinerary.title: KEY MONASTERY TO CHICHAM | Asia's Highest Bridge & Kibber 🌉
itinerary.description: Prepare for awe-inspiring sights today as we visit the famous Key Monastery, perched high on a conical hill with a history dating back to the 11th century. Interact with Buddhist monks, explore the ancient murals, and soak in panoramic views of the Spiti valley. After Key, cross the incredible Chicham Bridge — Asia's highest suspension bridge at 13,596 ft. Our journey takes us to Kibber village, world-famous for snow leopard sightings. Come back to Kaza and enjoy some warm, local home-cooked dinner. Meals: Breakfast & Dinner Included.

itinerary.title: KAZA TO KALPA | Scenic Drive via Nako Village 🏔️
itinerary.description: Our last morning in Kaza invites us to take a leisurely walk through town, soaking in the breathtaking scenery one last time. Hit the road to reach Kalpa via the picturesque Nako village and sacred Nako lake. Get ready for an overnight stay in Kalpa, surrounded by awe-inspiring vistas of the sacred Kinner Kailash range. Enjoy dinner and rest at our hotel in Kalpa. Meals: Breakfast & Dinner Included.

itinerary.title: KALPA TO SHIMLA & DEPARTURE TO DELHI | Suicide Point 📸
itinerary.description: Wake up to the serene beauty of Kalpa and enjoy a hearty breakfast with a majestic mountain view. Explore Kalpa, visit the nearby Suicide Point, and capture stunning photographs and Instagram-worthy reels. As we bid farewell to Kalpa, we will make our way back to Delhi via Shimla, cherishing the memories of an unforgettable journey. Board our overnight Volvo bus from Shimla to Delhi. Meals: Breakfast Included.

itinerary.title: ARRIVAL DELHI TO MUMBAI | Return with Lifetime Memories 🚆
itinerary.description: Arrive in Delhi early morning, carrying a heart full of memories and a bunch of new friends. Head to the railway station and board your 3AC train back to Mumbai. Trip concludes with hugs, smiles, unforgettable stories, and a lifelong Travel Tribe bond. Meals: Not Included.

itinerary.title: Mumbai to Jodhpur – Journey Begins
itinerary.description: Meet your tour guide and fellow travellers at Dadar Railway Station at 2:00 PM. Board train 20484 DDR BGKT SF and begin your journey towards Rajasthan. Enjoy scenic views of mountains and lakes along the way. Interact with fellow travellers and enjoy group games such as UNO and housie. Overnight journey by train.

itinerary.title: Jodhpur – Blue City Tour
itinerary.description: Arrive in Jodhpur at approximately 7:20 AM. Transfer your luggage to the tour bus. Check in to the hotel, enjoy breakfast, and take some time to relax. Explore Mehrangarh Fort and Jaswant Thada. Visit the Blue Corridor at your own expense, if time permits. In the evening, stroll around the Clock Tower area and explore Sardar Market. Enjoy dinner and an overnight stay in Jodhpur.

itinerary.title: Jodhpur to Jaisalmer – Golden Sands & Desert Camping
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast and begin your journey to Jaisalmer, approximately 5 hours away. Stop at the abandoned village of Kuldhara en route. Continue to Sam Village and check in to the desert camp. Experience a camel ride and jeep safari across the desert. Enjoy traditional dance performances and a DJ night at the camp. Relish dinner and spend the night under the desert sky.

itinerary.title: Jaisalmer – Golden City Exploration
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast at the desert camp. Explore Jaisalmer’s famous attractions, including Patwon Ki Haveli and Jaisalmer Fort. Visit Gadisar Lake and admire the surrounding architecture. Enjoy an optional boat ride at Gadisar Lake at your own expense. Have dinner organised by the tour operator. Begin the overnight journey to Jaipur, approximately 10 hours.

itinerary.title: Jaipur – Pink City & New Year Celebration
itinerary.description: Arrive in Jaipur early in the morning. Check in to the hotel, freshen up, and enjoy breakfast. Rest and prepare for a day of exploring the Pink City. Visit the magnificent Hawa Mahal, also known as the Palace of Winds. Explore City Palace, showcasing Rajasthani and Mughal architecture. Visit Jantar Mantar, the historic astronomical observatory. Return to the hotel and get ready for the New Year celebration. Enjoy a rooftop party featuring a gala dinner, DJ night, and fireworks. Celebrate the New Year with music, festive vibes, and fellow travellers. Overnight stay in Jaipur.

itinerary.title: Jaipur – Forts, Palaces & Local Markets
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast and begin another day of Jaipur sightseeing. Visit the majestic Amer Fort, located on a hilltop. Stop at Jal Mahal, the beautiful Water Palace situated in Man Sagar Lake. Visit Birla Temple. Explore the exterior of Albert Museum Hall. If time permits, shop at Bapu Bazaar. Enjoy dinner and an overnight stay in Jaipur.

itinerary.title: Jaipur to Udaipur – Kishangarh & Nathdwara
itinerary.description: Begin the journey to Udaipur, approximately 8 hours away. Stop at Kishangarh Snow Yard, a photogenic attraction in Rajasthan. Visit Nathdwara and see the famous Statue of Belief. Enjoy the light and sound show at Nathdwara. Arrive in Udaipur and check in to the hotel. Enjoy dinner and an overnight stay in Udaipur.

itinerary.title: Udaipur – City Tour & Return Journey
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast and check out from the hotel. Visit Karni Mata Mandir via ropeway. Enjoy views of Lake Pichola and opt for boating at your own expense. Explore City Palace and its museum. Have lunch at a café near Lake Pichola at your own expense. Visit Gangaur Ghat. Explore Jagdish Temple and Hathipole Market. Visit Saheliyon Ki Badi if time permits. Proceed to Udaipur Railway Station and board train 22902 towards Mumbai. Overnight journey by train.

itinerary.title: Return to Mumbai
itinerary.description: Arrive at Mumbai Bandra Terminus at approximately 1:25 PM. Conclude your Rajasthan New Year Special journey with wonderful memories and new friendships. Trip ends with a heart full of memories!

itinerary.title: Mumbai to Chandigarh – The Journey Begins
itinerary.description: Meet your tour guide and fellow travellers at the railway station by 10:00 AM. Board the 12925 Paschim Express towards Amritsar. Settle in for your train journey and enjoy the changing landscapes along the way. Get to know your fellow travellers and participate in indoor games such as UNO, housie, and dumb charades. Enjoy an overnight journey by train towards Amritsar.

itinerary.title: Chandigarh to Shimla – Into the Mountains
itinerary.description: Arrive at Chandigarh Railway Station in the afternoon. Transfer your luggage to the private tour bus. Begin your scenic road journey towards Shimla, approximately 4 hours away. Enjoy views of winding mountain roads, pine forests, and the Himalayan foothills. Arrive in Shimla and check in to your hotel. Freshen up and enjoy dinner. Relax and prepare for the adventures ahead. Overnight stay: Shimla

itinerary.title: Shimla Sightseeing & Overnight Journey to Manali
itinerary.description: Wake up early, enjoy breakfast, and check out from the hotel. Head to Kufri, where you can enjoy optional horse riding and other adventure activities, subject to availability. Return towards Shimla and visit Jakhoo Temple, known for its hilltop location. Visit the iconic Christ Church and enjoy the surrounding heritage area. Spend time exploring Mall Road and Scandal Point, popular spots for shopping, cafés, and photographs. Return to the hotel for dinner. Board the bus for the overnight journey to Manali, approximately 8 hours away.

itinerary.title: River Rafting & Manali Local Tour
itinerary.description: Arrive in the Kullu region early in the morning. Experience river rafting, included in the package, subject to operational and safety conditions. Paragliding may be available at an additional cost, depending on weather conditions. Continue towards Manali and check in to the hotel. Freshen up and take some time to relax. Begin the local sightseeing tour of Manali. Visit Hidimba Devi Temple, surrounded by cedar forests. Explore Van Vihar and enjoy the peaceful natural surroundings. Visit Mall Road for shopping, cafés, and local experiences. Explore the Tibetan Monastery. Return to the hotel for dinner and an overnight stay. Overnight stay: Manali

itinerary.title: Snow Point & New Year Celebration in Manali
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast at the hotel and get ready for a day in the mountains. Head towards Solang Valley or Sissu, depending on permissions, road conditions, and operational feasibility. Enjoy the Himalayan scenery and capture memorable photographs. Participate in optional snow activities such as ziplining, yak rides, snow biking, tube rides, and skiing at your own expense, subject to availability. Return to the hotel and prepare for the New Year celebration. Celebrate New Year’s Eve with a gala dinner, DJ night, music, and fireworks. Welcome the New Year with your fellow travellers in a festive mountain atmosphere. Enjoy dinner and an overnight stay in Manali. Overnight stay: Manali Note: Snowfall is weather-dependent and cannot be guaranteed. Additional charges may apply for Sissu/Rohtang access.

itinerary.title: Kasol Sightseeing & Overnight Journey to Amritsar
itinerary.description: Wake up to the first morning of the New Year in Manali. Enjoy breakfast and check out from the hotel. Begin the journey towards Kasol, approximately 3 hours away. Visit Manikaran Sahib Gurudwara and the Manikaran Temple. Explore the charming streets and local market of Kasol. Discover local cafés and try Himachali food at your own expense. Enjoy the scenic riverside atmosphere and spend time exploring with your fellow travellers. Head to the Kasol camp and enjoy a DJ night. Get ready for the overnight journey towards Amritsar, approximately 8 hours away.

itinerary.title: Amritsar City Tour – Heritage & Culture
itinerary.description: Arrive in Amritsar in the morning and transfer to the hotel. Early check-in is subject to availability. Enjoy breakfast and take some time to rest. Get ready to explore the historic city of Amritsar. Visit Jallianwala Bagh, a significant site in India’s history. Visit the magnificent Golden Temple and experience its peaceful atmosphere. Proceed to the Wagah Attari Border to witness the famous border ceremony, subject to schedule and access. In the evening, enjoy the illuminated Golden Temple and explore the local markets. Sample Amritsari street food at your own expense. Return to the hotel for dinner and an overnight stay. Overnight stay: Amritsar

itinerary.title: Amritsar to Mumbai – Return Journey
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast and check out from the hotel early in the morning. Transfer to Amritsar Railway Station. Board the Paschim Express/Amritsar Express towards Mumbai, as arranged by the tour operator. Enjoy the overnight train journey and reminisce about the trip with your fellow travellers.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Mumbai – Until the Next Adventure!
itinerary.description: Arrive in Mumbai by evening, as per the train schedule. Say goodbye to your fellow travellers and the mountains. Return home with wonderful memories of Himachal Pradesh, New Year celebrations, and new friendships. Trip ends with a heart full of memories!

itinerary.title: Mumbai → Mangalore | Train Journey & Ice-Breaking 🚂
itinerary.description: Meet your fellow Coorg travellers at the designated railway stations and begin your journey towards Mangalore by train. Enjoy the journey with fellow travellers and take part in ice-breaking games and group activities. Connect with your tribe, make new friends and get ready for the adventure ahead. Meals: Not included.

itinerary.title: Mangalore → Coorg | Coffee & Spice Plantation ☕🌿
itinerary.description: Arrive in Mangalore early morning around 6:00 AM and proceed towards Coorg's charming town of Madikeri. Enjoy breakfast during the journey before reaching Coorg and checking in to your stay. Explore Coorg's famous Coffee & Spice Plantations with a guided plantation tour. Experience a live coffee-tasting session and discover the region's coffee heritage. If time permits, visit Raja's Seat and enjoy panoramic views of the surrounding hills. Later, explore the local markets, cafés and streets of Madikeri at your own pace. Meals: Breakfast & Dinner.

itinerary.title: Namdroling Monastery → Elephant Camp → Chiklihole Dam 🛕🐘🌊
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast and get ready for another day of exploring Coorg. Visit Namdroling Buddhist Monastery, also known as the Golden Temple, one of the largest Tibetan settlements in India. Head to the Elephant Camp and experience the opportunity to see elephants up close, including bathing and rides as mentioned in the itinerary. Later, visit Chiklihole Dam, a scenic man-made reservoir surrounded by lush greenery. Return to the stay, enjoy dinner and relax after a day of exploration. Meals: Breakfast & Dinner.

itinerary.title: Mandalpatti → Abbey Falls → Mysore | New Year Celebration 🚙💦🎆
itinerary.description: Start the day early with an exciting Jeep ride to Mandalpatti Peak. Reach the viewpoint and enjoy the beautiful sunrise and panoramic views of Coorg's misty valleys. Later, visit the spectacular Abbey Falls. Visit the historic Omkareshwar Temple before leaving Coorg. Proceed towards Mysore and check in to your stay. In the evening, celebrate New Year's Eve near the magnificent Mysore Palace and welcome the New Year with your tribe. Meals: Breakfast & Dinner.

itinerary.title: Mysore Exploration → Mangalore → Mumbai 🏰🛍️🚂
itinerary.description: Start the New Year by visiting the magnificent Mysore Palace and experiencing its royal architecture. Explore Mysore's local sights, markets and food scene. Later, proceed towards Mangalore Junction for your return train journey. Board your train back towards Mumbai and spend the journey relaxing with your fellow travellers. Meals: Breakfast.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Mumbai 🏠✨
itinerary.description: Arrive back in Mumbai and conclude your Coorg–Mysore New Year adventure. Expected arrival of approximately 2:50 PM at Panvel or 3:45 PM at Thane. Return home with new friendships, photographs and memories from the trip.

itinerary.title: Guwahati → Shillong 🚗
itinerary.description: Arrive at Guwahati Airport before 11:00 AM, where our representative will meet and greet you. The group will depart for Shillong at 12:00 PM and enjoy a scenic drive through the beautiful landscapes of Meghalaya. En route, stop at Umiam Lake (Barapani) to enjoy the views and capture some beautiful photographs. On arrival in Shillong, check in to the hotel and take some time to relax. In the evening, head out to explore the lively Police Bazaar and experience the local atmosphere. Return to the hotel for an overnight stay in Shillong. Meals: Not included.

itinerary.title: Shillong → Laitlum Canyons → Krang Suri → Phe Phe Falls → Dawki 🏞️
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast at the hotel before checking out and starting the journey towards Dawki/Shnongpdeng. Visit the breathtaking Laitlum Canyons, known for its dramatic landscapes and panoramic valley views. Continue the journey and explore the beautiful Krang Suri Waterfall, surrounded by lush greenery. Later, visit the scenic Phe Phe Falls and enjoy the natural beauty of the waterfall. Continue towards Dawki/Shnongpdeng and check in to your hotel or homestay. Spend the evening at leisure, relaxing by the riverside and enjoying the peaceful surroundings. Overnight stay in Dawki/Shnongpdeng. Meals: Breakfast & Dinner.

itinerary.title: Dawki → Mawlynnong → Cherrapunjee 🛶
itinerary.description: Enjoy an exciting morning at Dawki River with boating, kayaking and cliff jumping. After the river activities, proceed towards Mawlynnong Village, known as one of Asia’s cleanest villages. Explore the famous Bamboo Sky Walk and Single Decker Living Root Bridge. Visit the Indo-Bangladesh Border and take in the unique views of the region. Later, proceed towards Cherrapunjee and check in to your stay. Spend the evening relaxing and enjoying the peaceful surroundings. Overnight stay: Cherrapunjee Meals: Breakfast.

itinerary.title: Cherrapunjee → Double Decker Living Root Bridge → Blue Lagoon 🌿💧
itinerary.description: After breakfast, depart for Tyrna Village, the starting point of your famous root bridge trek. Begin the trek towards the Single Decker Living Root Bridge and continue further through the lush forests. Reach the iconic Double Decker Living Root Bridge, one of Meghalaya's most unique natural attractions. Continue towards the beautiful Blue Lagoon Waterfall, where you can enjoy a refreshing swim in its crystal-clear natural pool. After spending time at the Blue Lagoon, trek back to Tyrna Village. The trek involves approximately 3,300 steps one way and around 6,600 steps in total. After completing the trek, drive back to Cherrapunjee for an overnight stay. Meals: Breakfast.

itinerary.title: Cherrapunjee Sightseeing → Shillong 🪨🌊
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast and check out from your stay before beginning your Cherrapunjee sightseeing. Visit the famous Mawsmai Cave and explore the fascinating Arwah Cave. Continue to the beautiful Garden of Caves, surrounded by Meghalaya's natural landscapes. Witness the spectacular Nohkalikai Falls and Seven Sisters Falls, two of the region's iconic waterfalls. Later, proceed back to Shillong and check in to your hotel. Spend the evening at leisure and enjoy an overnight stay in Shillong. Meals: Breakfast.

itinerary.title: Shillong → Guwahati Airport | Departure 🛫
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast and check out from the hotel. Depart for Guwahati Airport around 9:00 AM for your return journey. The drive to the airport takes approximately 4–5 hours, with an expected arrival around 3:00 PM. We recommend booking your return flight after 5:00 PM to allow sufficient time for the journey. Bid farewell to your fellow travellers and take home unforgettable memories from your Meghalaya adventure. Meals: Breakfast.

The trek involves approximately 3,300 steps one way and around 6,600 steps in total. After completing the trek, return to Cherrapunjee for an overnight stay. Meals: Breakfast & Dinner.

itinerary.title: Cherrapunjee Sightseeing → Shillong 🪨🌊
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast and check out from your stay. Visit the famous Mawsmai Cave and stop at Mawkdok Valley to enjoy its breathtaking views. Explore the fascinating Arwah Cave and the beautiful Garden of Caves. Witness the majestic Nohkalikai Falls, followed by Seven Sisters Falls and Eco Park. Later, proceed back to Shillong and check in to your stay. Spend the evening at leisure and relax at the hotel. Overnight stay in Shillong. Meals: Breakfast.

itinerary.title: Shillong → Kaziranga 🦏
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast and check out from the hotel. Depart for Kaziranga and enjoy a scenic drive through the beautiful landscapes of Assam. Arrive in Kaziranga by evening and check in to your hotel. Spend the evening at leisure, relaxing after the journey. Overnight stay in Kaziranga. Meals: Breakfast.

itinerary.title: Kaziranga Safari → Guwahati 🚙🦏
itinerary.description: Start your morning with an exciting Jeep Safari in Kaziranga National Park. Explore the national park and look out for wildlife including one-horned rhinoceros, elephants, water buffaloes, swamp deer and other species. After the safari, drive back towards Guwahati for your return journey. We recommend booking your return flight after 6:00 PM for a comfortable departure. End the trip with unforgettable memories and photographs from your Meghalaya and Kaziranga adventure. Meals: Breakfast.

itinerary.title: Welcome to Phuket – Beach Vibes & Nightlife
itinerary.description: Arrive in Phuket and meet the Travel Tribes team and fellow travellers. Transfer to the hotel and complete check-in. Freshen up and get ready to explore Phuket. Visit the famous Patong Beach and enjoy the tropical atmosphere. Explore Bangla Walking Street, known for its neon lights, music, street performances, and energetic nightlife. Spend the evening bonding with your fellow travellers and kick-start your Thailand adventure. Overnight stay: Phuket

itinerary.title: Phi Phi Islands – Turquoise Waters & Tropical Adventures
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast at the hotel. Head out for a full-day speedboat excursion to the beautiful Phi Phi Islands. Visit the iconic Maya Bay and admire its breathtaking natural scenery. Explore the spectacular Phi Leh Lagoon, surrounded by dramatic limestone cliffs. Enjoy snorkelling and discover the underwater world, subject to sea and weather conditions. Capture stunning photographs of crystal-clear waters and tropical landscapes. Enjoy a beachside Indian lunch during the excursion. Return to Phuket after a fun-filled day of island exploration. Overnight stay: Phuket

itinerary.title: Koh Samui & New Year Celebration at the Legendary Full Moon Party
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast and check out from the Phuket hotel. Begin your journey to Koh Samui by land and ferry. Arrive in Koh Samui and check in to the hotel. Get some time to freshen up and prepare for the biggest celebration of the trip. Take the speedboat transfer to Koh Phangan for the world-famous Full Moon Party. Experience an electrifying beach party with music, dancing, colourful lights, and travellers from around the world. Celebrate the New Year with your Travel Tribes crew in a vibrant tropical party atmosphere. Enjoy the festive energy, dance on the beach, and create unforgettable memories as you welcome the year ahead. Overnight stay: Koh Samui Note: Full Moon Party entry tickets are payable separately (Approx 200 THB)

itinerary.title: Koh Samui – Relax, Recharge & Island Life
itinerary.description: Enjoy a relaxed morning after the previous night's celebrations. Have breakfast at the hotel. Spend the day at leisure and recharge at your own pace. Relax by the hotel pool or enjoy Koh Samui’s beautiful beaches. Explore the island independently or spend quality time with your fellow travellers. Optionally visit Ark Bar for a lively beachfront atmosphere and nightlife. Enjoy a laid-back evening on this beautiful tropical island. Overnight stay: Koh Samui

itinerary.title: Journey to Krabi – Local Exploration & Nightlife
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast and check out from the hotel. Transfer from Koh Samui to Krabi via ferry and van. Arrive in Krabi and check in to the hotel. Freshen up and take some time to relax. Explore Krabi Town and browse the local markets. Discover local street-food spots and enjoy the lively evening atmosphere. Join the group for a fun pub crawl and experience Krabi’s nightlife. Return to the hotel after an exciting evening. Overnight stay: Krabi

itinerary.title: Krabi 4 Islands Tour – Beaches, Blue Waters & Island Hopping
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast at the hotel. Head out for the exciting Krabi 4 Islands speedboat tour. Visit Koh Poda and enjoy its beautiful tropical beach scenery. Explore Chicken Island and admire its distinctive limestone formation. Visit Tup Island, famous for its sandbar when tide and sea conditions permit. Discover Phra Nang Cave Beach, surrounded by towering limestone cliffs and clear blue waters. Enjoy time for swimming, snorkelling where conditions permit, photography, and relaxing by the sea. Enjoy an Indian lunch during the island tour. Return to Krabi after a memorable day of island hopping. Spend your final evening relaxing with the group and reminiscing about your Thailand adventures. Overnight stay: Krabi

itinerary.title: Departure – Until the Next Adventure!
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast at the hotel. Complete the check-out formalities. Transfer to the airport for your onward journey. Say goodbye to your fellow travellers with unforgettable memories of Thailand’s beaches, islands, nightlife, and adventures. Trip ends with a heart full of memories!

itinerary.title: Arrival in Sri Lanka → Negombo 🌴
itinerary.description: Arrive at Bandaranaike International Airport, where our local representative will welcome you. Transfer to Negombo, located approximately 20 minutes from the airport. Check in to your hotel, freshen up and relax after your journey. Spend the rest of the day at leisure and enjoy your first glimpse of Sri Lanka. Overnight stay: Negombo / Colombo.

itinerary.title: Negombo → Kandy | Elephants & Scenic Views 🐘🛕
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast and check out from the hotel before proceeding towards Kandy. En route, visit the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage and explore a Spice & Herbal Garden. Continue towards Kandy and visit the Gem Museum & Lapidary. Explore the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, one of Sri Lanka’s most revered Buddhist sites. Enjoy a scenic drive around Kandy Upper Lake and stop at a viewpoint for panoramic views. In the evening, experience the vibrant Kandy Cultural Dance Show. Check in to the hotel, enjoy dinner and relax for the night. Overnight stay: Kandy.

itinerary.title: Kandy → Sigiriya → Dambulla → Kandy 🦁🌾
itinerary.description: Start the day with an early breakfast and depart from the hotel at 8:00 AM. Climb the iconic Sigiriya Lion Rock Fortress, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and enjoy spectacular views from the top. Experience authentic Sri Lankan village life with a traditional bullock cart ride and canoe ride. Enjoy a traditional Sri Lankan lunch during the village experience. Visit the ancient Dambulla Cave Temple, home to more than 150 Buddha statues and historic cave paintings. After a full day of sightseeing and experiences, return to Kandy. Overnight stay: Kandy.

itinerary.title: Kandy → Nuwara Eliya → Ella 🚂⛰️
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast and check out from the hotel before departing for Nuwara Eliya at 7:30 AM. Visit a Tea Factory & Tea Gardens in Ramboda and learn about Sri Lanka’s famous tea production. Stop at the beautiful Ramboda Waterfalls for photographs and scenic views. Board the famous scenic train from Nanu Oya to Ella. Enjoy approximately 3–4 hours of scenic train travel through tea plantations, mountains and valleys. Arrive in Ella, transfer to your hotel and relax. Overnight stay: Ella.

itinerary.title: Ella Exploration & Adventure 🌉✨
itinerary.description: Start your day with breakfast at the hotel. Take an easy hike to Little Adam’s Peak and enjoy breathtaking views of Ella’s green landscapes. Visit the iconic Nine Arch Bridge, one of Sri Lanka’s most picturesque landmarks. If you're lucky, watch a train pass across the bridge for a memorable photo opportunity. Experience the thrilling Rawana Mega Zip Line and fly over Ella’s beautiful surroundings. Explore the historic and legendary Rawana Caves. Spend the evening at leisure exploring the charming town of Ella. Overnight stay: Ella.

itinerary.title: Ella → Mirissa | Waterfalls to Beach 🌊🏖️
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast and check out before beginning your scenic 5–6 hour journey towards Mirissa. Stop at the beautiful Rawana Waterfall en route and capture some photographs. Continue through Sri Lanka’s scenic landscapes towards the coast. Arrive in Mirissa and check in to your beachfront hotel. Relax and enjoy the ocean views before spending the evening at Mirissa Beach. Take a leisurely beach walk or simply relax on the sand and enjoy the coastal atmosphere. Overnight stay: Mirissa.

itinerary.title: Mirissa → Weligama | Ocean Adventures & Leisure 🐋🏄‍♂️
itinerary.description: Start the day early with an exciting Whale & Dolphin Watching Tour. Sightings are subject to weather and season. Return to the hotel for breakfast and freshen up. Head towards Weligama/Mirissa for a day of beach adventures. Try surfing, suitable for both beginners and experienced surfers. Explore the underwater world through snorkelling and discover colourful marine life. For adventure enthusiasts, scuba diving is also available with certified diving centres. Spend the afternoon at leisure, relaxing by the beach, café hopping and enjoying local flavours. Return to your stay and relax for the evening. Overnight stay: Mirissa.

itinerary.title: Mirissa → Departure 🛫🇱🇰
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast at the hotel and check out. Begin your journey towards Bandaranaike International Airport. Sit back and enjoy a comfortable transfer to the airport. Arrive at the airport and proceed for your onward journey. Bid farewell to Sri Lanka with unforgettable memories from your island adventure.

itinerary.title: Welcome to Bali – Seminyak 🌴
itinerary.description: Arrive at Bali DPS Airport and meet your Trip Captain, who will accompany you throughout the journey. Transfer to your stay in Seminyak, get comfortable and settle into the tropical Bali vibes. Spend some time relaxing after your arrival. In the evening, explore the local food scene and enjoy delicious Balinese cuisine or refreshing local beverages. Overnight stay: Seminyak.

itinerary.title: Surfing → Uluwatu → Kecak Fire Dance 🏄‍♂️🛕🔥
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast and get ready for an exciting day of exploration. Start with an optional 2-hour basic surfing session with a professional instructor. Head towards Uluwatu and relax at a beautiful hidden beach. Visit the iconic Uluwatu Temple, perched dramatically above the Indian Ocean. Explore the temple and learn about its cultural significance. In the evening, witness the famous Kecak Fire Dance against a beautiful sunset backdrop. Return to your stay and relax after an adventurous day. Overnight stay: Seminyak.

itinerary.title: Nusa Penida Island → Seminyak Nightlife 🚤🏖️🍹
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast before heading out for a full-day trip to the stunning Nusa Penida Island. Explore some of the island’s most breathtaking landscapes and iconic viewpoints. Visit Angel’s Billabong, Broken Beach, Kelingking Beach and Crystal Bay. Take in the turquoise waters, enjoy the views and capture memorable photographs. Return to Bali in the evening. Later, head to Seminyak and explore its vibrant beach clubs and nightlife. Overnight stay: Seminyak.

itinerary.title: Bali → Gili Islands | Island Vibes ⛵🏝️
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast before catching a fast boat to the beautiful Gili Islands. Experience the island’s traditional and eco-friendly mode of transport, the Cidomo horse cart. Check in to your stay and settle into the relaxed island atmosphere. Spend the rest of the day exploring the island, relaxing by the beach or enjoying the peaceful surroundings. Overnight stay: Gili Islands.

itinerary.title: Gili Islands | Explore & Unwind 🐢🤿🌅
itinerary.description: Enjoy a free day to explore the beautiful Gili Islands at your own pace. Choose from optional experiences such as scuba diving with turtles, snorkelling with reef sharks, café hopping or a relaxing massage. Spend the evening at one of the island’s beach bars. Watch the sunset, enjoy a refreshing cocktail and soak in the laid-back Gili island vibes. Overnight stay: Gili Islands.

itinerary.title: Gili → Bali → Ubud | Island to Jungle 🌴🐒🌿
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast and spend the morning at leisure before departing Gili for Bali around midday. Continue your journey towards Ubud, travelling from the tropical beaches to Bali’s scenic countryside and rice paddies. Visit the famous Ubud Monkey Forest and explore its beautiful surroundings. Spend some time exploring Ubud and experiencing its blend of culture, nature and laid-back atmosphere. Overnight stay: Ubud.

itinerary.title: Ubud Adventure → Waterfall → Day Club 🏎️💦🎉
itinerary.description: Get ready for a thrilling 1-hour tandem ATV adventure through jungle trails and lush landscapes. Visit the beautiful Tegenungan Waterfall, surrounded by tropical greenery. Capture photographs and enjoy a refreshing swim in the natural pool. Later, head to Omma Day Club to relax, chill and enjoy Bali’s vibrant atmosphere. Spend the evening at leisure before returning to your stay. Overnight stay: Ubud.

itinerary.title: Mount Batur Jeep Ride → Sunrise → Rice Terraces 🌋🚙🌾
itinerary.description: Begin the day early with a 2:00 AM departure for an unforgettable adventure. Experience an exciting 4x4 Jeep ride to Mount Batur through scenic volcanic landscapes. Reach a viewpoint to witness the breathtaking sunrise over Mount Batur. Enjoy breakfast while taking in panoramic morning views. Explore the unique Black Lava fields around Mount Batur. Later, visit Bali’s iconic rice terraces and admire the surrounding landscapes. Return to Ubud after a memorable day of adventure. Overnight stay: Ubud.

itinerary.title: Bali → Departure 🛫✨
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast and complete the hotel check-out process. Gather your belongings and get ready for your airport transfer. Meet your driver and proceed towards Bali DPS Airport. Keep your travel documents and essentials handy for a smooth journey. Bid farewell to Bali and your fellow travellers with unforgettable memories.

itinerary.title: Bagdogra → Jaigaon → Phuentsholing 🇧🇹
itinerary.description: Arrive at Bagdogra Airport and begin your journey towards Bhutan. Drive through scenic landscapes towards Jaigaon, the gateway to Bhutan. Cross the India–Bhutan border and enter Phuentsholing. Complete the Bhutan immigration and entry formalities. Check in to your hotel, relax and get ready for the adventure ahead. Overnight stay: Phuentsholing.

itinerary.title: Phuentsholing → Thimphu | Scenic Road Journey 🏔️🚗
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast and begin your journey towards Thimphu. Drive through winding mountain roads surrounded by lush forests, waterfalls and beautiful Bhutanese villages. Optional: Experience a fun river rafting adventure en route. Stop at the scenic Chuzom Bridge, where the Paro and Thimphu rivers meet. Capture photographs with the iconic portraits of the King and Queen. Arrive in Thimphu by evening and check in to your hotel. Later, explore the vibrant local markets of Thimphu. Overnight stay: Thimphu.

itinerary.title: Thimphu → Dochula Pass → Punakha → Thimphu 🛕⛰️🎉
itinerary.description: Explore Thimphu’s famous cultural landmarks and visit the Buddha Dordenma Statue. Drive to Dochula Pass at 3,050 metres and enjoy breathtaking Himalayan views. Visit the beautiful 108 Druk Wangyal Chortens. Continue towards Punakha Dzong, one of Bhutan’s most magnificent landmarks. Return to Thimphu and enjoy a fun game night and karaoke evening with the group. Overnight stay: Thimphu.

itinerary.title: Thimphu → Paro | Cultural Exploration 🏛️🎨🏔️
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast and check out before beginning your journey towards Paro. Visit Simply Bhutan, an immersive museum showcasing Bhutanese culture, architecture and traditional lifestyle. Continue the scenic drive towards Paro Valley. Check in to your hotel and relax. In the evening, explore Paro Market and shop for local souvenirs. Overnight stay: Paro.

itinerary.title: Paro → Tiger’s Nest Trek → Paro 🥾🐅⛩️
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast and get ready for the iconic Tiger’s Nest Trek. Hike through beautiful pine forests to reach the sacred Taktsang Monastery. The trek takes approximately 2–4 hours, depending on your pace. Explore the monastery, perched dramatically around 900 metres above the valley. Enjoy the peaceful surroundings, prayer flags and spectacular mountain views. Trek back and return to Paro. Optional: Relax with a traditional Bhutanese hot-stone bath. Overnight stay: Paro.

itinerary.title: Paro → Phuentsholing → Siliguri 📸🚙
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast and check out from your hotel in Paro. Dress up in a traditional Bhutanese outfit for a fun group photoshoot. Stop at a scenic viewpoint to capture views of the iconic Paro Airport. Begin your return journey through Bhutan’s beautiful valleys and landscapes. Cross Phuentsholing, re-enter India and continue towards Siliguri. Arrive in Siliguri by evening, check in and relax. Overnight stay: Siliguri.

itinerary.title: Siliguri → Bagdogra Airport | Departure 🛫✨
itinerary.description: Enjoy your final breakfast and check out from the hotel. Arrange your own transportation to Bagdogra Airport according to your flight timing. Depart for the airport and begin your journey back home. Bid farewell to your fellow travellers and take home unforgettable memories and new friendships.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Phu Quoc | Grand World & Cultural Show 🌴✨
itinerary.description: Arrive at Phu Quoc Airport and meet the local Travel Tribes team. Transfer to the hotel, check in and relax after your journey. In the evening, head to Grand World Phu Quoc for a walking tour. Explore the Venice Canal, shopping streets, cafés and entertainment zones. Experience Tinh Hoa Viet Nam, a spectacular live cultural show showcasing Vietnamese history, art and traditions. Overnight stay in Phu Quoc. Meals: Not included.

itinerary.title: 4-Island Tour | Cable Car | Aquatopia Water Park 🏝️🚡🌊
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head out for an exhilarating Four Island Tour. Explore tropical islands including Hon May Rut and Hon Thom. Enjoy a scenic cable car ride with panoramic ocean views across the archipelago. Experience snorkelling, beach time and tropical island exploration. Enjoy a delicious lunch during the tour. Visit Aquatopia Water Park for world-class water rides and entertainment. Return to the hotel and overnight stay in Phu Quoc. Meals: Breakfast & Lunch.

itinerary.title: VinPearl Safari | VinWonders | Flight to Da Nang 🦁🎢✈️
itinerary.description: After breakfast, visit VinPearl Safari, Vietnam’s premier wildlife conservation park. See exotic animals roaming in open and natural habitats. Continue to VinWonders Phu Quoc for thrilling rides, themed adventure zones, live shows and entertainment. In the evening, transfer to the airport and board your internal flight to Da Nang. Arrive in Da Nang, check in to your hotel and unwind. Overnight stay in Da Nang. Meals: Breakfast.

itinerary.title: Da Nang | Hoi An | Basket Boat | Lantern Street 🏖️🛶🏮
itinerary.description: Enjoy a relaxed morning at My Khe Beach, known for its pristine sands and blue waters. In the afternoon, experience an exciting Basket Boat Ride at the Coconut Village. Explore the historic UNESCO World Heritage streets of Hoi An Ancient Town. Visit the ancient Phung Hung houses, Japanese Covered Bridge, and historic trading port. Walk through the magically illuminated Lantern Street. Enjoy free time to explore local cafés and boutiques in Hoi An before returning to the hotel. Overnight stay in Da Nang. Meals: Breakfast.

itinerary.title: Ba Na Hills | Golden Bridge | French Village 🚡🌉🏰
itinerary.description: Depart for Ba Na Hills around 7:30 AM. Take the world-record cable car from Suoi Mo Station to Marseille Station. Walk across the world-famous iconic Golden Bridge held by colossal stone hands. Explore the Lunar Castle and continue towards the picturesque French Village. Enjoy Fantasy Park indoor theme park and visit King Peak for panoramic mountain vistas. Return to Da Nang for an overnight stay. Meals: Breakfast.

itinerary.title: Da Nang to Hanoi | Old Quarter | Train Street ✈️☕🚂
itinerary.description: Early morning transfer to Da Nang Airport and fly to Hanoi, Vietnam's historic capital. Meet the guide and transfer to your centrally located hotel. Around 5:00 PM, begin an atmospheric walking tour of Hanoi Old Quarter. Explore Phung Hung Mural Street and the world-famous Hanoi Train Street. Stop at local cafés and experience authentic Vietnamese egg coffee (Ca Phe Trung). Enjoy leisure time strolling around Hoan Kiem Lake. Overnight stay in Hanoi. Meals: Breakfast.

itinerary.title: Halong Bay Day Cruise | Surprising Cave & Kayaking 🚢⛰️🛶
itinerary.description: Transfer to Halong Bay in the morning through scenic countryside. Board your cruise at Tuan Chau Harbor for an unforgettable 5–6 hour cruise among thousands of limestone karsts. Enjoy a freshly prepared seafood/multi-cuisine lunch on board. Visit the impressive Sung Sot (Surprising Cave) with massive stalactites. Explore Ti Top Island, relax on the white beach and hike up for 360-degree bay views. Experience kayaking or bamboo boating through the tunnel of Luon Cave. Enjoy sunset tea and wine while cruising back to Tuan Chau Harbor. Return to Hanoi and overnight stay. Meals: Breakfast & Lunch.

itinerary.title: Departure from Hanoi 🛫✨
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast and some leisure time for last-minute souvenir shopping. Complete check-out and transfer to Hanoi Noi Bai Airport (HAN) for your flight back home. We recommend booking return flights departing after 5:30 PM Vietnam time. Bid farewell to Vietnam with incredible memories and lifelong friendships made with your tribe! Meals: Breakfast.

itinerary.title: Ho Chi Minh City Arrival | Saigon City Walk | Bui Vien 🏛️🍹
itinerary.description: Arrive at Ho Chi Minh City (HCMC) Airport and meet your guide. Transfer to your centrally located hotel and check in. In the evening, explore the vibrant heart of Saigon on a guided walking tour. Visit Saigon Central Post Office and see Saigon Cathedral. Explore HCMC Town Hall and experience local Vietnamese food at the food court near the War Museum. Later at night, head to Bui Vien Walking Street for the city’s famous nightlife and street energy. Overnight stay in Ho Chi Minh City. Meals: Not included.

itinerary.title: Cu Chi Tunnels | Fly to Da Nang 🕳️✈️🏖️
itinerary.description: After breakfast, depart for the historic Cu Chi Tunnels. Stop at the Egg Shell Gallery en route. Learn about the tunnel system through an introductory presentation and video. Explore the tunnels, living quarters, kitchens, weapons areas, factories and field hospitals. Taste complimentary wartime tea and boiled cassava root. Optional AK-47 and M4 shooting experience is available at an additional cost. In the evening, transfer to the airport and fly to Da Nang. Check in and overnight stay in Da Nang. Meals: Breakfast.

itinerary.title: Da Nang | Hoi An | Basket Boat | Lantern Street 🏖️🛶🏮
itinerary.description: Enjoy a relaxed morning at the beach in Da Nang. Experience a traditional Basket Boat Ride at the Coconut Forest. Explore UNESCO World Heritage Hoi An Ancient Town. Visit the old streets, Phung Hung houses, local market and ancient port. Experience the colourful, magical Lantern Street. Enjoy free time to explore local cafés and boutiques in Hoi An before returning to the hotel. Overnight stay in Da Nang. Meals: Breakfast.

itinerary.title: Ba Na Hills | Golden Bridge | French Village 🚡🌉🏰
itinerary.description: Depart for Ba Na Hills around 7–8 AM. Take the cable car from Suoi Mo Station to Marseille Station. Visit the iconic Golden Bridge held by the giant 'Hands of the Gods'. Explore the majestic Lunar Castle. Take the funicular train to the French Village. Enjoy games, rides and entertainment at Fantasy Park. Visit King Peak for panoramic mountain views. Return to Da Nang for an overnight stay. Meals: Breakfast.

itinerary.title: Da Nang to Hanoi | Old Quarter | Train Street ✈️☕🚂
itinerary.description: Early morning transfer to the airport and fly to Hanoi. Meet your guide and transfer to the hotel. Enjoy breakfast and freshen up. Around 5 PM, begin a walking tour of Hanoi Old Quarter. Explore Mural Street and cafés around the world-famous Train Street. Try the famous authentic Vietnamese egg coffee. Overnight stay in Hanoi. Meals: Breakfast.

itinerary.title: Halong Bay Cruise | Surprising Cave | Ti Top Island 🚢⛰️🛶
itinerary.description: Transfer from Hanoi to Halong Bay. Board the cruise at Tuan Chau Harbour. Enjoy a scenic 5–6 hour cruise with refreshments and a delicious Vietnamese lunch. Visit the impressive Surprising Cave (Sung Sot Cave). Explore Ti Top Island, including the beach and scenic viewpoint hike. Experience kayaking or bamboo boating at Luon Cave. Return to Hanoi after the cruise. Overnight stay in Hanoi. Meals: Breakfast & Lunch.

itinerary.title: Ninh Binh | Trang An Boat Ride | Mua Cave 🚣‍♂️🏞️🪜
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to Ninh Binh. Visit Mua Cave and climb approximately 500 stone steps for breathtaking karst panorama. Explore the Trang An Eco-Tourism Area by boat through serene riverways and limestone caves. Return to Hanoi for an overnight stay. Meals: Breakfast.

itinerary.title: Departure from Hanoi 🛫✨

Please ensure return flights from Hanoi are booked after 5:30 PM Vietnam time. Bid farewell to Vietnam with unforgettable memories and newfound lifelong friends from your tribe! Meals: Breakfast.

– Return back post sundown.
– Rest of the evening at leisure

itinerary.description:

– Cross the historic Elephant Pass , the gateway to the Jaffna Peninsula.
– Stop en route for traditional northern Sri Lankan cuisine.
–
Arrive in Jaffna by 4 PM and check into your homestay.
–
Freshen up and visit Nallur Kandaswamy Kovil:
Attend the evening Pooja (prayer ceremony) at this historic, gold-towered Hindu temple. Note: Men are required to remove their shirts before entering the inner sanctum.
–
Rest of the evening at leisure

itinerary.title: Jaffna
itinerary.description:
– Breakfast at the hotel.
– Leave for sightseeing in Jaffna. First visit, Keerimalai Naguleswaram Temple & Holy Springs, one of the island’s oldest Hindu shrines and its natural freshwater spring right beside the sea. Then visit the sacred Nagapooshani Amman Temple (Hindu) and Nagadeepa Purana Viharaya (Buddhist temple visited by Lord Buddha according to legend).
– Return to the town of Jaffna for Lunch (Try local Jaffna Crab Curry or vegetarian South Indian-style meals).
–
Leave fo r Jaffna Fort: Walk through the star-shaped fort built by the Portuguese in 1619 and later expanded by the Dutch. Enjoy sweeping views of the Jaffna Lagoon, Jaffna Public Library:
Admire the striking white neo-Moghul architecture of this historic institution, and Rio Ice Cream:
Stop at Jaffna’s iconic ice cream parlour for a classic local treat.

trips.title: Bucketlist Christmas + New Year: Paris & the French Riviera

itinerary.title: Christmas Welcome in Paris
itinerary.description:
Arrive in Paris on Christmas Day and check in at Hôtel Golden Tulip Opéra de Noailles, with welcome teas waiting and time to unpack before you meet the tribe.
Gather for the first session together, where hellos turn into proper conversations and a group of strangers starts to feel like a tribe.
Head out to the Tuileries Christmas market for a mulled-wine, fairy-light kind of evening, with dinner in the festive streets nearby, then carry the new friendships into the Paris bar crawl.

itinerary.title: A Private Christmas Walk and the Seine
itinerary.description:
Start with a private Paris Christmas walk from the Musée de l'Orangerie, strolling past holiday windows and lit-up streets with croissant stops along the way.
Sit down together for lunch in Saint-Germain-des-Prés, then keep the afternoon free for a museum or a café, whichever suits your mood.
Board a cruise on the Seine as the lights come on and the Eiffel Tower sparkles. Dinner is hosted at the Rue Cler bistros, with Eiffel photos to close the second Paris night.

itinerary.title: From Paris to Cannes by Train
itinerary.description:
Take the last Paris morning slowly with breakfast and checkout, then board the afternoon train from Paris to Cannes (14:10 to 19:32) and watch the grey winter slide into Riviera blue.
Arrive in Cannes and settle into the Hotel, with time to freshen up.
Share a light dinner near the hotel to start the Riviera chapter. If you still have energy, the Croisette lights are lovely for a short stroll.

itinerary.title: Cannes Mornings and a Private Speedboat
itinerary.description:
Start the day with breakfast in Cannes and a slow morning along La Croisette, with the Palais des Festivals and the seafront to wander as you like.
Join the private speedboat sail around the Lérins Islands before dinner with the tribe, bringing everyone back together after a morning spent following separate curiosities. You board at Port Camille Rayon for island views and plenty of group photos.
Back at the hotel, freshen up and gather for dinner nearby, with an optional Cannes nightcap for those still standing.

itinerary.title: Nice Food Trail, Our First Night
itinerary.description:
Check out after breakfast and ride the coastal road from Cannes to Nice, arriving at NH Nice Hotel to drop your bags and settle in.
Join the Nice food walking tour through old Nice, tasting pissaladière and other local favourites with a guide who knows the best corners. It is generous enough to count as lunch.
Meet again near the hotel, with Nice's nightlife close by if the night is still young.

itinerary.title: Èze and a Perfume of Your Own
itinerary.description:
Ride to the hilltop village of Èze, climbing its cobbled lanes to viewpoints high above the Riviera.
Break for lunch in the village, then join the Fragonard perfume workshop and blend a scent of your own to take home, a small reminder of the people and places from this week.
Spend the evening in Nice with a promenade walk by the sea. Monaco, Menton or shopping on Avenue de Verdun are there if you fancy an extra outing.

itinerary.title: Nice, One Last Night of 2026
itinerary.description:
Take New Year's Eve slowly in Nice with a lazy breakfast and a morning by the sea, then rest and glam up in the afternoon.
Meet the tribe for a pre-game at a bar on the Promenade des Anglais, then head into the New Year's Eve party at High Club.
Welcome 2027 along the Promenade des Anglais as Nice celebrates midnight, raising a glass to the days in Paris and Cannes and the people who shared them.

itinerary.title: New Year Breakfast, Nice Goodbyes
itinerary.description:
Share one last breakfast at the Hotel and trade favourite moments from Paris, Cannes and Nice before packing up.
Check out and make your own way to Nice Côte d'Azur Airport. The airport transfer is not included in the edition fee.
Say goodbye to the people who shared Christmas in Paris and New Year's Eve in Nice, then head home with their numbers and your Èze perfume.

itinerary.title: Christmas vibes, City Lights & a night to remember!
itinerary.description:
Merry Christmas! Check in, settle into Amsterdam and meet your new tribe for our first session together.
Freshen up before heading to the canal cruise pickup point by cab (BYOC).
Cruise through the Amsterdam Light Festival with dinner on Bucketlist, surrounded by canal views and festive lights.
After the cruise, choose to keep the night going or head back and recharge.

itinerary.title: Amsterdam Cycling Adventure - Bikes, Canal Streets & Christmas Markets
itinerary.description:
Start with breakfast at the hotel, then head out for a cycling experience through Amsterdam's canals and neighbourhoods.
After lunch, enjoy some free time to explore the city at your own pace.
Optional add-on: visit the Heineken Experience. Bring a valid ID if you're joining.
In the evening, soak up the festive atmosphere at the Museumplein Christmas market, then regroup for dinner.

itinerary.title: Welcome to Berlin - where the art is as alive as the music!
itinerary.description:
After breakfast and checkout, head to Amsterdam Centraal by cab (BYOC) and settle in for the train journey to Berlin.
Arrive in Berlin, transfer to the hotel by cab (BYOC), check in and freshen up before a comfort-food huddle.
Spend the evening at Berliner Weihnachtszeit, the Christmas market at Rotes Rathaus, before drinks and dinner.
Then head out for the Berlin pub crawl and a taste of the city's nightlife. Late-night burgers are an option afterwards.

itinerary.title: Offbeat Berlin: A Day Of Art Indulgence
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, discover a different side of Berlin on an alternate walking tour.
Stop for lunch, then enjoy free time to explore the city's landmarks at your own pace.
In the evening, head to Dark Matter by cab (BYOC) for an immersive art experience.
Regroup for dinner and drinks on our last evening in Berlin.

itinerary.title: Prague Calling: A Fairytale Come to Life
itinerary.description:
Have breakfast, check out and stock up on snacks before heading to the bus station by cab (BYOC).
Travel to Prague by FlixBus, then transfer to the hotel by cab (BYOC), check in and grab a bite.
Take a tribe walk to Charles Bridge and the Lennon Wall before returning to freshen up for the evening.
Head to the Jazz Boat by cab (BYOC) for a jazz-inspired dinner on Bucketlist, then choose whether to continue the night.

itinerary.title: Explore the City Like a Local, One Chimney Cake at a Time
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, meet Mike for a walk through Prague, with Prague Castle views and a chimney cake along the way.
Pause for lunch, then spend the afternoon exploring at your own pace, from the castle-side lanes to Old Town.
Optional: head out for speakeasy bar hopping in the evening.
Regroup with the tribe for dinner and drinks.

itinerary.title: The most epic party in town and a New Year countdown you'll never forget.
itinerary.description:
It's the last day of the year! Start with breakfast and a relaxed morning browsing nearby markets for souvenirs.
After lunch, enjoy some free time for Prague's parks, museums or one last wander.
In the evening, meet at the hotel for pre-drinks and a session with the tribe before heading out for the NYE party.
Welcome 2027 with your new friends, with the option of a late-night bite afterwards.

itinerary.title: Checkouts & goodbyes - leave with a new book of memories
itinerary.description:
Ease into the New Year with breakfast at the hotel, then check out and say your goodbyes.
Head home with a new book of memories and a tribe of friends from Amsterdam, Berlin and Prague.

itinerary.title: Ubud Starts at One Table
itinerary.description:
Make your own way from DPS to Tetirah Boutique Hotel, a short walk from central Ubud, then meet the eighteen-person tribe before dinner.
The first Ubud evening stays close to the centre, leaving time to settle before the Padang Bai ferry days begin.
Over the included welcome dinner, the tribe maps the week from Padang Bai ferries to Gili sunsets and Uluwatu midnight.

itinerary.title: Ubud Gets Mud on It
itinerary.description:
An included ATV ride pulls the tribe straight into Ubud's rougher side, where mud is more useful than another posed Bali photograph.
We regroup over an included shared lunch in Ubud, swapping the morning's near-misses before choosing how to use the open afternoon.
The rest of Ubud is yours: walk the Campuhan Ridge, find a table near Jalan Goutama or sleep before the Padang Bai ferry.

itinerary.title: Gili T Before the Music
itinerary.description:
A road transfer takes us from Ubud to Padang Bai, where the included fast ferry begins the crossing to Gili Trawangan.
With no cars on Gili T, the first walk to Jali Resort changes the rhythm before everyone meets again at sunset hour.
After dark, Gili T's beach bars take over, and the tribe can stay out together or follow the island at its own pace.

itinerary.title: Gili T, No Alarm Required
itinerary.description:
Gili Trawangan gives us a full car-free day with no scheduled excursion, so breakfast can stretch until the island feels properly awake.
Walk the coast or hire a bicycle directly on Gili T, keeping the afternoon yours without paying for movement you may not want.
The tribe meets again at sunset hour, whatever the weather brings, then follows the beach bars after dark for another island night.

itinerary.title: Gili T Gives Way to Uluwatu
itinerary.description:
The included ferry carries us back from Gili Trawangan to Padang Bai, with Uluwatu waiting at the end of the road transfer.
We arrive at Uluwatu Cottages on the clifftop for an included shared lunch, reset after the crossing and claim the corners that will become home.
The Uluwatu evening is open for Cemongkak Beach, a quiet night by the cottage pool or a drink with the tribe before New Year's Eve.

itinerary.title: Uluwatu Owns the Countdown
itinerary.description:
Keep the final Uluwatu morning slow around Cemongkak Beach, choosing sand, a café or a long lunch before the countdown.
An included shared dinner brings the tribe back to one table before everyone gets ready for the New Year's Eve party.
Your Uluwatu party entry is included, so midnight arrives with six shared Bali days behind the people counting down beside you.

itinerary.title: Uluwatu on the First Morning
itinerary.description:
The first breakfast of 2027 begins at Uluwatu Cottages, with last night's stories arriving at the table before everyone else.
Take one final look at the ocean from the clifftop, trade photographs with the tribe and check out without rushing the goodbye.
Departure rides to DPS are self-arranged, giving each traveller control over the airport timing and the people they choose to share with.

itinerary.title: Arrival & Northern Welcome
itinerary.description:
Your journey begins in Reykjavik, the world's northernmost capital and the start of your Bucketlist adventure.
Welcome to your first sesh as you meet the tribe you’ll be sharing this journey with; faces that will soon turn into unforgettable stories.
In the evening, we take a walk through the city’s coolest spots, including the iconic Rainbow Street, lined with charming cafés and boutiques. The night ends with a dinner date- good food, great drinks, and the best vibes!

itinerary.title: The Northern Lights Chase & Rustic Retreat
itinerary.description:
The adventure kicks into high gear as we grab our 4x4s and hit the road - epic landscapes, a killer playlist, and pure road trip freedom.
A caffeine stop fuels the journey before stocking up on road trip essentials because snacks are non-negotiable.
By afternoon, check into a cosy hideaway, then head out to chase stunning waterfalls that look straight out of a dream.
Tonight we set our sights on the Northern Lights - manifesting a front-row seat to one of the world’s greatest shows.

itinerary.title: Valley of Thunder Gods
itinerary.description:
Buckle up in Superjeeps as we power through terrains, cross icy rivers and navigate deep into Iceland s wildest landscapes.
Venture into the legendary Thorsmork valley, a land shaped by fire and ice and named after the Norse god of thunder.
Towering peaks, glacial valleys and raw untouched beauty surround us at every turn. Truly a front-row seat to nature's most dramatic views.

itinerary.title: Off to Majestic Waterfalls
itinerary.description:
We begin today's adventure with Seljalandsfoss, where you can walk behind the cascading waterfall for a surreal, up-close view.
Climb to Vik’s hilltop church for sweeping views of the rugged landscapes, a quiet spot with breathtaking views Enjoy lunch and some free time to explore Vik - wander through local shops, grab a coffee, or just take in the charm of this coastal town.

itinerary.title: Walking on Ice: Conquering Sólheimajökull
itinerary.description:
Hit the road and head to Sólheimajökull, where an epic glacier hike awaits - crampons on, ice axes ready, and a landscape straight out of another world. What an adventure!
Refuel with lunch and next we witness the mighty Skogafoss waterfall, where mist and rainbows dance in the air.
Drive to Flúðir, winding through Iceland’s vast and ever-changing landscapes, before checking in and winding down for the night.

itinerary.title: Snowmobile Thrills & Soothing Springs
itinerary.description:
Fuel up - both the cars and yourself, before setting off for a day packed with adventure.
Visit the legendary Gullfoss, where powerful cascades thunder into a dramatic canyon Gear up for an adrenaline rush as we take on Langjokull glaciers by snowmobile - speed, ice, and just pure thrill!
As the sun sets, soak in the warm, mineral-rich waters of the Secret Lagoon, the perfect way to unwind after an action-packed day.

itinerary.title: Where Continents Drift & Geysirs Roar
itinerary.description:
Your final day in Iceland beckons with the legacy of the ancients at Thingvellir National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage site steeped in geological and historical significance Wander the paths where the North American and Eurasian tectonic plates part ways, and Iceland's first parliament stood centuries ago Witness the raw power of nature at the geothermal fields as Strokkur erupts, shooting boiling water high into the air.
Hit the road back to Reykjavik - one last scenic drive through Iceland’s wild landscapes before the city lights welcome us home.
Gather for a final feast, toasting to your shared adventures with newfound friends.

itinerary.title: Memories of Iceland & Goodbyes
itinerary.description:
Pack up and check out, but some things don’t fit in a suitcase - the moments, the stories, and the bonds built along the way.
Say your ‘see you again,’ not just to this wild, untamed land but to the tribe that turned a trip into something unforgettable.

itinerary.title: Welcome to Srinagar – An adventure of a lifetime!
itinerary.description: Your Winter Wonderland begins! Check-in and take in the beauty of Srinagar, where snow-capped peaks and the serene Dal Lake welcome you After settling in, indulge in an authentic Kashmiri Wazwan dinner—a perfect introduction to the region’s rich culinary traditions Meet your tribe of fellow adventure lovers, ready to learn one of the greatest winter sports together and have an unforgettable experience The edition begins on a wholesome, cosy note - with a taste of luxury, local flavour, and good vibes!

itinerary.title: Off to Gulmarg – The Road to Snow-Capped Dreams
itinerary.description:
Finally, we head to our main adventure! Hit the road in your 4x4s to Gulmarg, where stunning snowy landscapes greet you at every turn Once we reach Gulmarg, you’ll meet a team of expert instructors who will guide you through mastering the slopes Quick intros, getting the perfect gear, and it’s already time for your very first Snowboarding/Skiing Session
A day packed with exploration, adrenaline, and new skills—this is just the beginning!

itinerary.title: Master the Slopes – Refine, Shred, Repeat
itinerary.description:
Today’s all about building on your snowboarding/skiing skills with refined slope tryouts and your second Snowboarding/Skiing Session
With your expert instructor by your side, focus on perfecting those turns, improving your balance, and soaking in the thrill of each descent With the slopes becoming more familiar, you’ll push your limits, gaining confidence with every turn Whether you're aiming for smooth glides or just feeling the rush of progress, this is your day to shred with style and make the slopes your own!

itinerary.title: Perfecting Your Flow
itinerary.description: Today is about fine-tuning, levelling up and making the most of your snow-covered playground Day by day, you’re getting better—and today, it’s all about pushing your limits! With your third Snowboarding/Skiing Session, you’ll refine your technique and tackle the slopes with growing confidence and skill Each run brings more confidence, and every turn feels smoother as you master the art of the descent and step closer to becoming a pro It gets better! You are also going to Kongdoori-Apharwat - the highest ski lift in the world! If that isn't a major Bucketlist moment, we don't know what is

itinerary.title: The Grand Finale on the Slopes
itinerary.description:
Your snowboarding/skiing journey culminates with the ultimate Final Run during your fourth session—time to put all your new skills to the test and show off your progress as you descend This is truly the big moment you've waited for & a win you've earned To celebrate this and soak in the rush, we ascend the mountain on the iconic Phase 1 & 2 Gondola Rides, where unreal views of the Himalayas await It's your moment to feel infinite and on top of the World
The adventure doesn’t stop there, gear up for a long snowmobile ride through endless powdery trails—pure winter magic! Make the most of your last evening with your tribe, celebrating your alpine triumphs in true adventurer style!

itinerary.title: Until Next Time
itinerary.description:
It’s time to say goodbye to the snow, the mountains, and your newfound tribe Kashmir’s magic has left its mark—until we meet again for the next adventure!
