trips.title: Mizoram Clouds, Cliffs & The Forgotten Hills

itinerary.title: Welcome to the Land of the Blue Mountains
itinerary.description:
Land at Lengpui Airport and drive into Aizawl, winding mountain roads and endless green hills offering the first glimpse of the journey ahead. After checking in, explore the capital: the magnificent Solomon's Temple, the lively Bara Bazar, and the everyday rhythm of Mizo life. As evening approaches, head to Durtlang Viewpoint before ending the day with sunset at Hangi Lunglen Tlang, overlooking layers of the Lushai Hills as the city lights come alive below.
🌙 Overnight: Aizawl
<div

itinerary.title: Into Mizoram's Hidden Wilderness
itinerary.description:
Leave the city behind and venture deeper into the hills. As the roads quieten and the forests thicken, arrive at Leisang Kurung — a short trek through the forest leads to a spectacular viewpoint over endless layers of green mountains, still unknown to most travellers outside Mizoram. Then explore Khuangchera Puk, a limestone cave steeped in Mizo folklore, believed to have once sheltered the legendary warrior Khuangchera. By evening, arrive at the campsite near Ailawng — bonfire, a hearty dinner, and a crisp winter night beneath a sky full of stars.
🌙 Overnight: Ailawng Camp
<div

itinerary.title: Sunrise Above the Clouds
itinerary.description:
An early start takes you to Reiek Peak, timed to catch sunrise over the rolling Lushai Hills — the crisp winter air often brings some of the clearest views of the season. Afterwards, visit Reiek Heritage Village for a glimpse into traditional Mizo architecture and way of life, then continue the scenic drive to Hmuifang, known for its peaceful meadows, pine forests and cool mountain air. By evening, arrive in Thenzawl, gateway to Mizoram's most spectacular waterfalls.
🌙 Overnight: Thenzawl
<div

itinerary.title: Chasing Mizoram's Hidden Waterfalls
itinerary.description:
A day built around two of Mizoram's most spectacular natural wonders. Begin at Vantawng Falls, the tallest waterfall in the state, cascading dramatically through dense forest. Then Tuirihiau Falls — one of the very few waterfalls in India where you can actually walk behind the curtain of water. If time permits, stop at the Thenzawl Handloom & Handicrafts Centre, where local artisans continue the centuries-old tradition of Mizo weaving. The day closes with a traditional Mizo dinner hosted by a local family.
🌙 Overnight: Thenzawl
<div

itinerary.title: Through the Heart of Mizoram
itinerary.description:
One of the most scenic drives of the trip, winding through rolling hills, picturesque villages and countless viewpoints on the way to Champhai, often called the Rice Bowl of Mizoram. On arrival, explore the beautiful valley, visit local vineyards and take in a peaceful sunset over the surrounding mountains — wide-open landscapes that feel like a completely different side of the state.
🌙 Overnight: Champhai
<div

itinerary.title: Where India Meets Myanmar
itinerary.description:
Visit Rih Dil, a serene heart-shaped lake just across the Myanmar border, considered sacred in Mizo folklore. Then Zokhawthar, the bustling border town where India meets Myanmar — a rare, unhurried blend of Mizo and Chin cultures, and a side of Northeast India very few travellers ever see. Return to Champhai for a relaxed final night in the valley town.
🌙 Overnight: Champhai
<div

itinerary.title: One Last Drive & New Year's Eve
itinerary.description:
Retrace the winding mountain roads back to Aizawl, with stops at picturesque viewpoints and charming villages along the way — one last chance to take in Mizoram's landscapes. By evening, check back into Aizawl for New Year's Eve — a celebration dinner with the group and the countdown to midnight over the lit-up hills, looking back on a week's worth of memories.
🌙 Overnight: Aizawl
<div

itinerary.title: Until the Next Adventure
itinerary.description:
Depending on your flight schedule, enjoy a relaxed morning in Aizawl before the transfer to Lengpui Airport. Wake up to the first morning of the new year in Aizawl. From hidden waterfalls and mountain camps to border towns and a New Year's Eve in the hills — you'll carry home stories from one of India's most unexplored states, and perhaps a reason to return.
✈️ Fly Home from Lengpui Airport

itinerary.title: Welcome to the Top of the World
itinerary.description:
Land at Leh Airport (3,256 m) and step into crisp, take-your-breath-away winter air. Drive to the hotel past snow-dusted mountains and the frozen Indus Valley, then rest. Acclimatisation at 3,500 m is non-negotiable, so drink water, eat light and sleep early on a Christmas night under a sky full of stars.
Highlight of the Day: That first breath of Leh air stepping off the plane. Cold, thin, completely unlike anything else.
🌙 Overnight: Leh
<div

itinerary.title: Leh, Uninterrupted
itinerary.description:
A slow day of sights. Climb to Leh Palace for rooftop views over the snow-covered valley, visit the glowing white Shanti Stupa, and explore Thiksey Monastery, a 12th century gompa stacked twelve storeys up a hillside in complete winter silence. Finish with something hot in a Leh caf .
Highlight of the Day: Thiksey Monastery in winter silence, twelve storeys of ancient gompa above the frozen Indus Valley.
🌙 Overnight: Leh
<div

itinerary.title: Into Snow Leopard Country
itinerary.description:
Drive west to Gurudwara Pathar Sahib, a 1517 shrine built into the rockface beside the Indus, then Alchi Monastery, a thousand-year-old complex famed for its ancient wall paintings. Continue into the wilder valleys of Hemis Shukpachan and Uley, the heart of snow leopard country. Early dinner, early night.
Highlight of the Day: Alchi's ancient murals, and arriving in snow leopard country as the light fades over the mountains.
🌙 Overnight: Hemis Shukpachan
<div

itinerary.title: The Ghost of the Himalayas
itinerary.description:
A pre-dawn start with your tracker for two sessions, morning and afternoon. In winter prey animals descend and the leopards follow, so this is the best sighting window of the year. Bharal, ibex, red fox and Himalayan birds are near-certain; the snow leopard itself can never be promised, but every effort goes into finding it.
Highlight of the Day: The tracker going still. The binoculars going up. The mountain holding its breath.
🌙 Overnight: Hemis Shukpachan
<div

itinerary.title: Over the Pass & Into the Valley
itinerary.description:
Drive back towards Leh, then north over Khardung La (5,359 m), snow-covered and almost empty in winter, with the Karakoram stretching ahead. Descend into Nubra Valley, stopping at Diskit Monastery and its 32-metre Maitreya Buddha, then on to Hunder and its frozen river and snowy dunes.
Highlight of the Day: Cresting Khardung La in winter with the Karakoram spread out below.
🌙 Overnight: Nubra
<div

itinerary.title: The Frozen Valley Is Yours
itinerary.description:
An early morning walk through Hunder's snow-covered dunes beside the frozen Shyok River. Then the Nubra hot springs: warm mineral pools in the middle of a frozen landscape. Around noon, head back to Leh.
Highlight of the Day: Sinking into a geothermal hot spring in the middle of a frozen Himalayan desert.
🌙 Overnight: Leh
<div

itinerary.title: The Long Road to Midnight
itinerary.description:
An early start along the dramatic Shyok route towards Pangong Tso, one of the highest saltwater lakes in the world. In deep winter this depends on army permissions and road conditions, so the lake is attempted but not guaranteed; the valley drive is spectacular either way. Back in Leh for New Year's Eve with a bonfire, local food and midnight at 3,500 m.
Highlight of the Day: Pangong frozen solid under a winter sky, or a bonfire in Leh at midnight with the Himalayas overhead.
🌙 Overnight: Leh
<div

trips.title: Sri Lanka From the Highlands to the Shore

itinerary.title: The Island Clocks In
itinerary.description:
Noon arrival, and Sri Lanka wastes no time. Christmas week here is warm, alive and nothing like the shut-down holiday of mainland Europe — Colombo is dressed up, the restaurants are full and the streets have that particular holiday electricity.
First stop, Galle Face Green: the long seafront promenade where the whole city comes to exhale, with kites, street food and the Indian Ocean doing its thing. Evening is Colombo after dark — rooftop bars with city and ocean views and Sri Lankan food that will reframe everything you thought you knew about the cuisine.
Highlight of the Day: First evening in Colombo — city below, ocean ahead, seven days of Sri Lanka still in front of you.
🌙 Overnight: Colombo
<div

itinerary.title: Into the Highlands
itinerary.description:
Drive east and up as Colombo gives way to the central highlands. Tea estates appear on the hillsides, the air cools noticeably and the whole country shifts into a different gear.
Laxapana Falls sits at 126 metres, one of the highest waterfalls in Sri Lanka, reached by a hike through forest and mist that earns the view properly. For those who want to go further, abseiling down the face of the falls is available as an optional experience. Hatton by evening — a small highland town most itineraries drive straight past. Dinner, warmth and the hills outside the window.
Highlight of the Day: Standing at the base of Laxapana Falls after the hike up — the water thundering above, the mist everywhere.
🌙 Overnight: Hatton
<div

itinerary.title: Tea, Temples & the Train
itinerary.description:
The most scenic day of the trip. Morning in Nuwara Eliya starts at a working tea estate where the journey from leaf to cup happens right in front of you, then Seetha Amman Kovil (Sitamma temple), a colourful Hindu temple tucked into the hills and traditionally associated with the Ramayana.
Then on to Ella. For those who want it, the optional scenic train from Nanu Oya through tea country is one of the great rail journeys in Asia (a roughly 4-hour ride, subject to availability). On the way, Nine Arches Bridge, a British-built stone viaduct in the jungle, best seen the local way: by tuk-tuk. Arrive in Ella by evening — a tiny mountain town with big energy. Golden-hour walk up Little Adam's Peak if the light is right, or straight into caf -hopping down the main strip.
Highlight of the Day: Leaning out that train window. You'll know the exact moment.
🌙 Overnight: Ella
<div

itinerary.title: Jeeps, Elephants & the Coast Ahead
itinerary.description:
Today has range. Breakfast, then out of Ella's cool air with a stop at Ravana Falls before the landscape shifts from tea estates to dry scrub. En route, the Udawalawe Elephant Transit Home, where rescued and orphaned young elephants are rehabilitated before release — a quieter, more emotional stop before the main event.
Then an open-jeep safari through Udawalawe National Park by afternoon, with herds of elephants moving through the scrub in golden light. Then the coast: Mirissa appearing ahead as the sun drops and the air turns salty and warm. Check in and let the southern coast settle around you.
Highlight of the Day: Elephants at golden hour in Udawalawe. Africa-level safari in South Asia.
🌙 Overnight: Mirissa
<div

itinerary.title: The Last Day of the Year
itinerary.description:
New Year's Eve in Mirissa on the southern coast. If yesterday had range, today has only one setting: beach, full volume. If you're up for it, a beginner surf lesson on one of the best learn-to-surf breaks in Sri Lanka — nobody leaves without standing up at least once.
Then a secret beach you can swing from the palm trees, and Coconut Hill for the views and the inevitable photoshoot. The evening builds and midnight arrives with the Indian Ocean ahead, fireworks somewhere behind you and the whole group together welcoming 2027.
Highlight of the Day: Midnight on the southern coast. 2027 arriving with the Indian Ocean in front of you and everyone around you.
🌙 Overnight: Mirissa
<div

itinerary.title: The First Day of 2027
itinerary.description:
Happy New Year. Check out of Mirissa and drive up the southwestern coast to Galle, where the ocean is right outside the window the whole way. Galle Fort is a UNESCO World Heritage site of 17th century Dutch colonial architecture, cobblestone lanes, coffee shops, boutique galleries and a lovely bookstore. Walk the ramparts, find a lunch spot with fort and ocean views and get happily lost.
After lunch, drive north to Bentota with a Madu River boat safari on the way — mangrove tunnels so dense they block out the sky, monitor lizards and kingfishers. As the light goes golden, a visit to the turtle hatchery, then a final dinner in Bentota.
Highlight of the Day: Baby turtles heading into the ocean on the first day of 2027. Sri Lanka's final act does not phone it in.
🌙 Overnight: Bentota
<div

trips.title: Philippines The Ocean’s Best Kept Secret

itinerary.title: Welcome to the Philippines
itinerary.description:
Land in Cebu, clear immigration and hit the road south to Oslob, four hours down the coast of Cebu island. Oslob is a slow, sleepy coastal town where the sea does the talking.
Check in, freshen up, go somewhere good for dinner and call it a night. Maybe? Tomorrow starts early.
Highlight of the Day: That first glimpse of the Cebu coast from the car window and the slow realisation that the next eight days are going to be very, very good.
🌙 Overnight: Oslob
<div

itinerary.title: The 3% Island
itinerary.description:
Early morning, an optional swim with whale sharks. It's one of the most debated wildlife experiences in the country, so the full picture is in the FAQs. Not for you? Sleep in and grab a coffee by the water.
Noon ferry across to Siquijor, the Island of Fire, which less than 3% of visitors ever reach. Check in, grab scooters and head straight to Paliton Beach for sunset — white sand, ancient acacia trees and a quiet, warm sea.
Highlight of the Day: Paliton Beach at sunset on your first evening in Siquijor — the 3% destination.
🌙 Overnight: Siquijor
<div

itinerary.title: Siquijor, Fully
itinerary.description:
A whole day on scooters with no fixed schedule. Start at Cantabon Cave, a living cave system where you wade through underground streams, squeeze through narrow passages and emerge into cathedral-sized chambers.
Then Cambugahay Falls, turquoise freshwater tiers tumbling through the jungle, and Salagdoong cliff jumping — two platforms, one reasonable and one that makes you reconsider your life choices. Somewhere in the day, the PTT Secret Experience.
Highlight of the Day: Siquijor giving you a cave, a waterfall, a cliff jump and a secret all in one day.
🌙 Overnight: Siquijor
<div

itinerary.title: The Ocean Puts On a Show
itinerary.description:
A drive and a ferry take you back to Cebu island, then up the coast to Moalboal, a small, laid-back diving town with a coral-fringed coastline and cold San Miguel. Check in and be in the water by noon.
PTT includes a scuba dive straight through the sardine run — millions of fish moving as one around you, sea turtles cruising past. Certified or not, you're in: an introductory fun dive needs no certification and no swimming ability, and snorkelling is available too.
Highlight of the Day: Being completely inside a sardine run underwater, the fish parting around you, a sea turtle drifting past.
🌙 Overnight: Moalboal
<div

itinerary.title: Into the Canyon
itinerary.description:
Roughly 5 hours+ of jumping, sliding, climbing, wading and swimming through the limestone canyon at Kawasan, with cliff jumps ranging from manageable to absolutely not . It ends at Kawasan Falls, a three-tiered turquoise waterfall.
Non swimmers are completely covered with life jackets and experienced guides, and nobody is pushed beyond their comfort zone. Evening back in Moalboal for rest, food and the ocean.
Highlight of the Day: That last jump into the turquoise pool at the base of Kawasan Falls, the whole group in the water and the falls thundering above you.
🌙 Overnight: Moalboal
<div

itinerary.title: Island Hop
itinerary.description:
Check out of Moalboal and transfer to Cebu Airport, about three hours by road, for the flight to Coron. Coron from the air is your first hint of what's coming — limestone karsts rising straight out of turquoise water.
Land, transfer to town and check in. Coron town is small, warm and immediately likeable, with a waterfront main street, bangka boats in the harbour and low-key nightlife. Dinner, cold beers by the water and an early night — tomorrow is the big one.
Highlight of the Day: That first view of Coron from the plane.
🌙 Overnight: Coron
<div

itinerary.title: The Best Day
itinerary.description:
The best day of every PTT trip it has ever appeared on. A bangka boat takes you through Coron Bay to Kayangan Lake, Twin Lagoon and Coral Garden for snorkelling among clownfish, parrotfish and sea turtles.
Then a beachside group lunch on a sandbar in the middle of the ocean, and Barracuda Lake after lunch, where the water shifts from warm to scalding within metres. Back in Coron by sunset — nobody wants it to be over.
Highlight of the Day: All of it. Coron's boat day doesn't have a highlight. It is the highlight, start to finish.
🌙 Overnight: Coron
<div

itinerary.title: Home. Or the Beginning of Something Else
itinerary.description:
Transfer to Coron Airport and fly home with eight days of the Philippines within you.
✈️ Coron Airport → Home

itinerary.title: Georgia Doesn't Wait
itinerary.description:
Arrive before 2:30pm, transfer to the hotel, and step straight into a Tbilisi fully lit up for Christmas week. Wander the main Christmas fair — handmade crafts, street food, mulled wine, and a shot of chacha likely appearing in your hand before you've asked for one.
Highlight of the Day: That first walk through Tbilisi's Christmas fair when the fairy lights come on, the chacha appears and you realise this country is going to be nothing like what you expected.
🌙 Overnight: Tbilisi
<div

itinerary.title: Into the Vines
itinerary.description:
Drive east into Kakheti, the wine region of a country that invented wine 8,000 years ago, for the PTT Secret Experience and a stop at Bodbe Monastery. Then Sighnaghi, the City of Love — walk its medieval walls at sunset as the valley below turns gold. Sleep in an igloo dome above it all.
Highlight of the Day: Walking Sighnaghi's medieval walls at sunset with the Alazani Valley going gold below and the Caucasus behind it. And then climbing into an igloo dome above all of it.
🌙 Overnight: Sighnaghi
<div

itinerary.title: Tbilisi From Above
itinerary.description:
Drive back to Tbilisi for Narikala Fortress and Kartlis Deda, the 20-metre Mother of Georgia statue overlooking the city. Ride the Mtatsminda funicular up to 770 metres for sweeping views. Evening free for the sulphur baths or dinner in the old town.
Highlight of the Day: Kartlis Deda rising above Narikala Fortress with sword and wine bowl raised and the whole of Tbilisi below her. Georgia's character in one image.
🌙 Overnight: Tbilisi
<div

itinerary.title: The Road That Legends Are Made Of
itinerary.description:
Drive the legendary Georgian Military Highway, stopping at the Zhinvali Reservoir and the 16th century Ananuri Fortress. The road climbs north through the Caucasus as snow takes over the landscape, ending at Gudauri — a ski resort at 2,196 metres.
Highlight of the Day: That first moment the Caucasus opens up fully around you on the Military Highway and you realise this road has been making people stop and stare for two thousand years. For good reason.
🌙 Overnight: Gudauri
<div

itinerary.title: Peak Georgia
itinerary.description:
Visit the Friendship Monument, then take 4x4s up a snowy mountain track to Gergeti Trinity Church at 2,170 metres, with Mount Kazbek rising behind it. Afternoon free to ski, snowboard, sled, or just take in the mountains. Last night in Gudauri.
Highlight of the Day: Gergeti Trinity Church in the snow with Mt. Kazbek behind it.
🌙 Overnight: Gudauri
<div

itinerary.title: Ancient Capitals & The Night Georgia Goes Crazy
itinerary.description:
Drive south to Mtskheta, Georgia's ancient capital, visiting the Living Pillar Cathedral and Jvari Monastery, then the striking Chronicles of Georgia monument. Back in Tbilisi by evening for New Year's Eve — fireworks, chacha, and strangers greeting you like family until dawn.
Highlight of the Day: Tbilisi at midnight on New Year's Eve. Fireworks, chacha, strangers who feel like old friends and a city that celebrates like it means it. There is nowhere else on earth you'd rather be right now.
🌙 Overnight: Tbilisi
<div

itinerary.title: Happy New Year. Now What?
itinerary.description:
Head to the airport with seven days of Georgia behind you — or stay on. Tbilisi on New Year's Day is slow, warm, and quiet enough to finally wander properly. The trip officially ends today.
✈️ Fly Home from Tbilisi (or Stay On)

itinerary.title: Arrival
itinerary.description:
Mirissa
Arrive at Bandaranaike International Airport where the Offline by Happy Hour team will receive you. After everyone assembles, begin the drive to Mirissa via the Southern Expressway. Enjoy the changing landscapes as you travel from Colombo to the southern coast. Upon arrival, check into the hotel and relax after your journey. Spend some free time by the beach or pool before heading to Secret Jungle Party in the evening (entry at own expense). This lively beach venue is the perfect place to get to know your fellow travellers over music, food and drinks.

itinerary.title: Mirissa & Galle
itinerary.description: After breakfast, enjoy a relaxed morning in Mirissa or Learn suffing at Weligama beach. Later drive to the historic Galle Dutch Fort. Walk along the famous ramparts, lighthouse, charming colonial streets, cafés and boutique stores while enjoying spectacular ocean views. Capture sunset photographs before returning to Mirissa for dinner and head to Dr House for Party

itinerary.title: Mirissa – Ella
itinerary.description: Early risers can opt for the famous Swim with Turtles experience (optional and at additional cost). After breakfast, check out and proceed towards Ella through beautiful mountain roads. On arrival, enjoy an authentic Sri Lankan cooking class where you will learn traditional recipes and local flavours. Check into the hotel and spend the evening exploring Ella.

itinerary.title: Exploring Ella
itinerary.description: Visit the iconic Nine Arches Bridge, Ravana Falls and Little Adam's Peak. Wear comfortable shoes and carry a change of clothes if you wish to enjoy the waterfall. In the evening unwind at Ravana Pool Club with included pool access and redeemable food & beverage credit. Explore Ella Market in the evening

itinerary.title: Ella – Nuwara Eliya
itinerary.description: Travel to the charming hill station of Nuwara Eliya. En route, visit Seetha Amman Temple, lush tea gardens and Gregory Lake. Learn about Sri Lanka's tea heritage and spend time soaking in the cool climate before checking into the hotel.

itinerary.title: Nuwara Eliya – Kandy
itinerary.description: Drive towards Kandy. Visit a Spice Garden and witness a traditional Sri Lankan Cultural Show. Later explore Kandy city at leisure before checking into the hotel

itinerary.title: Kandy – Colombo
itinerary.description: Proceed to Colombo after breakfast. Enjoy a guided city tour covering Independence Square, Galle Face Green, Pettah Market and One Galle Face Mall. Spend your final evening shopping, Casino & enjoy local cuisine and celebrating the end of a memorable trip.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Last morning | Goodbyes and airport drops One last breakfast together and a closing circle where the week gets talked about properly. Then check out, and airport transfers timed to your flights.

trips.title: Paris to Budapest - NYE in Europe

itinerary.title: Arrival
itinerary.description:
Arrival in Paris & Christmas Eve
Meet your Trip Captain for a warm welcome and hotel check-in assistance. Afterward, unwind and spend the rest of the day exploring Paris at your leisure: stroll Parisian streets, admire the architecture, visit local cafes for croissants, macarons, and coffee, and soak up the lively atmosphere in nearby squares and street performances.

itinerary.title: Eiffel Tower visit | Arc de Triomphe| Christmas markets exploration
itinerary.description: Upon completing the sightseeing, we will walk through the streets of Paris to soak in the beautiful evening vibes of the city. Visit the iconic Eiffel Tower and take in breathtaking panoramic views of Paris from the 2nd level, with your entry tickets included. Later we head to fascinating Arc de Triomphe, Spend your evening exploring Christmas markets and drink Mulled wine.

itinerary.title: Marais district exploration in Paris | Christmas markets wandering
itinerary.description: You can take a walk around the rustic streets of Paris, go for wine tasting, visit perfumeries, explore cafes, etc. You also have a choice to take an optional tour to the Louvre Museum, where the famous Mona Lisa painting is kept. You can also opt for a full-day trip to Disneyland Paris to relive your favourite childhood days as you meet your favourite Disney characters while exploring the five captivating realms with classic attractions, dazzling shows, and lively street parades.

itinerary.title: Breakfast | Departure to Amsterdam
itinerary.description:
Have your breakfast at the hotel and get ready for your journey to Amsterdam.
Hotel check-in
You can take a peaceful walk along the famous canals, explore nearby streets, or sit at a local cafe or go pub crawling. Free evening

itinerary.title: Walking guided tour of Amsterdam + History of Amsterdam
itinerary.description: Start your day with a guided walking tour to get to know the history of Amsterdam. Later Relax, walk, or cycle through Amsterdam’s famous 19th-century park, which frequently hosts free open-air shows and performances. Experience evening Canal cruise the city's iconic waterways.

itinerary.title: Half-Day Escape to Zaanse Schans( Amsterdam)
itinerary.description:
Half-Day Escape to Zaanse Schans
- After breakfast, head out for a scenic trip to the charming Dutch village of Zaanse Schans.
- Explore iconic windmills, pretty green wooden houses, and picture-perfect countryside views.
- Soak in the charm of traditional Dutch life before heading back to Amsterdam.
- Spend the rest of the day exploring Amsterdam at your own pace.
**Overnight stay in Amsterdam.**

itinerary.title: Breakfast & The Journey to Berlin
itinerary.description:
Start your morning with breakfast before hopping on the train to Berlin, Germany's vibrant capital. Sit back, enjoy the journey, and watch the European landscapes roll by.
Once you arrive, check in to your hotel, freshen up, and ease into the city at your own pace. Spend the evening wandering through charming streets, discovering local cafés, or grabbing drinks with the group.
Your Berlin adventure starts here

itinerary.title: Berlin's History & A Beer Bike Adventure
itinerary.description:
Step into Berlin's past on a guided WWII walking tour, exploring historic landmarks, remnants of the Berlin Wall and the iconic Checkpoint Charlie. Discover the stories that shaped the city as you walk through some of its most significant historical sites.
Then, switch gears and experience Berlin's fun side with a Berlin Beer Bike ride, enjoying up to 1 litre of beer per person as you pedal through the city with the group.
Spend the evening at leisure. Explore Berlin's buzzing nightlife, discover local bars or simply unwind with your fellow travellers.
History, beer and great company. That's Berlin!

itinerary.title: Prague Calling- MIDNIGHT Fireworks, bells, celebrations
itinerary.description:
Start your morning with breakfast before boarding your train to Prague, the enchanting capital of the Czech Republic. Arrive in the afternoon, check in and get ready to explore this fairytale city along with fireworks at city center, where city turns into big party.
Step into history with entry to the magnificent Prague Castle, followed by a guided walking tour through Prague's charming Old Town, filled with cobblestone streets, stunning architecture and hidden gems.
As evening approaches, head to the iconic Old Town Square with the group to welcome the New Year amid festive celebrations, music and an unforgettable European atmosphere.
New city, new memories

itinerary.title: Exploring Prague & Old town
itinerary.description: Discover Prague’s iconic Old Town Square, Astronomical Clock and St. Nicholas Church, followed by the famous Charles Bridge. In the evening, get ready for Pub crawl and witness unique beers in Prague.

itinerary.title: Sleep in & recovery | Free day to explore Prague
itinerary.description: Take a well-deserved break after the celebrations and enjoy Prague at your own pace. Unwind at a cosy café, wander through charming streets or opt for a Vltava River cruise or a Hop-On Hop-Off bus tour. Today is all about relaxing and exploring your way.

itinerary.title: Breakfast | Train to Budapest (2.5 hrs, scenic Danube valley)
itinerary.description: After breakfast, board your train to Budapest for a scenic journey through the Danube Valley. Upon arrival, settle into the city before heading out for an evening Danube River cruise, with beautiful views of Budapest’s illuminated landmarks. The rest of the evening is yours to explore.

itinerary.title: Free day to explore Budapest
itinerary.description:
**Title:** Budapest Unplugged: Thermal Baths & One Last Hurrah 🥂
**Copy:**
After days of exploring Europe, it’s time to slow down! Spend the afternoon unwinding at Budapest’s famous Széchenyi Thermal Baths (optional, at your own cost), the perfect way to relax after all those late nights.
Want to explore more? Shop along Fashion Street, soak up panoramic views from Gellért Hill, discover cosy local cafés or try an optional shooting range experience.
As evening rolls in, get ready to raise a glass with your travel crew and celebrate the final night of our European adventure.
**13 days, countless memories, one unforgettable trip. What. A. Journey!** 🇭🇺✨

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Breakfast Budapest | Farewell and final adios | Departure flight One last breakfast together and a closing circle where the week gets talked about properly. Then check out, and airport transfers timed to your flights.

itinerary.title: Arrival
itinerary.description:
Arrival in Hanoi & Half-Day City Tour
Touch down in Hanoi, Vietnam's charming capital, where a private transfer will take you straight to your hotel. Once settled in, set out on a half-day city tour through the city's timeless landmarks — think tree-lined boulevards, colonial-era architecture, and the atmospheric Old Quarter with its bustling streets. Round off the day with a relaxed evening exploring local street food and the shimmering Hoan Kiem Lake.
Overnight stay in Hanoi

itinerary.title: Halong Bay Day Cruise
itinerary.description:
Head out on a full-day cruise across the emerald waters of Halong Bay, one of the world's most spectacular natural wonders. Drift past thousands of towering limestone karsts and islets, stop to explore a striking limestone cave, and enjoy a freshly prepared seafood lunch onboard as the dramatic scenery glides by. Return to Hanoi in the evening with memories (and photos) to last a lifetime.
Overnight stay in Hanoi

itinerary.title: Hanoi to Da Nang & Hoi An Lantern Boat Ride
itinerary.description:
Fly from Hanoi to Da Nang, where you'll be met and transferred onward to the enchanting ancient town of Hoi An. As dusk falls, glide along the Thu Bon River on a traditional lantern boat ride, surrounded by the glow of hundreds of floating paper lanterns — a magical, unmissable Hoi An experience. Spend the rest of the evening wandering the lantern-lit Old Town.
Overnight stay in Da Nang

itinerary.title: Ba Na Hills Full-Day Tour
itinerary.description:
Spend a full day at Ba Na Hills, a mountaintop resort accessed via one of the world's longest cable car rides, offering sweeping views over forested hills and the coastline. Walk across the iconic Golden Bridge, cradled by a pair of giant stone hands, explore the charming recreated French Village, and enjoy the rides and attractions at Fantasy Park before transferring back in the evening.
Overnight stay in Da Nang

itinerary.title: Da Nang to Phu Quoc – Day at Leisure
itinerary.description:
Bid farewell to Da Nang and fly to the tropical island paradise of Phu Quoc. With the rest of the day free at leisure, use the time to unwind on pristine white-sand beaches, take a dip in the turquoise waters, or simply relax by the pool at your resort and soak in the island's laid-back vibe.
Overnight stay in Phy Qouc

itinerary.title: VinWonders, Kiss Bridge & Kiss of the Sea Show
itinerary.description:
Enjoy an entrance-ticket-included day at VinWonders, Phu Quoc's massive theme park packed with thrilling rides, water attractions, and entertainment for all ages. Later, visit the striking Kiss Bridge at Sunset Town before capping off the year in spectacular style at the Kiss of the Sea show — a dazzling display of lights, water, and fire performances, the perfect way to welcome the New Year.
Overnight stay in Phu Quoc

itinerary.title: 4 Island Tour, Phu Quoc
itinerary.description:
Start the New Year with an island-hopping adventure across four of Phu Quoc's most beautiful islands. Snorkel through vibrant coral reefs, laze on secluded white-sand beaches, and savour a fresh seafood lunch aboard the boat as you cruise between islands under the tropical sun.
Overnight stay in Phu Quoc

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Last morning | Goodbyes and airport drops As your trip draws to a close, enjoy some free time for last-minute shopping or relaxation before a private transfer takes you to Phu Quoc Airport for your onward flight home, marking the end of a memorable Vietnam journey.

itinerary.title: Arrival
itinerary.description:
Arrive in Ubud | Explore & Vibe
Arrive in Bali and head to Ubud, surrounded by lush forests and rice fields. Check in and ease into the trip. Evening: explore bars & restaurants with the group — relaxed vibes, good food, easy conversations.

itinerary.title: ATV Adventure | Swings | Cretya Scene - Arrive in Ubud | Explore & Vibe
itinerary.description:
Head out for the famous ATV ride through jungles, rivers, caves & rice fields. Lunch buffet is included after the ATV ride.
Visit coffee plantations on the way during room, offering a complimentary coffee tasting session.
Head to Alas Harum for the iconic Bali Swing & terrace views.
End at Cretya beach club (entry included) by the evening.
Optional : Visit Ubud market in the night!
Overnight stay in Ubud.

itinerary.title: Ubud to Gili T | Island Mode On
itinerary.description:
Have an early breakfast on the go and head early morning to take the transfer from hotel to Padang Bai harbour.
Now we take a ferry here from the harbour to Gili T island. Land tax and cidomo (horse cart) is included.
Gili T is a small motor free island, which has no cars or cabs. You can walk or take a scooty on rental to cover the island.
Travel to Gili Trawangan — beaches, bikes, island energy. Check in & explore. Sunset views.
Night: pub crawl (optional) — music, drinks, fun night.

itinerary.title: Snorkel, Chill & Welcome 2027!
itinerary.description:
Have a relaxing breakfast at Gili.
Head out to spend your day island-hopping through the breathtaking Gili Islands, with an optional snorkelling experience to swim alongside sea turtles, explore vibrant coral reefs, and discover the famous underwater statues.
Gili T is famous for scuba, which is a must try! (not included)
As the sun sets, the islands transform into one giant celebration. Dance barefoot on the beach, watch fireworks light up the sky, hop between beach bars, and welcome the New Year surrounded by music, ocean views, and an unforgettable crowd. It's the kind of night you'll be talking about long after the countdown ends.
here, we celebrate the New Year together!
Trip Highlight ✨

itinerary.title: Back to Bali | Seminyak Nights
itinerary.description:
Wake up early, have breakfast and take the ferry back to Padang Bai.
From there, we have a transfer directly to Seminyak.
Return to Bali & check into Seminyak hotel.
Visit Love Anchor, explore the Canggu area and explore La Favela / Mexicola. (additonal)

itinerary.title: Nusa Penida or Beach Clubs
itinerary.description:
This day is a bit relaxed! You can choose formt he two -
Option 1: Nusa Penida — cliffs, iconic views.
Option 2: Beach clubs — The iconic Finns beahc club (pool, music, cocktails).

itinerary.title: Uluwatu Sunset | Finale
itinerary.description:
This is a full day Uluwatu tour.
Wake up, have breakfast and head to the Melasti beach.
Later, we visit the Uluwatu Temple sunset & Kecak fire dance.
In evening we bid farewell meetup for the one last goodbye before we meet again!

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Last morning | Goodbyes and airport drops One last breakfast together and a closing circle where the week gets talked about properly. Then check out, and airport transfers timed to your flights.

trips.title: Bali: The Island Affair , New Year's Edition

itinerary.title: Arrival
itinerary.description:
Touchdown in Bali
The Arrival: Land at Ngurah Rai International Airport (Denpasar), meet your driver, and leave the bustle behind on a scenic drive straight into the lush green heart of Ubud.
Settle In: Check in to your hotel / stay.
Evening: Celebrate your first night with curated welcome ice breakers.
Overnight Stay: 5-Star Resort, Ubud.

itinerary.title: Tirta Emplul Temple, Kanto Lampo waterfall, Alas Harum, Cretya and Bali swing
itinerary.description:
Fuel Up: A slow, luxurious morning breakfast.
The Plan: Take a day tour of Ubud visiting the sacred Tirta Empul temple, famous for it's spiritual bath, the iconic Kanto Lampo waterfall and Alas Harum.
Later, visit the amazing Bali Swing (entry included), and Cretya beach club with a private pool bed.
If time allows, visit the Ubud market late evening.
Overnight Stay: 5-Star Resort, Ubud.

itinerary.title: Transer to Gili T
itinerary.description:
Fuel Up: Quick breakfast on the go and early check-out.
Private transfer to Padang Bai harbour via bus.
From there, we take a luxury AC ferry to Gili T island (approx 3 hours). Land tax is included.
Gili T is a very small motor free island and there are no cars / cabs available. It is majorly covered by walking, horse carts or scooty rentals.
From the harbour, we take a horse cart (included) to the hotel.
Settle In & Explore: Check in to your beachfront 5-star resort. Spend the evening exploring the island’s sandy paths by bicycle or on foot, concluding with a peaceful seaside dinner right on the water.
Later in the evening, we explore the cool bars around Gili T.
Overnight Stay: 5-Star Beachfront Resort, Gili Islands

itinerary.title: The NYE Gala
itinerary.description:
The Day: Wake up late to the sound of ocean waves. Dive into optional snorkelling or glass-or scuba, or simply spend the day floating in the pool and lounging on white-sand shores.
The Celebration: Ring in the New Year in ultimate style. Step out for a private, ultra-exclusive New Year’s Eve Beachfront Gala Dinner (included). Witness the NY 2027 along with fireworks bursting over the Indian Ocean as the midnight clock strikes.
Overnight Stay: 5-Star Beachfront Resort, Gili Islands.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Seminyak
itinerary.description:
Fuel Up: Early New Year's Day breakfast and check to take the ferry back to the harbour.
The Journey: Board your return fast-boat back to mainland Bali, followed by a private transfer to the island’s most polished coastal stretch - Seminyak.
Settle In: Check in to your 5-star Seminyak resort.
Evening: Ease into the first night of the year with beach club sundowners, sunset views, or a quiet, tailored dinner at your own pace.
Optional visit to La Favela, Mexicola and the vibrant nightlife of Bali.
Overnight Stay: 5-Star Resort, Seminyak.

itinerary.title: The Finns Day
itinerary.description:
Wake up and have a relaxing breakfast.
Experience one of the most iconic beach clubs in the world - FINNS! Visit by noon and spend the entire day at the beach club.
Overnight Stay: 5-Star Resort, Seminyak.

itinerary.title: Uluwatu tour & Kecak fire dance
itinerary.description:
Full day uluwatu tour covering the Melasti beach, Uluwatu temple and Kecak Fire Dance. (included)
Overnight stay in Seminyak
One last farewell night before we bid goodbyes!

itinerary.title: Warm Goodbyes & Departure
itinerary.description:
Fuel Up: Final breakfast at the resort and check-out.
Farewell: Spend your final morning browsing local markets for last-minute souvenirs or relaxing by the pool. Take a comfortable private group transfer to Ngurah Rai International Airport for your onward journey home.

itinerary.title: Arrival
itinerary.description:
ARRIVAL IN TBILISI
ARRIVAL IN TBILISI | LET’S GET OFFLINE!
meet your fellow travellers at the airport.
Transfer to the hotel, check in and freshen up.
Get to know your travel gang with fun ice-breaking activities.
Head out to explore Tbilisi’s charming streets, beautifully illuminated with Christmas lights.
Soak in the festive vibes, capture memories and kickstart the trip with new friendships!

itinerary.title: TBILISI OLD TOWN & CITY TOUR
itinerary.description:
Breakfast at the hotel.
Explore the charming Old Town of Tbilisi on a guided walking tour.
Take the cable car to Narikala Fortress and enjoy panoramic city views.
Walk through picturesque streets, visit the waterfall and explore the famous Sulphur Baths area. Cross the iconic Bridge of Peace and discover historic landmarks like Sioni Cathedral, Anchiskhati Church and the famous Clock Tower.
Soak in Tbilisi’s culture, architecture, food and vibrant local charm!

itinerary.title: KAKHETI | WINE, LOVE & COUNTRYSIDE- New Year Celebration
itinerary.description:
Breakfast at the Hotel
Breakfast at the hotel, followed by a scenic drive to Kakheti, Georgia’s famous wine region.
Visit KTW Winery for a wine-tasting experience amidst beautiful vineyards.
Optional bread-making experience at the winery.
Explore the historic Bodbe Monastery and Sighnaghi, famously known as the City of Love.
Enjoy picturesque landscapes, local culture and beautiful moments with your travel gang!
Get Ready for Firework in Freedom Square, New Year Countdowns Begin
Return to Tbilisi

itinerary.title: NEW YEAR'S DAY | MTSKHETA city tour
itinerary.description:
Start the first morning of the New Year with breakfast at the hotel.
Visit Iconic Chronicles of Georgia
Head to Mtskheta, Georgia’s ancient capital, and explore UNESCO-listed landmarks including Jvari Monastery and Svetitskhoveli Cathedral.
End the day soaking in Tbilisi’s vibrant social scene at the iconic Fabrika Bar

itinerary.title: KAZBEGI | MOUNTAIN ADVENTURE & FAREWELL NIGHT
itinerary.description:
Breakfast at the hotel, followed by a scenic drive towards Kazbegi via Gudauri.
Enjoy breathtaking views along the Georgian Military Highway, with a stop at the iconic Russia-Georgia Friendship Monument. Take an adventurous 4x4 Jeep ride to Gergeti Trinity Church, surrounded by majestic snow-covered mountains.
Return to Tbilisi for your final evening.
Wrap up the trip with a memorable farewell night, celebrating new friendships, unforgettable experiences and all the memories made together!

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description:
DEPARTURE | UNTIL NEXT TIME!
Breakfast at the hotel, followed by check-out.
Group Transfer to Tbilisi International Airport for your return journey.
Bid goodbye! taking home beautiful memories, new friendships and stories to last a lifetime

itinerary.title: Arrival
itinerary.description:
Arrival in Paradise — Welcome to Mirissa
Arrive in Colombo (CMB): Meet your group coordinator for a quick briefing, then drive south to Mirissa.
Check-In & Unwind: Settle into your beachfront hotel and freshen up.
Sunset & Social: Sunset walk at Mirissa Beach and meet your fellow travelers over a relaxed evening.
Later, explore the vibrant nightlight in and around Mirissa.

itinerary.title: Coastal Leisure & Historic Galle Fort Discovery
itinerary.description:
Morning at Leisure: Enjoy breakfast, swim at Mirissa Beach, and visit iconic coastal spots like Coconut Tree Hill and Parrot Rock.
You can also opt for some famous water activities surfing lessons (famous in Mirissa).
Galle Fort Exploration: Head to the UNESCO-listed fortress to walk the 17th-century ramparts, view the lighthouse, explore boutique shops, and dine at charming heritage cafes.
Evening Wind-Down: Return to the coast for a stroll along the shoreline and watch the sunset over the Indian Ocean. Explore the nearby cute cafes, instagrammable streets and street markets.
Evening - Visit the beach clubs / bars and get ready for a pre new year party!

itinerary.title: Marine Adventures & New Year's Eve Celebration
itinerary.description:
Beach Morning: Enjoy a beachfront breakfast, swim, and relax before the day's adventure.
Turtle & Reef Snorkeling (3–4 hrs): Guided ocean expedition to swim alongside sea turtles and explore vibrant coral reefs.
Hiriketiya Beach Excursion: Afternoon visit to Hiriketiya Bay for swimming, cafe-hopping, and relaxing before evening festivities.
New Year's Eve Options: Yacht Party: Exclusive evening sunset yacht cruise with DJ and drinks and head back by late evening. (not included)
Later, celebrate onshore with a coastal countdown across iconic hotspots (Secret Jungle Party or Doctor House or Tiki Bar) and a beach bonfire.

itinerary.title: Journey to Colombo — City Discovery Begins
itinerary.description:
Morning Recovery & Travel: Enjoy a late breakfast, check out of your hotel, and take the scenic drive north from Mirissa to Colombo.
Check-In & Rest: Settle into your centrally located Colombo hotel and freshen up for the evening.
Galle Face & Fort District Walk: Stroll the iconic Galle Face Green promenade and explore the historic colonial architecture of the Fort District.
Rooftop Sunset & Dining: Wrap up the day with drinks at a city-view rooftop bar and experience Colombo's vibrant dining scene.

itinerary.title: Colombo Immersion — Culture, Shopping & Nightlife
itinerary.description:
Museum & Colonial Heritage: Breakfast at the hotel, followed by an optional visit to the National Museum or a walking tour of the historic Fort District.
Shopping & Local Flavors: Explore local food markets, shop for fashion and handicrafts at Odel, and lunch at modern city cafes.
Coastal Icons & Relaxation: Tour the historic Galle Face Hotel / mall or head to Mount Lavinia Beach for a swim and optional spa treatments.
Fine Dining & Nightlife: Dine at world-famous spots like Ministry of Crab, then hit rooftop lounges, beach clubs, or top venues like The Ritz. You can also opt to visit the famous casinos in Colombo.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description:
Last morning | Goodbyes and airport drops Final Morning: Enjoy breakfast, take a quick walk for last-minute souvenir shopping, and grab final photos.
Checkout & Departure: Check out of your Colombo hotel and transfer to Bandaranaike International Airport for your flight home.

itinerary.title: Arrival
itinerary.description:
Arrival in Dubai & Marina Dhow Cruise with Dinner
Arrive in Dubai and transfer to the hotel for check-in. In the evening, enjoy a Marina Dhow Cruise with dinner while taking in the illuminated skyline and waterfront views.

itinerary.title: Half-Day Dubai City Tour & Desert Safari with BBQ Dinner
itinerary.description: Explore Dubai's iconic landmarks, including Jumeirah Beach, Burj Al Arab, Palm Jumeirah and Atlantis The Palm. Later, head into the Arabian desert for 4x4 dune bashing, sunset views and a BBQ dinner with live entertainment.

itinerary.title: Burj Khalifa & New Year's Eve Gala Dinner
itinerary.description: Visit the observation deck of Burj Khalifa on the 124th floor and enjoy spectacular views of the city. In the evening, get ready for a special New Year's Eve Gala Dinner / NYE party with music, entertainment and a midnight countdown to welcome 2027.

itinerary.title: New Year's Day at Leisure
itinerary.description: Enjoy a relaxed breakfast and a slow start to the year. Spend the day exploring Dubai's beaches, cafés and shopping destinations or simply unwind after the celebrations.

itinerary.title: Abu Dhabi City Tour & Ferrari World
itinerary.description: Travel to Abu Dhabi and visit the magnificent Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, followed by a city tour covering prominent landmarks. Continue to Yas Island for an exciting visit to Ferrari World before returning to Dubai.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description:
Departure
Enjoy breakfast at the hotel, check out and transfer to Dubai International Airport for your return journey to India.

itinerary.title: Arrival
itinerary.description:
Arrive in Phuket | Settle in, meet the group Welcome to Thailand.
Private airport transfers, hotel check-in, and time to settle into island mode before meeting your fellow travellers. Meet the crew and kick off the trip with introductions, drinks, and good vibes.
Optional water sports at Patong Beach, including jet skis, parasailing and banana boats.
Tonight, we hit Bangla Walking Street: neon lights, packed bars, street performers, and the perfect start to an unforgettable week.

itinerary.title: Phi Phi Island
itinerary.description:
A full day exploring Thailand's most iconic islands. Maya Bay, Phi Leh Lagoon, Snorkelling sessions among colourful coral reefs and tropical marine life.
Beachside lunch included.
Full day speedboat experience.

itinerary.title: Full Moon Party aka New Year Party
itinerary.description:
Travel to Koh Samui (LAND AND FERRY TRANSFER ) and check into your stay.
As the evening sets in, head to Koh Phangan to welcome the year in style.
Celebrate New Year's Eve at one of the world's most iconic beach parties, with dazzling fireworks, electrifying DJ sets, neon-lit celebrations, fire performances, and thousands of people counting down to midnight under the tropical sky.
Trip Highlight ✨

itinerary.title: Recovery Mode Activated
itinerary.description:
Sleep in, lounge by the pool, hit the beach, or simply recover from the night before.
Explore Chaweng Beach, beach clubs and sunset spots.
Optional night out at Ark Bar.

itinerary.title: Krabi Arrival
itinerary.description:
Travel to Krabi and check into your hotel. Enjoy a traditional Thai massage, local markets and street food.
Join the group pub crawl through Ao Nang's liveliest bars.

itinerary.title: Krabi 4 Islands Adventure
itinerary.description: Visit Koh Poda, Chicken Island and Tup Island. Explore Phra Nang Cave Beach. Enjoy swimming, snorkeling and a free evening in Krabi.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Last morning | Goodbyes and airport drops One last breakfast together and a closing circle where the week gets talked about properly. Then check out, and airport transfers timed to your flights.

itinerary.title: Arrival
itinerary.description:
Arrive in Meghalaya | Settle in, meet the group Arrive in Guwahati and meet your curated group of like-minded travellers. Begin the scenic journey to Shillong, with a stop at the beautiful Umiam Lake (time permitting). En route, break the ice with fun introductions and light-hearted group games. On reaching Shillong, check in to your stay, freshen up and spend the evening getting to know your fellow travellers over good conversations, local food and a relaxed group gathering.
Overnight stay in Shillong.

itinerary.title: Landscapes That Leave You Speechless
itinerary.description:
Visit Laitlum Canyon, Lyngksiar Waterfalls, Arwah Cave, and Nohkalikai Falls. Pause for a sunset viewpoint moment. Return to Cherrapunjee for a relaxed evening with an optional card games / storytelling circle.
Overnight stay in Cherrapunjee

itinerary.title: The Experience That Brings People Closer
itinerary.description:
Trek from Tyrna Village to the Single Root Bridge and the iconic Double Decker Living Root Bridge. A "buddy switch" activity along the way encourages everyone to interact beyond their comfort zone. Post-trek: group reflection + chill session (music, light conversations).
Overnight stay in Cherrapunjee

itinerary.title: Culture, Simplicity & Riverside Evenings
itinerary.description:
Explore Mawsmai Cave and walk through Mawlynnong village. Local lunch experience with Khasi cuisine. Head to Shnongpdeng for riverside camping. Evening bonfire night with curated music, games, and a light-hearted connections circle.
Overnight stay in Dawki region

itinerary.title: Adventure & A Perfect Goodbye Night
itinerary.description:
Experience the crystal-clear waters of the Umngot River — kayaking, boating, or cliff jumping. Visit Krang Suri Waterfall. Return to Shillong for a high-energy closing night with music, dancing, and fun group awards.
OVERNIGHT STAY IN SHILLONG.

itinerary.title: Slow Morning → Departure
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a slow, unhurried morning. Optional coffee hangout or lakeside walk at Umiam Lake before departure. Leave with shared memories, inside jokes, and meaningful connections.
Book early, pay less Dates & prices DEC 30
Dec 30 – Jan 4

trips.title: India's Biggest NYE Trip with 100 Singles — Jaisalmer

itinerary.title: Arrival
itinerary.description: The road trip begins Evening meet-up at the Delhi pickup point. Introductions and icebreakers to kick things off on the road. Overnight drive to Jaisalmer by Tempo Traveller / bus.

itinerary.title: Into the desert & NYE under the stars
itinerary.description: Morning arrival in Jaisalmer and transfer to the desert camp. Check in, freshen up, welcome briefing and group bonding at camp. Afternoon at leisure to rest and recharge after the drive. The big one: NYE gala dinner, music and dancing under the desert sky, and a midnight countdown to 2027 with 100 new people.

itinerary.title: Golden Fort, Ghost Village & sunset on the dunes
itinerary.description: Late start after the celebrations, followed by breakfast. Explore Jaisalmer Fort and its golden sandstone architecture, with free time in the local markets. Visit Kuldhara, the abandoned village popularly known as the Ghost Village. Afternoon jeep safari and camel ride at Sam Sand Dunes, and sunset across the dunes. Back at camp for a Rajasthani folk cultural evening and dinner.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description:
Back to reality (sadly)
Breakfast at camp. Check out and drive back to Delhi, arriving late night.

itinerary.title: Overnight departure from Delhi
itinerary.description:
Board your overnight Volvo from Delhi and get ready for a refreshing mountain escape. Leave behind the city chaos, settle into your seats, make yourself comfortable and enjoy the overnight journey.
Get some rest along the way, because by morning, you'll be waking up to winding mountain roads, fresh mountain air and the beautiful landscapes of Himachal Pradesh.

itinerary.title: The Journey Begins to Jibhi
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Aut Tunnel early in the morning, where our tempo traveller will be waiting to pick us up for a scenic drive to Jibhi in the beautiful Tirthan Valley (approximately 2 hours). Enjoy the winding mountain roads, lush green landscapes and refreshing Himalayan air as we make our way towards our destination.
On reaching Jibhi, check into your stay, freshen up and take some time to relax after the overnight journey. Once everyone is recharged, head out to explore the charming Jibhi Waterfall, followed by the stunning turquoise pools of Kulhi Katandi, popularly known as Mini Thailand. Spend some time soaking in the natural beauty before exploring Jibhi's quaint mountain cafés and enjoying the laid-back village vibe.
Return to the property by evening, unwind and enjoy a delicious dinner with the group.

itinerary.title: Jalori Pass & Raghupur Fort with DJ Night
itinerary.description:
Wake up to a refreshing mountain morning and enjoy a hearty breakfast before setting off towards Jalori Pass. From here, we'll begin our trek to the beautiful Raghupur Fort, walking through enchanting forest trails surrounded by towering pine trees and breathtaking Himalayan landscapes. Once at the top, soak in the spectacular 360-degree panoramic views of the surrounding mountains and valleys.
Please note that the trek is subject to weather conditions, snow levels and trail accessibility. In case the route is closed or deemed unsafe, we'll arrange an alternative experience so the adventure doesn't stop!
After an adventurous day in the mountains, return to the stay and gear up for a cosy evening filled with music, laughter, a bonfire and an exciting DJ night under the starry Himalayan sky.

itinerary.title: One Last Mountain Escape
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a slow and peaceful morning in the mountains with a relaxed breakfast and some downtime at the property. Once you've soaked in the last bit of Jibhi's laid-back mountain vibe, check out and head out for a short 30-minute trek to a nearby waterfall. Spend some time amidst nature, capture a few final memories and make the most of your last adventure in the valley.
After lunch, we'll bid goodbye to the beautiful mountains and drive towards Aut Tunnel, where we'll board our overnight Volvo back to Delhi.
Sit back, relax and relive all the beautiful memories, new friendships and adventures from the trip as we make our way home.

itinerary.title: Arrival
itinerary.description:
Arrival & Almaty welcome • Arrive in Almaty and complete immigration formalities.
• Meet our team at the airport and transfer to the hotel.
• Check in, settle in and take the afternoon to unwind after your journey.
• Evening: Welcome dinner with introductions and a short trip briefing on timings, weather, local etiquette and group communication.
Overnight stay in Almaty.

itinerary.title: Almaty city tour & Kok Tobe
itinerary.description:
• Breakfast at the hotel.
• City tour covering Zenkov Cathedral, Panfilov Park and the vibrant Green Bazaar.
• Ride the cable car up to Kok Tobe for panoramic views of the city and the snow-capped mountains • Return to the hotel. Later, explore the lively Arbat Street at your own pace.
Overnight stay in Almaty.

itinerary.title: Charyn Canyon, Kolsai Lake & Saty Village
itinerary.description:
• Early breakfast at the hotel, then set off on a scenic road trip through Kazakhstan’s winter landscapes.
• Explore the dramatic rock formations of Charyn Canyon on a hike through the Valley of Castles.
• Continue to Kolsai Lake, frozen over and surrounded by snow-covered spruce forests and mountains.
Overnight stay in Saty Village.

itinerary.title: Kaindy Lake & back to Almaty
itinerary.description:
• Breakfast at the guesthouse, then head out to Kaindy Lake.
• Continue towards the lake on foot, or opt for a local 4x4 or horseback ride (at own cost).
• See the frozen lake and its iconic sunken forest, with spruce trunks rising out of the ice.
• Drive back to Almaty and check in at the hotel.
Overnight stay in Almaty.

itinerary.title: Almaty city, views & farewell
itinerary.description:
• Breakfast at the hotel.
• Head to Shymbulak Ski Resort, set in the Zailiysky Alatau mountains.
• Enjoy a scenic cable car ride with panoramic mountain views.
• Explore the resort and try optional skiing, snowboarding and winter activities (at own cost).
Return to Almaty and unwind at the hotel.
• In the evening, opt for a casino visit for some late-night excitement (by own)
Overnight stay in Almaty.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description:
Departure & Goodbyes
Breakfast at the hotel.
• Warm hugs & Memories, Bid goodbyes until we meet again!
Book early, pay less Dates & prices JAN 15
Jan 15 – 20

trips.title: Thailand After Dark: The Full Moon Experience

itinerary.title: Arrival
itinerary.description:
Welcome to Thailand
• Touch down in Phuket and take a private airport transfer to your hotel • Check in, freshen up and unwind before the adventure begins • Meet your fellow travellers over welcome drinks, good conversation and island vibes • Optional: head to Patong Beach for water sports like jet skiing, parasailing and banana boat rides • As the sun goes down, Phuket comes alive. Spend the night on Bangla Walking Street, with neon lights, buzzing bars and live entertainment • An unforgettable first night with the crew.
Overnight in Phuket

itinerary.title: Island Hopping – Phi Phi by Speedboat
itinerary.description:
• A full day on a speedboat exploring Thailand’s most famous islands • Cruise into Maya Bay, the stunning cove surrounded by tall limestone cliffs • Float through the clear, emerald water of Phi Leh Lagoon
• Snorkel among colourful coral reefs and tropical fish • Lunch on the beach, included, with island views • Head back to Phuket as the sun goes down, sun-kissed and happy Overnight in Phuket

itinerary.title: The Full Moon Party - Highlight of the Trip
itinerary.description:
• Travel to Koh Samui by road and ferry, with sea views along the way • Check in to your stay and rest up before the big night • In the evening, take a boat across to Koh Phangan for the legendary Full Moon Party
• Dance on the beach to DJ sets, with neon body paint, fire shows and beachside bars • A night of dancing under the full moon that you’ll talk about for years Overnight in Koh Samui

itinerary.title: Slow Day in Koh Samui
itinerary.description: • Sleep in and recover from the night before. No alarms today • Lounge by the pool, hit the beach or book a spa session • Explore Chaweng Beach, its beach clubs and the best sunset spots on the island • Optional: a night out at Ark Bar, one of Samui’s best-known beach party spots Overnight in Koh Samui

itinerary.title: On to Krabi
itinerary.description:
• Travel from Koh Samui to Krabi by ferry and road • Check in to your hotel in Ao Nang
• Unwind with a traditional Thai massage (optional, not included)
• Wander the local markets and try Thai street food: pad thai, mango sticky rice and more • Join the group pub crawl through Ao Nang’s liveliest bars. (Cost not included)
Overnight in Krabi

itinerary.title: Krabi Island Hopping
itinerary.description: • Hop across Koh Poda, Chicken Island and Tup Island by boat • Walk the sandbar that links Tup Island to its neighbours at low tide • Explore Phra Nang Cave Beach, with its limestone cliffs and turquoise water • Swim and snorkel in calm, clear water • Free evening in Krabi to explore, shop or just relax Overnight in Krabi

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description:
Goodbye, Thailand
• One last breakfast together • A closing circle to look back on the week, its best moments and the friendships made • Check out, with airport transfers timed to your flights • Leave with sun-kissed memories and a new travel crew

trips.title: Ladakh Winter Trip: Frozen Pangong & Nubra

itinerary.title: Arrival
itinerary.description:
Land in Leh, Acclimatize day Morning flight into Leh; your trip captain meets you at arrivals. Check in to heated rooms and rest. That's the whole plan. A short, flat stroll near the hotel in the late afternoon, then the Offline welcome dinner: your name, one story, one confession.
Overnight stay in Leh

itinerary.title: Monasteries, Markets & Exploring Leh
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, explore Leh’s cultural and historical landmarks. Visit the iconic Pathar Sahib Gurudwara, followed by the Hall of Fame, a museum dedicated to the Indian Army and its history in Ladakh.
Continue to Leh Palace, offering beautiful views of the town and surrounding mountains. Later, visit Shanti Stupa to soak in the panoramic views of Leh.
Spend the evening exploring Leh Market, browsing local shops, picking up souvenirs and enjoying the cafés. Return to the hotel for dinner.
Overnight stay in Leh.

itinerary.title: Leh- Khardungla- Nubra valley
itinerary.description:
Get ready for a thrilling mountain drive! Cross the snow-covered Khardung La Pass (5,359 m), stop for those mandatory group pictures and descend into the beautiful Nubra Valley.
Visit Diskit Monastery and its magnificent 106-foot Maitreya Buddha, followed by the magical snow-dusted landscapes of Hunder. A day full of mountain views and unforgettable moments Overnight stay in Nubra Valley

itinerary.title: Nubra Valley – Pangong Lake
itinerary.description:
Buckle up for another scenic adventure as we drive towards the iconic Pangong Lake.
Watch dramatic mountain landscapes unfold along the way before arriving at the breathtaking lake. Spend time soaking in its surreal winter beauty and capturing memories with your fellow travellers.
Overnight stay in PANGONG

itinerary.title: Republic Day, over Pangong Lake and back to Leh
itinerary.description:
Wake up to the magical winter landscapes of Pangong Lake. Enjoy the peaceful surroundings and spectacular views before beginning our journey back to Leh. Spend your final evening together, reliving the best moments of the trip, sharing stories and celebrating the friendships made along the way.
Overnight stay in Leh

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description:
Fly home After breakfast, it's time to check out and head to Leh Airport. Take back a camera full of memories, a bunch of new friendships and stories that will last long after the mountains are behind you. Until the next Offline adventure!
Book early, pay less Dates & prices JAN 22
Jan 22 – 27

itinerary.title: Arrival
itinerary.description:
Xin Chào, Hanoi
• Arrive at Noi Bai International Airport and transfer to your hotel • Check in, freshen up and settle into Vietnam’s capital • Spend the rest of the day at your own pace in Hanoi’s Old Quarter, a maze of busy streets, street-food stalls and colonial-era buildings • Take a gentle stroll around Hoan Kiem Lake and see the red Huc Bridge
• Try a Vietnamese egg coffee or sip a drink at one of the city’s buzzing cafés
Overnight in Hanoi

itinerary.title: Ninh Binh – Hoa Lu & Trang An
itinerary.description:
• After breakfast, drive to Ninh Binh, often called the “Ha Long Bay on land”
• Explore Hoa Lu, Vietnam’s ancient capital, with temples dedicated to its early kings • Take a scenic sampan boat ride through Trang An, gliding between towering limestone peaks, rice fields and through natural caves • Soak in some of Vietnam’s most beautiful countryside and stop for plenty of photos • Return to Hanoi in the evening Overnight in Hanoi

itinerary.title: Ha Long Bay Luxury Day Cruise
itinerary.description:
• Travel from Hanoi to Ha Long Bay, a UNESCO World Heritage Site
• Board a luxury day cruise through thousands of limestone islands rising out of emerald water • Enjoy lunch on board with sweeping views of the bay • Explore the bay with cave visits, kayaking or a bamboo boat ride, depending on the cruise route and schedule • Relax on the sundeck and watch the scenery drift by • Return to Hanoi in the evening Overnight in Hanoi

itinerary.title: Fly to Da Nang
itinerary.description:
• After breakfast, check out and transfer to the airport for your domestic flight to Da Nang
• On arrival, transfer to your hotel and check in • The rest of the day is free. Head to My Khe Beach for sand and sea, or stroll along the Han River promenade • In the evening, see Da Nang’s bridges lit up over the river Overnight in Da Nang

itinerary.title: Ba Na Hills & the Golden Bridge
itinerary.description:
• Ride one of the world’s longest cable cars up into the misty Ba Na Hills
• Walk the iconic Golden Bridge, held up by two giant stone hands • Wander through colourful flower gardens and visit the peaceful Linh Ung Pagoda
• Explore the French Village, with cobbled streets, a cathedral and European-style squares • Enjoy an Indian buffet lunch • Have fun at Fantasy Park, the indoor amusement park (not included)
• Return to Da Nang in the evening Overnight in Da Nang

itinerary.title: Marble Mountains, Coconut Forest & Hoi An
itinerary.description:
• Explore the Marble Mountains, a cluster of limestone hills hiding caves, Buddhist pagodas and panoramic viewpoints • Take a fun, traditional basket boat ride through the Cam Thanh Coconut Forest
• Continue to Hoi An Ancient Town, a UNESCO site full of yellow-walled houses, lantern-lined streets and riverside cafés
• Explore the Japanese Covered Bridge, old merchant houses and local tailor shops • As night falls, take a lantern boat ride on the Hoai River and float your own lantern for good luck • Return to Da Nang
Overnight in Da Nang

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description:
Tạm Biệt, Vietnam

Ayubowan, Sri Lanka! – Colombo to Mirissa

Overnight stay at Mirissa

itinerary.description:
• Breakfast at the hotel • Beginner surf lesson at Weligama, one of Sri Lanka’s best beginner beaches, with instructors and boards provided • Spend the afternoon at Galle Fort, a UNESCO-listed old town: walk the ramparts, see the lighthouse and explore the colonial streets full of cafés and boutiques • Watch the sunset from the fort walls as the sky turns gold over the ocean • Head back to Mirissa for a night out at Dr House (own cost)
Overnight stay at Mirissa

itinerary.title: Coastal Views to Jungle Country – Mirissa to Yala
itinerary.description:

• Check in and settle in near the national park • Group dinner out (own cost) and an early night ahead of the safari Over night stay at Yala

itinerary.description:

• Back to the hotel for breakfast, then check out • A scenic 3-hour drive climbing into the hills, past waterfalls and cooler air, to Ella
• Check in and enjoy the mountain views Over night stay at Ella

itinerary.title: Peaks, Trains & Curry in Ella
itinerary.description: • An easy morning hike up Little Adam’s Peak for sweeping views over the valley and tea slopes • Visit the iconic Nine Arch Bridge, timed to catch a train crossing • A Sri Lankan cooking class for lunch: the group cooks its own rice and curry, then sits down to eat together • Unwind late afternoon at Ravana Pool Club, with pool access and food and drink credit included • Night out on Ella’s lively main street Over night stay at Ella

itinerary.title: The Scenic Train Ride & Tea Country
itinerary.description:

Overnight stay at Nuwara Eliya

itinerary.title: White-Water Rafting & Colombo Nights
itinerary.description:

Overnight stay at Colombo

itinerary.description:

trips.title: Finland & Sweden: Valentine's Under the Aurora

itinerary.title: Arrival
itinerary.description:
Helsinki · Hello, Finland
Touch down in Helsinki, where your trip captain meets you and gets you settled into the hotel.
As the afternoon light turns gold, wander with the group past Senate Square, the gleaming White Cathedral and the harbourside Market Square.
End your first day at the welcome meet-up, where a group of strangers starts becoming a crew.
Break the ice with two truths and a lie, Nordic edition, and a seat shuffle so you meet everyone.

itinerary.title: Helsinki & Suomenlinna → night train north · Sauna, sea and the sleeper
itinerary.description:
Hop on the little ferry across the wintry harbour to Suomenlinna, a UNESCO-listed sea fortress, and explore its tunnels, ramparts and snowy lanes.
Warm up the Finnish way, with a sauna and heated sea pool right on the waterfront, and a cold Baltic plunge for the brave.
As night falls, board the Santa Claus Express, battle it out at quiz night in the restaurant car, then drift off as the train heads north to the Arctic.

itinerary.title: Rovaniemi, Lapland · Wake up in the Arctic
itinerary.description:
Open the blinds to snow-covered forests as the train pulls into Rovaniemi, the official hometown of Santa Claus.
Settle into the hotel over breakfast, take a slow afternoon in town, and get fitted for the thermal suit that keeps you toasty at minus 20.
After dark, your trip captain leads the group to a dark-sky spot outside town for your first aurora night, with hot drinks to keep you warm. The lights are never guaranteed, but three aurora nights in mid-February give you strong odds.
Place your aurora bets: everyone guesses what time the lights will show up.

itinerary.title: Rovaniemi & Santa Claus Village · Valentine's, Arctic edition
itinerary.description:
Spend Valentine's morning at Santa Claus Village and step across the Arctic Circle line.
Draw your Secret Valentine and write them an anonymous card at Santa's Post Office. Your trip captain keeps the cards safe until the big reveal.
Glide through the snowy forest on a husky sleigh ride.
As night falls, head out on a guided aurora hunt and gather around a wilderness bonfire, waiting for the sky to turn green.

itinerary.title: Rovaniemi, Lapland · Reindeer, snowmobiles, ice holes
itinerary.description:
Visit a reindeer farm, take a short reindeer sleigh ride, and hear how herding families live this far north.
Up for some speed? Join the optional snowmobile safari across frozen rivers and forest trails (you need a valid driving licence to drive; otherwise, ride as a passenger).
In the evening, sweat it out in a Finnish sauna, then take the plunge into an ice hole while the group cheers you on. Back in the warmth, it's sauna confessions: everyone answers one honest question, and what is said in the sauna stays in the sauna.
Wrap up with a guided aurora hunt on your last night under the Arctic sky.

itinerary.title: Rovaniemi → night train south · A slow Lapland day
itinerary.description:
Take the morning at your own pace: float on a frozen river in a survival suit, explore the Arktikum museum, or curl up in a cafe and watch the snow fall.
Pick up your last Lapland souvenirs in town.
Board the evening sleeper train south and take one last look at Lapland from the window, while the group votes on the Lapland superlatives: who has earned which title so far?

itinerary.title: Helsinki → overnight cruise to Stockholm · The party cruise
itinerary.description:
Roll back into Helsinki in the early morning and leave your bags at the luggage storage we arrange.
Spend a few free hours at Oodi, Helsinki's striking library, or browsing the shops of the Design District.
In the late afternoon, board the overnight cruise to Stockholm and watch Helsinki slip away at sunset from the deck.
Then the ship comes alive. Dress in red for our Valentine's-week party night, with bars, live music and a dance floor that goes late.

itinerary.title: Stockholm · Islands, ships and Södermalm
itinerary.description:
Wake up to snowy islands as the ship threads through the Stockholm archipelago, then drop your bags at the hotel.
Step inside the Vasa Museum, home to a 17th-century warship that sank on its maiden voyage and was raised from the sea almost intact.
Graze your way through Östermalm's historic food hall, then pair up at random for fika roulette: an afternoon coffee and cinnamon bun with someone new.
Spend the evening in Södermalm, Stockholm's creative, bar-filled island.

itinerary.title: Stockholm · One last night
itinerary.description:
Walk Gamla Stan's cobbled lanes with your trip captain, from colourful Stortorget square to the Royal Palace.
Take a free afternoon for shopping, museums or one more fika.
Close the trip with a farewell night, the Offline Awards and the Secret Valentine reveal, when you finally find out who wrote your card.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Stockholm → home · Fly home Share one last breakfast with the crew, snap the last group photo and take the group transfer to Stockholm Arlanda, with the trip playlist landing on your phone on the way.
