• Head out on the famous ATV ride through jungle trails, muddy rivers, caves and rice fields. Expect to get gloriously muddy!
• Refuel with an included buffet lunch after the ride • On the way, stop at a coffee plantation for a free coffee tasting session, including Bali’s famous Luwak coffee ☕
• Head to Alas Harum for the iconic Bali Swing, flying high over the rice terraces, plus the terrace viewpoints and photo spots • End the day at Cretya beach club (entry included), with infinity pools overlooking the jungle and sunset drinks • Optional: explore Ubud Night Market for local food and souvenirs Overnight stay at Ubud

itinerary.title: Off to Gili Trawangan
itinerary.description:
• An early start with breakfast on the go • Transfer from the hotel to Padang Bai harbour • Take a fast boat across the sea to Gili Trawangan (Gili T)
• Island land tax and a cidomo (horse cart) ride to your stay are included • Gili T has no cars, scooters or cabs. Get around on foot or by renting a bicycle • Check in and explore the island’s beaches, beach bars and laid-back island energy • Catch your first Gili sunset from the west coast, one of the best sunset spots around • Night: optional pub crawl with music, drinks and a fun first night on the island Overnight stay at Gili Trawangan

itinerary.title: Scuba & Party
itinerary.description:
• A slow, relaxed breakfast on the island • Spend the day island-hopping through the beautiful Gili Islands
• Optional snorkelling: swim with sea turtles, explore vibrant coral reefs and see the famous underwater statues • Gili T is famous for scuba diving, so it’s a must-try for anyone keen (not included) 🤿
• As the sun sets, the island becomes one giant celebration • Dance barefoot on the beach, hop between beach bars and watch fireworks light up the sky Overnight stay at Gili Trawangan

itinerary.title: Back to Bali – Seminyak & Canggu
itinerary.description:
• Wake up, have breakfast and take the fast boat back to Padang Bai
• Transfer directly to Seminyak and check in at the hotel • Visit Love Anchor, Canggu’s bohemian weekend market of crafts, clothes and food stalls • Explore the trendy Canggu area, with surf beaches, cafés and boutiques • In the evening, head to La Favela or Mexicola, two of Seminyak’s most popular bar and party spots (at own cost)
Overnight stay: at Seminyak

itinerary.title: Your Pick – Nusa Penida or Beach Club Day
itinerary.description:
• Option 1: Nusa Penida. A day trip to Bali’s most dramatic island, with towering cliffs, the famous T-Rex-shaped Kelingking Beach, Broken Beach and Angel’s Billabong
• Option 2: Beach club day. Spend the day at the iconic Finns Beach Club, with pools, DJs, cocktails and sunset on the beach 🍸
Overnight stay at Seminyak

itinerary.title: Uluwatu – Beaches, Cliffs & Fire Dance
itinerary.description:
• After breakfast, set off on a full-day Uluwatu tour • Start at Melasti Beach, with white sand, turquoise water and dramatic limestone cliffs • Visit Uluwatu Temple, perched on a clifftop 70 m above the ocean, for a breathtaking sunset (watch out for the cheeky monkeys! )
• Watch the traditional Kecak fire dance at sunset, a hypnotic performance with chanting and fire, set against the ocean • In the evening, get together for a farewell meetup, one last night with the crew Overnight stay at Seminyak

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description:
Sampai Jumpa, Bali
• One last breakfast together • A closing circle to talk about the week properly, with the best moments, funniest memories and new friendships • Check out, with airport transfers timed to your flights • Leave with sun-kissed memories, sandy feet and a new travel crew!

itinerary.title: Arrival
itinerary.description:
Konnichiwa, Tokyo! – Arrival & Pub Crawl
• Arrive at Narita International Airport. A group pickup is arranged, so there’s no need to figure out Tokyo’s trains on day one • Get your first glimpse of Tokyo’s skyline on the drive into the city • Check in at the hotel, settle into your rooms and freshen up after the journey • In the evening, meet your fellow travellers and kick things off on a social note • Head out on a Tokyo Pub Crawl through the city’s lively bar scene, with buzzing drinking spots, music and Tokyo’s after-dark energy •Break the ice, make new friends and get a perfect first taste of Tokyo nightlife • One-way transfer arranged for the pub crawl; make your own way back to the hotel afterwards Overnight Stay at Tokyo

itinerary.title: Temples, Towers & Digital Art
itinerary.description:
• After breakfast, explore Tokyo’s mix of old traditions and futuristic city life • Visit Asakusa and the iconic Sensō-ji Temple, Tokyo’s oldest temple, with its giant red lantern at the Kaminarimon Gate
• Stroll down Nakamise Shopping Street, lined with traditional snacks, souvenirs and local crafts • Take in panoramic city views from the observation deck of Tokyo Skytree, Japan’s tallest tower • Experience the controlled chaos of Shibuya Crossing, one of the world’s busiest pedestrian crossings • Step into teamLab Planets Borderless, an immersive digital art museum.
• Spot cherry blossoms along the way (season and bloom conditions permitting)
Overnight Stay at Tokyo

itinerary.title: Tokyo DisneySea & Shinjuku After Dark
itinerary.description:
• After breakfast, spend a full day at Tokyo DisneySea, a Disney theme park found only in Japan
• Discover the magic of Fantasy Springs, go on adventures at Mysterious Island and wander the Mediterranean Harbor
• Ride the park’s most iconic attractions and meet your favourite Disney characters • Try themed food and snacks, and take plenty of photos in its beautifully designed lands • In the evening, head to Shinjuku, Tokyo’s neon-lit entertainment district:
Godzilla Head: spot the giant Godzilla looming over the streets of Kabukicho
3D Cat Billboard: catch the famous giant cat that seems to leap out of a huge digital screen Neon streets: walk among towering billboards, colourful lights and buzzing entertainment spots Overnight Stay at Tokyo

itinerary.title: Mount Fuji & Hakone Day Trip
itinerary.description:
• After breakfast, set off on a private transfer for a scenic day trip • Visit Mount Fuji’s 5th Station for up-close views of Japan’s most famous mountain (subject to weather and road conditions)
• Explore Oshino Hakkai, a charming village of crystal-clear spring-fed ponds with Fuji in the background • Discover Owakudani Valley in Hakone, a volcanic landscape of steaming vents and sulphur fumes, famous for its black eggs • Enjoy breathtaking views of Mount Fuji all day, and cherry blossoms if the timing is right • Return to Tokyo in the evening Overnight Stay at Tokyo

itinerary.title: Bullet Train to Kyoto
itinerary.description:
• After breakfast, board Japan’s iconic Shinkansen (bullet train) from Tokyo to Kyoto, speeding through the Japanese countryside at up to 300 km/h
• Check in at the hotel in Kyoto
• Explore Nishiki Market, known as “Kyoto’s Kitchen”, and try local delicacies like fresh sushi, tamagoyaki, matcha sweets and grilled seafood skewers • Go on a walking tour of Gion, Kyoto’s historic geisha district, full of traditional wooden teahouses, lantern-lit lanes and old-world charm • During sakura season, see cherry blossoms framing Kyoto’s timeless streets Overnight Stay at Kyoto

itinerary.title: Kyoto & Nara – Japan’s Cultural Heart
itinerary.description:
• After breakfast, set off on a full day of Japan’s most iconic landmarks • Walk through Arashiyama Bamboo Forest, where towering bamboo stalks create a surreal, peaceful trail • Visit Kinkaku-ji (the Golden Pavilion), a Zen temple covered in gold leaf and reflected in a mirror-like pond • See Kiyomizu-dera Temple, with its famous wooden terrace and panoramic views over Kyoto
• Walk through the thousands of red torii gates winding up the hillside at Fushimi Inari Taisha
• Head to Nara Deer Park to walk among hundreds of freely roaming, bowing deer • Visit Tōdai-ji Temple, home to one of Japan’s largest bronze Buddha statues • In the evening, explore Kyoto’s atmospheric alleyways, tucked-away bars and Japanese whisky bars 🥃
Overnight Stay at Kyoto

itinerary.title: Osaka – Castles, Daruma & Dotonbori
itinerary.description:
• After breakfast, check out and take a private transfer to Osaka, Japan’s food and entertainment capital • Visit Osaka Castle, one of Japan’s most famous landmarks, ringed by gardens, moats and huge stone walls • Discover Katsuo-ji Temple, the “Temple of Victory”, covered in thousands of red Daruma dolls left by visitors wishing for success • Take in sweeping views from the open-air Floating Garden Observatory at the Umeda Sky Building
• Shop along Shinsaibashi, Osaka’s busiest shopping street • End the day in Dotonbori, with giant neon signs, canal-side buzz and endless street food: takoyaki, okonomiyaki and more • Don’t miss a photo with the iconic Glico Running Man sign! 🏃
• Free time to eat, shop and soak in Osaka’s energy Overnight Stay at Osaka

itinerary.title: Osaka Free Day, Karaoke & Arcades
itinerary.description:
• After breakfast, enjoy a free day to explore Osaka at your own pace • Go shopping, wander local neighbourhoods, hunt down hidden cafés or eat your way through Osaka’s street food • In the evening, get together for a Japanese karaoke night: grab the mic, sing your favourites and let loose with the group • Then hit Japan’s famous gaming arcades: claw machines, racing simulators, rhythm games and all kinds of quirky experiences • A relaxed day and a lively evening, the perfect last full day in Japan
Overnight Stay at Osaka

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description:
Sayonara, Japan
• Enjoy a final breakfast and check out • Group transfer to Kansai International Airport (KIX) for your onward flight • Take home unforgettable memories, new friendships and countless stories from Japan!
